import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math';

import 'package:photo_manager/photo_manager.dart';
import 'package:video_thumbnail/video_thumbnail.dart';

import 'local_cache.dart';
import 'offline_media_cache.dart';

import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

/// Supabase data boundary for Twice. UI widgets should call this repository
/// rather than issuing database requests directly.
class SocialRepository {
  SocialRepository._();
  static final SocialRepository instance = SocialRepository._();
  SupabaseClient get _db => Supabase.instance.client;
  String get userId => _db.auth.currentUser!.id;
  LocalCache get _cache => LocalCache.instance;

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> cachedFeed() async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return [];
    final value = await _cache.get(uid, 'feed');
    if (value is! List) return [];
    return value.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList();
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> cachedMyProfile() async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return null;
    final value = await _cache.get(uid, 'profile');
    return value is Map ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(value) : null;
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _resolveProfileAvatar(
    Map<String, dynamic> row,
  ) async {
    final path = (row['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    row['avatar_object_path'] = path.startsWith('http') ? '' : path;
    if (path.isEmpty || path.startsWith('http')) return row;
    try {
      final local = await OfflineMediaCache.instance.existingUri(
        'post-media',
        path,
      );
      if (local != null) {
        row['avatar_url'] = local;
      } else {
        final signed = await _db.storage
            .from('post-media')
            .createSignedUrl(path, 3600);
        row['avatar_url'] = signed;
        unawaited(
          _warmAvatarCache(row, path, signed).catchError((Object _) {}),
        );
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Keep the stored path if storage cannot resolve it.
    }
    return row;
  }

  // FBFIX: only download once. The next feed load finds the file through
  // OfflineMediaCache.existingUri(); rewriting the whole feed JSON per avatar
  // caused UI lag.
  Future<void> _warmAvatarCache(
    Map<String, dynamic> profile,
    String objectPath,
    String signedUrl,
  ) async {
    await OfflineMediaCache.instance.cacheFromUrl(
      bucket: 'post-media',
      objectPath: objectPath,
      signedUrl: signedUrl,
      isVideo: false,
    );
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> ensureProfile() async {
    final user = _db.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) throw AuthException('Please sign in again.');
    final existing = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select()
        .eq('id', user.id)
        .maybeSingle();
    final meta = user.userMetadata ?? const <String, dynamic>{};
    if (existing != null) {
      final row = Map<String, dynamic>.from(existing);
      final currentName = (row['display_name'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      final metadataName = (meta['name'] ?? meta['full_name'] ?? '')
          .toString()
          .trim();
      if (currentName.isEmpty && metadataName.isNotEmpty) {
        await _db
            .from('profiles')
            .update({'display_name': metadataName})
            .eq('id', user.id);
        row['display_name'] = metadataName;
      }
      return await _resolveProfileAvatar(row);
    }
    final baseRaw = _slug(
      (meta['name'] ??
              meta['full_name'] ??
              user.email?.split('@').first ??
              'twice_user')
          .toString(),
    );
    final base = baseRaw.length > 20 ? baseRaw.substring(0, 20) : baseRaw;
    var username = base.isEmpty ? 'twice_user' : base;
    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      final found = await _db
          .from('profiles')
          .select('id')
          .eq('username', username)
          .maybeSingle();
      if (found == null) break;
      username =
          '${base.isEmpty ? 'twice_user' : base}_${user.id.substring(0, 4 + i)}';
    }
    final display = (meta['name'] ?? meta['full_name'] ?? username)
        .toString()
        .trim();
    await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .upsert(
          {
            'id': user.id,
            'username': username,
            'display_name': display.isEmpty ? username : display,
          },
          onConflict: 'id',
          ignoreDuplicates: true,
        );
    final result = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select()
        .eq('id', user.id)
        .single();
    return await _resolveProfileAvatar(Map<String, dynamic>.from(result));
  }

  String _slug(String value) {
    final cleaned = value
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9_]'), '_')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'_+'), '_')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'^_|_$'), '');
    return cleaned.length > 24 ? cleaned.substring(0, 24) : cleaned;
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> myProfile() async {
    await ensureProfile();
    final row = await _db.from('profiles').select().eq('id', userId).single();
    final resolved = await _resolveProfileAvatar(
      Map<String, dynamic>.from(row),
    );
    await _cache.put(userId, 'profile', resolved);
    return resolved;
  }

  Future<void> updateProfile({
    required String displayName,
    required String username,
    required String bio,
    AssetEntity? avatarAsset,
  }) async {
    final clean = username.trim().replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^@'), '').toLowerCase();
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9_]{3,30}$').hasMatch(clean)) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Username must be 3–30 characters using letters, numbers, or underscores.',
      );
    }

    final values = <String, dynamic>{
      'display_name': displayName.trim(),
      'username': clean,
      'bio': bio.trim(),
    };

    if (avatarAsset != null) {
      final file = await avatarAsset.file;
      if (file == null) {
        throw Exception('Could not read the selected profile photo.');
      }
      final ext = file.path.split('.').last.toLowerCase();
      final objectPath =
          '$userId/avatar_${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}.$ext';

      await _db.storage
          .from('post-media')
          .upload(
            objectPath,
            file,
            fileOptions: FileOptions(contentType: _mime(ext), upsert: false),
          );

      // Store the storage path, not an expiring signed URL.
      values['avatar_url'] = objectPath;
      try {
        await _db.from('profiles').update(values).eq('id', userId);
      } catch (_) {
        try {
          await _db.storage.from('post-media').remove([objectPath]);
        } catch (_) {}
        rethrow;
      }
    } else {
      await _db.from('profiles').update(values).eq('id', userId);
    }
    try {
      await _cache.put(userId, 'profile', await myProfile());
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> feed({
    int limit = 30,
    int offset = 0,
  }) async {
    await ensureProfile();
    final rows = await _db
        .from('posts')
        .select(
          'id,user_id,caption,visibility,comments_enabled,created_at,profiles!posts_user_id_fkey(id,username,display_name,avatar_url),post_media(id,media_url,thumbnail_url,media_type,position),post_likes(user_id),saved_posts(user_id)',
        )
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
    final resolved = await Future.wait<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      (rows as List).map((raw) async {
        final post = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map);
        final authorRaw = post['profiles'];

        // Resolve the avatar and media independently to reduce feed latency.
        final avatarFuture = authorRaw is Map
            ? _resolveProfileAvatar(Map<String, dynamic>.from(authorRaw))
            : Future<Map<String, dynamic>?>.value(null);
        final mediaFuture = _resolveMedia(
          post['post_media'] as List? ?? const [],
          'post-media',
        );
        final values = await Future.wait<dynamic>([avatarFuture, mediaFuture]);

        if (values[0] is Map<String, dynamic>) {
          post['profiles'] = values[0];
        }
        post['media_resolved'] = values[1] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
        return post;
      }),
    );
    await _cache.put(userId, 'feed', resolved);
    // Do not block first paint on media downloads. Successfully downloaded
    // media paths are persisted into this feed cache for the next offline launch.
    unawaited(_warmFeedMediaCache(resolved).catchError((Object _) {}));
    return resolved;
  }

  // FBFIX: lightweight, bounded prefetch of photos + thumbnails (3 at a time).
  // Videos stream and are cached by the player when watched.
  Future<void> _warmFeedMediaCache(List<Map<String, dynamic>> feedRows) async {
    final jobs = <Future<void> Function()>[];
    Future<void> add(String path, String url, bool video) async {
      if (path.isEmpty || url.isEmpty || url.startsWith('file://')) return;
      await OfflineMediaCache.instance.cacheFromUrl(
        bucket: 'post-media',
        objectPath: path,
        signedUrl: url,
        isVideo: video,
      );
    }

    for (final post in feedRows.take(40)) {
      for (final raw in (post['media_resolved'] as List? ?? const [])) {
        if (raw is! Map) continue;
        final type = (raw['media_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
        final path = (raw['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        final url = (raw['resolved_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        final thumbPath = (raw['thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        final thumbUrl = (raw['resolved_thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        jobs.add(() => add(thumbPath, thumbUrl, false));
        if (type != 'video') jobs.add(() => add(path, url, false));
      }
    }
    var next = 0;
    Future<void> worker() async {
      while (next < jobs.length) {
        final job = jobs[next++];
        try {
          await job();
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }

    await Future.wait(List.generate(3, (_) => worker()));
  }

  /// Refreshes a storage object's URL, preferring a complete offline copy.
  /// Returns null when the object cannot be resolved.
  Future<String?> refreshMediaUrl(
    String objectPath, {
    String bucket = 'post-media',
  }) async {
    final path = objectPath.trim();
    if (path.isEmpty) return null;
    if (path.startsWith('http://') || path.startsWith('https://')) {
      return path;
    }

    try {
      final local = await OfflineMediaCache.instance.existingUri(bucket, path);
      if (local != null) return local;
      return await _db.storage.from(bucket).createSignedUrl(path, 3600);
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _resolveMedia(
    List rows,
    String bucket,
  ) async {
    return Future.wait<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      rows.map((raw) async {
        final item = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map);
        final path = (item['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        final thumbnailPath = (item['thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();

        // Resolve the main media and thumbnail concurrently.
        final urls = await Future.wait<String>([
          _resolveOneMediaUrl(path, bucket),
          _resolveOneMediaUrl(thumbnailPath, bucket),
        ]);
        item['resolved_url'] = urls[0];
        item['resolved_thumbnail_url'] = urls[1];
        return item;
      }),
    );
  }

  Future<String> _resolveOneMediaUrl(String path, String bucket) async {
    if (path.isEmpty) return '';
    if (path.startsWith('http://') || path.startsWith('https://')) {
      return path;
    }

    try {
      final local = await OfflineMediaCache.instance.existingUri(bucket, path);
      if (local != null) return local;
      return await _db.storage.from(bucket).createSignedUrl(path, 3600);
    } catch (_) {
      return '';
    }
  }

  bool _looksLikeNetworkFailure(Object error) {
    final text = error.toString().toLowerCase();
    return text.contains('socketexception') ||
        text.contains('failed host lookup') ||
        text.contains('clientexception') ||
        text.contains('connection reset') ||
        text.contains('connection refused') ||
        text.contains('connection aborted') ||
        text.contains('connection closed') ||
        text.contains('connection terminated') ||
        text.contains('network is unreachable') ||
        text.contains('no address associated with hostname') ||
        text.contains('handshakeexception') ||
        text.contains('broken pipe') ||
        text.contains('socket is not connected') ||
        text.contains('software caused connection abort') ||
        text.contains('timed out') ||
        text.contains('timeout');
  }

  Future<void> _applyLikeState(String postId, bool liked) async {
    if (liked) {
      await _db
          .from('post_likes')
          .upsert(
            {'post_id': postId, 'user_id': userId},
            onConflict: 'post_id,user_id',
            ignoreDuplicates: true,
          );
    } else {
      await _db
          .from('post_likes')
          .delete()
          .eq('post_id', postId)
          .eq('user_id', userId);
    }
  }

  /// Applies the requested state, queueing only likely connectivity failures.
  /// The payload is a desired state, not a toggle, so retries are idempotent.
  Future<void> setLikeState(String postId, bool liked) async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) throw AuthException('Please sign in again.');

    try {
      await _applyLikeState(postId, liked);
      final pending = await _cache.pending(uid);
      for (final item in pending) {
        if (item['operation'] == 'set_like' &&
            item['payload'] is Map &&
            item['payload']['post_id'] == postId) {
          await _cache.removePending(item['id'].toString());
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!_looksLikeNetworkFailure(error)) rethrow;
      await _cache.enqueue(uid, 'set_like', {
        'post_id': postId,
        'liked': liked,
      });
    }
    await _updateCachedLike(postId, liked);
  }

  /// Kept for existing callers: currentlyLiked is the state before the tap.
  Future<void> toggleLike(String postId, bool currentlyLiked) async {
    await setLikeState(postId, !currentlyLiked);
  }

  Future<void> _updateCachedLike(String postId, bool liked) async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;
    final cached = await _cache.get(uid, 'feed');
    if (cached is! List) return;

    final updated = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (final raw in cached) {
      if (raw is! Map) continue;
      final post = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);
      if (post['id']?.toString() == postId) {
        final likes = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
          (post['post_likes'] as List? ?? const []).whereType<Map>().map(
            (row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row),
          ),
        );
        likes.removeWhere((row) => row['user_id']?.toString() == uid);
        if (liked) likes.add({'user_id': uid});
        post['post_likes'] = likes;
      }
      updated.add(post);
    }
    await _cache.put(uid, 'feed', updated);
  }

  /// Replays queued likes and comments for the signed-in account.
  Future<void> syncPendingLikes() async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;

    final pending = await _cache.pending(uid);
    for (final item in pending) {
      if (item['operation'] != 'set_like' &&
          item['operation'] != 'add_comment') {
        continue;
      }
      try {
        final payload = Map<String, dynamic>.from(item['payload'] as Map);
        if (item['operation'] == 'add_comment') {
          await _db
              .from('comments')
              .upsert(payload, onConflict: 'id', ignoreDuplicates: true)
              .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
          await _cache.removePending(item['id'].toString());
          continue;
        }
        final postId = payload['post_id']?.toString();
        if (postId == null || postId.isEmpty) {
          await _cache.removePending(item['id'].toString());
          continue;
        }
        final liked = payload['liked'] == true;
        await _applyLikeState(postId, liked);
        await _updateCachedLike(postId, liked);
        await _cache.removePending(item['id'].toString());
      } catch (error) {
        await _cache.markFailed(item['id'].toString(), error);
        if (_looksLikeNetworkFailure(error)) break;
        // A permanent policy/schema error should not block unrelated queued
        // operations. Keep the row for diagnostics and continue with the next.
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> toggleSaved(String postId, bool saved) async {
    if (saved) {
      await _db
          .from('saved_posts')
          .delete()
          .eq('post_id', postId)
          .eq('user_id', userId);
    } else {
      await _db
          .from('saved_posts')
          .upsert(
            {'post_id': postId, 'user_id': userId},
            onConflict: 'user_id,post_id',
            ignoreDuplicates: true,
          );
    }
  }

  Future<String> publishPost(
    String caption,
    List<AssetEntity> assets, {
    String visibility = 'public',
  }) async {
    final text = caption.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty && assets.isEmpty) {
      throw const FormatException('Add a caption or select media.');
    }
    final created = await _db
        .from('posts')
        .insert({'user_id': userId, 'caption': text, 'visibility': visibility})
        .select('id')
        .single();
    final postId = created['id'].toString();
    final uploadedPaths = <String>[];
    try {
      var position = 0;
      for (final asset in assets) {
        final file = await asset.file;
        if (file == null) continue;
        final ext = file.path.split('.').last.toLowerCase();
        final type = asset.type == AssetType.video
            ? 'video'
            : (ext == 'gif' ? 'gif' : 'image');
        final objectPath =
            '$userId/$postId/${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}_$position.$ext';
        await _db.storage
            .from('post-media')
            .upload(
              objectPath,
              file,
              fileOptions: FileOptions(contentType: _mime(ext), upsert: false),
            );
        uploadedPaths.add(objectPath);

        String? thumbnailPath;
        if (type == 'video') {
          try {
            final bytes = await VideoThumbnail.thumbnailData(
              video: file.path,
              imageFormat: ImageFormat.JPEG,
              maxWidth: 720,
              quality: 78,
            );
            if (bytes != null && bytes.isNotEmpty) {
              final candidate =
                  '$userId/$postId/${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}_${position}_thumb.jpg';
              await _db.storage
                  .from('post-media')
                  .uploadBinary(
                    candidate,
                    bytes,
                    fileOptions: const FileOptions(
                      contentType: 'image/jpeg',
                      upsert: false,
                    ),
                  );
              uploadedPaths.add(candidate);
              thumbnailPath = candidate;
            }
          } catch (_) {
            // Thumbnail extraction is optional; preserve the video upload.
          }
        }

        await _db.from('post_media').insert({
          'post_id': postId,
          'media_url': objectPath,
          'thumbnail_url': thumbnailPath,
          'media_type': type,
          'position': position,
        });
        position++;
      }
      return postId;
    } catch (_) {
      // Avoid leaving a half-created post or orphaned storage objects.
      if (uploadedPaths.isNotEmpty) {
        try {
          await _db.storage.from('post-media').remove(uploadedPaths);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      await _db.from('posts').delete().eq('id', postId);
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> loadStories() async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('stories')
        .select('id,user_id,media_url,media_type,caption,created_at,expires_at')
        .gt('expires_at', DateTime.now().toUtc().toIso8601String())
        .order('created_at', ascending: true);

    final stories = (rows as List)
        .map((row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row as Map))
        .toList();

    if (stories.isEmpty) return stories;

    final ids = stories
        .map((story) => story['user_id'].toString())
        .toSet()
        .toList();

    final profiles = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id,username,display_name,avatar_url')
        .inFilter('id', ids);

    final byId = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
    for (final raw in profiles as List) {
      final profile = await _resolveProfileAvatar(
        Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map),
      );
      byId[profile['id'].toString()] = profile;
    }

    for (final story in stories) {
      story['profiles'] = byId[story['user_id'].toString()] ?? {};
      final path = (story['media_url'] ?? '').toString();
      try {
        story['resolved_url'] = path.startsWith('http')
            ? path
            : await _db.storage.from('stories').createSignedUrl(path, 3600);
      } catch (_) {
        story['resolved_url'] = '';
      }
    }

    return stories;
  }

  Future<void> publishStory(AssetEntity asset, String caption) async {
    final file = await asset.file;
    if (file == null) {
      throw Exception('Could not read the selected story media.');
    }

    final ext = file.path.split('.').last.toLowerCase();
    final storyId = await _db
        .from('stories')
        .insert({
          'user_id': userId,
          'media_url': 'pending',
          'media_type': asset.type == AssetType.video ? 'video' : 'image',
          'caption': caption.trim(),
        })
        .select('id')
        .single();

    final id = storyId['id'].toString();
    final objectPath =
        '$userId/$id/${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}.$ext';

    try {
      await _db.storage
          .from('stories')
          .upload(
            objectPath,
            file,
            fileOptions: FileOptions(contentType: _mime(ext), upsert: false),
          );

      await _db.from('stories').update({'media_url': objectPath}).eq('id', id);
    } catch (_) {
      try {
        await _db.storage.from('stories').remove([objectPath]);
      } catch (_) {}
      try {
        await _db.from('stories').delete().eq('id', id);
      } catch (_) {}
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  String _mime(String ext) => switch (ext) {
    'jpg' => 'image/jpeg',
    'jpeg' => 'image/jpeg',
    'jpe' => 'image/jpeg',
    'png' => 'image/png',
    'webp' => 'image/webp',
    'gif' => 'image/gif',
    'mp4' => 'video/mp4',
    'm4v' => 'video/x-m4v',
    'mov' => 'video/quicktime',
    'webm' => 'video/webm',
    'mkv' => 'video/x-matroska',
    '3gp' => 'video/3gpp',
    'heic' => 'image/heic',
    'heif' => 'image/heif',
    'avif' => 'image/avif',
    _ => 'application/octet-stream',
  };

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> search(String query) async {
    final q = query.trim();
    if (q.isEmpty) return [];
    final safe = q
        .replaceAll('%', r'\%')
        .replaceAll('_', r'\_')
        .replaceAll(',', ' ')
        .replaceAll('(', ' ')
        .replaceAll(')', ' ');
    final results = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    final byUsername = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id,username,display_name,bio,avatar_url,is_private')
        .ilike('username', '%$safe%')
        .limit(20);
    final byName = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id,username,display_name,bio,avatar_url,is_private')
        .ilike('display_name', '%$safe%')
        .limit(20);
    final usersById = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
    for (final row in [...byUsername, ...byName]) {
      final user = Map<String, dynamic>.from(row as Map);
      usersById[user['id'].toString()] = user;
    }
    results.addAll(usersById.values.map((e) => {...e, 'result_type': 'user'}));
    final posts = await _db
        .from('posts')
        .select(
          'id,user_id,caption,created_at,profiles!posts_user_id_fkey(username,display_name,avatar_url)',
        )
        .ilike('caption', '%$safe%')
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .limit(20);
    results.addAll(
      (posts as List).map(
        (e) => {...Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map), 'result_type': 'post'},
      ),
    );
    return results;
  }

  Future<String> getFollowLabel(String profileId) async {
    if (profileId.isEmpty || profileId == userId) return '';

    final outgoing = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('status')
        .eq('follower_id', userId)
        .eq('following_id', profileId)
        .maybeSingle();

    final incoming = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('status')
        .eq('follower_id', profileId)
        .eq('following_id', userId)
        .maybeSingle();

    final outgoingStatus = (outgoing?['status'] ?? '').toString();
    final incomingStatus = (incoming?['status'] ?? '').toString();

    if (outgoingStatus == 'pending') return 'Requested';
    final followsMe = incomingStatus == 'accepted';
    final iFollow = outgoingStatus == 'accepted';

    if (iFollow && followsMe) return 'Connected';
    if (iFollow) return 'Following';
    if (followsMe) return 'Follow Back';
    return 'Follow';
  }

  Future<bool> isFollowing(String profileId) async =>
      await _db
          .from('follows')
          .select('follower_id')
          .eq('follower_id', userId)
          .eq('following_id', profileId)
          .eq('status', 'accepted')
          .maybeSingle() !=
      null;

  Future<bool> isConnected(String profileId) async {
    final outgoing = await isFollowing(profileId);
    if (!outgoing) return false;
    final incoming = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('follower_id')
        .eq('follower_id', profileId)
        .eq('following_id', userId)
        .eq('status', 'accepted')
        .maybeSingle();
    return incoming != null;
  }

  Future<bool> isPrivateAccount(String profileId) async {
    final row = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('is_private')
        .eq('id', profileId)
        .maybeSingle();
    return row?['is_private'] == true;
  }

  Future<void> follow(String profileId, {required bool privateAccount}) async {
    if (profileId == userId) {
      throw ArgumentError('You cannot follow your own account.');
    }

    final existing = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('follower_id')
        .eq('follower_id', userId)
        .eq('following_id', profileId)
        .maybeSingle();

    if (existing != null) return;

    try {
      await _db.from('follows').insert({
        'follower_id': userId,
        'following_id': profileId,
        'status': privateAccount ? 'pending' : 'accepted',
      });
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      // A concurrent tap may have created the same relationship already.
      if (e.code == '23505') return;
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> unfollow(String profileId) async {
    await _db
        .from('follows')
        .delete()
        .eq('follower_id', userId)
        .eq('following_id', profileId);
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> followProfiles({
    required String profileId,
    required bool followers,
  }) async {
    final relationshipColumn = followers ? 'following_id' : 'follower_id';
    final resultColumn = followers ? 'follower_id' : 'following_id';

    final relations = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select(resultColumn)
        .eq(relationshipColumn, profileId)
        .eq('status', 'accepted');

    final ids = (relations as List)
        .map((row) => (row[resultColumn] ?? '').toString())
        .where((id) => id.isNotEmpty)
        .toSet()
        .toList();

    if (ids.isEmpty) return [];

    final rows = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id,display_name,username,avatar_url,is_private')
        .inFilter('id', ids)
        .order('display_name');

    final profiles = (rows as List)
        .map((row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row as Map))
        .toList();

    final currentUserId = userId;
    final outgoingRows = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('following_id,status')
        .eq('follower_id', currentUserId)
        .inFilter('following_id', ids);
    final outgoingStatus = <String, String>{};
    for (final row in outgoingRows as List) {
      outgoingStatus[(row['following_id'] ?? '').toString()] =
          (row['status'] ?? '').toString();
    }

    for (final profile in profiles) {
      final id = (profile['id'] ?? '').toString();
      final status = outgoingStatus[id];
      profile['is_following_back'] = status == 'accepted';
      profile['follow_request_pending'] = status == 'pending';
      profile['is_connected'] = id.isNotEmpty ? await isConnected(id) : false;
      profile['is_current_user'] = id == currentUserId;
    }

    return Future.wait(profiles.map(_resolveProfileAvatar));
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> comments(String postId) async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) throw AuthException('Please sign in again.');
    try {
      final rows = await _db
          .from('comments')
          .select(
            'id,post_id,user_id,parent_id,body,created_at,profiles!comments_user_id_fkey(id,username,display_name,avatar_url)',
          )
          .eq('post_id', postId)
          .order('created_at')
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
      final result = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      for (final raw in rows as List) {
        final row = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map);
        final rawProfile = row['profiles'];
        if (rawProfile is Map) {
          final profile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawProfile);
          if (profile.isNotEmpty) {
            row['profiles'] = await _resolveProfileAvatar(profile);
          }
        } else if (rawProfile is List && rawProfile.isNotEmpty) {
          final profile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawProfile.first as Map);
          row['profiles'] = await _resolveProfileAvatar(profile);
        }
        result.add(row);
      }
      await _cache.put(uid, 'comments', result, id: postId);
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      if (_looksLikeNetworkFailure(error)) {
        return cachedComments(postId);
      }
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> cachedComments(String postId) async {
    final value = await _cache.get(userId, 'comments', id: postId);
    if (value is! List) return [];
    return value.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList();
  }

  String _newCommentId() {
    final random = Random.secure();
    final bytes = List<int>.generate(16, (_) => random.nextInt(256));
    bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
    bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
    final hex = bytes.map((b) => b.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0')).join();
    return '${hex.substring(0, 8)}-${hex.substring(8, 12)}-'
        '${hex.substring(12, 16)}-${hex.substring(16, 20)}-${hex.substring(20)}';
  }

  /// Returns true when confirmed by Supabase; false when safely queued offline.
  Future<bool> addComment(
    String postId,
    String body, {
    String? commentId,
  }) async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) throw AuthException('Please sign in again.');
    final text = body.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return true;
    final id = commentId ?? _newCommentId();

    // Use the cached profile for immediate/offline comments. If the profile
    // has not been cached yet, fall back to available auth metadata.
    final cachedProfile = await _cache.get(uid, 'profile');
    final user = _db.auth.currentUser!;
    final metadata = user.userMetadata ?? const <String, dynamic>{};
    final authorProfile = cachedProfile is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(cachedProfile)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    authorProfile['id'] ??= uid;
    authorProfile['username'] ??=
        (metadata['username'] ?? user.email?.split('@').first ?? 'user')
            .toString();
    authorProfile['display_name'] ??=
        (metadata['display_name'] ??
                metadata['name'] ??
                metadata['full_name'] ??
                authorProfile['username'])
            .toString();

    final payload = <String, dynamic>{
      'id': id,
      'post_id': postId,
      'user_id': uid,
      'body': text,
    };
    try {
      await _db
          .from('comments')
          .insert(payload)
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
      final pending = await _cache.pending(uid);
      for (final item in pending) {
        if (item['operation'] == 'add_comment' &&
            item['payload'] is Map &&
            item['payload']['id'] == id) {
          await _cache.removePending(item['id'].toString());
        }
      }
      final cached = await _cache.get(uid, 'comments', id: postId);
      final rows = cached is List
          ? cached.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList()
          : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      if (!rows.any((row) => row['id']?.toString() == id)) {
        rows.add({
          ...payload,
          'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
          'profiles': authorProfile,
        });
        await _cache.put(uid, 'comments', rows, id: postId);
      }
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      if (!_looksLikeNetworkFailure(error)) rethrow;
      await _cache.enqueue(uid, 'add_comment', payload);
      final cached = await _cache.get(uid, 'comments', id: postId);
      final rows = cached is List
          ? cached.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList()
          : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      if (!rows.any((row) => row['id']?.toString() == id)) {
        rows.add({
          ...payload,
          'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
          'profiles': authorProfile,
          '_queued': true,
        });
        await _cache.put(uid, 'comments', rows, id: postId);
      }
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> notifications() async {

  Future<int> count(String table, String column, String value) async {
    final rows = await _db.from(table).select(column).eq(column, value);
    return (rows as List).length;
  }

  Future<String> createConversation(String otherUserId) async {
    final session = _db.auth.currentSession;
    if (session == null) {
      throw AuthException('Your session has expired. Please sign in again.');
    }

    // Validate the active access token with Supabase before writing.
    final verified = await _db.auth.getUser();
    final verifiedUser = verified.user;
    if (verifiedUser == null) {
      throw AuthException(
        'Could not verify your account. Please sign in again.',
      );
    }
    final uid = verifiedUser.id;

    if (uid != session.user.id) {
      throw AuthException(
        'Authentication identity mismatch. Please sign out and sign in again.',
      );
    }

    if (otherUserId == uid) {
      throw const FormatException('You cannot message yourself.');
    }

    final existing = await _db
        .from('conversation_members')
        .select('conversation_id')
        .eq('user_id', uid);

    for (final row in (existing as List)) {
      final id = row['conversation_id'].toString();
      final other = await _db
          .from('conversation_members')
          .select('user_id')
          .eq('conversation_id', id)
          .eq('user_id', otherUserId)
          .maybeSingle();
      if (other != null) return id;
    }

    final created = await _db
        .from('conversations')
        .insert({'created_by': uid, 'is_group': false})
        .select('id')
        .single();

    final id = created['id'].toString();

    await _db.from('conversation_members').insert([
      {'conversation_id': id, 'user_id': uid},
      {'conversation_id': id, 'user_id': otherUserId},
    ]);

    return id;
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> conversations() async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('conversation_members')
        .select(
          'conversation_id,last_read_at,conversations(id,title,is_group,created_at)',
        )
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .order('joined_at', ascending: false);
    return (rows as List)
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
        .toList();
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> messages(String conversationId) async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('messages')
        .select(
          'id,conversation_id,sender_id,body,media_url,media_type,created_at',
        )
        .eq('conversation_id', conversationId)
        .isFilter('deleted_at', null)
        .order('created_at')
        .limit(200);
    return (rows as List)
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
        .toList();
  }

  Future<void> sendMessage(String conversationId, String body) async {
    if (body.trim().isEmpty) return;
    await _db.from('messages').insert({
      'conversation_id': conversationId,
      'sender_id': userId,
      'body': body.trim(),
    });
  }
}

ImageProvider<Object> _twiceImageProvider(String source) {
  final value = source.trim();
  if (value.startsWith('file://')) {
    return FileImage(File.fromUri(Uri.parse(value)));
  }
  if (value.startsWith('/')) return FileImage(File(value));
  return NetworkImage(value);
}

String _newTwiceUuid() {
  final random = Random.secure();
  final bytes = List<int>.generate(16, (_) => random.nextInt(256));
  bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
  bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
  final hex = bytes.map((b) => b.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0')).join();
  return '${hex.substring(0, 8)}-${hex.substring(8, 12)}-'
      '${hex.substring(12, 16)}-${hex.substring(16, 20)}-${hex.substring(20)}';
}

const supabaseUrl = String.fromEnvironment('SUPABASE_URL');
const supabasePublishableKey= [REDACTED]
  'SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY',
);

bool get supabaseConfigured =>
    supabaseUrl.startsWith('https://') && supabasePublishableKey.isNotEmpty;

// True only after Supabase has initialized successfully. If configuration is
// missing or initialization fails, the app still starts and shows its setup
// screen instead of remaining on Android's Flutter splash screen.
bool supabaseReady = false;
String? supabaseStartupError;

Future<void> main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  // Never let a bad/missing Supabase configuration prevent Flutter from
  // drawing the first frame indefinitely.
  if (!supabaseConfigured) {
    final missing = <String>[
      if (!supabaseUrl.startsWith('https://')) 'SUPABASE_URL',
      if (supabasePublishableKey.isEmpty) 'SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY',
    ];
    supabaseStartupError =
        'Missing or invalid build configuration: ${missing.join(', ')}. '
        'Check GitHub Repository secrets and rebuild the APK.';
  } else {
    try {
      await Supabase.initialize(
        url: supabaseUrl,
        publishableKey: [REDACTED],
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12));
      supabaseReady = true;
    } catch (error, stackTrace) {
      // Keep startup alive; the auth gate will show the configuration screen.
      debugPrint('Twice Supabase startup failed: $error');
      debugPrintStack(stackTrace: stackTrace);
      supabaseReady = false;
      final details = error
          .toString()
          .replaceAll(supabaseUrl, '[Supabase URL hidden]')
          .replaceAll(supabasePublishableKey, '[key hidden]');
      supabaseStartupError =
          'Supabase initialization failed (${error.runtimeType}): $details';
    }
  }

  runApp(const TwiceApp());
}

class NativeCore {
  NativeCore._() {
    try {
      final lib = DynamicLibrary.open('libtwice_native.so');
      _add = lib
          .lookupFunction<Int32 Function(Int32, Int32), int Function(int, int)>(
            'twice_native_add',
          );
    } catch (_) {
      // Keeps Flutter tests and non-Android preview environments usable.
      _add = null;
    }
  }

  static final NativeCore instance = NativeCore._();

  late final int Function(int, int)? _add;

  int add(int a, int b) => _add?.call(a, b) ?? a + b;

  bool get isLoaded => _add != null;
}

class TwiceApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const TwiceApp({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      title: 'Twice',
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
      theme: ThemeData(
        useMaterial3: true,
        scaffoldBackgroundColor: canvas,
        colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(
          seedColor: violet,
          brightness: Brightness.light,
        ),
        fontFamily: 'Roboto',
        textTheme: ThemeData.light().textTheme.apply(fontFamily: 'Roboto'),
        primaryTextTheme: ThemeData.light().primaryTextTheme.apply(
          fontFamily: 'Roboto',
        ),
        appBarTheme: const AppBarTheme(
          backgroundColor: canvas,
          foregroundColor: ink,
          elevation: 0,
          centerTitle: false,
        ),
      ),
      home: const TwiceAuthGate(),
    );
  }
}

class TwiceAuthGate extends StatelessWidget {
  const TwiceAuthGate({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!supabaseReady) {
      return TwiceSignInPage(
        configurationMissing: true,
        startupError: supabaseStartupError,
      );
    }

    return StreamBuilder<AuthState>(
      stream: Supabase.instance.client.auth.onAuthStateChange,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        final session = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentSession;
        if (session != null) return const TwiceShell();
        return const TwiceSignInPage();
      },
    );
  }
}

      decoration: BoxDecoration(

        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFFFCACA)),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      ),
      child: SelectableText(
        message,
        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
        style: const TextStyle(
          color: Color(0xFFB42318),
          fontSize: 12,
          height: 1.45,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class TwiceSignInPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const TwiceSignInPage({
    super.key,
    this.configurationMissing = false,
    this.startupError,
  });

  final bool configurationMissing;
  final String? startupError;

  @override
  State<TwiceSignInPage> createState() => _TwiceSignInPageState();
}

class _TwiceSignInPageState extends State<TwiceSignInPage> {
  final _emailController = TextEditingController();
  final _codeController = TextEditingController();
  bool _loading = false;
  bool _codeSent = false;
  String? _error;
  String? _message;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _emailController.dispose();
    _codeController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String get _email => _emailController.text.trim().toLowerCase();

  Future<void> _sendCode() async {
    if (widget.configurationMissing || _loading) return;
    if (!_emailController.text.trim().contains('@')) {
      setState(() => _error = 'Enter a valid email address.');
      return;
    }

    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
      _message = null;
    });

    try {
      final localPart = _email.split('@').first;
      final username = localPart
          .toLowerCase()
          .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9_]'), '_')
          .replaceAll(RegExp(r'_+'), '_');
      final safeUsername = username.isEmpty
          ? 'twice_user'
          : username.substring(0, username.length > 24 ? 24 : username.length);

      final response = await Supabase.instance.client.functions.invoke(
        'twice-email-code',
        body: {
          'action': 'send_code',
          'email': _email,
          'username': safeUsername,
          'display_name': localPart,
        },
      );

      final data = response.data;
      if (response.status < 200 ||
          response.status >= 300 ||
          data is! Map ||
          data['ok'] != true) {
        throw Exception(
          data is Map
              ? (data['error'] ?? 'Could not send the verification code.')
              : 'Could not send the verification code.',
        );
      }

      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _codeSent = true;
        _message =
            'If this address can receive mail, a code has been sent. '
            'Check your inbox and spam folder.';
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _error = 'Could not send the code. ${e.toString()}';
      });
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _verifyCode() async {
    if (widget.configurationMissing || _loading) return;
    final code = _codeController.text.trim();
    if (!RegExp(r'^\d{6}$').hasMatch(code)) {
      setState(() => _error = 'Enter the six-digit code from your email.');
      return;
    }

    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
      _message = null;
    });

    try {
      final response = await Supabase.instance.client.functions.invoke(
        'twice-email-code',
        body: {'action': 'verify_code', 'email': _email, 'code': code},
      );

      final data = response.data;
      if (response.status < 200 ||
          response.status >= 300 ||
          data is! Map ||
          data['ok'] != true ||
          data['token_hash'] is! String) {
        throw Exception(
          data is Map
              ? (data['error'] ?? 'The code could not be verified.')
              : 'The code could not be verified.',
        );
      }

      final tokenHash = data['token_hash'] as String;
      await Supabase.instance.client.auth.verifyOTP(
        tokenHash: tokenHash,
        type: OtpType.magiclink,
      );

      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _message = 'Verified! Opening Twice...';
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _error = 'Verification failed. ${e.toString()}';
      });
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: canvas,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, constraints) => SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 28, vertical: 24),
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: BoxConstraints(
                minHeight: constraints.maxHeight - 48,
              ),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  Center(
                    child: Container(
                      width: 76,
                      height: 76,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: violet,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(25),
                      ),
                      alignment: Alignment.center,
                      child: const Text(
                        't.',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          fontSize: 49,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                          height: 1,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 30),
                  const Text(
                    'Welcome to Twice',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: ink,
                      fontSize: 30,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                      letterSpacing: -0.8,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  const Text(
                    'Your people. Your moments. All in one place.',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 15, height: 1.5),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 34),
                  TextField(
                    controller: _emailController,
                    enabled: !_loading && !_codeSent,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
                    textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                    autofillHints: const [AutofillHints.email],
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Email address',
                      hintText: 'you@example.com',
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.email_outlined),
                      filled: true,
                      fillColor: Colors.white,
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFE2E3EA)),
                      ),
                      enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFE2E3EA)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (_codeSent) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    TextField(
                      controller: _codeController,
                      enabled: !_loading,
                      keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                      textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                      autofillHints: const [AutofillHints.oneTimeCode],
                      maxLength: 6,
                      inputFormatters: [
                        FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly,
                        LengthLimitingTextInputFormatter(6),
                      ],
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 25,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                        letterSpacing: 10,
                      ),
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Six-digit email code',
                        hintText: '000000',
                        counterText: '',
                        filled: true,
                        fillColor: Colors.white,
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                  const SizedBox(height: 18),
                  FilledButton(
                    onPressed: _loading || widget.configurationMissing
                        ? null
                        : (_codeSent ? _verifyCode : _sendCode),
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                      minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(56),
                      backgroundColor: violet,
                      foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(17),
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: _loading
                        ? const SizedBox(
                            width: 22,
                            height: 22,
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                              strokeWidth: 2.5,
                              color: Colors.white,
                            ),
                          )
                        : Text(
                            _codeSent
                                ? 'Verify and continue'
                                : 'Send email code',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 15,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                            ),
                          ),
                  ),
                  if (_codeSent) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    TextButton(
                      onPressed: _loading
                          ? null
                          : () {
                              setState(() {
                                _codeSent = false;
                                _codeController.clear();
                                _error = null;
                                _message = null;
                              });
                            },
                      child: const Text('Use a different email address'),
                    ),
                    TextButton(
                      onPressed: _loading ? null : _sendCode,
                      child: const Text('Resend code'),
                    ),
                  ],
                  if (widget.configurationMissing) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 18),
                    _ErrorPanel(
                      message: widget.startupError ?? 'Supabase configuration is missing. Check the GitHub Actions build secrets.',
                    ),
                  ],
                  if (_error != null) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    _ErrorPanel(message: _error!),
                  ],
                  if (_message != null) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    Text(
                      _message!,
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        color: Color(0xFF287A45),
                        fontSize: 13,
                        height: 1.5,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                  const SizedBox(height: 30),
                  const Text(
                    'Secure email verification powered by Supabase.',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 12),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 20),
                  const Text(
                    "By continuing, you agree to Twice's Terms of Service "
                    'and Privacy Policy.',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 11, height: 1.6),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class SocialPost {
  SocialPost(this.data);
  final Map<String, dynamic> data;
  String get id => data['id'].toString();
  String get caption => (data['caption'] ?? '').toString();
  Map<String, dynamic> get author =>
      Map<String, dynamic>.from(data['profiles'] as Map? ?? const {});
  String get name =>
      (author['display_name'] ?? author['username'] ?? 'Twice user').toString();
  String get username => (author['username'] ?? 'user').toString();
  String get handle => '@$username';
  String? get avatarUrl => author['avatar_url']?.toString();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get media =>
      (data['media_resolved'] as List? ?? const [])
          .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
          .toList();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get likesRows =>
      (data['post_likes'] as List? ?? const [])
          .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
          .toList();
  bool get liked => likesRows.any(
    (e) => e['user_id'] == Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id,
  );
  int get likes => likesRows.length;
  bool get saved =>
      ((data['saved_posts'] as List? ?? const []).cast<Map>()).any(
        (e) => e['user_id'] == Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id,
      );
}

class TwiceShell extends StatefulWidget {
  const TwiceShell({super.key});
  @override
  State<TwiceShell> createState() => _TwiceShellState();
}

class _TwiceShellState extends State<TwiceShell> with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  final repo = SocialRepository.instance;
  int selected = 0;
  bool loading = true;
  String? error;
  Map<String, dynamic> profile = {};
  List<SocialPost> posts = [];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> stories = [];
  final GlobalKey<StoryStripState> _storyStripKey =
      GlobalKey<StoryStripState>();

  DateTime? _lastResumeRefresh;
  bool _refreshingOnResume = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    _loadAll();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    if (state != AppLifecycleState.resumed || !mounted) return;

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final previous = _lastResumeRefresh;
    if (previous != null &&
        now.difference(previous) < const Duration(seconds: 15)) {
      return;
    }

    _lastResumeRefresh = now;
    _refreshAfterResume();
  }

  Future<void> _refreshAfterResume() async {
    if (_refreshingOnResume || !mounted) return;
    _refreshingOnResume = true;

    try {
      await repo.syncPendingLikes();
      if (mounted) await _refreshQuietly();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Twice background refresh deferred: $e');
    } finally {
      _refreshingOnResume = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _refreshQuietly() async {
    if (!mounted) return;

    try {
      final values = await Future.wait<dynamic>([
        repo.myProfile(),
        repo.feed(),
        repo.loadStories(),
      ]);
      if (!mounted) return;

      final freshProfile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(values[0] as Map);
      final freshRows = values[1] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
      final freshStories = values[2] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;

      void preserveAvatar(
        Map<String, dynamic> fresh,
        Map<String, dynamic> old,
      ) {
        final freshPath = fresh['avatar_object_path']?.toString() ?? '';
        final oldPath = old['avatar_object_path']?.toString() ?? '';
        if (freshPath.isNotEmpty && freshPath == oldPath) {
          fresh['avatar_url'] = old['avatar_url'];
        }
      }

      preserveAvatar(freshProfile, profile);

      final existingPosts = <String, SocialPost>{
        for (final post in posts) post.id: post,
      };
      final mergedPosts = <SocialPost>[];

      for (final raw in freshRows) {
        final incoming = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);
        final id = (incoming['id'] ?? '').toString();
        final existing = existingPosts[id];

        if (existing != null) {
          final oldData = existing.data;
          final oldAuthor = oldData['profiles'];
          final newAuthor = incoming['profiles'];

          if (oldAuthor is Map && newAuthor is Map) {
            final oldProfile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(oldAuthor);
            final newProfile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(newAuthor);
            preserveAvatar(newProfile, oldProfile);
            incoming['profiles'] = newProfile;
          }

          final oldMedia = oldData['media_resolved'];
          final newMedia = incoming['media_resolved'];

          if (oldMedia is List && newMedia is List) {
            for (final item in newMedia) {
              if (item is! Map) continue;
              final freshMedia = Map<String, dynamic>.from(item);
              final match = oldMedia
                  .whereType<Map>()
                  .where(
                    (old) =>
                        old['id'] == freshMedia['id'] &&
                        old['media_url'] == freshMedia['media_url'],
                  )
                  .firstOrNull;

              if (match != null) {
                // Preserve offline files, never reuse potentially expired
                // signed network URLs from the previous feed snapshot.
                final cachedMediaUrl = (match['resolved_url'] ?? '').toString();
                if (cachedMediaUrl.startsWith('file://')) {
                  freshMedia['resolved_url'] = cachedMediaUrl;
                }

                final cachedThumbnailUrl =
                    (match['resolved_thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString();
                if (match['thumbnail_url'] == freshMedia['thumbnail_url'] &&
                    cachedThumbnailUrl.startsWith('file://')) {
                  freshMedia['resolved_thumbnail_url'] = cachedThumbnailUrl;
                }
              }

              final index = newMedia.indexOf(item);
              newMedia[index] = freshMedia;
            }
          }

          // Keep the SocialPost instance alive for this post ID.
          existing.data
            ..clear()
            ..addAll(incoming);
          mergedPosts.add(existing);
        } else {
          mergedPosts.add(SocialPost(incoming));
        }
      }

      final oldStoriesById = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{
        for (final story in stories) (story['id'] ?? '').toString(): story,
      };
      final mergedStories = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];

      for (final raw in freshStories) {
        final fresh = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);
        final old = oldStoriesById[(fresh['id'] ?? '').toString()];

        if (old != null) {
          if (old['media_url'] == fresh['media_url']) {
            for (final key in ['resolved_url', 'resolved_thumbnail_url']) {
              final cachedUrl = (old[key] ?? '').toString();
              // Keep only local cached files; fresh network URLs must win.
              if (cachedUrl.startsWith('file://')) {
                fresh[key] = cachedUrl;
              }
            }
          }

          final oldAuthor = old['profiles'];
          final newAuthor = fresh['profiles'];
          if (oldAuthor is Map && newAuthor is Map) {
            final author = Map<String, dynamic>.from(newAuthor);
            preserveAvatar(author, Map<String, dynamic>.from(oldAuthor));
            fresh['profiles'] = author;
          }
        }
        mergedStories.add(fresh);
      }

      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        profile = freshProfile;
        posts = mergedPosts;
        stories = mergedStories;
        error = null;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      // A failed background refresh must not blank or interrupt the feed.
      debugPrint('Twice quiet refresh deferred: $e');
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _syncPendingLikes() async {
    try {
      await repo.syncPendingLikes();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Twice pending-like sync deferred: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadAll() async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    _syncPendingLikes(); // Replay in background; show cached content immediately.
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    // Render durable local data first. The network refresh below updates the
    // same UI after the cache has already appeared, avoiding a blank cold start.
    try {
      final cached = await Future.wait<dynamic>([
        repo.cachedMyProfile(),
        repo.cachedFeed(),
      ]);
      if (!mounted) return;
      final cachedProfile = cached[0];
      final cachedPosts = cached[1] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
      if (cachedProfile is Map || cachedPosts.isNotEmpty) {
        setState(() {
          if (cachedProfile is Map) {
            profile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(cachedProfile);
          }
          if (cachedPosts.isNotEmpty) {
            posts = cachedPosts.map(SocialPost.new).toList();
          }
          loading = false;
          error = null;
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {
      /* A first install simply has an empty cache. */
    }
    try {
      final values = await Future.wait<dynamic>([
        repo.myProfile(),
        repo.feed(),
        repo.loadStories().catchError((_) => <Map<String, dynamic>>[]),
      ]);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        profile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(values[0] as Map);
        posts = (values[1] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>)
            .map(SocialPost.new)
            .toList();
        stories = values[2] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
        loading = false;
        error = null;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        loading = false;
        error = posts.isNotEmpty || profile.isNotEmpty
            ? null
            : _friendlyError(e);
      });
    }
  }

  String _friendlyError(Object e) {
    final text = e.toString();
    final lower = text.toLowerCase();
    if (lower.contains('socketexception') ||
        lower.contains('failed host lookup') ||
        lower.contains('clientexception') ||
        lower.contains('connection reset') ||
        lower.contains('connection refused') ||
        lower.contains('connection aborted') ||
        lower.contains('connection closed') ||
        lower.contains('connection terminated') ||
        lower.contains('network is unreachable') ||
        lower.contains('handshakeexception') ||
        lower.contains('broken pipe') ||
        lower.contains('timed out') ||
        lower.contains('timeout')) {
      return 'Unable to reach the server right now. Check your connection and retry.';
    }
    if (text.contains('duplicate key') || text.contains('23505')) {
      return 'That username is already taken. Edit your profile to choose another.';
    }
    return text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
  }

  Future<void> _like(SocialPost post) async {
    final wasLiked = post.liked;
    setState(() {
      final rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
        post.data['post_likes'] as List? ?? [],
      );
      final uid = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser!.id;
      if (wasLiked) {
        rows.removeWhere((e) => e['user_id'] == uid);
      } else {
        rows.add({'user_id': uid});
      }
      post.data['post_likes'] = rows;
    });
    try {
      await repo.toggleLike(post.id, wasLiked);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        final rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
          post.data['post_likes'] as List? ?? [],
        );
        final uid = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
        rows.removeWhere((row) => row['user_id'] == uid);
        if (wasLiked && uid != null) rows.add({'user_id': uid});
        post.data['post_likes'] = rows;
      });
      _message('Like could not sync: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _publish(
    String caption,
    List<AssetEntity> media,
    String visibility,
  ) async {
    try {
      await repo.publishPost(caption, media, visibility: visibility);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => selected = 0);
      await _loadAll();
      if (mounted) _message('Post published.');
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) _message('Could not publish: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  void _openComposer() {
    Navigator.of(context).push<void>(
      PageRouteBuilder<void>(
        transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 380),
        reverseTransitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
        pageBuilder: (_, animation, secondaryAnimation) =>
            CreatePage(onPost: _publish),
        transitionsBuilder: (_, animation, secondaryAnimation, child) {
          final curved = CurvedAnimation(
            parent: animation,
            curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
            reverseCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,
          );
          return FadeTransition(
            opacity: curved,
            child: ScaleTransition(
              scale: Tween<double>(begin: 0.97, end: 1).animate(curved),
              child: child,
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  void _message(String message) =>
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
          .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(message)));

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final title = [
      'Twice',
      'Search',
      'Create',
      'Activity',
      'Profile',
    ][selected];
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: selected == 4
          ? null
          : AppBar(
              title: title == 'Twice'
                  ? ShaderMask(
                      shaderCallback: (bounds) => const LinearGradient(
                        colors: [
                          Color(0xFFFF5FA2),
                          Color(0xFFFF2D75),
                          Color(0xFFD946EF),
                        ],
                      ).createShader(bounds),
                      child: const Text(
                        'Twice',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                          fontSize: 25,
                        ),
                      ),
                    )
                  : Text(
                      title,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                        fontSize: 25,
                      ),
                    ),
              actions: [
                IconButton(
                  tooltip: 'Messages',
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).push(
                    MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                      builder: (_) => const MessagesPage(),
                    ),
                  ),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.send_outlined),
                ),
              ],
            ),
      body: loading && posts.isEmpty && profile.isEmpty
          ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
          : error != null && profile.isEmpty
          ? _ErrorPanel(message: error!)
          : IndexedStack(
              index: selected,
              children: [
                FeedPage(
                  storyStripKey: _storyStripKey,
                  profile: profile,
                  stories: stories,
                  onCreateStory: (asset, caption) async {
                    await repo.publishStory(asset, caption);
                    await _loadAll();
                  },
                  posts: posts,
                  onLike: _like,
                  onRefresh: _loadAll,
                  onOpenComposer: _openComposer,
                  onCommentChanged: () {
                    if (mounted) setState(() {});
                  },
                ),
                const SearchPage(),
                const SizedBox.shrink(),
                const ActivityPage(),
                ProfilePage(
                  profile: profile,
                  posts: posts,
                  onRefresh: _loadAll,
                ),
              ],
            ),
      bottomNavigationBar: NavigationBar(
        selectedIndex: selected,
        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
        indicatorColor: const Color(0xFFECE7FF),
        onDestinationSelected: (value) {
          if (value == 2) {
            _openComposer();
          } else {
            setState(() => selected = value);
          }
        },
        destinations: const [
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.home_outlined),
            selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.home_rounded),
            label: 'Home',
          ),
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.search_rounded),
            label: 'Search',
          ),
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.video_library_outlined),
            selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.video_library_rounded),
            label: 'Create',
          ),
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.notifications_none_rounded),
            selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.notifications_rounded),
            label: 'Activity',
          ),
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.account_circle_outlined),
            selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.account_circle_rounded),
            label: 'Profile',
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class StoryStrip extends StatefulWidget {
  const StoryStrip({
    super.key,
    required this.onCreateStory,
    required this.profile,
    required this.stories,
  });

  final Future<void> Function(AssetEntity asset, String caption) onCreateStory;
  final Map<String, dynamic> profile;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> stories;

  @override
  State<StoryStrip> createState() => StoryStripState();
}

class StoryStripState extends State<StoryStrip> {
  final Set<String> _viewedStoryIds = <String>{};
  bool _viewedStoriesLoaded = false;

  String get _storyViewsCacheKey =>
      Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id ?? '';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _restoreViewedStories();
  }

  Future<void> _restoreViewedStories() async {
    final uid = _storyViewsCacheKey;
    if (uid.isEmpty) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _viewedStoriesLoaded = true);
      return;
    }
    try {
      final saved = await LocalCache.instance.get(uid, 'viewed_stories');
      if (saved is List) {
        _viewedStoryIds.addAll(
          saved.map((value) => value.toString()).where((id) => id.isNotEmpty),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Could not restore viewed stories: $e');
    }
    if (mounted) setState(() => _viewedStoriesLoaded = true);
  }

  void _markStoryViewed(String storyId) {
    if (storyId.isEmpty || !_viewedStoryIds.add(storyId)) return;
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
    final uid = _storyViewsCacheKey;
    if (uid.isNotEmpty) {
      LocalCache.instance
          .put(uid, 'viewed_stories', _viewedStoryIds.toList())
          .catchError((Object e) {
            debugPrint('Could not save viewed stories: $e');
          });
    }
  }

  Future<void> openCreator() async {
    final context = this.context;
    final permission = await PhotoManager.requestPermissionExtend();
    if (!permission.isAuth && !permission.hasAccess) {
      if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('Allow photo access to create a story.'),
          ),
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    final imagePaths = await PhotoManager.getAssetPathList(
      type: RequestType.image,
      onlyAll: true,
    );
    final videoPaths = await PhotoManager.getAssetPathList(
      type: RequestType.video,
      onlyAll: true,
    );
    final assets = <AssetEntity>[];
    if (imagePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      assets.addAll(
        await imagePaths.first.getAssetListPaged(page: 0, size: 100),
      );
    }
    if (videoPaths.isNotEmpty) {
      assets.addAll(
        await videoPaths.first.getAssetListPaged(page: 0, size: 100),
      );
    }
    assets.sort(
      (a, b) => (b.createDateSecond ?? 0).compareTo(a.createDateSecond ?? 0),
    );

    if (!context.mounted) return;
    if (assets.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('No photos or videos found.')),
      );
      return;
    }

    final asset = await showModalBottomSheet<AssetEntity>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (sheetContext) => SafeArea(
        child: SizedBox(
          height: MediaQuery.of(sheetContext).size.height * .68,
          child: Column(
            children: [
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
                child: Text(
                  'Choose one photo or video',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                ),
              ),
              Expanded(
                child: GridView.builder(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
                    crossAxisCount: 3,
                    crossAxisSpacing: 4,
                    mainAxisSpacing: 4,
                  ),
                  itemCount: assets.length,
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                    final item = assets[index];
                    return FutureBuilder<Uint8List?>(
                      future: item.thumbnailDataWithSize(
                        const ThumbnailSize(240, 240),
                      ),
                      builder: (context, snapshot) => InkWell(
                        onTap: () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, item),
                        child: Stack(
                          fit: StackFit.expand,
                          children: [
                            if (snapshot.data != null)
                              Image.memory(snapshot.data!, fit: BoxFit.cover)
                            else
                              const ColoredBox(
                                color: Color(0xFFF0F0F4),
                                child: Icon(Icons.image_outlined),
                              ),
                            if (item.type == AssetType.video)
                              const Positioned(
                                right: 6,
                                bottom: 6,
                                child: Icon(
                                  Icons.play_circle_fill,
                                  color: Colors.white,
                                ),
                              ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (asset == null || !context.mounted) return;

    final controller = TextEditingController();
    final caption = await showModalBottomSheet<String>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (sheetContext) => Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
          16,
          20,
          16,
          MediaQuery.of(sheetContext).viewInsets.bottom + 16,
        ),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            const Text(
              'Create story',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextField(
              controller: controller,
              maxLength: 300,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'Write a caption (optional)',
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              child: FilledButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, controller.text),
                child: const Text('Share story'),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    controller.dispose();
    if (caption == null || !context.mounted) return;

    try {
      await widget.onCreateStory(asset, caption);
      if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Story shared for 24 hours.')),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
            .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Could not share story: $e')));
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final ownId = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id ?? '';
    final grouped = <String, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>{};
    for (final story in widget.stories) {
      final uid = (story['user_id'] ?? '').toString();
      if (uid.isNotEmpty) (grouped[uid] ??= []).add(story);
    }
    final ownStories = grouped.remove(ownId) ?? [];
