    final otherIds = grouped.keys.toList();

    return SizedBox(
      height: 104,
      child: ListView(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 5),
        children: [
          _storyCircle(
            context,
            profile: widget.profile,
            stories: ownStories,
            label: 'Your story',
            own: true,
          ),
          ...otherIds.map((uid) {
            final rows = grouped[uid]!;
            final user = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
              rows.first['profiles'] as Map? ?? const {},
            );
            final label =
                (user['display_name'] ?? user['username'] ?? 'Twice user')
                    .toString();
            return _storyCircle(
              context,
              profile: user,
              stories: rows,
              label: label,
              own: false,
            );
          }),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _storyCircle(
    BuildContext context, {
    required Map<String, dynamic> profile,
    required List<Map<String, dynamic>> stories,
    required String label,
    required bool own,
  }) {
    final avatar = (profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final allViewed =
        stories.isNotEmpty &&
        stories.every(
          (story) => _viewedStoryIds.contains((story['id'] ?? '').toString()),
        );
    return SizedBox(
      width: 76,
      child: InkWell(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(42),
        onTap: () {
          if (stories.isEmpty) {
            if (own) openCreator();
            return;
          }
          Navigator.of(context).push(
            PageRouteBuilder<void>(
              opaque: true,
              transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 360),
              pageBuilder: (_, animation, _) => StoryViewer(
                stories: stories,
                initialProfile: profile,
                onStoryViewed: (storyId) {
                  if (!own && mounted) _markStoryViewed(storyId);
                },
              ),
              transitionsBuilder: (_, animation, _, child) => FadeTransition(
                opacity: animation,
                child: ScaleTransition(
                  scale: Tween<double>(begin: .88, end: 1).animate(
                    CurvedAnimation(
                      parent: animation,
                      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: child,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Stack(
              clipBehavior: Clip.none,
              children: [
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(3),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    gradient:
                        stories.isNotEmpty && !allViewed && _viewedStoriesLoaded
                        ? const LinearGradient(
                            colors: [
                              Color(0xFFF9CE34),
                              Color(0xFFEE2A7B),
                              Color(0xFF6228D7),
                            ],
                            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                          )
                        : null,
                    border: stories.isEmpty || allViewed
                        ? Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFB8BBC4), width: 1.7)
                        : null,
                  ),
                  child: CircleAvatar(
                    radius: 29,
                    backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF0F0F4),
                    backgroundImage: avatar.startsWith('http')
                        ? NetworkImage(avatar)
                        : null,
                    child: avatar.startsWith('http')
                        ? null
                        : const Icon(
                            Icons.person_rounded,
                            color: muted,
                            size: 30,
                          ),
                  ),
                ),
                if (own)
                  Positioned(
                    right: 0,
                    bottom: 0,
                    child: Material(
                      color: violet,
                      shape: const CircleBorder(),
                      child: InkWell(
                        customBorder: const CircleBorder(),
                        onTap: openCreator,
                        child: Container(
                          width: 25,
                          height: 25,
                          alignment: Alignment.center,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            border: Border.all(color: Colors.white, width: 2),
                          ),
                          child: const Icon(
                            Icons.add_rounded,
                            size: 17,
                            color: Colors.white,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 5),
            Text(
              label,
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: ink),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class StoryViewer extends StatefulWidget {
  const StoryViewer({
    super.key,
    required this.stories,
    required this.initialProfile,
    required this.onStoryViewed,
  });

  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> stories;
  final Map<String, dynamic> initialProfile;
  final ValueChanged<String> onStoryViewed;

  @override
  State<StoryViewer> createState() => _StoryViewerState();
}

class _StoryViewerState extends State<StoryViewer>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _progress;
  VideoPlayerController? _video;
  int _index = 0;
  bool _paused = false;
  bool _videoReady = false;

  Map<String, dynamic> get _story => widget.stories[_index];
  String get _url => (_story['resolved_url'] ?? '').toString();
  bool get _isVideo => _story['media_type'] == 'video';
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _progress =
        AnimationController(vsync: this, duration: const Duration(seconds: 5))
          ..addStatusListener((status) {
            if (status == AnimationStatus.completed && mounted) {
              _next(completed: true);
            }
          });
    _loadCurrent();
  }

  Future<void> _loadCurrent() async {
    _progress.stop();
    _progress.value = 0;
    final previous = _video;
    _video = null;
    _videoReady = false;
    if (previous != null) {
      await previous.pause();
      await previous.dispose();
    }
    if (!mounted) return;

    if (_url.isEmpty) {
      _progress.duration = const Duration(seconds: 5);
      _progress.forward();
      setState(() {});
      return;
    }

    if (_isVideo) {
      final controller = _url.startsWith('file://')
          ? VideoPlayerController.file(File.fromUri(Uri.parse(_url)))
          : VideoPlayerController.networkUrl(Uri.parse(_url));
      _video = controller;
      try {
        await controller.initialize();
        if (!mounted || _video != controller) return;
        _videoReady = true;
        _progress.duration = controller.value.duration;
        controller.addListener(_onVideoTick);
        if (!_paused) await controller.play();
      } catch (_) {
        _videoReady = false;
      }
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (!_isVideo || !_videoReady) {
      _progress.duration = const Duration(seconds: 5);
    }
    if (!_paused) _progress.forward();
    setState(() {});
  }

  void _onVideoTick() {
    final controller = _video;
    if (controller == null || !controller.value.isInitialized) return;
    if (controller.value.position >= controller.value.duration &&
        controller.value.duration > Duration.zero) {
      _next(completed: true);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pause() async {
    if (_paused) return;
    _paused = true;
    _progress.stop();
    await _video?.pause();
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Future<void> _resume() async {
    if (!_paused) return;
    _paused = false;
    if (_videoReady) await _video?.play();
    _progress.forward();
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  void _next({bool completed = false}) {
    if (completed) {
      final storyId = (_story['id'] ?? '').toString();
      if (storyId.isNotEmpty) widget.onStoryViewed(storyId);
    }
    if (_index + 1 >= widget.stories.length) {
      Navigator.of(context).pop();
      return;
    }
    setState(() => _index++);
    _loadCurrent();
  }

  void _previous() {
    if (_progress.value > .12) {
      _progress.value = 0;
      if (_videoReady) {
        _video?.seekTo(Duration.zero);
        if (!_paused) _video?.play();
      } else if (!_paused) {
        _progress.forward();
      }
      return;
    }
    if (_index > 0) {
      setState(() => _index--);
      _loadCurrent();
    } else {
      _progress.value = 0;
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _progress.dispose();
    _video?.removeListener(_onVideoTick);
    _video?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final user = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
      _story['profiles'] as Map? ?? widget.initialProfile,
    );
    final avatar = (user['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString();
    final url = _url;
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Colors.black,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: GestureDetector(
          behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
          onLongPressStart: (_) => _pause(),
          onLongPressEnd: (_) => _resume(),
          onTapUp: (details) {
            final width = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width;
            if (details.localPosition.dx < width * .35) {
              _previous();
            } else if (details.localPosition.dx > width * .65) {
              _next();
            } else if (_paused) {
              _resume();
            }
          },
          child: Stack(
            fit: StackFit.expand,
            children: [
              Center(
                child: _isVideo
                    ? (_videoReady && _video != null
                          ? AspectRatio(
                              aspectRatio: _video!.value.aspectRatio > 0
                                  ? _video!.value.aspectRatio
                                  : 9 / 16,
                              child: VideoPlayer(_video!),
                            )
                          : const CircularProgressIndicator(
                              color: Colors.white,
                            ))
                    : ((url.startsWith('http') ||
                              url.startsWith('file://') ||
                              url.startsWith('/'))
                          ? Image(
                              image: _twiceImageProvider(url),
                              fit: BoxFit.contain,
                              errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => const Icon(
                                Icons.broken_image_outlined,
                                color: Colors.white,
                                size: 52,
                              ),
                            )
                          : const Icon(
                              Icons.broken_image_outlined,
                              color: Colors.white,
                              size: 52,
                            )),
              ),
              Positioned(
                top: 8,
                left: 10,
                right: 10,
                child: Row(
                  children: List.generate(widget.stories.length, (i) {
                    return Expanded(
                      child: Container(
                        height: 3,
                        margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 2),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Colors.white24,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(5),
                        ),
                        child: Align(
                          alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                          child: FractionallySizedBox(
                            widthFactor: i < _index
                                ? 1
                                : i == _index
                                ? _progress.value
                                : 0,
                            child: Container(
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: Colors.white,
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(5),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  }),
                ),
              ),
              Positioned(
                top: 22,
                left: 12,
                right: 8,
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    CircleAvatar(
                      radius: 17,
                      backgroundImage: avatar.startsWith('http')
                          ? NetworkImage(avatar)
                          : null,
                      child: avatar.startsWith('http')
                          ? null
                          : const Icon(Icons.person, size: 18),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 9),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        (user['display_name'] ??
                                user['username'] ??
                                'Twice user')
                            .toString(),
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close, color: Colors.white),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              if ((_story['caption'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty)
                Positioned(
                  left: 24,
                  right: 24,
                  bottom: 32,
                  child: Text(
                    _story['caption'].toString(),
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      fontSize: 16,
                      shadows: [Shadow(blurRadius: 8, color: Colors.black)],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              if (_paused)
                const Center(
                  child: Icon(
                    Icons.pause_circle_filled,
                    color: Colors.white70,
                    size: 60,
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class FeedPage extends StatelessWidget {
  const FeedPage({
    super.key,
    required this.storyStripKey,
    required this.profile,
    required this.stories,
    required this.onCreateStory,
    required this.posts,
    required this.onLike,
    required this.onRefresh,
    required this.onCommentChanged,
    required this.onOpenComposer,
  });

  final GlobalKey<StoryStripState> storyStripKey;
  final Map<String, dynamic> profile;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> stories;
  final Future<void> Function(AssetEntity asset, String caption) onCreateStory;
  final List<SocialPost> posts;
  final ValueChanged<SocialPost> onLike;
  final Future<void> Function() onRefresh;
  final VoidCallback onCommentChanged;
  final VoidCallback onOpenComposer;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => RefreshIndicator(
    onRefresh: onRefresh,
    child: ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(0, 4, 0, 24),
      children: [
        StoryStrip(
          key: storyStripKey,
          onCreateStory: onCreateStory,
          profile: profile,
          stories: stories,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 5),
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 8, 14, 12),
          child: Material(
            color: Colors.white,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(17),
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: onOpenComposer,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(17),
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    CircleAvatar(
                      radius: 22,
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFECE7FF),
                      backgroundImage:
                          (profile['avatar_url'] ?? '')
                              .toString()
                              .trim()
                              .startsWith('http')
                          ? NetworkImage(
                              (profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
                            )
                          : null,
                      child:
                          (profile['avatar_url'] ?? '')
                              .toString()
                              .trim()
                              .startsWith('http')
                          ? null
                          : const Icon(
                              Icons.person_rounded,
                              color: violet,
                              size: 27,
                            ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 16,
                          vertical: 12,
                        ),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: const Color(0xFFF2F3F5),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(25),
                        ),
                        child: const Text(
                          "What's on your mind?",
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: Color(0xFF65676B),
                            fontSize: 15,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    const Icon(
                      Icons.photo_library_outlined,
                      color: Color(0xFF45BD62),
                      size: 25,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        if (posts.isEmpty)
          const Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 70),
            child: Column(
              children: [
                Icon(Icons.dynamic_feed_outlined, size: 56, color: muted),
                SizedBox(height: 14),
                Text(
                  'No posts yet',
                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 20),
                ),
                SizedBox(height: 7),
                Text(
                  'Follow people or share your first moment.',
                  style: TextStyle(color: muted),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          )
        else
          ...posts.map(
            (post) => PostCard(
              key: ValueKey('post-${post.id}'),
              post: post,
              onLike: onLike,
              onCommentChanged: onCommentChanged,
            ),
          ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

class _AnimatedLikeButton extends StatefulWidget {
  const _AnimatedLikeButton({required this.liked, required this.onPressed});

  final bool liked;
  final VoidCallback onPressed;

  @override
  State<_AnimatedLikeButton> createState() => _AnimatedLikeButtonState();
}

class _AnimatedLikeButtonState extends State<_AnimatedLikeButton>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _controller = AnimationController(
    vsync: this,
    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 380),
  );

  late final Animation<double> _scale = TweenSequence<double>([
    TweenSequenceItem(
      tween: Tween(
        begin: 1.0,
        end: 1.35,
      ).chain(CurveTween(curve: Curves.easeOut)),
      weight: 45,
    ),
    TweenSequenceItem(
      tween: Tween(
        begin: 1.35,
        end: 1.0,
      ).chain(CurveTween(curve: Curves.easeInOut)),
      weight: 55,
    ),
  ]).animate(_controller);

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant _AnimatedLikeButton oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.liked != widget.liked) {
      _controller.forward(from: 0);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => IconButton(
    tooltip: widget.liked ? 'Unlike post' : 'Like post',
    onPressed: () {
      _controller.forward(from: 0);
      widget.onPressed();
    },
    icon: ScaleTransition(
      scale: _scale,
      child: Icon(
        widget.liked ? Icons.favorite_rounded : Icons.favorite_border_rounded,
        size: 27,
        color: widget.liked ? Colors.redAccent : ink,
      ),
    ),
  );
}

class _PostMediaItem extends StatefulWidget {
  const _PostMediaItem({super.key, required this.media});

  final Map<String, dynamic> media;

  @override
  State<_PostMediaItem> createState() => _PostMediaItemState();
}

class _PostMediaItemState extends State<_PostMediaItem> {
  VideoPlayerController? _controller;
  bool _failed = false;
  bool _userPaused = false;
  bool _showVideoControls = true;
  bool _hasVideoFrame = false;
  double _visibleFraction = 0;
  Timer? _controlsTimer;

  bool get _isVideo =>
      (widget.media['media_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() == 'video';

  String get _url => (widget.media['resolved_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();

  String get _thumbnailUrl =>
      (widget.media['resolved_thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initializeVideo();
  }

  Future<void> _initializeVideo({bool allowUrlRefresh = true}) async {
    if (!_isVideo) return;

    if (_url.isEmpty) {
      if (allowUrlRefresh && await _refreshAndRetryVideo()) return;
      if (mounted) setState(() => _failed = true);
      return;
    }

    final source = _url;
    final controller = source.startsWith('file://')
        ? VideoPlayerController.file(File.fromUri(Uri.parse(source)))
        : VideoPlayerController.networkUrl(Uri.parse(source));
    _controller = controller;
    controller.addListener(_onVideoValueChanged);

    try {
      await controller.initialize();
      await controller.setLooping(true);
      await controller.setVolume(1);
      if (!mounted || !identical(_controller, controller)) {
        controller.removeListener(_onVideoValueChanged);
        await controller.dispose();
        return;
      }
      setState(() {});
      _syncPlayback(controller);
    } catch (_) {
      controller.removeListener(_onVideoValueChanged);
      await controller.dispose();
      if (identical(_controller, controller)) _controller = null;

      // Retry once with a fresh signed URL or an available offline copy.
      if (allowUrlRefresh && await _refreshAndRetryVideo()) return;
      if (mounted) setState(() => _failed = true);
    }
  }

  Future<bool> _refreshAndRetryVideo() async {
    final objectPath = (widget.media['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (objectPath.isEmpty ||
        objectPath.startsWith('http://') ||
        objectPath.startsWith('https://')) {
      return false;
    }

    try {
      final refreshed = await SocialRepository.instance.refreshMediaUrl(
        objectPath,
        bucket: 'post-media',
      );
      if (refreshed == null || refreshed.isEmpty || !mounted) return false;

      widget.media['resolved_url'] = refreshed;
      setState(() => _failed = false);
      await _initializeVideo(allowUrlRefresh: false);

      // The retry succeeds only if a controller initialized successfully.
      final active = _controller;
      final succeeded =
          mounted &&
          active != null &&
          active.value.isInitialized &&
          !active.value.hasError;

      if (!succeeded && mounted) {
        setState(() => _failed = true);
      }
      return succeeded;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  void _onVideoValueChanged() {
    final controller = _controller;
    if (!mounted || controller == null || _hasVideoFrame) return;
    if (controller.value.isInitialized &&
        controller.value.position > Duration.zero) {
      setState(() => _hasVideoFrame = true);
    }
  }

  void _showControlsTemporarily() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _showVideoControls = true);
    _controlsTimer?.cancel();
    _controlsTimer = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 2), () {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _showVideoControls = false);
    });
  }

  void _syncPlayback(VideoPlayerController controller) {
    if (!mounted || !controller.value.isInitialized) return;
    if (_visibleFraction >= 0.6 && !_userPaused) {
      if (!controller.value.isPlaying) {
        controller.play();
        _showControlsTemporarily();
      }
    } else if (controller.value.isPlaying) {
      controller.pause();
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant _PostMediaItem oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);

    // Signed URLs may refresh while the underlying media object stays the same.
    // Keep the existing player in that case to avoid feed-scroll flicker.
    final oldPath = oldWidget.media['media_url'];
    final newPath = widget.media['media_url'];
    if (oldPath != newPath ||
        oldWidget.media['media_type'] != widget.media['media_type']) {
      final old = _controller;
      _controller = null;
      old?.removeListener(_onVideoValueChanged);
      old?.pause();
      old?.dispose();
      _failed = false;
      _userPaused = false;
      _hasVideoFrame = false;
      _initializeVideo();
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controlsTimer?.cancel();
    final controller = _controller;
    if (controller != null) {
      controller.removeListener(_onVideoValueChanged);
      controller.pause();
      controller.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  Widget _poster({bool cover = false}) {
    final url = _thumbnailUrl;
    return ColoredBox(
      color: const Color(0xFFF4F5F7),
      child: Stack(
        fit: StackFit.expand,
        alignment: Alignment.center,
        children: [
          if (url.isNotEmpty)
            Image(
              image: _twiceImageProvider(url),
              fit: cover ? BoxFit.cover : BoxFit.contain,
              width: double.infinity,
              errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => const SizedBox.shrink(),
            ),
          const Center(
            child: Icon(
              Icons.play_circle_outline_rounded,
              color: Color(0xFF65676B),
              size: 52,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final url = _url;

    if (!_isVideo) {
      return ColoredBox(
        color: const Color(0xFFF4F5F7),
        child: url.isEmpty
            ? const Center(
                child: Icon(
                  Icons.broken_image_outlined,
                  size: 42,
                  color: muted,
                ),
              )
            : Image(
                image: _twiceImageProvider(url),
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                width: double.infinity,
                errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => const Center(
                  child: Icon(
                    Icons.broken_image_outlined,
                    size: 42,
                    color: muted,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
      );
    }

    final controller = _controller;
    return VisibilityDetector(
      key: ValueKey('twice-video-${widget.media['media_url'] ?? url}'),
      onVisibilityChanged: (info) {
        _visibleFraction = info.visibleFraction;
        final active = _controller;
        if (active != null) _syncPlayback(active);
      },
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: _showControlsTemporarily,
        child: Stack(
          fit: StackFit.expand,
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          children: [
            // Keep a real poster underneath initialization, buffering and errors.
            _poster(),
            if (!_failed &&
                controller != null &&
                controller.value.isInitialized &&
                _hasVideoFrame)
              FittedBox(
                fit: BoxFit.contain,
                child: SizedBox(
                  width: controller.value.size.width,
                  height: controller.value.size.height,
                  child: VideoPlayer(controller),
                ),
              ),
            if (!_failed &&
                (controller == null || !controller.value.isInitialized))
              const Center(
                child: SizedBox(
                  width: 24,
                  height: 24,
                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                    strokeWidth: 2,
                    color: Color(0xFF65676B),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            if (_failed)
              const Center(
                child: Icon(
                  Icons.refresh_rounded,
                  color: Color(0xFF65676B),
                  size: 42,
                ),
              ),
            if (controller != null &&
                controller.value.isInitialized &&
                _hasVideoFrame &&
                _showVideoControls)
              Center(
                child: Material(
                  color: const Color(0x99000000),
                  shape: const CircleBorder(),
                  child: IconButton(
                    tooltip: controller.value.isPlaying
                        ? 'Pause video'
                        : 'Play video',
                    onPressed: () {
                      if (controller.value.isPlaying) {
                        _userPaused = true;
                        controller.pause();
                      } else {
                        _userPaused = false;
                        _syncPlayback(controller);
                      }
                      _showControlsTemporarily();
                    },
                    icon: Icon(
                      controller.value.isPlaying
                          ? Icons.pause_rounded
                          : Icons.play_arrow_rounded,
                      color: Colors.white,
                      size: 42,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _PostFollowButton extends StatefulWidget {
  const _PostFollowButton({required this.profileId, required this.onChanged});

  final String profileId;
  final VoidCallback onChanged;

  @override
  State<_PostFollowButton> createState() => _PostFollowButtonState();
}

class _PostFollowButtonState extends State<_PostFollowButton> {
  String _label = '';
  bool _loading = true;
  bool _busy = false;
  int _generation = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant _PostFollowButton oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.profileId != widget.profileId) _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final generation = ++_generation;
    if (widget.profileId.isEmpty) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _label = '';
          _loading = false;
        });
      }
      return;
    }
    if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = true);
    try {
      final label = await SocialRepository.instance.getFollowLabel(
        widget.profileId,
      );
      if (mounted && generation == _generation) {
        setState(() {
          _label = label;
          _loading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && generation == _generation) {
        setState(() {
          _label = '';
          _loading = false;
        });
        debugPrint('Follow state load failed: $e');
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _tap() async {
    if (_busy || widget.profileId.isEmpty || _label.isEmpty) return;
    final previous = _label;
    final repo = SocialRepository.instance;
    setState(() => _busy = true);

    try {
      if (previous == 'Following' ||
          previous == 'Connected' ||
          previous == 'Requested') {
        setState(() => _label = 'Follow');
        await repo.unfollow(widget.profileId);
      } else {
        final privateAccount = await repo.isPrivateAccount(widget.profileId);
        setState(() {
          _label = privateAccount ? 'Requested' : 'Following';
        });
        await repo.follow(widget.profileId, privateAccount: privateAccount);
      }
      await _load();
      widget.onChanged();
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _label = previous);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Could not update follow: $e')));
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (widget.profileId.isEmpty || _label.isEmpty) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }
    final active = _label == 'Following' || _label == 'Connected';
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 4),
      child: SizedBox(
        height: 32,
        child: OutlinedButton(
          onPressed: _loading || _busy ? null : _tap,
          style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
            foregroundColor: active ? muted : violet,
            side: BorderSide(color: active ? const Color(0xFFE1E3EA) : violet),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9),
            minimumSize: const Size(0, 32),
            tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
            visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
            ),
          ),
          child: _loading || _busy
              ? const SizedBox(
                  width: 13,
                  height: 13,
                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 1.5),
                )
              : Text(
                  _label,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 10,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  ),
                ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class PostCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const PostCard({
    super.key,
    required this.post,
    required this.onLike,
    required this.onCommentChanged,
  });

  final SocialPost post;
  final ValueChanged<SocialPost> onLike;
  final VoidCallback onCommentChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final media = post.media;

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFEDEDED)),
      ),
      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(13, 12, 8, 10),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                SizedBox(
                  width: 44,
                  height: 44,
                  child: ClipOval(
                    child: (post.avatarUrl ?? '').trim().isEmpty
                        ? const ColoredBox(
                            color: Color(0xFFF0F2F5),
                            child: Icon(
                              Icons.person_outline_rounded,
                              color: muted,
                            ),
                          )
                        : Image(
                            image: _twiceImageProvider(post.avatarUrl!),
                            fit: BoxFit.cover,
                            errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => const ColoredBox(
                              color: Color(0xFFF0F2F5),
                              child: Icon(
                                Icons.person_outline_rounded,
                                color: muted,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        post.name,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 14,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          color: ink,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      Text(
                        '${post.handle} · ${_timeAgo(post.data['created_at'])}',
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: muted),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                if (post.author['id'] != null &&
                    post.author['id'].toString().isNotEmpty)
                  _PostFollowButton(
                    profileId: post.author['id'].toString(),
                    onChanged: onCommentChanged,
                  ),
                PopupMenuButton<String>(
                  tooltip: 'Post options',
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.more_horiz_rounded, color: ink),
                  onSelected: (value) {
                    if (value == 'copy') {
                      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                        const SnackBar(
                          content: Text(
                            'Use your device share options to share this post.',
                          ),
                        ),
                      );
                    }
                  },
                  itemBuilder: (_) => const [
                    PopupMenuItem(
                      value: 'copy',
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(Icons.ios_share_rounded, size: 19),
                          SizedBox(width: 10),
                          Text('Share options'),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),

          if (post.caption.isNotEmpty)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 0, 14, 12),
              child: Text(
                post.caption,
                style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14, height: 1.4),
              ),
            ),

          if (media.isNotEmpty)
            AspectRatio(
              aspectRatio: media.length == 1 ? 1 : 0.92,
              child: Stack(
                fit: StackFit.expand,
                children: [
                  PageView.builder(
                    itemCount: media.length,
                    itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                      final item = media[index];
                      return _PostMediaItem(
                        key: ValueKey(
                          'media-${item['id'] ?? item['media_url']}',
                        ),
                        media: item,
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                  if (media.length > 1)
                    Positioned(
                      top: 12,
                      right: 12,
                      child: DecoratedBox(
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: const Color(0xB8000000),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                        ),
                        child: Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 10,
                            vertical: 5,
                          ),
                          child: Text(
                            '${media.length} photos/videos',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              color: Colors.white,
                              fontSize: 11,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),

          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(10, 4, 10, 12),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    _AnimatedLikeButton(
                      liked: post.liked,
                      onPressed: () => onLike(post),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Comments',
                      onPressed: () async {
                        await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
                          context: context,
                          isScrollControlled: true,
                          useSafeArea: true,
                          backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
                          barrierColor: Colors.black54,
                          enableDrag: true,
                          showDragHandle: false,
                          shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(
                              top: Radius.circular(24),
                            ),
                          ),
                          clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
                          builder: (_) => CommentsSheet(post: post),
                        );
                        onCommentChanged();
                      },
                      icon: const Icon(
                        Icons.chat_bubble_outline_rounded,
                        size: 25,
                        color: ink,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const Spacer(),
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: post.saved ? 'Remove saved post' : 'Save post',
                      onPressed: () {
                        final wasSaved = post.saved;
                        final uid =
                            Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
                        if (uid == null) return;

                        final rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
                          (post.data['saved_posts'] as List? ?? const [])
                              .whereType<Map>()
                              .map((row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row)),
                        );

                        // Update the bookmark immediately.
                        if (wasSaved) {
                          rows.removeWhere((row) => row['user_id'] == uid);
                        } else {
                          rows.add({'user_id': uid});
                        }
                        post.data['saved_posts'] = rows;
                        onCommentChanged();

                        // Persist asynchronously; do not reload the feed.
                        SocialRepository.instance
                            .toggleSaved(post.id, wasSaved)
                            .catchError((Object e) {
                              if (!context.mounted) return;
                              // Roll back only this bookmark state.
                              final current = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
                                (post.data['saved_posts'] as List? ?? const [])
                                    .whereType<Map>()
                                    .map(
                                      (row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row),
                                    ),
                              );
                              current.removeWhere(
                                (row) => row['user_id'] == uid,
                              );
                              if (wasSaved) current.add({'user_id': uid});
                              post.data['saved_posts'] = current;
                              onCommentChanged();
                              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                                SnackBar(content: Text('Save failed: $e')),
                              );
                            });
                      },
                      icon: Icon(
                        post.saved
                            ? Icons.bookmark_rounded
                            : Icons.bookmark_border_rounded,
                        size: 26,
                        color: post.saved ? const Color(0xFFE2B900) : ink,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 5),
                  child: Text(
                    '${post.likes} ${post.likes == 1 ? 'like' : 'likes'}',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      fontSize: 13,
                      color: ink,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                if (post.caption.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 5),
                    child: Text.rich(
                      TextSpan(
                        children: [
                          TextSpan(
                            text: '${post.handle}  ',
                            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                          ),
                          TextSpan(text: post.caption),
                        ],
                      ),
                      maxLines: 4,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

String _timeAgo(dynamic value) {
  final date = DateTime.tryParse(value?.toString() ?? '')?.toLocal();
  if (date == null) return '';
  final diff = DateTime.now().difference(date);
  if (diff.inMinutes < 1) return 'Just now';
  if (diff.inHours < 1) return '${diff.inMinutes}m ago';
  if (diff.inDays < 1) return '${diff.inHours}h ago';
  if (diff.inDays < 7) return '${diff.inDays}d ago';
  return '${date.day}/${date.month}/${date.year}';
}

Future<List<AssetEntity>> _loadSelectableMedia({int size = 200}) async {
  // Query images and videos independently: some Android gallery providers
  // omit video rows from RequestType.common when access is partially granted.
  final permission = await PhotoManager.requestPermissionExtend();
  if (!permission.isAuth && !permission.hasAccess) return <AssetEntity>[];

  final results = <String, AssetEntity>{};
  for (final type in <RequestType>[RequestType.image, RequestType.video]) {
    final paths = await PhotoManager.getAssetPathList(
      type: type,
      onlyAll: true,
    );
    if (paths.isEmpty) continue;
    final assets = await paths.first.getAssetListPaged(page: 0, size: size);
    for (final asset in assets) {
      if (asset.type == AssetType.image || asset.type == AssetType.video) {
        results[asset.id] = asset;
      }
    }
  }
  final assets = results.values.toList()
    ..sort(
      (a, b) => (b.createDateSecond ?? 0).compareTo(a.createDateSecond ?? 0),
    );
  return assets;
}

class CreatePage extends StatefulWidget {
  const CreatePage({super.key, required this.onPost});
  final Future<void> Function(
    String caption,
    List<AssetEntity> media,
    String visibility,
  )
  onPost;
  @override
  State<CreatePage> createState() => _CreatePageState();
}

class _CreatePageState extends State<CreatePage> {
  final controller = TextEditingController();
  final selectedMedia = <AssetEntity>[];
  String visibility = 'public';
  bool publishing = false;
  @override
  void dispose() {
    controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _pick() async {
    List<AssetEntity> assets;
    try {
      assets = await _loadSelectableMedia(size: 300);
    } catch (error) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Could not open media library: $error')),
        );
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (assets.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            'No accessible photos or videos. Check media permissions.',
          ),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final picked = await showModalBottomSheet<List<AssetEntity>>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      useSafeArea: true,
      builder: (_) => _MediaPicker(assets: assets),
    );

    if (picked != null && mounted) {
      setState(() {
        selectedMedia
          ..clear()
          ..addAll(picked.take(10));
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _publish() async {
    if (publishing) return;
    setState(() => publishing = true);
    try {
      await widget.onPost(controller.text, selectedMedia, visibility);
      controller.clear();
      setState(() => selectedMedia.clear());
    } catch (_) {
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => publishing = false);
    }
  }

class _MediaPicker extends StatefulWidget {
  const _MediaPicker({required this.assets});
  final List<AssetEntity> assets;
  @override
  State<_MediaPicker> createState() => _MediaPickerState();
}

class _MediaPickerState extends State<_MediaPicker> {
  final Set<AssetEntity> chosen = {};
  final Map<String, Future<Uint8List?>> _thumbnailFutures = {};

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    for (final asset in widget.assets) {
      _thumbnailFutures.putIfAbsent(
        asset.id,
        () => asset.thumbnailDataWithSize(const ThumbnailSize(220, 220)),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => SizedBox(
    height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * .78,
    child: Column(
      children: [
        ListTile(
          title: const Text(
            'Select media',
            style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
          ),
          subtitle: Text('${chosen.length}/10 selected'),
          trailing: TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, chosen.toList()),
            child: const Text('Done'),
          ),
        ),
        Expanded(
          child: GridView.builder(
            key: const PageStorageKey<String>('twice-media-picker-grid'),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
            gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
              crossAxisCount: 4,
              crossAxisSpacing: 3,
              mainAxisSpacing: 3,
            ),
            itemCount: widget.assets.length,
            itemBuilder: (_, i) {
              final asset = widget.assets[i];
              final isChosen = chosen.contains(asset);
              return InkWell(
                key: ValueKey<String>(asset.id),
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() {
                    if (isChosen) {
                      chosen.remove(asset);
                    } else if (chosen.length < 10) {
                      chosen.add(asset);
                    }
                  });
                },
                child: Stack(
                  fit: StackFit.expand,
                  children: [
                    FutureBuilder<Uint8List?>(
                      future: _thumbnailFutures[asset.id],
                      builder: (_, snapshot) {
                        final bytes = snapshot.data;
                        if (bytes == null || bytes.isEmpty) {
                          return const ColoredBox(color: canvas);
                        }
                        return Image.memory(
                          bytes,
                          fit: BoxFit.cover,
                          gaplessPlayback: true,
                          filterQuality: FilterQuality.low,
                          errorBuilder: (_, _, _) =>
                              const ColoredBox(color: canvas),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                    if (asset.type == AssetType.video)
                      const Positioned(
                        right: 4,
                        bottom: 4,
                        child: Icon(
                          Icons.play_circle_fill,
                          color: Colors.white,
                          shadows: [Shadow(blurRadius: 4)],
                        ),
                      ),
                    if (isChosen)
                      const Positioned(
                        top: 4,
                        right: 4,
                        child: Icon(
                          Icons.check_circle,
                          color: violet,
                          shadows: [Shadow(blurRadius: 3)],
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

class SearchPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const SearchPage({super.key});
  @override
  State<SearchPage> createState() => _SearchPageState();
}

class _SearchPageState extends State<SearchPage> {
  final controller = TextEditingController();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> results = [];
  bool busy = false;
  String? error;
  @override
  void dispose() {
    controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _search(String q) async {
    if (q.trim().isEmpty) {
      setState(() {
        results = [];
        error = null;
      });
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      busy = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final data = await SocialRepository.instance.search(q);
      if (mounted) setState(() => results = data);
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => error = e.toString());
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => busy = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
    children: [
      Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: TextField(
          controller: controller,
          onChanged: _search,
          decoration: InputDecoration(
            hintText: 'Search people by name or @username',
            prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search),
            suffixIcon: IconButton(
              onPressed: () {
                controller.clear();
                _search('');
              },
              icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
            ),
            filled: true,
            fillColor: Colors.white,
            border: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
              borderSide: BorderSide.none,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      if (busy) const LinearProgressIndicator(),
      if (error != null)
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          child: Text(error!, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
        ),
      Expanded(
        child: results.isEmpty
            ? Center(
                child: Text(
                  controller.text.isEmpty
                      ? 'Search for real Twice users'
                      : 'No users found',
                  style: const TextStyle(color: muted),
                ),
              )
            : ListView.builder(
                itemCount: results.length,
                itemBuilder: (_, i) => _UserTile(user: results[i]),
              ),
      ),
    ],
  );
}

class _UserTile extends StatefulWidget {
  const _UserTile({required this.user});
  final Map<String, dynamic> user;
  @override
  State<_UserTile> createState() => _UserTileState();
}

class _UserTileState extends State<_UserTile> {
  bool following = false, busy = false;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final user = widget.user;
    if (user['result_type'] == 'post') {
      final author = user['profiles'] as Map? ?? {};
      return ListTile(
        leading: const CircleAvatar(child: Icon(Icons.article_outlined)),
        title: Text(
          (user['caption'] ?? 'Media post').toString(),
          maxLines: 2,
          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
        ),
        subtitle: Text(
          '${author['display_name'] ?? author['username'] ?? 'Twice user'} · @${author['username'] ?? 'user'}',
        ),
      );
    }
    final isSelf = user['id'] == Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
    return ListTile(
      leading: CircleAvatar(
        backgroundImage: user['avatar_url'] == null
            ? null
            : NetworkImage(user['avatar_url'].toString()),
        child: user['avatar_url'] == null ? const Icon(Icons.person) : null,
      ),
      title: Text(
        (user['display_name'] ?? user['username'] ?? 'Twice user').toString(),
        style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
      ),
      subtitle: Text('@${user['username'] ?? 'user'}'),
      trailing: isSelf
          ? null
          : Wrap(
              children: [
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: busy
                      ? null
                      : () async {
                          setState(() => busy = true);
                          try {
                            if (following) {
                              await SocialRepository.instance.unfollow(
                                user['id'].toString(),
                              );
                            } else {
                              await SocialRepository.instance.follow(
                                user['id'].toString(),
                                privateAccount: user['is_private'] == true,
                              );
                            }
                            if (mounted) setState(() => following = !following);
                          } catch (e) {
                            if (mounted) {
                              ScaffoldMessenger.of(this.context).showSnackBar(
                                SnackBar(
                                  content: Text('Follow action failed: $e'),
                                ),
                              );
                            }
                          } finally {
                            if (mounted) setState(() => busy = false);
                          }
                        },
                  child: Text(
                    busy
                        ? '…'
                        : following
                        ? 'Following'
                        : 'Follow',
                  ),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  tooltip: 'Message',
                  onPressed: busy
                      ? null
                      : () async {
                          setState(() => busy = true);
                          try {
                            final id = await SocialRepository.instance
                                .createConversation(user['id'].toString());
                            if (context.mounted) {
                              Navigator.of(context).push(
                                MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                                  builder: (_) => ConversationPage(
                                    id: id,
                                    title:
                                        (user['display_name'] ??
                                                user['username'] ??
                                                'Message')
                                            .toString(),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              );
                            }
                          } catch (e) {
                            if (mounted) {
                              ScaffoldMessenger.of(this.context).showSnackBar(
                                SnackBar(
                                  content: Text(
                                    'Could not start conversation: $e',
                                  ),
                                ),
                              );
                            }
                          } finally {
                            if (mounted) setState(() => busy = false);
                          }
                        },
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.send_outlined),
                ),
              ],
            ),
    );
  }
}

class CommentsSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const CommentsSheet({super.key, required this.post});
  final SocialPost post;
  @override
  State<CommentsSheet> createState() => _CommentsSheetState();
}

class _CommentsSheetState extends State<CommentsSheet> {
  final controller = TextEditingController();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows = [];
  bool busy = true;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String? loadError;
  bool sending = false;

  Future<void> _load() async {
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        busy = true;
        loadError = null;
      });
    }
    try {
      final data = await SocialRepository.instance.comments(widget.post.id);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          rows = data;
          busy = false;
          loadError = null;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          busy = false;
          loadError = e.toString();
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _send() async {
    if (sending) return;
    final text = controller.text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return;

    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();

    final optimistic = <String, dynamic>{
      'id': _newTwiceUuid(),
      'post_id': widget.post.id,
      'user_id': Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id ?? '',
      'body': text,
      'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
      'profiles': <String, dynamic>{'display_name': 'You'},
      '_pending': true,
    };

    // Render immediately and clear the composer before network work begins.
    setState(() {
      rows = [...rows, optimistic];
      controller.clear();
      loadError = null;
      busy = false;
      sending = true;
    });

    // Persist in the background; no comments refresh or feed reload.
    try {
      final synced = await SocialRepository.instance.addComment(
        widget.post.id,
        text,
        commentId: optimistic['id'].toString(),
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        optimistic.remove('_pending');
        if (!synced) optimistic['_queued'] = true;
      });
      if (!synced) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              'Saved offline. This comment will sync when you reconnect.',
            ),
            behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        optimistic['_failed'] = true;
        optimistic.remove('_pending');
      });
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('Comment is visible but could not sync: $e'),
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => sending = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Container(
    height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * .78,
    decoration: const BoxDecoration(
      color: Colors.white,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
    ),
    child: Column(
      children: [
        const SizedBox(height: 10),
        Container(
          width: 38,
          height: 4,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Colors.black26,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99),
          ),
        ),
        const Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
          child: Text(
            'Comments',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
          ),
        ),
        Expanded(
          child: busy
              ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
              : loadError != null
              ? Center(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                    child: Column(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        const Text('Could not load comments'),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        Text(loadError!, textAlign: TextAlign.center),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        TextButton(
                          onPressed: _load,
                          child: const Text('Retry'),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                )
              : rows.isEmpty
              ? const Center(child: Text('No comments yet'))
              : ListView.builder(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 4, 16, 16),
                  itemCount: rows.length,
                  itemBuilder: (_, i) {
                    final r = rows[i];
                    final p = r['profiles'] as Map? ?? {};
                    final name = (p['display_name'] ?? p['username'] ?? 'User')
                        .toString();
                    return Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                      child: Row(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Builder(
                            builder: (context) {
                              final avatar = (p['avatar_url'] ?? '')
                                  .toString()
                                  .trim();
                              final hasAvatar =
                                  avatar.startsWith('http') ||
                                  avatar.startsWith('file://') ||
                                  avatar.startsWith('/');
                              return CircleAvatar(
                                radius: 17,
                                backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFEDE7FF),
                                backgroundImage: hasAvatar
                                    ? _twiceImageProvider(avatar)
                                    : null,
                                child: hasAvatar
                                    ? null
                                    : Text(
                                        name.isNotEmpty
                                            ? name[0].toUpperCase()
                                            : 'U',
                                        style: const TextStyle(
                                          color: violet,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                              );
                            },
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 10),
                          Flexible(
                            child: Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 14,
                                vertical: 10,
                              ),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: const Color(0xFFF3F3F6),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                              ),
                              child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                children: [
                                  Text(
                                    name,
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                      fontSize: 13,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
                                  Text(
                                    '@${(p['username'] ?? 'user').toString().replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^@'), '')}  ·  ${_timeAgo(r['created_at'])}',
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                      color: muted,
                                      fontSize: 11,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 5),
                                  Text((r['body'] ?? '').toString()),
                                  if (r['_queued'] == true)
                                    const Padding(
                                      padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                                      child: Text(
                                        'Saved offline · waiting to sync',
                                        style: TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 11,
                                          color: muted,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  if (r['_failed'] == true)
                                    const Padding(
                                      padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                                      child: Text(
                                        'Not synced · check connection and retry',
                                        style: TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 11,
                                          color: Colors.redAccent,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
        ),
        SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              14,
              8,
              14,
              10 + MediaQuery.viewInsetsOf(context).bottom,
            ),
            child: Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Container(
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: const Color(0xFFF3F3F6),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26),
                      border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFE5E3EC)),
                    ),
                    child: TextField(
                      controller: controller,
                      minLines: 1,
                      maxLines: 4,
                      textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                      textInputAction: TextInputAction.send,
                      onSubmitted: (_) => _send(),
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        hintText: 'Write a comment…',
                        contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 18,
                          vertical: 12,
                        ),
                        border: InputBorder.none,
                        enabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                        focusedBorder: InputBorder.none,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Material(
                  color: violet,
                  shape: const CircleBorder(),
                  child: InkWell(
                    customBorder: const CircleBorder(),
                    onTap: sending ? null : _send,
                    child: SizedBox(
                      width: 46,
                      height: 46,
                      child: Center(
                        child: sending
                            ? const SizedBox(
                                width: 20,
                                height: 20,
                                child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                  strokeWidth: 2,
                                  color: Colors.white,
                                ),
                              )
                            : const Icon(
                                Icons.send_rounded,
                                color: Colors.white,
                                size: 21,
                              ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

class ActivityPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ActivityPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<ActivityPage> createState() => _ActivityPageState();
}

class _ActivityPageState extends State<ActivityPage> {
  late Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> future;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    future = SocialRepository.instance.notifications();
  }

  Future<void> _refresh() async {
    setState(() => future = SocialRepository.instance.notifications());
    await future;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return FutureBuilder<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      future: future,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        if (snapshot.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
          return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
        }
        if (snapshot.hasError) {
          return Center(
            child: Text('Could not load activity: ${snapshot.error}'),
          );
        }
        final rows = snapshot.data ?? [];
        if (rows.isEmpty) {
          return RefreshIndicator(
            onRefresh: _refresh,
            child: ListView(
              physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              children: const [
                SizedBox(height: 180),
                Center(
                  child: Text(
                    'No activity yet',
                    style: TextStyle(color: muted),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        }
        return RefreshIndicator(
          onRefresh: _refresh,
          child: ListView.builder(
            itemCount: rows.length,
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              final row = rows[index];
              final actor = row['profiles'] as Map? ?? {};
              return ListTile(
                leading: const CircleAvatar(
                  child: Icon(Icons.notifications_none),
                ),
                title: Text(
                  '${actor['display_name'] ?? actor['username'] ?? 'Someone'} '
                  '${row['type'] ?? 'interacted'} with you',
                ),
                subtitle: Text(_timeAgo(row['created_at'])),
              );
            },
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

  final Map<String, dynamic> profile;
