}

class EditProfilePage extends StatefulWidget {
  const EditProfilePage({
    super.key,
    required this.profile,
    required this.onSaved,
  });

  final Map<String, dynamic> profile;
  final Future<void> Function() onSaved;

  @override
  State<EditProfilePage> createState() => _EditProfilePageState();
}

class _EditProfilePageState extends State<EditProfilePage> {
  late final TextEditingController display;
  late final TextEditingController username;
  late final TextEditingController bio;
  AssetEntity? photo;
  bool saving = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    display = TextEditingController(
      text: (widget.profile['display_name'] ?? '').toString(),
    );
    username = TextEditingController(
      text: (widget.profile['username'] ?? '').toString(),
    );
    bio = TextEditingController(text: (widget.profile['bio'] ?? '').toString());
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    display.dispose();
    username.dispose();
    bio.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _choosePhoto() async {
    List<AssetEntity> photos;
    try {
      photos = await _loadSelectableMedia(size: 150);
      photos.removeWhere((asset) => asset.type != AssetType.image);
    } catch (error) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Could not open media library: $error')),
        );
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    final picked = await showModalBottomSheet<List<AssetEntity>>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (_) => _MediaPicker(assets: photos),
    );
    if (picked != null && picked.isNotEmpty && mounted) {
      setState(() => photo = picked.first);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    if (saving) return;
    if (display.text.trim().isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
          .showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Enter a display name.')));
      return;
    }
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      await SocialRepository.instance.updateProfile(
        displayName: display.text,
        username: username.text,
        bio: bio.text,
        avatarAsset: photo,
      );
      await widget.onSaved();
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Profile updated successfully')),
        );
        Navigator.of(context).pop();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Could not save profile: $e')));
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  InputDecoration _decoration(String label, IconData icon) => InputDecoration(
    labelText: label,
    prefixIcon: Icon(icon, color: violet),
    filled: true,
    fillColor: Colors.white,
    contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 17),
    border: OutlineInputBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
      borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFE8E8F0)),
    ),
    enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
      borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFE8E8F0)),
    ),
    focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
      borderSide: const BorderSide(color: violet, width: 1.5),
    ),
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final avatar = (widget.profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString();
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: canvas,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        leading: IconButton(
          tooltip: 'Back',
          onPressed: saving ? null : () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
        ),
        title: const Text(
          'Edit Profile',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
        ),
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 22, 22, 24),
                children: [
                  Center(
                    child: Column(
                      children: [
                        Stack(
                          clipBehavior: Clip.none,
                          children: [
                            Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                                color: Colors.white,
                                border: Border.all(
                                  color: const Color(0xFFE5DFFF),
                                  width: 2,
                                ),
                              ),
                              child: ClipOval(
                                child: SizedBox(
                                  width: 112,
                                  height: 112,
                                  child: photo != null
                                      ? FutureBuilder<Uint8List?>(
                                          future: photo!.thumbnailDataWithSize(
                                            const ThumbnailSize(360, 360),
                                          ),
                                          builder: (_, snap) =>
                                              snap.data == null
                                              ? const Center(
                                                  child:
                                                      CircularProgressIndicator(),
                                                )
                                              : Image.memory(
                                                  snap.data!,
                                                  fit: BoxFit.cover,
                                                ),
                                        )
                                      : avatar.isNotEmpty
                                      ? Image(
                                          image: _twiceImageProvider(avatar),
                                          fit: BoxFit.cover,
                                          errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => const Icon(
                                            Icons.person_rounded,
                                            size: 54,
                                          ),
                                        )
                                      : const Icon(
                                          Icons.person_rounded,
                                          size: 54,
                                          color: muted,
                                        ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                            Positioned(
                              right: 0,
                              bottom: 0,
                              child: Material(
                                color: violet,
                                shape: const CircleBorder(),
                                child: InkWell(
                                  customBorder: const CircleBorder(),
                                  onTap: _choosePhoto,
                                  child: const Padding(
                                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(10),
                                    child: Icon(
                                      Icons.add_rounded,
                                      color: Colors.white,
                                      size: 22,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        TextButton.icon(
                          onPressed: _choosePhoto,
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.photo_outlined),
                          label: const Text('Change profile photo'),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 24),
                  TextField(
                    controller: display,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                    maxLength: 60,
                    decoration: _decoration(
                      'Display name',
                      Icons.person_outline_rounded,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  TextField(
                    controller: username,
                    autocorrect: false,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.none,
                    decoration: _decoration(
                      '@Username',
                      Icons.alternate_email_rounded,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  TextField(
                    controller: bio,
                    maxLines: 4,
                    maxLength: 160,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                    decoration: _decoration('Bio', Icons.notes_rounded),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 12, 20, 16),
              decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white,
                border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFECECF2))),
              ),
              child: SizedBox(
                width: double.infinity,
                height: 54,
                child: FilledButton(
                  onPressed: saving ? null : _save,
                  style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: violet,
                    foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: saving
                      ? const SizedBox(
                          width: 22,
                          height: 22,
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                            strokeWidth: 2,
                            color: Colors.white,
                          ),
                        )
                      : const Text(
                          'Save Changes',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 16,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          ),
                        ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class FollowListPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const FollowListPage({
    super.key,
    required this.profileId,
    required this.followers,
  });

  final String profileId;
  final bool followers;

  @override
  State<FollowListPage> createState() => _FollowListPageState();
}

class _FollowListPageState extends State<FollowListPage> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> users = [];
  final Set<String> _busyUsers = {};
  bool loading = true;
  String? error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        loading = true;
        error = null;
      });
    }
    try {
      final result = await SocialRepository.instance.followProfiles(
        profileId: widget.profileId,
        followers: widget.followers,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        users = result;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        error = e.toString();
        loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  Widget _followAction(Map<String, dynamic> user) {
    final id = (user['id'] ?? '').toString();
    final connected = user['is_connected'] == true;
    final followingBack = user['is_following_back'] == true;
    final busy = _busyUsers.contains(id);

    final label = connected
        ? 'Connected'
        : followingBack
        ? 'Following'
        : user['follow_request_pending'] == true
        ? 'Requested'
        : 'Follow back';

    return OutlinedButton(
      onPressed: busy || id.isEmpty || connected || followingBack
          ? null
          : () async {
              setState(() => _busyUsers.add(id));
              try {
                final repo = SocialRepository.instance;
                final privateAccount = await repo.isPrivateAccount(id);
                await repo.follow(id, privateAccount: privateAccount);
                if (!mounted) return;
                await _load();
              } catch (e) {
                if (mounted) {
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                    SnackBar(content: Text('Could not follow user: $e')),
                  );
                }
              } finally {
                if (mounted) setState(() => _busyUsers.remove(id));
              }
            },
      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
        foregroundColor: connected ? Colors.green.shade700 : violet,
        side: BorderSide(
          color: connected ? Colors.green.shade300 : const Color(0xFFDCD6FF),
        ),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 9),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13)),
      ),
      child: busy
          ? const SizedBox(
              width: 16,
              height: 16,
              child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: violet),
            )
          : Text(
              label,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
            ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final title = widget.followers ? 'Followers' : 'Following';
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: canvas,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        leading: IconButton(
          tooltip: 'Back',
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
        ),
        title: Text(
          title,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
        ),
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: loading
            ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: violet))
            : error != null
            ? Center(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      const Icon(
                        Icons.cloud_off_rounded,
                        size: 42,
                        color: muted,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      const Text(
                        'Could not load users',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          fontSize: 17,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Text(
                        error!,
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        style: const TextStyle(color: muted),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      FilledButton.icon(
                        onPressed: _load,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded),
                        label: const Text('Try again'),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              )
            : users.isEmpty
            ? Center(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                        color: Color(0xFFEDE9FF),
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      ),
                      child: const Icon(
                        Icons.people_outline_rounded,
                        size: 36,
                        color: violet,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    Text(
                      widget.followers
                          ? 'No followers yet'
                          : 'Not following anyone yet',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 17,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 5),
                    const Text(
                      'People will appear here when available.',
                      style: TextStyle(color: muted),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              )
            : RefreshIndicator(
                color: violet,
                onRefresh: _load,
                child: ListView.separated(
                  physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 24),
                  itemCount: users.length,
                  separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  itemBuilder: (_, index) {
                    final user = users[index];
                    final name = (user['display_name'] ?? '').toString().trim();
                    final username = (user['username'] ?? '').toString().trim();
                    final avatar = (user['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
                    return Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 14,
                        vertical: 12,
                      ),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFECECF2)),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          CircleAvatar(
                            radius: 27,
                            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFEDE9FF),
                            backgroundImage: avatar.isNotEmpty
                                ? NetworkImage(avatar)
                                : null,
                            child: avatar.isEmpty
                                ? const Icon(
                                    Icons.person_rounded,
                                    color: violet,
                                    size: 28,
                                  )
                                : null,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 13),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: [
                                Text(
                                  name.isEmpty ? username : name,
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                    fontSize: 15,
                                  ),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(height: 3),
                                Text(
                                  username.isEmpty ? '@user' : '@$username',
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    color: muted,
                                    fontSize: 13,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                          if (widget.followers &&
                              user['is_current_user'] != true) ...[
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            _followAction(user),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ProfilePageState extends State<ProfilePage> {
  bool _accountMenuOpen = false;

  int selectedTab = 0;
  int followersCount = 0;
  int followingCount = 0;
  bool _countsLoading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadFollowCounts();
  }

  Future<void> _logout() async {
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
        title: const Text('Log out of Twice?'),
        content: const Text(
          'You will be signed out of your account on this device.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFD92D20),
            ),
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
            child: const Text('Log out'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirmed != true || !mounted) return;

    try {
      await Supabase.instance.client.auth.signOut(scope: SignOutScope.local);
      // TwiceAuthGate listens to onAuthStateChange and returns to sign-in.
    } catch (_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('Could not log out. Please try again.')),
      );
    }
  }

  Widget _clickableFollowStat(String value, String label, bool followers) {
    return InkWell(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      onTap: _countsLoading
          ? null
          : () {
              Navigator.of(context).push(
                MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                  builder: (_) => FollowListPage(
                    profileId: (widget.profile['id'] ?? '').toString(),
                    followers: followers,
                  ),
                ),
              );
            },
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 5),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Text(
              value,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 3),
            Text(
              label,
              style: const TextStyle(
                color: muted,
                fontSize: 11,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _loadFollowCounts() async {
    final id = (widget.profile['id'] ?? '').toString();
    if (id.isEmpty) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _countsLoading = false);
      return;
    }
    try {
      final db = Supabase.instance.client;
      final values = await Future.wait<List<dynamic>>([
        db
            .from('follows')
            .select('follower_id')
            .eq('following_id', id)
            .eq('status', 'accepted'),
        db
            .from('follows')
            .select('following_id')
            .eq('follower_id', id)
            .eq('status', 'accepted'),
      ]);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        followersCount = values[0].length;
        followingCount = values[1].length;
        _countsLoading = false;
      });
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _countsLoading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant ProfilePage oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.profile['id'] != widget.profile['id']) {
      _countsLoading = true;
      _loadFollowCounts();
    }
  }

  List<SocialPost> get _myPosts => widget.posts
      .where(
        (p) =>
            p.data['user_id'] == Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id,
      )
      .toList();

  List<SocialPost> get _visiblePosts {
    if (selectedTab == 1) {
      return _myPosts
          .where(
            (p) => p.media.any(
              (m) =>
                  (m['media_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() == 'image',
            ),
          )
          .toList();
    }
    if (selectedTab == 2) {
      return _myPosts
          .where(
            (p) => p.media.any(
              (m) =>
                  (m['media_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() == 'video',
            ),
          )
          .toList();
    }
    return _myPosts;
  }

class MessagesPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const MessagesPage({super.key});
  @override
  State<MessagesPage> createState() => _MessagesPageState();
}

class _MessagesPageState extends State<MessagesPage> {
  late Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> future;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    future = SocialRepository.instance.conversations();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Messages')),
    body: FutureBuilder<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      future: future,
      builder: (_, s) {
        if (s.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
          return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
        }
        if (s.hasError) {
          return Center(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: Text('Could not load conversations: ${s.error}'),
            ),
          );
        }
        final rows = s.data ?? [];
        if (rows.isEmpty) {
          return const Center(child: Text('No conversations yet'));
        }
        return ListView.builder(
          itemCount: rows.length,
          itemBuilder: (_, i) {
            final r = rows[i];
            final c = r['conversations'] as Map? ?? {};
            return ListTile(
              leading: const CircleAvatar(child: Icon(Icons.person)),
              title: Text((c['title'] ?? 'Conversation').toString()),
              subtitle: const Text('Open conversation'),
              onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).push(
                MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                  builder: (_) => ConversationPage(
                    id: r['conversation_id'].toString(),
                    title: (c['title'] ?? 'Conversation').toString(),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    ),
  );
}

class ConversationPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ConversationPage({super.key, required this.id, required this.title});
  final String id, title;
  @override
  State<ConversationPage> createState() => _ConversationPageState();
}

class _ConversationPageState extends State<ConversationPage> {
  final controller = TextEditingController();
  late Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> future;
  bool sending = false;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    future = SocialRepository.instance.messages(widget.id);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _send() async {
    final body = controller.text.trim();
    if (body.isEmpty || sending) return;
    setState(() => sending = true);
    try {
      await SocialRepository.instance.sendMessage(widget.id, body);
      if (!mounted) return;
      controller.clear();
      setState(() => future = SocialRepository.instance.messages(widget.id));
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
            .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Message failed: $e')));
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => sending = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.title)),
    body: Column(
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: FutureBuilder<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
            future: future,
            builder: (_, s) {
              if (s.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
                return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
              }
              if (s.hasError) {
                return Center(
                  child: Text('Could not load messages: ${s.error}'),
                );
              }
              final rows = s.data ?? [];
              return ListView.builder(
                reverse: false,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                itemCount: rows.length,
                itemBuilder: (_, i) {
                  final r = rows[i];
                  final own =
                      r['sender_id'] ==
                      Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
                  return Align(
                    alignment: own
                        ? Alignment.centerRight
                        : Alignment.centerLeft,
                    child: Container(
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: own ? const Color(0xFFECE7FF) : Colors.white,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                      ),
                      child: Text((r['body'] ?? '').toString()),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
        SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: TextField(
                    controller: controller,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(hintText: 'Message…'),
                  ),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  onPressed: sending ? null : _send,
                  icon: sending
                      ? const SizedBox(
                          width: 18,
                          height: 18,
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                        )
                      : const Icon(Icons.send, color: violet),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math';

import 'package:photo_manager/photo_manager.dart';
import 'package:video_thumbnail/video_thumbnail.dart';

import 'local_cache.dart';
import 'offline_media_cache.dart';

import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

/// Supabase data boundary for Twice. UI widgets should call this repository
/// rather than issuing database requests directly.
class SocialRepository {
  SocialRepository._();
  static final SocialRepository instance = SocialRepository._();
  SupabaseClient get _db => Supabase.instance.client;
  String get userId => _db.auth.currentUser!.id;
  LocalCache get _cache => LocalCache.instance;

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> cachedFeed() async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return [];
    final value = await _cache.get(uid, 'feed');
    if (value is! List) return [];
    return value.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList();
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> cachedMyProfile() async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return null;
    final value = await _cache.get(uid, 'profile');
    return value is Map ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(value) : null;
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _resolveProfileAvatar(
    Map<String, dynamic> row,
  ) async {
    final path = (row['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    row['avatar_object_path'] = path.startsWith('http') ? '' : path;
    if (path.isEmpty || path.startsWith('http')) return row;
    try {
      final local = await OfflineMediaCache.instance.existingUri(
        'post-media',
        path,
      );
      if (local != null) {
        row['avatar_url'] = local;
      } else {
        final signed = await _db.storage
            .from('post-media')
            .createSignedUrl(path, 3600);
        row['avatar_url'] = signed;
        unawaited(
          _warmAvatarCache(row, path, signed).catchError((Object _) {}),
        );
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Keep the stored path if storage cannot resolve it.
    }
    return row;
  }

  Future<void> _warmAvatarCache(
    Map<String, dynamic> profile,
    String objectPath,
    String signedUrl,
  ) async {
    final local = await OfflineMediaCache.instance.cacheFromUrl(
      bucket: 'post-media',
      objectPath: objectPath,
      signedUrl: signedUrl,
      isVideo: false,
    );
    if (local == null) return;
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    final profileId = profile['id']?.toString();
    if (uid == null || profileId == null) return;
    if (profileId == uid) {
      final cachedProfile = await _cache.get(uid, 'profile');
      if (cachedProfile is Map &&
          cachedProfile['avatar_url']?.toString() == signedUrl) {
        cachedProfile['avatar_url'] = local;
        await _cache.put(uid, 'profile', cachedProfile);
      }
    }
    final cachedFeed = await _cache.get(uid, 'feed');
    if (cachedFeed is List) {
      for (final rawPost in cachedFeed) {
        if (rawPost is! Map) continue;
        final author = rawPost['profiles'];
        if (author is Map &&
            author['id']?.toString() == profileId &&
            author['avatar_url']?.toString() == signedUrl) {
          author['avatar_url'] = local;
        }
      }
      await _cache.put(uid, 'feed', cachedFeed);
    }
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> ensureProfile() async {
    final user = _db.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) throw AuthException('Please sign in again.');
    final existing = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select()
        .eq('id', user.id)
        .maybeSingle();
    final meta = user.userMetadata ?? const <String, dynamic>{};
    if (existing != null) {
      final row = Map<String, dynamic>.from(existing);
      final currentName = (row['display_name'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      final metadataName = (meta['name'] ?? meta['full_name'] ?? '')
          .toString()
          .trim();
      if (currentName.isEmpty && metadataName.isNotEmpty) {
        await _db
            .from('profiles')
            .update({'display_name': metadataName})
            .eq('id', user.id);
        row['display_name'] = metadataName;
      }
      return await _resolveProfileAvatar(row);
    }
    final baseRaw = _slug(
      (meta['name'] ??
              meta['full_name'] ??
              user.email?.split('@').first ??
              'twice_user')
          .toString(),
    );
    final base = baseRaw.length > 20 ? baseRaw.substring(0, 20) : baseRaw;
    var username = base.isEmpty ? 'twice_user' : base;
    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      final found = await _db
          .from('profiles')
          .select('id')
          .eq('username', username)
          .maybeSingle();
      if (found == null) break;
      username =
          '${base.isEmpty ? 'twice_user' : base}_${user.id.substring(0, 4 + i)}';
    }
    final display = (meta['name'] ?? meta['full_name'] ?? username)
        .toString()
        .trim();
    await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .upsert(
          {
            'id': user.id,
            'username': username,
            'display_name': display.isEmpty ? username : display,
          },
          onConflict: 'id',
          ignoreDuplicates: true,
        );
    final result = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select()
        .eq('id', user.id)
        .single();
    return await _resolveProfileAvatar(Map<String, dynamic>.from(result));
  }

  String _slug(String value) {
    final cleaned = value
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9_]'), '_')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'_+'), '_')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'^_|_$'), '');
    return cleaned.length > 24 ? cleaned.substring(0, 24) : cleaned;
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> myProfile() async {
    await ensureProfile();
    final row = await _db.from('profiles').select().eq('id', userId).single();
    final resolved = await _resolveProfileAvatar(
      Map<String, dynamic>.from(row),
    );
    await _cache.put(userId, 'profile', resolved);
    return resolved;
  }

  Future<void> updateProfile({
    required String displayName,
    required String username,
    required String bio,
    AssetEntity? avatarAsset,
  }) async {
    final clean = username.trim().replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^@'), '').toLowerCase();
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9_]{3,30}$').hasMatch(clean)) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Username must be 3–30 characters using letters, numbers, or underscores.',
      );
    }

    final values = <String, dynamic>{
      'display_name': displayName.trim(),
      'username': clean,
      'bio': bio.trim(),
    };

    if (avatarAsset != null) {
      final file = await avatarAsset.file;
      if (file == null) {
        throw Exception('Could not read the selected profile photo.');
      }
      final ext = file.path.split('.').last.toLowerCase();
      final objectPath =
          '$userId/avatar_${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}.$ext';

      await _db.storage
          .from('post-media')
          .upload(
            objectPath,
            file,
            fileOptions: FileOptions(contentType: _mime(ext), upsert: false),
          );

      // Store the storage path, not an expiring signed URL.
      values['avatar_url'] = objectPath;
      try {
        await _db.from('profiles').update(values).eq('id', userId);
      } catch (_) {
        try {
          await _db.storage.from('post-media').remove([objectPath]);
        } catch (_) {}
        rethrow;
      }
    } else {
      await _db.from('profiles').update(values).eq('id', userId);
    }
    try {
      await _cache.put(userId, 'profile', await myProfile());
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> feed({
    int limit = 30,
    int offset = 0,
  }) async {
    await ensureProfile();
    final rows = await _db
        .from('posts')
        .select(
          'id,user_id,caption,visibility,comments_enabled,created_at,profiles!posts_user_id_fkey(id,username,display_name,avatar_url),post_media(id,media_url,thumbnail_url,media_type,position),post_likes(user_id),saved_posts(user_id)',
        )
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
    final resolved = await Future.wait<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      (rows as List).map((raw) async {
        final post = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map);
        final authorRaw = post['profiles'];

        // Resolve the avatar and media independently to reduce feed latency.
        final avatarFuture = authorRaw is Map
            ? _resolveProfileAvatar(Map<String, dynamic>.from(authorRaw))
            : Future<Map<String, dynamic>?>.value(null);
        final mediaFuture = _resolveMedia(
          post['post_media'] as List? ?? const [],
          'post-media',
        );
        final values = await Future.wait<dynamic>([avatarFuture, mediaFuture]);

        if (values[0] is Map<String, dynamic>) {
          post['profiles'] = values[0];
        }
        post['media_resolved'] = values[1] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
        return post;
      }),
    );
    await _cache.put(userId, 'feed', resolved);
    // Do not block first paint on media downloads. Successfully downloaded
    // media paths are persisted into this feed cache for the next offline launch.
    unawaited(_warmFeedMediaCache(resolved).catchError((Object _) {}));
    return resolved;
  }

  Future<void> _warmFeedMediaCache(List<Map<String, dynamic>> feedRows) async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;
    var warmed = 0;
    for (final post in feedRows) {
      final media = (post['media_resolved'] as List? ?? const []);
      for (final raw in media) {
        if (warmed >= 12) return; // Bound background data usage per refresh.
        if (raw is! Map) continue;
        final item = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);
        final objectPath = (item['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        final url = (item['resolved_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        if (objectPath.isEmpty || url.isEmpty || url.startsWith('file://')) {
          continue;
        }
        warmed++;
        final type = (item['media_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
        final local = await OfflineMediaCache.instance.cacheFromUrl(
          bucket: 'post-media',
          objectPath: objectPath,
          signedUrl: url,
          isVideo: type == 'video',
        );
        if (local == null) continue;
        item['resolved_url'] = local;
        final thumbnailPath = (item['thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        final thumbnailUrl = (item['resolved_thumbnail_url'] ?? '')
            .toString()
            .trim();
        if (thumbnailPath.isNotEmpty &&
            thumbnailUrl.isNotEmpty &&
            !thumbnailUrl.startsWith('file://')) {
          final localThumb = await OfflineMediaCache.instance.cacheFromUrl(
            bucket: 'post-media',
            objectPath: thumbnailPath,
            signedUrl: thumbnailUrl,
            isVideo: false,
          );
          if (localThumb != null) item['resolved_thumbnail_url'] = localThumb;
        }
        final liveMedia = (post['media_resolved'] as List? ?? const []);
        for (var i = 0; i < liveMedia.length; i++) {
          if (liveMedia[i] is Map &&
              liveMedia[i]['media_url']?.toString() == objectPath) {
            liveMedia[i]['resolved_url'] = local;
            if (item['resolved_thumbnail_url']?.toString().startsWith(
                  'file://',
                ) ==
                true) {
              liveMedia[i]['resolved_thumbnail_url'] =
                  item['resolved_thumbnail_url'];
            }
          }
        }
        final cached = await _cache.get(uid, 'feed');
        if (cached is List) {
          for (final cachedRaw in cached) {
            if (cachedRaw is! Map) continue;
            if (cachedRaw['id']?.toString() != post['id']?.toString()) {
              continue;
            }
            final cachedMedia =
                (cachedRaw['media_resolved'] as List? ?? const []);
            for (final cachedItem in cachedMedia) {
              if (cachedItem is Map &&
                  cachedItem['media_url']?.toString() == objectPath) {
                cachedItem['resolved_url'] = local;
                if (item['resolved_thumbnail_url']?.toString().startsWith(
                      'file://',
                    ) ==
                    true) {
                  cachedItem['resolved_thumbnail_url'] =
                      item['resolved_thumbnail_url'];
                }
              }
            }
          }
          await _cache.put(uid, 'feed', cached);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /// Refreshes a storage object's URL, preferring a complete offline copy.
  /// Returns null when the object cannot be resolved.
  Future<String?> refreshMediaUrl(
    String objectPath, {
    String bucket = 'post-media',
  }) async {
    final path = objectPath.trim();
    if (path.isEmpty) return null;
    if (path.startsWith('http://') || path.startsWith('https://')) {
      return path;
    }

    try {
      final local = await OfflineMediaCache.instance.existingUri(bucket, path);
      if (local != null) return local;
      return await _db.storage.from(bucket).createSignedUrl(path, 3600);
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _resolveMedia(
    List rows,
    String bucket,
  ) async {
    return Future.wait<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      rows.map((raw) async {
        final item = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map);
        final path = (item['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        final thumbnailPath = (item['thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();

        // Resolve the main media and thumbnail concurrently.
        final urls = await Future.wait<String>([
          _resolveOneMediaUrl(path, bucket),
          _resolveOneMediaUrl(thumbnailPath, bucket),
        ]);
        item['resolved_url'] = urls[0];
        item['resolved_thumbnail_url'] = urls[1];
        return item;
      }),
    );
  }

  Future<String> _resolveOneMediaUrl(String path, String bucket) async {
    if (path.isEmpty) return '';
    if (path.startsWith('http://') || path.startsWith('https://')) {
      return path;
    }

    try {
      final local = await OfflineMediaCache.instance.existingUri(bucket, path);
      if (local != null) return local;
      return await _db.storage.from(bucket).createSignedUrl(path, 3600);
    } catch (_) {
      return '';
    }
  }

  bool _looksLikeNetworkFailure(Object error) {
    final text = error.toString().toLowerCase();
    return text.contains('socketexception') ||
        text.contains('failed host lookup') ||
        text.contains('clientexception') ||
        text.contains('connection reset') ||
        text.contains('connection refused') ||
        text.contains('connection aborted') ||
        text.contains('connection closed') ||
        text.contains('connection terminated') ||
        text.contains('network is unreachable') ||
        text.contains('no address associated with hostname') ||
        text.contains('handshakeexception') ||
        text.contains('broken pipe') ||
        text.contains('socket is not connected') ||
        text.contains('software caused connection abort') ||
        text.contains('timed out') ||
        text.contains('timeout');
  }

  Future<void> _applyLikeState(String postId, bool liked) async {
    if (liked) {
      await _db
          .from('post_likes')
          .upsert(
            {'post_id': postId, 'user_id': userId},
            onConflict: 'post_id,user_id',
            ignoreDuplicates: true,
          );
    } else {
      await _db
          .from('post_likes')
          .delete()
          .eq('post_id', postId)
          .eq('user_id', userId);
    }
  }

  /// Applies the requested state, queueing only likely connectivity failures.
  /// The payload is a desired state, not a toggle, so retries are idempotent.
  Future<void> setLikeState(String postId, bool liked) async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) throw AuthException('Please sign in again.');

    try {
      await _applyLikeState(postId, liked);
      final pending = await _cache.pending(uid);
      for (final item in pending) {
        if (item['operation'] == 'set_like' &&
            item['payload'] is Map &&
            item['payload']['post_id'] == postId) {
          await _cache.removePending(item['id'].toString());
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!_looksLikeNetworkFailure(error)) rethrow;
      await _cache.enqueue(uid, 'set_like', {
        'post_id': postId,
        'liked': liked,
      });
    }
    await _updateCachedLike(postId, liked);
  }

  /// Kept for existing callers: currentlyLiked is the state before the tap.
  Future<void> toggleLike(String postId, bool currentlyLiked) async {
    await setLikeState(postId, !currentlyLiked);
  }

  Future<void> _updateCachedLike(String postId, bool liked) async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;
    final cached = await _cache.get(uid, 'feed');
    if (cached is! List) return;

    final updated = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (final raw in cached) {
      if (raw is! Map) continue;
      final post = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);
      if (post['id']?.toString() == postId) {
        final likes = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
          (post['post_likes'] as List? ?? const []).whereType<Map>().map(
            (row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row),
          ),
        );
        likes.removeWhere((row) => row['user_id']?.toString() == uid);
        if (liked) likes.add({'user_id': uid});
        post['post_likes'] = likes;
      }
      updated.add(post);
    }
    await _cache.put(uid, 'feed', updated);
  }

  /// Replays queued likes and comments for the signed-in account.
  Future<void> syncPendingLikes() async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;

    final pending = await _cache.pending(uid);
    for (final item in pending) {
      if (item['operation'] != 'set_like' &&
          item['operation'] != 'add_comment') {
        continue;
      }
      try {
        final payload = Map<String, dynamic>.from(item['payload'] as Map);
        if (item['operation'] == 'add_comment') {
          await _db
              .from('comments')
              .upsert(payload, onConflict: 'id', ignoreDuplicates: true)
              .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
          await _cache.removePending(item['id'].toString());
          continue;
        }
        final postId = payload['post_id']?.toString();
        if (postId == null || postId.isEmpty) {
          await _cache.removePending(item['id'].toString());
          continue;
        }
        final liked = payload['liked'] == true;
        await _applyLikeState(postId, liked);
        await _updateCachedLike(postId, liked);
        await _cache.removePending(item['id'].toString());
      } catch (error) {
        await _cache.markFailed(item['id'].toString(), error);
        if (_looksLikeNetworkFailure(error)) break;
        // A permanent policy/schema error should not block unrelated queued
        // operations. Keep the row for diagnostics and continue with the next.
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> toggleSaved(String postId, bool saved) async {
    if (saved) {
      await _db
          .from('saved_posts')
          .delete()
          .eq('post_id', postId)
          .eq('user_id', userId);
    } else {
      await _db
          .from('saved_posts')
          .upsert(
            {'post_id': postId, 'user_id': userId},
            onConflict: 'user_id,post_id',
            ignoreDuplicates: true,
          );
    }
  }

  Future<String> publishPost(
    String caption,
    List<AssetEntity> assets, {
    String visibility = 'public',
  }) async {
    final text = caption.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty && assets.isEmpty) {
      throw const FormatException('Add a caption or select media.');
    }
    final created = await _db
        .from('posts')
        .insert({'user_id': userId, 'caption': text, 'visibility': visibility})
        .select('id')
        .single();
    final postId = created['id'].toString();
    final uploadedPaths = <String>[];
    try {
      var position = 0;
      for (final asset in assets) {
        final file = await asset.file;
        if (file == null) continue;
        final ext = file.path.split('.').last.toLowerCase();
        final type = asset.type == AssetType.video
            ? 'video'
            : (ext == 'gif' ? 'gif' : 'image');
        final objectPath =
            '$userId/$postId/${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}_$position.$ext';
        await _db.storage
            .from('post-media')
            .upload(
              objectPath,
              file,
              fileOptions: FileOptions(contentType: _mime(ext), upsert: false),
            );
        uploadedPaths.add(objectPath);

        String? thumbnailPath;
        if (type == 'video') {
          try {
            final bytes = await VideoThumbnail.thumbnailData(
              video: file.path,
              imageFormat: ImageFormat.JPEG,
              maxWidth: 720,
              quality: 78,
            );
            if (bytes != null && bytes.isNotEmpty) {
              final candidate =
                  '$userId/$postId/${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}_${position}_thumb.jpg';
              await _db.storage
                  .from('post-media')
                  .uploadBinary(
                    candidate,
                    bytes,
                    fileOptions: const FileOptions(
                      contentType: 'image/jpeg',
                      upsert: false,
                    ),
                  );
              uploadedPaths.add(candidate);
              thumbnailPath = candidate;
            }
          } catch (_) {
            // Thumbnail extraction is optional; preserve the video upload.
          }
        }

        await _db.from('post_media').insert({
          'post_id': postId,
          'media_url': objectPath,
          'thumbnail_url': thumbnailPath,
          'media_type': type,
          'position': position,
        });
        position++;
      }
      return postId;
    } catch (_) {
      // Avoid leaving a half-created post or orphaned storage objects.
      if (uploadedPaths.isNotEmpty) {
        try {
          await _db.storage.from('post-media').remove(uploadedPaths);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      await _db.from('posts').delete().eq('id', postId);
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> loadStories() async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('stories')
        .select('id,user_id,media_url,media_type,caption,created_at,expires_at')
        .gt('expires_at', DateTime.now().toUtc().toIso8601String())
        .order('created_at', ascending: true);

    final stories = (rows as List)
        .map((row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row as Map))
        .toList();

    if (stories.isEmpty) return stories;

    final ids = stories
        .map((story) => story['user_id'].toString())
        .toSet()
        .toList();

    final profiles = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id,username,display_name,avatar_url')
        .inFilter('id', ids);

    final byId = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
    for (final raw in profiles as List) {
      final profile = await _resolveProfileAvatar(
        Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map),
      );
      byId[profile['id'].toString()] = profile;
    }

    for (final story in stories) {
      story['profiles'] = byId[story['user_id'].toString()] ?? {};
      final path = (story['media_url'] ?? '').toString();
      try {
        story['resolved_url'] = path.startsWith('http')
            ? path
            : await _db.storage.from('stories').createSignedUrl(path, 3600);
      } catch (_) {
        story['resolved_url'] = '';
      }
    }

    return stories;
  }

  Future<void> publishStory(AssetEntity asset, String caption) async {
    final file = await asset.file;
    if (file == null) {
      throw Exception('Could not read the selected story media.');
    }

    final ext = file.path.split('.').last.toLowerCase();
    final storyId = await _db
        .from('stories')
        .insert({
          'user_id': userId,
          'media_url': 'pending',
          'media_type': asset.type == AssetType.video ? 'video' : 'image',
          'caption': caption.trim(),
        })
        .select('id')
        .single();

    final id = storyId['id'].toString();
    final objectPath =
        '$userId/$id/${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}.$ext';

    try {
      await _db.storage
          .from('stories')
          .upload(
            objectPath,
            file,
            fileOptions: FileOptions(contentType: _mime(ext), upsert: false),
          );

      await _db.from('stories').update({'media_url': objectPath}).eq('id', id);
    } catch (_) {
      try {
        await _db.storage.from('stories').remove([objectPath]);
      } catch (_) {}
      try {
        await _db.from('stories').delete().eq('id', id);
      } catch (_) {}
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  String _mime(String ext) => switch (ext) {
    'jpg' => 'image/jpeg',
    'jpeg' => 'image/jpeg',
    'jpe' => 'image/jpeg',
    'png' => 'image/png',
    'webp' => 'image/webp',
    'gif' => 'image/gif',
    'mp4' => 'video/mp4',
    'm4v' => 'video/x-m4v',
    'mov' => 'video/quicktime',
    'webm' => 'video/webm',
    'mkv' => 'video/x-matroska',
    '3gp' => 'video/3gpp',
    'heic' => 'image/heic',
    'heif' => 'image/heif',
    'avif' => 'image/avif',
    _ => 'application/octet-stream',
  };

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> search(String query) async {
    final q = query.trim();
    if (q.isEmpty) return [];
    final safe = q
        .replaceAll('%', r'\%')
        .replaceAll('_', r'\_')
        .replaceAll(',', ' ')
        .replaceAll('(', ' ')
        .replaceAll(')', ' ');
    final results = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    final byUsername = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id,username,display_name,bio,avatar_url,is_private')
        .ilike('username', '%$safe%')
        .limit(20);
    final byName = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id,username,display_name,bio,avatar_url,is_private')
        .ilike('display_name', '%$safe%')
        .limit(20);
    final usersById = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
    for (final row in [...byUsername, ...byName]) {
      final user = Map<String, dynamic>.from(row as Map);
      usersById[user['id'].toString()] = user;
    }
    results.addAll(usersById.values.map((e) => {...e, 'result_type': 'user'}));
    final posts = await _db
        .from('posts')
        .select(
          'id,user_id,caption,created_at,profiles!posts_user_id_fkey(username,display_name,avatar_url)',
        )
        .ilike('caption', '%$safe%')
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .limit(20);
    results.addAll(
      (posts as List).map(
        (e) => {...Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map), 'result_type': 'post'},
      ),
    );
    return results;
  }

  Future<String> getFollowLabel(String profileId) async {
    if (profileId.isEmpty || profileId == userId) return '';

    final outgoing = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('status')
        .eq('follower_id', userId)
        .eq('following_id', profileId)
        .maybeSingle();

    final incoming = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('status')
        .eq('follower_id', profileId)
        .eq('following_id', userId)
        .maybeSingle();

    final outgoingStatus = (outgoing?['status'] ?? '').toString();
    final incomingStatus = (incoming?['status'] ?? '').toString();

    if (outgoingStatus == 'pending') return 'Requested';
    final followsMe = incomingStatus == 'accepted';
    final iFollow = outgoingStatus == 'accepted';

    if (iFollow && followsMe) return 'Connected';
    if (iFollow) return 'Following';
    if (followsMe) return 'Follow Back';
    return 'Follow';
  }

  Future<bool> isFollowing(String profileId) async =>
      await _db
          .from('follows')
          .select('follower_id')
          .eq('follower_id', userId)
          .eq('following_id', profileId)
          .eq('status', 'accepted')
          .maybeSingle() !=
      null;

  Future<bool> isConnected(String profileId) async {
    final outgoing = await isFollowing(profileId);
    if (!outgoing) return false;
    final incoming = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('follower_id')
        .eq('follower_id', profileId)
        .eq('following_id', userId)
        .eq('status', 'accepted')
        .maybeSingle();
    return incoming != null;
  }

  Future<bool> isPrivateAccount(String profileId) async {
    final row = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('is_private')
        .eq('id', profileId)
        .maybeSingle();
    return row?['is_private'] == true;
  }

  Future<void> follow(String profileId, {required bool privateAccount}) async {
    if (profileId == userId) {
      throw ArgumentError('You cannot follow your own account.');
    }

    final existing = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('follower_id')
        .eq('follower_id', userId)
        .eq('following_id', profileId)
        .maybeSingle();

    if (existing != null) return;

    try {
      await _db.from('follows').insert({
        'follower_id': userId,
        'following_id': profileId,
        'status': privateAccount ? 'pending' : 'accepted',
      });
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      // A concurrent tap may have created the same relationship already.
      if (e.code == '23505') return;
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> unfollow(String profileId) async {
    await _db
        .from('follows')
        .delete()
        .eq('follower_id', userId)
        .eq('following_id', profileId);
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> followProfiles({
    required String profileId,
    required bool followers,
  }) async {
    final relationshipColumn = followers ? 'following_id' : 'follower_id';
    final resultColumn = followers ? 'follower_id' : 'following_id';

    final relations = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select(resultColumn)
        .eq(relationshipColumn, profileId)
        .eq('status', 'accepted');

    final ids = (relations as List)
        .map((row) => (row[resultColumn] ?? '').toString())
        .where((id) => id.isNotEmpty)
        .toSet()
        .toList();

    if (ids.isEmpty) return [];

    final rows = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id,display_name,username,avatar_url,is_private')
        .inFilter('id', ids)
        .order('display_name');

    final profiles = (rows as List)
        .map((row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row as Map))
        .toList();

    final currentUserId = userId;
    final outgoingRows = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('following_id,status')
        .eq('follower_id', currentUserId)
        .inFilter('following_id', ids);
    final outgoingStatus = <String, String>{};
    for (final row in outgoingRows as List) {
      outgoingStatus[(row['following_id'] ?? '').toString()] =
          (row['status'] ?? '').toString();
    }

    for (final profile in profiles) {
      final id = (profile['id'] ?? '').toString();
      final status = outgoingStatus[id];
      profile['is_following_back'] = status == 'accepted';
      profile['follow_request_pending'] = status == 'pending';
      profile['is_connected'] = id.isNotEmpty ? await isConnected(id) : false;
      profile['is_current_user'] = id == currentUserId;
    }

    return Future.wait(profiles.map(_resolveProfileAvatar));
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> comments(String postId) async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) throw AuthException('Please sign in again.');
    try {
      final rows = await _db
          .from('comments')
          .select(
            'id,post_id,user_id,parent_id,body,created_at,profiles!comments_user_id_fkey(id,username,display_name,avatar_url)',
          )
          .eq('post_id', postId)
          .order('created_at')
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
      final result = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      for (final raw in rows as List) {
        final row = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map);
        final rawProfile = row['profiles'];
        if (rawProfile is Map) {
          final profile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawProfile);
          if (profile.isNotEmpty) {
            row['profiles'] = await _resolveProfileAvatar(profile);
          }
        } else if (rawProfile is List && rawProfile.isNotEmpty) {
          final profile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawProfile.first as Map);
          row['profiles'] = await _resolveProfileAvatar(profile);
        }
        result.add(row);
      }
      await _cache.put(uid, 'comments', result, id: postId);
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      if (_looksLikeNetworkFailure(error)) {
        return cachedComments(postId);
      }
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> cachedComments(String postId) async {
    final value = await _cache.get(userId, 'comments', id: postId);
    if (value is! List) return [];
    return value.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList();
  }

  String _newCommentId() {
    final random = Random.secure();
    final bytes = List<int>.generate(16, (_) => random.nextInt(256));
    bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
    bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
    final hex = bytes.map((b) => b.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0')).join();
    return '${hex.substring(0, 8)}-${hex.substring(8, 12)}-'
        '${hex.substring(12, 16)}-${hex.substring(16, 20)}-${hex.substring(20)}';
  }

  /// Returns true when confirmed by Supabase; false when safely queued offline.
  Future<bool> addComment(
    String postId,
    String body, {
    String? commentId,
  }) async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) throw AuthException('Please sign in again.');
    final text = body.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return true;
    final id = commentId ?? _newCommentId();

    // Use the cached profile for immediate/offline comments. If the profile
    // has not been cached yet, fall back to available auth metadata.
    final cachedProfile = await _cache.get(uid, 'profile');
    final user = _db.auth.currentUser!;
    final metadata = user.userMetadata ?? const <String, dynamic>{};
    final authorProfile = cachedProfile is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(cachedProfile)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    authorProfile['id'] ??= uid;
    authorProfile['username'] ??=
        (metadata['username'] ?? user.email?.split('@').first ?? 'user')
            .toString();
    authorProfile['display_name'] ??=
        (metadata['display_name'] ??
                metadata['name'] ??
                metadata['full_name'] ??
                authorProfile['username'])
            .toString();

    final payload = <String, dynamic>{
      'id': id,
      'post_id': postId,
      'user_id': uid,
      'body': text,
    };
    try {
      await _db
          .from('comments')
          .insert(payload)
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
      final pending = await _cache.pending(uid);
      for (final item in pending) {
        if (item['operation'] == 'add_comment' &&
            item['payload'] is Map &&
            item['payload']['id'] == id) {
          await _cache.removePending(item['id'].toString());
        }
      }
      final cached = await _cache.get(uid, 'comments', id: postId);
      final rows = cached is List
          ? cached.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList()
          : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      if (!rows.any((row) => row['id']?.toString() == id)) {
        rows.add({
          ...payload,
          'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
          'profiles': authorProfile,
        });
        await _cache.put(uid, 'comments', rows, id: postId);
      }
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      if (!_looksLikeNetworkFailure(error)) rethrow;
      await _cache.enqueue(uid, 'add_comment', payload);
      final cached = await _cache.get(uid, 'comments', id: postId);
      final rows = cached is List
          ? cached.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList()
          : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      if (!rows.any((row) => row['id']?.toString() == id)) {
        rows.add({
          ...payload,
          'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
          'profiles': authorProfile,
          '_queued': true,
        });
        await _cache.put(uid, 'comments', rows, id: postId);
      }
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> notifications() async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('notifications')
        .select(
          'id,type,is_read,created_at,profiles!notifications_actor_id_fkey(username,display_name,avatar_url),posts(caption)',
        )
        .eq('recipient_id', userId)
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .limit(50);
    return (rows as List)
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
        .toList();
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> myPosts() async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('posts')
        .select(
          'id,user_id,caption,created_at,post_media(media_url,media_type,position)',
        )
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .limit(100);
    return (rows as List)
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
        .toList();
  }

  Future<int> count(String table, String column, String value) async {
    final rows = await _db.from(table).select(column).eq(column, value);
    return (rows as List).length;
  }

  Future<String> createConversation(String otherUserId) async {
    final session = _db.auth.currentSession;
    if (session == null) {
      throw AuthException('Your session has expired. Please sign in again.');
    }

    // Validate the active access token with Supabase before writing.
    final verified = await _db.auth.getUser();
    final verifiedUser = verified.user;
    if (verifiedUser == null) {
      throw AuthException(
        'Could not verify your account. Please sign in again.',
      );
    }
    final uid = verifiedUser.id;

    if (uid != session.user.id) {
      throw AuthException(
        'Authentication identity mismatch. Please sign out and sign in again.',
      );
    }

    if (otherUserId == uid) {
      throw const FormatException('You cannot message yourself.');
    }

    final existing = await _db
        .from('conversation_members')
        .select('conversation_id')
        .eq('user_id', uid);

    for (final row in (existing as List)) {
      final id = row['conversation_id'].toString();
      final other = await _db
          .from('conversation_members')
          .select('user_id')
          .eq('conversation_id', id)
          .eq('user_id', otherUserId)
          .maybeSingle();
      if (other != null) return id;
    }

    final created = await _db
        .from('conversations')
        .insert({'created_by': uid, 'is_group': false})
        .select('id')
        .single();

    final id = created['id'].toString();

    await _db.from('conversation_members').insert([
      {'conversation_id': id, 'user_id': uid},
      {'conversation_id': id, 'user_id': otherUserId},
    ]);

    return id;
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> conversations() async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('conversation_members')
        .select(
          'conversation_id,last_read_at,conversations(id,title,is_group,created_at)',
        )
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .order('joined_at', ascending: false);
    return (rows as List)
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
        .toList();
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> messages(String conversationId) async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('messages')
        .select(
          'id,conversation_id,sender_id,body,media_url,media_type,created_at',
        )
        .eq('conversation_id', conversationId)
        .isFilter('deleted_at', null)
        .order('created_at')
        .limit(200);
    return (rows as List)
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
        .toList();
  }

  Future<void> sendMessage(String conversationId, String body) async {
    if (body.trim().isEmpty) return;
    await _db.from('messages').insert({
      'conversation_id': conversationId,
      'sender_id': userId,
      'body': body.trim(),
    });
  }
}

ImageProvider<Object> _twiceImageProvider(
  String source, {
  int maxDimension = 1080,
}) {
  final value = source.trim();
  if (value.startsWith('file://')) {
    return ResizeImage.resizeIfNeeded(
      maxDimension,
      null,
      FileImage(File.fromUri(Uri.parse(value))),
    );
  }
  if (value.startsWith('/')) {
    return ResizeImage.resizeIfNeeded(maxDimension, null, FileImage(File(value)));
  }
  return TwiceNetworkImage(value, maxDimension: maxDimension);
}

ImageProvider<Object> _twiceAvatarProvider(String source) =>
    _twiceImageProvider(source, maxDimension: 256);

String _formatClock(int seconds) =>
    '${seconds ~/ 60}:${(seconds % 60).toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

// A usable image source is a network URL OR a saved local copy (file:// or a
// device path). Saved avatars become file:// after they are cached.
bool _isImageSource(String value) {
  final v = value.trim();
  return v.startsWith('http') || v.startsWith('file://') || v.startsWith('/');
}

String _newTwiceUuid() {
  final random = Random.secure();
  final bytes = List<int>.generate(16, (_) => random.nextInt(256));
  bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
  bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
  final hex = bytes.map((b) => b.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0')).join();
  return '${hex.substring(0, 8)}-${hex.substring(8, 12)}-'
      '${hex.substring(12, 16)}-${hex.substring(16, 20)}-${hex.substring(20)}';
}

const ink = Color(0xFF171923);
const muted = Color(0xFF7B8191);
const violet = Color(0xFF7257F5);
const canvas = Color(0xFFF7F7FB);

const supabaseUrl = String.fromEnvironment('SUPABASE_URL');
const supabasePublishableKey= [REDACTED]
  'SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY',
);

bool get supabaseConfigured =>
    supabaseUrl.startsWith('https://') && supabasePublishableKey.isNotEmpty;

// True only after Supabase has initialized successfully. If configuration is
// missing or initialization fails, the app still starts and shows its setup
// screen instead of remaining on Android's Flutter splash screen.
bool supabaseReady = false;
String? supabaseStartupError;

// BOOTFIX: the first frame is drawn immediately. Supabase starts in the
// background and the gate swaps from the splash to the app when it is ready.
final ValueNotifier<bool> supabaseBootFinished = ValueNotifier<bool>(false);

Future<void> _bootSupabase() async {
  final watch = Stopwatch()..start();
  if (!supabaseConfigured) {
    final missing = <String>[
      if (!supabaseUrl.startsWith('https://')) 'SUPABASE_URL',
      if (supabasePublishableKey.isEmpty) 'SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY',
    ];
    supabaseStartupError =
        'Missing or invalid build configuration: ${missing.join(', ')}. '
        'Check GitHub Repository secrets and rebuild the APK.';
  } else {
    try {
      await Supabase.initialize(
        url: supabaseUrl,
        publishableKey: [REDACTED],
      );
      supabaseReady = true;
    } catch (error, stackTrace) {
      debugPrint('Twice Supabase startup failed: $error');
      debugPrintStack(stackTrace: stackTrace);
      supabaseReady = false;
      final details = error
          .toString()
          .replaceAll(supabaseUrl, '[Supabase URL hidden]')
          .replaceAll(supabasePublishableKey, '[key hidden]');
      supabaseStartupError =
          'Supabase initialization failed (${error.runtimeType}): $details';
    }
  }
  debugPrint(
    'TWICE_BOOT supabase ready=$supabaseReady in ${watch.elapsedMilliseconds}ms',
  );
  supabaseBootFinished.value = true;
}

Future<void> main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  TwiceMedia.configure();
  runApp(const TwiceApp());
  unawaited(_bootSupabase());
  unawaited(TwiceMedia.trimDiskCache());
}

class NativeCore {
  NativeCore._() {
    try {
      final lib = DynamicLibrary.open('libtwice_native.so');
      _add = lib
          .lookupFunction<Int32 Function(Int32, Int32), int Function(int, int)>(
            'twice_native_add',
          );
    } catch (_) {
      // Keeps Flutter tests and non-Android preview environments usable.
      _add = null;
    }
  }

  static final NativeCore instance = NativeCore._();

  late final int Function(int, int)? _add;

  int add(int a, int b) => _add?.call(a, b) ?? a + b;

  bool get isLoaded => _add != null;
}

class TwiceAuthGate extends StatelessWidget {
  const TwiceAuthGate({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ValueListenableBuilder<bool>(
      valueListenable: supabaseBootFinished,
      builder: (context, finished, _) {
        if (!finished && supabaseConfigured) return const _TwiceSplash();
        if (!supabaseReady) {
          return TwiceSignInPage(
            configurationMissing: true,
            startupError: supabaseStartupError,
          );
        }
        return StreamBuilder<AuthState>(
          stream: Supabase.instance.client.auth.onAuthStateChange,
          builder: (context, snapshot) {
            final session = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentSession;
            if (session != null) return const TwiceShell();
            return const TwiceSignInPage();
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }
}
