                          context: context,
                          isScrollControlled: true,
                          useSafeArea: true,
                          backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
                          barrierColor: Colors.black54,
                          enableDrag: true,
                          showDragHandle: false,
                          shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(
                              top: Radius.circular(24),
                            ),
                          ),
                          clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
                          builder: (_) => CommentsSheet(post: post),
                        );
                        try {
                          final n = await SocialRepository.instance
                              .commentCount(post.id);
                          post.data['comments'] = [
                            {'count': n},
                          ];
                        } catch (_) {}
                        onCommentChanged();
                      },
                      radius: 26,
                      child: Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 10,
                          vertical: 12,
                        ),
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            const _InstagramCommentIcon(size: 25, color: ink),
                            if (post.commentCount > 0) ...[
                              const SizedBox(width: 6),
                              Text(
                                '${post.commentCount}',
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                  fontSize: 14,
                                  color: ink,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const Spacer(),
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: post.saved ? 'Remove saved post' : 'Save post',
                      onPressed: () {
                        final wasSaved = post.saved;
                        final uid =
                            Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
                        if (uid == null) return;

                        final rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
                          (post.data['saved_posts'] as List? ?? const [])
                              .whereType<Map>()
                              .map((row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row)),
                        );

                        // Update the bookmark immediately.
                        if (wasSaved) {
                          rows.removeWhere((row) => row['user_id'] == uid);
                        } else {
                          rows.add({'user_id': uid});
                        }
                        post.data['saved_posts'] = rows;
                        onCommentChanged();

                        // Persist asynchronously; do not reload the feed.
                        SocialRepository.instance
                            .toggleSaved(post.id, wasSaved)
                            .catchError((Object e) {
                              if (!context.mounted) return;
                              // Roll back only this bookmark state.
                              final current = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
                                (post.data['saved_posts'] as List? ?? const [])
                                    .whereType<Map>()
                                    .map(
                                      (row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row),
                                    ),
                              );
                              current.removeWhere(
                                (row) => row['user_id'] == uid,
                              );
                              if (wasSaved) current.add({'user_id': uid});
                              post.data['saved_posts'] = current;
                              onCommentChanged();
                              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                                SnackBar(content: Text('Save failed: $e')),
                              );
                            });
                      },
                      icon: Icon(
                        post.saved
                            ? Icons.bookmark_rounded
                            : Icons.bookmark_border_rounded,
                        size: 26,
                        color: post.saved ? const Color(0xFFE2B900) : ink,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 5),
                  child: Text(
                    '${post.likes} ${post.likes == 1 ? 'like' : 'likes'}',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      fontSize: 13,
                      color: ink,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                if (post.caption.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 5),
                    child: Text.rich(
                      TextSpan(
                        children: [
                          TextSpan(
                            text: '${post.handle}  ',
                            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                          ),
                          TextSpan(text: post.caption),
                        ],
                      ),
                      maxLines: 4,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

String _timeAgo(dynamic value) {
  final date = DateTime.tryParse(value?.toString() ?? '')?.toLocal();
  if (date == null) return '';
  final diff = DateTime.now().difference(date);
  if (diff.inMinutes < 1) return 'Just now';
  if (diff.inHours < 1) return '${diff.inMinutes}m ago';
  if (diff.inDays < 1) return '${diff.inHours}h ago';
  if (diff.inDays < 7) return '${diff.inDays}d ago';
  return '${date.day}/${date.month}/${date.year}';
}

Future<List<AssetEntity>> _loadSelectableMedia({int size = 200}) async {
  // Query images and videos independently: some Android gallery providers
  // omit video rows from RequestType.common when access is partially granted.
  final permission = await PhotoManager.requestPermissionExtend();
  if (!permission.isAuth && !permission.hasAccess) return <AssetEntity>[];

  final results = <String, AssetEntity>{};
  for (final type in <RequestType>[RequestType.image, RequestType.video]) {
    final paths = await PhotoManager.getAssetPathList(
      type: type,
      onlyAll: true,
    );
    if (paths.isEmpty) continue;
    final assets = await paths.first.getAssetListPaged(page: 0, size: size);
    for (final asset in assets) {
      if (asset.type == AssetType.image || asset.type == AssetType.video) {
        results[asset.id] = asset;
      }
    }
  }
  final assets = results.values.toList()
    ..sort(
      (a, b) => (b.createDateSecond ?? 0).compareTo(a.createDateSecond ?? 0),
    );
  return assets;
}

class CreatePage extends StatefulWidget {
  const CreatePage({super.key, required this.onPost});
  final Future<void> Function(
    String caption,
    List<AssetEntity> media,
    String visibility,
  )
  onPost;
  @override
  State<CreatePage> createState() => _CreatePageState();
}

class _CreatePageState extends State<CreatePage> {
  final controller = TextEditingController();
  final selectedMedia = <AssetEntity>[];
  String visibility = 'public';
  bool publishing = false;
  @override
  void dispose() {
    controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _pick() async {
    List<AssetEntity> assets;
    try {
      assets = await _loadSelectableMedia(size: 300);
    } catch (error) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Could not open media library: $error')),
        );
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (assets.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            'No accessible photos or videos. Check media permissions.',
          ),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final picked = await showModalBottomSheet<List<AssetEntity>>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      useSafeArea: true,
      builder: (_) => _MediaPicker(assets: assets),
    );

    if (picked != null && mounted) {
      setState(() {
        selectedMedia
          ..clear()
          ..addAll(picked.take(10));
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _publish() async {
    if (publishing) return;
    setState(() => publishing = true);
    try {
      await widget.onPost(controller.text, selectedMedia, visibility);
      controller.clear();
      setState(() => selectedMedia.clear());
    } catch (_) {
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => publishing = false);
    }
  }

      ),
      title: const Text(
        'Create post',
        style: TextStyle(color: Colors.black, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
      ),
      actions: [
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 12),
          child: Center(
            child: FilledButton(
              onPressed: publishing ? null : _publish,
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF1877F2),
                foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20),
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),
                ),

              child: Text(publishing ? 'Posting…' : 'Post'),

          ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
    body: SafeArea(

                      ),

                      children: [

}

class _MediaPicker extends StatefulWidget {
  const _MediaPicker({required this.assets});
  final List<AssetEntity> assets;
  @override
  State<_MediaPicker> createState() => _MediaPickerState();
}

class _MediaPickerState extends State<_MediaPicker> {
  final Set<AssetEntity> chosen = {};
  final Map<String, Future<Uint8List?>> _thumbnailFutures = {};

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    for (final asset in widget.assets) {
      _thumbnailFutures.putIfAbsent(
        asset.id,
        () => asset.thumbnailDataWithSize(const ThumbnailSize(220, 220)),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => SizedBox(
    height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * .78,
    child: Column(
      children: [
        ListTile(
          title: const Text(
            'Select media',
            style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
          ),
          subtitle: Text('${chosen.length}/10 selected'),
          trailing: TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, chosen.toList()),
            child: const Text('Done'),
          ),
        ),
        Expanded(
          child: GridView.builder(
            key: const PageStorageKey<String>('twice-media-picker-grid'),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
            gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
              crossAxisCount: 4,
              crossAxisSpacing: 3,
              mainAxisSpacing: 3,
            ),
            itemCount: widget.assets.length,
            itemBuilder: (_, i) {
              final asset = widget.assets[i];
              final isChosen = chosen.contains(asset);
              return InkWell(
                key: ValueKey<String>(asset.id),
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() {
                    if (isChosen) {
                      chosen.remove(asset);
                    } else if (chosen.length < 10) {
                      chosen.add(asset);
                    }
                  });
                },
                child: Stack(
                  fit: StackFit.expand,
                  children: [
                    FutureBuilder<Uint8List?>(
                      future: _thumbnailFutures[asset.id],
                      builder: (_, snapshot) {
                        final bytes = snapshot.data;
                        if (bytes == null || bytes.isEmpty) {
                          return const ColoredBox(color: canvas);
                        }
                        return Image.memory(
                          bytes,
                          fit: BoxFit.cover,
                          gaplessPlayback: true,
                          filterQuality: FilterQuality.low,
                          errorBuilder: (_, _, _) =>
                              const ColoredBox(color: canvas),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                    if (asset.type == AssetType.video)
                      const Positioned(
                        right: 4,
                        bottom: 4,
                        child: Icon(
                          Icons.play_circle_fill,
                          color: Colors.white,
                          shadows: [Shadow(blurRadius: 4)],
                        ),
                      ),
                    if (isChosen)
                      const Positioned(
                        top: 4,
                        right: 4,
                        child: Icon(
                          Icons.check_circle,
                          color: violet,
                          shadows: [Shadow(blurRadius: 3)],
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

class SearchPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const SearchPage({super.key});
  @override
  State<SearchPage> createState() => _SearchPageState();
}

class _SearchPageState extends State<SearchPage> {
  final controller = TextEditingController();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> results = [];
  bool busy = false;
  String? error;
  @override
  void dispose() {
    controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _search(String q) async {
    if (q.trim().isEmpty) {
      setState(() {
        results = [];
        error = null;
      });
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      busy = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final data = await SocialRepository.instance.search(q);
      if (mounted) setState(() => results = data);
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => error = e.toString());
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => busy = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
    children: [
      Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: TextField(
          controller: controller,
          onChanged: _search,
          decoration: InputDecoration(
            hintText: 'Search people by name or @username',
            prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search),
            suffixIcon: IconButton(
              onPressed: () {
                controller.clear();
                _search('');
              },
              icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
            ),
            filled: true,
            fillColor: Colors.white,
            border: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
              borderSide: BorderSide.none,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      if (busy) const LinearProgressIndicator(),
      if (error != null)
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          child: Text(error!, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
        ),
      Expanded(
        child: results.isEmpty
            ? Center(
                child: Text(
                  controller.text.isEmpty
                      ? 'Search for real Twice users'
                      : 'No users found',
                  style: const TextStyle(color: muted),
                ),
              )
            : ListView.builder(
                itemCount: results.length,
                itemBuilder: (_, i) => _UserTile(user: results[i]),
              ),
      ),
    ],
  );
}

class _UserTile extends StatefulWidget {
  const _UserTile({required this.user});
  final Map<String, dynamic> user;
  @override
  State<_UserTile> createState() => _UserTileState();
}

class _UserTileState extends State<_UserTile> {
  bool following = false, busy = false;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final user = widget.user;
    if (user['result_type'] == 'post') {
      final author = user['profiles'] as Map? ?? {};
      return ListTile(
        leading: const CircleAvatar(child: Icon(Icons.article_outlined)),
        title: Text(
          (user['caption'] ?? 'Media post').toString(),
          maxLines: 2,
          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
        ),
        subtitle: Text(
          '${author['display_name'] ?? author['username'] ?? 'Twice user'} · @${author['username'] ?? 'user'}',
        ),
      );
    }
    final isSelf = user['id'] == Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
    return ListTile(
      leading: CircleAvatar(
        backgroundImage: user['avatar_url'] == null
            ? null
            : _twiceAvatarProvider(user['avatar_url'].toString()),
        child: user['avatar_url'] == null ? const Icon(Icons.person) : null,
      ),
      title: Text(
        (user['display_name'] ?? user['username'] ?? 'Twice user').toString(),
        style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
      ),
      subtitle: Text('@${user['username'] ?? 'user'}'),
      trailing: isSelf
          ? null
          : Wrap(
              children: [
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: busy
                      ? null
                      : () async {
                          setState(() => busy = true);
                          try {
                            if (following) {
                              await SocialRepository.instance.unfollow(
                                user['id'].toString(),
                              );
                            } else {
                              await SocialRepository.instance.follow(
                                user['id'].toString(),
                                privateAccount: user['is_private'] == true,
                              );
                            }
                            if (mounted) setState(() => following = !following);
                          } catch (e) {
                            if (mounted) {
                              ScaffoldMessenger.of(this.context).showSnackBar(
                                SnackBar(
                                  content: Text('Follow action failed: $e'),
                                ),
                              );
                            }
                          } finally {
                            if (mounted) setState(() => busy = false);
                          }
                        },
                  child: Text(
                    busy
                        ? '…'
                        : following
                        ? 'Following'
                        : 'Follow',
                  ),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  tooltip: 'Message',
                  onPressed: busy
                      ? null
                      : () async {
                          setState(() => busy = true);
                          try {
                            final id = await SocialRepository.instance
                                .createConversation(user['id'].toString());
                            if (context.mounted) {
                              Navigator.of(context).push(
                                MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                                  builder: (_) => ConversationPage(
                                    id: id,
                                    title:
                                        (user['display_name'] ??
                                                user['username'] ??
                                                'Message')
                                            .toString(),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              );
                            }
                          } catch (e) {
                            if (mounted) {
                              ScaffoldMessenger.of(this.context).showSnackBar(
                                SnackBar(
                                  content: Text(
                                    'Could not start conversation: $e',
                                  ),
                                ),
                              );
                            }
                          } finally {
                            if (mounted) setState(() => busy = false);
                          }
                        },
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.send_outlined),
                ),
              ],
            ),
    );
  }
}

class CommentsSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const CommentsSheet({super.key, required this.post});
  final SocialPost post;
  @override
  State<CommentsSheet> createState() => _CommentsSheetState();
}

class _CommentsSheetState extends State<CommentsSheet> {
  final controller = TextEditingController();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows = [];
  bool busy = true;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String? loadError;
  bool sending = false;

  Future<void> _load() async {
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        busy = true;
        loadError = null;
      });
    }
    try {
      final data = await SocialRepository.instance.comments(widget.post.id);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          rows = data;
          busy = false;
          loadError = null;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          busy = false;
          loadError = e.toString();
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _send() async {
    if (sending) return;
    final text = controller.text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return;

    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();

    final optimistic = <String, dynamic>{
      'id': _newTwiceUuid(),
      'post_id': widget.post.id,
      'user_id': Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id ?? '',
      'body': text,
      'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
      'profiles': <String, dynamic>{'display_name': 'You'},
      '_pending': true,
    };

    // Render immediately and clear the composer before network work begins.
    setState(() {
      rows = [...rows, optimistic];
      controller.clear();
      loadError = null;
      busy = false;
      sending = true;
    });

    // Persist in the background; no comments refresh or feed reload.
    try {
      final synced = await SocialRepository.instance.addComment(
        widget.post.id,
        text,
        commentId: optimistic['id'].toString(),
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        optimistic.remove('_pending');
        if (!synced) optimistic['_queued'] = true;
      });
      if (!synced) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              'Saved offline. This comment will sync when you reconnect.',
            ),
            behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        optimistic['_failed'] = true;
        optimistic.remove('_pending');
      });
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('Comment is visible but could not sync: $e'),
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => sending = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Container(
    height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * .78,
    decoration: const BoxDecoration(
      color: Colors.white,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
    ),
    child: Column(
      children: [
        const SizedBox(height: 10),
        Container(
          width: 38,
          height: 4,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Colors.black26,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99),
          ),
        ),
        const Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
          child: Text(
            'Comments',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
          ),
        ),
        Expanded(
          child: busy
              ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
              : loadError != null
              ? Center(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                    child: Column(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        const Text('Could not load comments'),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        Text(loadError!, textAlign: TextAlign.center),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        TextButton(
                          onPressed: _load,
                          child: const Text('Retry'),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                )
              : rows.isEmpty
              ? const Center(child: Text('No comments yet'))
              : ListView.builder(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 4, 16, 16),
                  itemCount: rows.length,
                  itemBuilder: (_, i) {
                    final r = rows[i];
                    final p = r['profiles'] as Map? ?? {};
                    final name = (p['display_name'] ?? p['username'] ?? 'User')
                        .toString();
                    return Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                      child: Row(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Builder(
                            builder: (context) {
                              final avatar = (p['avatar_url'] ?? '')
                                  .toString()
                                  .trim();
                              final hasAvatar =
                                  _isImageSource(avatar) ||
                                  avatar.startsWith('file://') ||
                                  avatar.startsWith('/');
                              return CircleAvatar(
                                radius: 17,
                                backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFEDE7FF),
                                backgroundImage: hasAvatar
                                    ? _twiceAvatarProvider(avatar)
                                    : null,
                                child: hasAvatar
                                    ? null
                                    : Text(
                                        name.isNotEmpty
                                            ? name[0].toUpperCase()
                                            : 'U',
                                        style: const TextStyle(
                                          color: violet,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                              );
                            },
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 10),
                          Flexible(
                            child: Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 14,
                                vertical: 10,
                              ),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: const Color(0xFFF3F3F6),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                              ),
                              child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                children: [
                                  Text(
                                    name,
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                      fontSize: 13,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
                                  Text(
                                    '@${(p['username'] ?? 'user').toString().replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^@'), '')}  ·  ${_timeAgo(r['created_at'])}',
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                      color: muted,
                                      fontSize: 11,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 5),
                                  Text((r['body'] ?? '').toString()),
                                  if (r['_queued'] == true)
                                    const Padding(
                                      padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                                      child: Text(
                                        'Saved offline · waiting to sync',
                                        style: TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 11,
                                          color: muted,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  if (r['_failed'] == true)
                                    const Padding(
                                      padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                                      child: Text(
                                        'Not synced · check connection and retry',
                                        style: TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 11,
                                          color: Colors.redAccent,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
        ),
        SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              14,
              8,
              14,
              10 + MediaQuery.viewInsetsOf(context).bottom,
            ),
            child: Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Container(
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: const Color(0xFFF3F3F6),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26),
                      border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFE5E3EC)),
                    ),
                    child: TextField(
                      controller: controller,
                      minLines: 1,
                      maxLines: 4,
                      textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                      textInputAction: TextInputAction.send,
                      onSubmitted: (_) => _send(),
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        hintText: 'Write a comment…',
                        contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 18,
                          vertical: 12,
                        ),
                        border: InputBorder.none,
                        enabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                        focusedBorder: InputBorder.none,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Material(
                  color: violet,
                  shape: const CircleBorder(),
                  child: InkWell(
                    customBorder: const CircleBorder(),
                    onTap: sending ? null : _send,
                    child: SizedBox(
                      width: 46,
                      height: 46,
                      child: Center(
                        child: sending
                            ? const SizedBox(
                                width: 20,
                                height: 20,
                                child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                  strokeWidth: 2,
                                  color: Colors.white,
                                ),
                              )
                            : const Icon(
                                Icons.send_rounded,
                                color: Colors.white,
                                size: 21,
                              ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

class ActivityPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ActivityPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<ActivityPage> createState() => _ActivityPageState();
}

class _ActivityPageState extends State<ActivityPage> {
  late Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> future;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    future = SocialRepository.instance.notifications();
  }

  Future<void> _refresh() async {
    setState(() => future = SocialRepository.instance.notifications());
    await future;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return FutureBuilder<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      future: future,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        if (snapshot.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
          return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
        }
        if (snapshot.hasError) {
          return Center(
            child: Text('Could not load activity: ${snapshot.error}'),
          );
        }
        final rows = snapshot.data ?? [];
        if (rows.isEmpty) {
          return RefreshIndicator(
            onRefresh: _refresh,
            child: ListView(
              physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              children: const [
                SizedBox(height: 180),
                Center(
                  child: Text(
                    'No activity yet',
                    style: TextStyle(color: muted),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        }
        return RefreshIndicator(
          onRefresh: _refresh,
          child: ListView.builder(
            itemCount: rows.length,
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              final row = rows[index];
              final actor = row['profiles'] as Map? ?? {};
              return ListTile(
                leading: const CircleAvatar(
                  child: Icon(Icons.notifications_none),
                ),
                title: Text(
                  '${actor['display_name'] ?? actor['username'] ?? 'Someone'} '
                  '${row['type'] ?? 'interacted'} with you',
                ),
                subtitle: Text(_timeAgo(row['created_at'])),
              );
            },
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class ProfilePage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ProfilePage({
    super.key,
    required this.profile,
    required this.posts,
    required this.onRefresh,
  });

  final Map<String, dynamic> profile;
  final List<SocialPost> posts;
  final Future<void> Function() onRefresh;

  @override
  State<ProfilePage> createState() => _ProfilePageState();
}

class EditProfilePage extends StatefulWidget {
  const EditProfilePage({
    super.key,
    required this.profile,
    required this.onSaved,
  });

  final Map<String, dynamic> profile;
  final Future<void> Function() onSaved;

  @override
  State<EditProfilePage> createState() => _EditProfilePageState();
}

class _EditProfilePageState extends State<EditProfilePage> {
  late final TextEditingController display;
  late final TextEditingController username;
  late final TextEditingController bio;
  AssetEntity? photo;
  bool saving = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    display = TextEditingController(
      text: (widget.profile['display_name'] ?? '').toString(),
    );
    username = TextEditingController(
      text: (widget.profile['username'] ?? '').toString(),
    );
    bio = TextEditingController(text: (widget.profile['bio'] ?? '').toString());
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    display.dispose();
    username.dispose();
    bio.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _choosePhoto() async {
    List<AssetEntity> photos;
    try {
      photos = await _loadSelectableMedia(size: 150);
      photos.removeWhere((asset) => asset.type != AssetType.image);
    } catch (error) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Could not open media library: $error')),
        );
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    final picked = await showModalBottomSheet<List<AssetEntity>>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (_) => _MediaPicker(assets: photos),
    );
    if (picked != null && picked.isNotEmpty && mounted) {
      setState(() => photo = picked.first);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    if (saving) return;
    if (display.text.trim().isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
          .showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Enter a display name.')));
      return;
    }
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      await SocialRepository.instance.updateProfile(
        displayName: display.text,
        username: username.text,
        bio: bio.text,
        avatarAsset: photo,
      );
      await widget.onSaved();
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Profile updated successfully')),
        );
        Navigator.of(context).pop();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Could not save profile: $e')));
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  InputDecoration _decoration(String label, IconData icon) => InputDecoration(
    labelText: label,
    prefixIcon: Icon(icon, color: violet),
    filled: true,
    fillColor: Colors.white,
    contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 17),
    border: OutlineInputBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
      borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFE8E8F0)),
    ),
    enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
      borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFE8E8F0)),
    ),
    focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
      borderSide: const BorderSide(color: violet, width: 1.5),
    ),
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final avatar = (widget.profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString();
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: canvas,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        leading: IconButton(
          tooltip: 'Back',
          onPressed: saving ? null : () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
        ),
        title: const Text(
          'Edit Profile',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
        ),
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 22, 22, 24),
                children: [
                  Center(
                    child: Column(
                      children: [
                        Stack(
                          clipBehavior: Clip.none,
                          children: [
                            Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                                color: Colors.white,
                                border: Border.all(
                                  color: const Color(0xFFE5DFFF),
                                  width: 2,
                                ),
                              ),
                              child: ClipOval(
                                child: SizedBox(
                                  width: 112,
                                  height: 112,
                                  child: photo != null
                                      ? FutureBuilder<Uint8List?>(
                                          future: photo!.thumbnailDataWithSize(
                                            const ThumbnailSize(360, 360),
                                          ),
                                          builder: (_, snap) =>
                                              snap.data == null
                                              ? const Center(
                                                  child:
                                                      CircularProgressIndicator(),
                                                )
                                              : Image.memory(
                                                  snap.data!,
                                                  fit: BoxFit.cover,
                                                ),
                                        )
                                      : avatar.isNotEmpty
                                      ? Image(
                                          image: _twiceAvatarProvider(avatar),
                                          fit: BoxFit.cover,
                                          errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => const Icon(
                                            Icons.person_rounded,
                                            size: 54,
                                          ),
                                        )
                                      : const Icon(
                                          Icons.person_rounded,
                                          size: 54,
                                          color: muted,
                                        ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                            Positioned(
                              right: 0,
                              bottom: 0,
                              child: Material(
                                color: violet,
                                shape: const CircleBorder(),
                                child: InkWell(
                                  customBorder: const CircleBorder(),
                                  onTap: _choosePhoto,
                                  child: const Padding(
                                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(10),
                                    child: Icon(
                                      Icons.add_rounded,
                                      color: Colors.white,
                                      size: 22,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        TextButton.icon(
                          onPressed: _choosePhoto,
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.photo_outlined),
                          label: const Text('Change profile photo'),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 24),
                  TextField(
                    controller: display,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                    maxLength: 60,
                    decoration: _decoration(
                      'Display name',
                      Icons.person_outline_rounded,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  TextField(
                    controller: username,
                    autocorrect: false,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.none,
                    decoration: _decoration(
                      '@Username',
                      Icons.alternate_email_rounded,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  TextField(
                    controller: bio,
                    maxLines: 4,
                    maxLength: 160,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                    decoration: _decoration('Bio', Icons.notes_rounded),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 12, 20, 16),
              decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white,
                border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFECECF2))),
              ),
              child: SizedBox(
                width: double.infinity,
                height: 54,
                child: FilledButton(
                  onPressed: saving ? null : _save,
                  style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: violet,
                    foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: saving
                      ? const SizedBox(
                          width: 22,
                          height: 22,
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                            strokeWidth: 2,
                            color: Colors.white,
                          ),
                        )
                      : const Text(
                          'Save Changes',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 16,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          ),
                        ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class FollowListPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const FollowListPage({
    super.key,
    required this.profileId,
    required this.followers,
  });

  final String profileId;
  final bool followers;

  @override
  State<FollowListPage> createState() => _FollowListPageState();
}

class _FollowListPageState extends State<FollowListPage> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> users = [];
  final Set<String> _busyUsers = {};
  bool loading = true;
  String? error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        loading = true;
        error = null;
      });
    }
    try {
      final result = await SocialRepository.instance.followProfiles(
        profileId: widget.profileId,
        followers: widget.followers,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        users = result;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        error = e.toString();
        loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  Widget _followAction(Map<String, dynamic> user) {
    final id = (user['id'] ?? '').toString();
    final connected = user['is_connected'] == true;
    final followingBack = user['is_following_back'] == true;
    final busy = _busyUsers.contains(id);

    final label = connected
        ? 'Connected'
        : followingBack
        ? 'Following'
        : user['follow_request_pending'] == true
        ? 'Requested'
        : 'Follow back';

    return OutlinedButton(
      onPressed: busy || id.isEmpty || connected || followingBack
          ? null
          : () async {
              setState(() => _busyUsers.add(id));
              try {
                final repo = SocialRepository.instance;
                final privateAccount = await repo.isPrivateAccount(id);
                await repo.follow(id, privateAccount: privateAccount);
                if (!mounted) return;
                await _load();
              } catch (e) {
                if (mounted) {
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                    SnackBar(content: Text('Could not follow user: $e')),
                  );
                }
              } finally {
                if (mounted) setState(() => _busyUsers.remove(id));
              }
            },
      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
        foregroundColor: connected ? Colors.green.shade700 : violet,
        side: BorderSide(
          color: connected ? Colors.green.shade300 : const Color(0xFFDCD6FF),
        ),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 9),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13)),
      ),
      child: busy
          ? const SizedBox(
              width: 16,
              height: 16,
              child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: violet),
            )
          : Text(
              label,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
            ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final title = widget.followers ? 'Followers' : 'Following';
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: canvas,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        leading: IconButton(
          tooltip: 'Back',
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
        ),
        title: Text(
          title,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
        ),
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: loading
            ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: violet))
            : error != null
            ? Center(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      const Icon(
                        Icons.cloud_off_rounded,
                        size: 42,
                        color: muted,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      const Text(
                        'Could not load users',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          fontSize: 17,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Text(
                        error!,
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        style: const TextStyle(color: muted),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      FilledButton.icon(
                        onPressed: _load,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded),
                        label: const Text('Try again'),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              )
            : users.isEmpty
            ? Center(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                        color: Color(0xFFEDE9FF),
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      ),
                      child: const Icon(
                        Icons.people_outline_rounded,
                        size: 36,
                        color: violet,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    Text(
                      widget.followers
                          ? 'No followers yet'
                          : 'Not following anyone yet',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 17,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 5),
                    const Text(
                      'People will appear here when available.',
                      style: TextStyle(color: muted),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              )
            : RefreshIndicator(
                color: violet,
                onRefresh: _load,
                child: ListView.separated(
                  physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 24),
                  itemCount: users.length,
                  separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  itemBuilder: (_, index) {
                    final user = users[index];
                    final name = (user['display_name'] ?? '').toString().trim();
                    final username = (user['username'] ?? '').toString().trim();
                    final avatar = (user['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
                    return Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 14,
                        vertical: 12,
                      ),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFECECF2)),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          CircleAvatar(
                            radius: 27,
                            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFEDE9FF),
                            backgroundImage: avatar.isNotEmpty
                                ? _twiceAvatarProvider(avatar)
                                : null,
                            child: avatar.isEmpty
                                ? const Icon(
                                    Icons.person_rounded,
                                    color: violet,
                                    size: 28,
                                  )
                                : null,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 13),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: [
                                Text(
                                  name.isEmpty ? username : name,
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                    fontSize: 15,
                                  ),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(height: 3),
                                Text(
                                  username.isEmpty ? '@user' : '@$username',
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    color: muted,
                                    fontSize: 13,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                          if (widget.followers &&
                              user['is_current_user'] != true) ...[
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            _followAction(user),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ProfilePageState extends State<ProfilePage> {
  bool _accountMenuOpen = false;

  int selectedTab = 0;
  int followersCount = 0;
  int followingCount = 0;
  bool _countsLoading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadFollowCounts();
  }

  Future<void> _logout() async {
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
        title: const Text('Log out of Twice?'),
        content: const Text(
          'You will be signed out of your account on this device.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFD92D20),
            ),
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
            child: const Text('Log out'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirmed != true || !mounted) return;

    try {
      await Supabase.instance.client.auth.signOut(scope: SignOutScope.local);
      // TwiceAuthGate listens to onAuthStateChange and returns to sign-in.
    } catch (_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('Could not log out. Please try again.')),
      );
    }
  }

  Widget _clickableFollowStat(String value, String label, bool followers) {
    return InkWell(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      onTap: _countsLoading
          ? null
          : () {
              Navigator.of(context).push(
                MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                  builder: (_) => FollowListPage(
                    profileId: (widget.profile['id'] ?? '').toString(),
                    followers: followers,
                  ),
                ),
              );
            },
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 5),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Text(
              value,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 3),
            Text(
              label,
              style: const TextStyle(
                color: muted,
                fontSize: 11,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _loadFollowCounts() async {
    final id = (widget.profile['id'] ?? '').toString();
    if (id.isEmpty) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _countsLoading = false);
      return;
    }
    try {
      final db = Supabase.instance.client;
      final values = await Future.wait<List<dynamic>>([
        db
            .from('follows')
            .select('follower_id')
            .eq('following_id', id)
            .eq('status', 'accepted'),
        db
            .from('follows')
            .select('following_id')
            .eq('follower_id', id)
            .eq('status', 'accepted'),
      ]);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        followersCount = values[0].length;
        followingCount = values[1].length;
        _countsLoading = false;
      });
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _countsLoading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant ProfilePage oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.profile['id'] != widget.profile['id']) {
      _countsLoading = true;
      _loadFollowCounts();
    }
  }

  List<SocialPost> get _myPosts => widget.posts
      .where(
        (p) =>
            p.data['user_id'] == Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id,
      )
      .toList();

  List<SocialPost> get _visiblePosts {
    if (selectedTab == 1) {
      return _myPosts
          .where(
            (p) => p.media.any(
              (m) =>
                  (m['media_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() == 'image',
            ),
          )
          .toList();
    }
    if (selectedTab == 2) {
      return _myPosts
          .where(
            (p) => p.media.any(
              (m) =>
                  (m['media_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() == 'video',
            ),
          )
          .toList();
    }
    return _myPosts;
  }

  Future<void> _edit() async {
    await Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => EditProfilePage(
          profile: Map<String, dynamic>.from(widget.profile),
          onSaved: widget.onRefresh,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _shareProfile() async {
    final username = (widget.profile['username'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (username.isEmpty || !mounted) return;

    final profileUrl = 'https://twice.app/@$username';
    final avatarUrl = (widget.profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final displayName = (widget.profile['display_name'] ?? '')
        .toString()
        .trim();
    final brightness = ScreenBrightness();

    try {
      await brightness.setApplicationScreenBrightness(1.0);
      if (!mounted) {
        await brightness.resetApplicationScreenBrightness();
        return;
      }

      await showDialog<void>(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: true,
        builder: (dialogContext) => Dialog(
          insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: 20,
            vertical: 24,
          ),
          backgroundColor: Colors.white,
          elevation: 18,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(32),
          ),
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 24),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Align(
                    alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                    child: IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Close',
                      onPressed: () => Navigator.of(dialogContext).pop(),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded),
                    ),
                  ),
                  Container(
                    width: 76,
                    height: 76,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      border: Border.all(
                        color: const Color(0xFFEAE7FF),
                        width: 3,
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: CircleAvatar(
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF0F2F5),
                      backgroundImage: avatarUrl.isNotEmpty
                          ? _twiceAvatarProvider(avatarUrl)
                          : null,
                      child: avatarUrl.isEmpty
                          ? const Icon(Icons.person_rounded, size: 38)
                          : null,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Text(
                    displayName.isNotEmpty ? displayName : '@$username',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: ink,
                      fontSize: 21,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    '@$username',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: const TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 14),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 22),
                  Center(
                    child: Container(
                      width: 292,
                      height: 292,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26),
                        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFECEAF5)),
                        boxShadow: const [
                          BoxShadow(
                            color: Color(0x12000000),
                            blurRadius: 22,
                            offset: Offset(0, 8),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      child: QrImageView(
                        data: profileUrl,
                        version: QrVersions.auto,
                        size: 272,
                        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
                        errorCorrectionLevel: QrErrorCorrectLevel.H,
                        embeddedImage: avatarUrl.isNotEmpty
                            ? _twiceAvatarProvider(avatarUrl)
                            : null,
                        embeddedImageStyle: const QrEmbeddedImageStyle(
                          size: Size(58, 58),
                        ),
                        embeddedImageEmitsError: true,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 18),
                  const Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        Icons.qr_code_scanner_rounded,
                        size: 18,
                        color: violet,
                      ),
                      SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Flexible(
                        child: Text(
                          'Scan to find this profile on Twice',
                          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: muted,
                            fontSize: 13,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 22),
                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    height: 52,
                    child: FilledButton.icon(
                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: violet,
                        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(17),
                        ),
                      ),
                      onPressed: () async {
                        await Clipboard.setData(
                          ClipboardData(text: profileUrl),
                        );
                        if (dialogContext.mounted) {
                          Navigator.of(dialogContext).pop();
                        }
                        if (mounted) {
                          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                            const SnackBar(
                              content: Text('Profile link copied'),
                            ),
                          );
                        }
                      },
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.copy_rounded),
                      label: const Text(
                        'Copy profile link',
                        style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      await brightness.resetApplicationScreenBrightness();
    }
  }

  Widget _stat(String value, String label) => Column(
    children: [
      Text(
        value,
        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 3),
      Text(label, style: const TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 12)),
    ],
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final profile = widget.profile;
    final username = (profile['username'] ?? '').toString();
    final bio = (profile['bio'] ?? '').toString();
    final posts = _visiblePosts;

    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: widget.onRefresh,
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 28),
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              18,
              MediaQuery.of(context).padding.top + 8,
              18,
              12,
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Flexible(
                        child: Text(
                          username.isEmpty ? 'Your profile' : '@$username',
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 21,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 3),
                      Material(
                        color: _accountMenuOpen
                            ? const Color(0xFFEDE9FF)
                            : Colors.transparent,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        child: InkWell(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          onTap: () => setState(
                            () => _accountMenuOpen = !_accountMenuOpen,
                          ),
                          child: Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(7),
                            child: AnimatedRotation(
                              turns: _accountMenuOpen ? 0.5 : 0,
                              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
                              child: const Icon(
                                Icons.keyboard_arrow_down_rounded,
                                size: 23,
                                color: violet,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  tooltip: 'Share profile',
                  onPressed: _shareProfile,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.qr_code_rounded),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  tooltip: 'Edit profile',
                  onPressed: _edit,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_outlined),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          AnimatedSize(
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 260),
            curve: Curves.easeInOutCubic,
            child: _accountMenuOpen
                ? Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 0, 18, 14),
                    child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFE8E7F0)),
                        boxShadow: const [
                          BoxShadow(
                            color: Color(0x0D171923),
                            blurRadius: 18,
                            offset: Offset(0, 6),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      child: Material(
                        color: Colors.transparent,
                        child: InkWell(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                          onTap: () {
                            setState(() => _accountMenuOpen = false);
                            _logout();
                          },
                          child: const Padding(
                            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 12,
                              vertical: 13,
                            ),
                            child: Row(
                              children: [
                                Icon(
                                  Icons.logout_rounded,
                                  color: Color(0xFFD92D20),
                                  size: 21,
                                ),
                                SizedBox(width: 12),
                                Expanded(
                                  child: Text(
                                    'Log out',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                      color: Color(0xFFD92D20),
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                      fontSize: 14,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                                Icon(
                                  Icons.arrow_forward_ios_rounded,
                                  size: 14,
                                  color: muted,
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  )
                : const SizedBox(width: double.infinity, height: 0),
          ),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18),
            child: Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
              children: [
                Container(
                  width: 86,
                  height: 86,
                  decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                    color: Color(0xFFF0F2F5),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),
                  clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
                  child: (profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty
                      ? const Icon(Icons.person_outline_rounded, size: 43)
                      : Image(
                          image: _twiceImageProvider(
                            profile['avatar_url'].toString(),
                          ),

                    .trim()

                    profile['display_name'].toString().trim(),

                      fontSize: 15,

                        onPressed: _edit,

                        onPressed: _shareProfile,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.share_outlined, size: 18),
                        label: const Text('Share profile'),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),

            children: [
              _profileTab(0, Icons.grid_on_rounded, 'Posts'),
              _profileTab(1, Icons.photo_outlined, 'Photos'),
              _profileTab(2, Icons.play_circle_outline_rounded, 'Videos'),
            ],
          ),
          const Divider(height: 1, color: Color(0xFFEDEDED)),
          if (posts.isEmpty)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 55, horizontal: 24),
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  const Icon(
                    Icons.photo_library_outlined,
                    size: 43,
                    color: muted,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Text(
                    selectedTab == 0
                        ? 'No posts yet'
                        : selectedTab == 1
                        ? 'No photos yet'
                        : 'No videos yet',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      fontSize: 17,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 5),
                  const Text(
                    'Share a moment and it will appear here.',

                    style: TextStyle(color: muted),
                  ),
