                      fontSize: 17,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 5),
                  const Text(
                    'Share a moment and it will appear here.',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(color: muted),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            )
          else
            ...posts.map(
              (post) => Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 5),
                child: PostCard(
                  post: post,
                  onLike: (item) async {
                    final wasLiked = item.liked;
                    final uid = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
                    if (uid == null) return;
                    final rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
                      item.data['post_likes'] as List? ?? [],
                    );
                    setState(() {
                      if (wasLiked) {
                        rows.removeWhere((e) => e['user_id'] == uid);
                      } else {
                        rows.add({'user_id': uid});
                      }
                      item.data['post_likes'] = rows;
                    });
                    try {
                      await SocialRepository.instance.toggleLike(
                        item.id,
                        wasLiked,
                      );
                    } catch (e) {
                      await widget.onRefresh();
                      if (mounted) {
                        if (!mounted) return;
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(this.context).showSnackBar(
                          SnackBar(content: Text('Like failed: $e')),
                        );
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  onCommentChanged: widget.onRefresh,
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _profileTab(int index, IconData icon, String label) {
    final active = selectedTab == index;
    return Expanded(
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () => setState(() => selectedTab = index),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            border: Border(
              bottom: BorderSide(
                color: active ? ink : Colors.transparent,
                width: 2,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Icon(icon, size: 18, color: active ? ink : muted),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Text(
                label,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontWeight: active ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w500,
                  color: active ? ink : muted,
                  fontSize: 12,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class MessagesPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const MessagesPage({super.key});
  @override
  State<MessagesPage> createState() => _MessagesPageState();
}

class _MessagesPageState extends State<MessagesPage> {
  late Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> future;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    future = SocialRepository.instance.conversations();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Messages')),
    body: FutureBuilder<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      future: future,
      builder: (_, s) {
        if (s.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
          return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
        }
        if (s.hasError) {
          return Center(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: Text('Could not load conversations: ${s.error}'),
            ),
          );
        }
        final rows = s.data ?? [];
        if (rows.isEmpty) {
          return const Center(child: Text('No conversations yet'));
        }
        return ListView.builder(
          itemCount: rows.length,
          itemBuilder: (_, i) {
            final r = rows[i];
            final c = r['conversations'] as Map? ?? {};
            return ListTile(
              leading: const CircleAvatar(child: Icon(Icons.person)),
              title: Text((c['title'] ?? 'Conversation').toString()),
              subtitle: const Text('Open conversation'),
              onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).push(
                MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                  builder: (_) => ConversationPage(
                    id: r['conversation_id'].toString(),
                    title: (c['title'] ?? 'Conversation').toString(),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    ),
  );
}

class ConversationPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ConversationPage({super.key, required this.id, required this.title});
  final String id, title;
  @override
  State<ConversationPage> createState() => _ConversationPageState();
}

class _ConversationPageState extends State<ConversationPage> {
  final controller = TextEditingController();
  late Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> future;
  bool sending = false;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    future = SocialRepository.instance.messages(widget.id);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _send() async {
    final body = controller.text.trim();
    if (body.isEmpty || sending) return;
    setState(() => sending = true);
    try {
      await SocialRepository.instance.sendMessage(widget.id, body);
      if (!mounted) return;
      controller.clear();
      setState(() => future = SocialRepository.instance.messages(widget.id));
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
            .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Message failed: $e')));
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => sending = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.title)),
    body: Column(
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: FutureBuilder<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
            future: future,
            builder: (_, s) {
              if (s.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
                return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
              }
              if (s.hasError) {
                return Center(
                  child: Text('Could not load messages: ${s.error}'),
                );
              }
              final rows = s.data ?? [];
              return ListView.builder(
                reverse: false,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                itemCount: rows.length,
                itemBuilder: (_, i) {
                  final r = rows[i];
                  final own =
                      r['sender_id'] ==
                      Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
                  return Align(
                    alignment: own
                        ? Alignment.centerRight
                        : Alignment.centerLeft,
                    child: Container(
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: own ? const Color(0xFFECE7FF) : Colors.white,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                      ),
                      child: Text((r['body'] ?? '').toString()),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
        SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: TextField(
                    controller: controller,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(hintText: 'Message…'),
                  ),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  onPressed: sending ? null : _send,
                  icon: sending
                      ? const SizedBox(
                          width: 18,
                          height: 18,
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                        )
                      : const Icon(Icons.send, color: violet),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}


class _ProfileNavAvatar extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ProfileNavAvatar({
    required this.url,
    required this.fallback,
    required this.selected,
  });

  final String url;
  final String fallback;
  final bool selected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final imageSource = url.trim();
    final initial = fallback.trim().isNotEmpty
        ? fallback.trim().characters.first.toUpperCase()
        : 'U';
    final hasImage = _isImageSource(imageSource);

    return Container(
      width: 29,
      height: 29,
      padding: EdgeInsets.all(selected ? 2 : 0),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        shape: BoxShape.circle,
        border: selected
            ? Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF262626), width: 1.8)
            : null,
      ),
      child: ClipOval(
        child: hasImage
            ? Image(
                image: _twiceAvatarProvider(imageSource),
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                width: 29,
                height: 29,
                errorBuilder: (context, error, stackTrace) =>
                    _fallback(initial),
              )
            : _fallback(initial),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _fallback(String initial) {
    return ColoredBox(
      color: const Color(0xFFECE7FF),
      child: Center(
        child: Text(
          initial,
          style: const TextStyle(
            color: Color(0xFF5135B5),
            fontSize: 13,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}


enum _SocialNavKind { home, search, create, activity }

class _SocialNavIcon extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SocialNavIcon({
    required this.kind,
    this.selected = false,
  });

  final _SocialNavKind kind;
  final bool selected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final color = const Color(0xFF262626);
    final stroke = selected ? 2.35 : 1.75;

    return SizedBox(
      width: 27,
      height: 27,
      child: CustomPaint(
        painter: _SocialNavPainter(
          kind: kind,
          color: color,
          stroke: stroke,
          selected: selected,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _SocialNavPainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _SocialNavPainter({
    required this.kind,
    required this.color,
    required this.stroke,
    required this.selected,
  });

  final _SocialNavKind kind;
  final Color color;
  final double stroke;
  final bool selected;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final paint = Paint()
      ..color = color
      ..style = selected ? PaintingStyle.fill : PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = stroke
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round
      ..strokeJoin = StrokeJoin.round;

    final outline = Paint()
      ..color = color
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = stroke
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round
      ..strokeJoin = StrokeJoin.round;

    switch (kind) {
      case _SocialNavKind.home:
        final path = Path()
          ..moveTo(3, 12)
          ..lineTo(13.5, 3.5)
          ..lineTo(24, 12)
          ..lineTo(22, 12)
          ..lineTo(22, 23)
          ..lineTo(15.8, 23)
          ..lineTo(15.8, 16.5)
          ..lineTo(11.2, 16.5)
          ..lineTo(11.2, 23)
          ..lineTo(5, 23)
          ..lineTo(5, 12)
          ..close();
        if (selected) {
          canvas.drawPath(path, paint);
          canvas.drawRect(
            const Rect.fromLTWH(11.2, 16.5, 4.6, 6.5),
            Paint()..color = Colors.white,
          );
        } else {
          canvas.drawPath(path, outline);
        }

      case _SocialNavKind.search:
        canvas.drawCircle(const Offset(11, 11), 7, outline);
        canvas.drawLine(
          const Offset(16.2, 16.2),
          const Offset(23, 23),
          outline,
        );

      case _SocialNavKind.create:
        final back = RRect.fromRectAndRadius(
          const Rect.fromLTWH(3, 2.5, 17, 19),
          const Radius.circular(3.5),
        );
        final front = RRect.fromRectAndRadius(
          const Rect.fromLTWH(7, 5.5, 17, 19),
          const Radius.circular(3.5),
        );
        canvas.drawRRect(back, outline);
        if (selected) {
          canvas.drawRRect(front, paint);
          final cutout = Paint()..color = Colors.white;
          final triangle = Path()
            ..moveTo(13, 11)
            ..lineTo(13, 19)
            ..lineTo(19, 15)
            ..close();
          canvas.drawPath(triangle, cutout);
        } else {
          canvas.drawRRect(front, outline);
          final triangle = Path()
            ..moveTo(13, 11)
            ..lineTo(13, 19)
            ..lineTo(19, 15)
            ..close();
          canvas.drawPath(triangle, outline);
        }

      case _SocialNavKind.activity:
        final heart = Path()
          ..moveTo(13.5, 23)
          ..cubicTo(11.5, 21, 3, 15, 3, 9)
          ..cubicTo(3, 3, 10, 2, 13.5, 7)
          ..cubicTo(17, 2, 24, 3, 24, 9)
          ..cubicTo(24, 15, 15.5, 21, 13.5, 23)
          ..close();
        canvas.drawPath(heart, selected ? paint : outline);
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _SocialNavPainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.kind != kind ||
      oldDelegate.color != color ||
      oldDelegate.stroke != stroke ||
      oldDelegate.selected != selected;
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math';

import 'package:photo_manager/photo_manager.dart';
import 'package:video_thumbnail/video_thumbnail.dart';

import 'local_cache.dart';
import 'offline_media_cache.dart';

import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

/// Supabase data boundary for Twice. UI widgets should call this repository
/// rather than issuing database requests directly.
class SocialRepository {
  SocialRepository._();
  static final SocialRepository instance = SocialRepository._();
  SupabaseClient get _db => Supabase.instance.client;
  String get userId => _db.auth.currentUser!.id;
  LocalCache get _cache => LocalCache.instance;

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> cachedFeed() async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return [];
    final value = await _cache.get(uid, 'feed');
    if (value is! List) return [];
    return value.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList();
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> cachedMyProfile() async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return null;
    final value = await _cache.get(uid, 'profile');
    return value is Map ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(value) : null;
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _resolveProfileAvatar(
    Map<String, dynamic> row,
  ) async {
    final path = (row['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    row['avatar_object_path'] = path.startsWith('http') ? '' : path;
    if (path.isEmpty || path.startsWith('http')) return row;
    try {
      final local = await OfflineMediaCache.instance.existingUri(
        'post-media',
        path,
      );
      if (local != null) {
        row['avatar_url'] = local;
      } else {
        final signed = await _db.storage
            .from('post-media')
            .createSignedUrl(path, 3600);
        row['avatar_url'] = signed;
        unawaited(
          _warmAvatarCache(row, path, signed).catchError((Object _) {}),
        );
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Keep the stored path if storage cannot resolve it.
    }
    return row;
  }

  // FBFIX: only download once. The next feed load finds the file through
  // OfflineMediaCache.existingUri(); rewriting the whole feed JSON per avatar
  // caused UI lag.
  Future<void> _warmAvatarCache(
    Map<String, dynamic> profile,
    String objectPath,
    String signedUrl,
  ) async {
    await OfflineMediaCache.instance.cacheFromUrl(
      bucket: 'post-media',
      objectPath: objectPath,
      signedUrl: signedUrl,
      isVideo: false,
    );
  }

  // BOOTFIX: the profile only needs to be verified once per session. It used
  // to run 3+ times on every launch, each time costing network round trips.
  String? _ensuredFor;
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>>? _ensuring;

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> ensureProfile() {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    final running = _ensuring;
    if (running != null && _ensuredFor == uid) return running;
    _ensuredFor = uid;
    final work = _ensureProfileImpl();
    _ensuring = work;
    work.then<void>((_) {}, onError: (Object _) {
      if (identical(_ensuring, work)) _ensuring = null;
    });
    return work;
  }

  /// One local-cache check per path, then ONE batched signing request per
  /// 100 paths (instead of one HTTP request per image).
  Future<Map<String, String>> _resolvePaths(
    String bucket,
    Iterable<String> paths, {
    bool strict = false,
  }) async {
    final unique = paths.where((p) => p.isNotEmpty).toSet().toList();
    final result = <String, String>{};
    final missing = <String>[];
    await Future.wait<void>(
      unique.map((path) async {
        final local = await OfflineMediaCache.instance.existingUri(
          bucket,
          path,
        );
        if (local != null) {
          result[path] = local;
        } else {
          missing.add(path);
        }
      }),
    );
    for (var i = 0; i < missing.length; i += 100) {
      final chunk = missing.sublist(i, min(i + 100, missing.length));
      try {
        final signed = await _db.storage
            .from(bucket)
            // ignore: deprecated_member_use
            .createSignedUrls(chunk, 3600)
            .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
        for (final item in signed) {
          final url = item.signedUrl;
          if (url.contains('token=')) result[item.path.toString()] = url;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        if (strict) rethrow;
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  static bool _isStoragePath(String value) =>
      value.isNotEmpty &&
      value != 'pending' &&
      !value.startsWith('http://') &&
      !value.startsWith('https://');

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _ensureProfileImpl() async {
    final user = _db.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) throw AuthException('Please sign in again.');
    final existing = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select()
        .eq('id', user.id)
        .maybeSingle();
    final meta = user.userMetadata ?? const <String, dynamic>{};
    if (existing != null) {
      final row = Map<String, dynamic>.from(existing);
      final currentName = (row['display_name'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      final metadataName = (meta['name'] ?? meta['full_name'] ?? '')
          .toString()
          .trim();
      if (currentName.isEmpty && metadataName.isNotEmpty) {
        await _db
            .from('profiles')
            .update({'display_name': metadataName})
            .eq('id', user.id);
        row['display_name'] = metadataName;
      }
      return await _resolveProfileAvatar(row);
    }
    final baseRaw = _slug(
      (meta['name'] ??
              meta['full_name'] ??
              user.email?.split('@').first ??
              'twice_user')
          .toString(),
    );
    final base = baseRaw.length > 20 ? baseRaw.substring(0, 20) : baseRaw;
    var username = base.isEmpty ? 'twice_user' : base;
    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      final found = await _db
          .from('profiles')
          .select('id')
          .eq('username', username)
          .maybeSingle();
      if (found == null) break;
      username =
          '${base.isEmpty ? 'twice_user' : base}_${user.id.substring(0, 4 + i)}';
    }
    final display = (meta['name'] ?? meta['full_name'] ?? username)
        .toString()
        .trim();
    await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .upsert(
          {
            'id': user.id,
            'username': username,
            'display_name': display.isEmpty ? username : display,
          },
          onConflict: 'id',
          ignoreDuplicates: true,
        );
    final result = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select()
        .eq('id', user.id)
        .single();
    return await _resolveProfileAvatar(Map<String, dynamic>.from(result));
  }

  String _slug(String value) {
    final cleaned = value
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9_]'), '_')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'_+'), '_')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'^_|_$'), '');
    return cleaned.length > 24 ? cleaned.substring(0, 24) : cleaned;
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> myProfile() async {
    await ensureProfile();
    final row = await _db.from('profiles').select().eq('id', userId).single();
    final resolved = await _resolveProfileAvatar(
      Map<String, dynamic>.from(row),
    );
    await _cache.put(userId, 'profile', resolved);
    return resolved;
  }

  Future<void> updateProfile({
    required String displayName,
    required String username,
    required String bio,
    AssetEntity? avatarAsset,
  }) async {
    final clean = username.trim().replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^@'), '').toLowerCase();
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9_]{3,30}$').hasMatch(clean)) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Username must be 3–30 characters using letters, numbers, or underscores.',
      );
    }

    final values = <String, dynamic>{
      'display_name': displayName.trim(),
      'username': clean,
      'bio': bio.trim(),
    };

    if (avatarAsset != null) {
      final file = await avatarAsset.file;
      if (file == null) {
        throw Exception('Could not read the selected profile photo.');
      }
      final ext = file.path.split('.').last.toLowerCase();
      final objectPath =
          '$userId/avatar_${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}.$ext';

      await _db.storage
          .from('post-media')
          .upload(
            objectPath,
            file,
            fileOptions: FileOptions(contentType: _mime(ext), upsert: false),
          );

      // Store the storage path, not an expiring signed URL.
      values['avatar_url'] = objectPath;
      try {
        await _db.from('profiles').update(values).eq('id', userId);
      } catch (_) {
        try {
          await _db.storage.from('post-media').remove([objectPath]);
        } catch (_) {}
        rethrow;
      }
    } else {
      await _db.from('profiles').update(values).eq('id', userId);
    }
    try {
      await _cache.put(userId, 'profile', await myProfile());
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> feed({
    int limit = 30,
    int offset = 0,
  }) async {
    await ensureProfile();
    final rows = await _db
        .from('posts')
        .select(
          'id,user_id,caption,visibility,comments_enabled,created_at,profiles!posts_user_id_fkey(id,username,display_name,avatar_url),post_media(id,media_url,thumbnail_url,media_type,position),post_likes(user_id),saved_posts(user_id),comments(count)',
        )
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .range(offset, offset + limit - 1)
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 25));

    final posts = (rows as List)
        .map((raw) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map))
        .toList();

    // BOOTFIX: collect every storage path once (authors repeat across posts),
    // then sign them all with a single batched request.
    final needed = <String>{};
    for (final post in posts) {
      final author = post['profiles'];
      if (author is Map) {
        final path = (author['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        if (_isStoragePath(path)) needed.add(path);
      }
      for (final media in (post['post_media'] as List? ?? const [])) {
        if (media is! Map) continue;
        for (final key in const ['media_url', 'thumbnail_url']) {
          final path = (media[key] ?? '').toString().trim();
          if (_isStoragePath(path)) needed.add(path);
        }
      }
    }
    // strict: if signing fails the caller keeps showing the cached feed.
    final urls = await _resolvePaths('post-media', needed, strict: true);

    String resolve(String path) {
      if (path.isEmpty) return '';
      if (!_isStoragePath(path)) return path;
      return urls[path] ?? '';
    }

    for (final post in posts) {
      final authorRaw = post['profiles'];
      if (authorRaw is Map) {
        final author = Map<String, dynamic>.from(authorRaw);
        final path = (author['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        author['avatar_object_path'] = _isStoragePath(path) ? path : '';
        author['avatar_url'] = resolve(path);
        post['profiles'] = author;
      }
      post['media_resolved'] = (post['post_media'] as List? ?? const [])
          .whereType<Map>()
          .map((raw) {
            final item = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);
            item['resolved_url'] = resolve(
              (item['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
            );
            item['resolved_thumbnail_url'] = resolve(
              (item['thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
            );
            return item;
          })
          .toList();
    }

    await _cache.put(userId, 'feed', posts);
    // Prefetch only after the screen is already drawn, so it never competes
    // with the first paint for bandwidth.
    unawaited(
      Future<void>.delayed(
        const Duration(seconds: 4),
        () => _warmFeedMediaCache(posts),
      ).catchError((Object _) {}),
    );
    return posts;
  }

  // FBFIX: lightweight, bounded prefetch of photos + thumbnails (3 at a time).
  // Videos stream and are cached by the player when watched.
  Future<void> _warmFeedMediaCache(List<Map<String, dynamic>> feedRows) async {
    final jobs = <Future<void> Function()>[];
    Future<void> add(String path, String url, bool video) async {
      if (path.isEmpty || url.isEmpty || url.startsWith('file://')) return;
      await OfflineMediaCache.instance.cacheFromUrl(
        bucket: 'post-media',
        objectPath: path,
        signedUrl: url,
        isVideo: video,
      );
    }

    for (final post in feedRows.take(40)) {
      for (final raw in (post['media_resolved'] as List? ?? const [])) {
        if (raw is! Map) continue;
        final type = (raw['media_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
        final path = (raw['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        final url = (raw['resolved_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        final thumbPath = (raw['thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        final thumbUrl = (raw['resolved_thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        jobs.add(() => add(thumbPath, thumbUrl, false));
        if (type != 'video') jobs.add(() => add(path, url, false));
      }
    }
    var next = 0;
    Future<void> worker() async {
      while (next < jobs.length) {
        final job = jobs[next++];
        try {
          await job();
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }

    await Future.wait(List.generate(3, (_) => worker()));
  }

  /// Refreshes a storage object's URL, preferring a complete offline copy.
  /// Returns null when the object cannot be resolved.
  Future<String?> refreshMediaUrl(
    String objectPath, {
    String bucket = 'post-media',
  }) async {
    final path = objectPath.trim();
    if (path.isEmpty) return null;
    if (path.startsWith('http://') || path.startsWith('https://')) {
      return path;
    }

    try {
      final local = await OfflineMediaCache.instance.existingUri(bucket, path);
      if (local != null) return local;
      return await _db.storage.from(bucket).createSignedUrl(path, 3600);
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  bool _looksLikeNetworkFailure(Object error) {
    final text = error.toString().toLowerCase();
    return text.contains('socketexception') ||
        text.contains('failed host lookup') ||
        text.contains('clientexception') ||
        text.contains('connection reset') ||
        text.contains('connection refused') ||
        text.contains('connection aborted') ||
        text.contains('connection closed') ||
        text.contains('connection terminated') ||
        text.contains('network is unreachable') ||
        text.contains('no address associated with hostname') ||
        text.contains('handshakeexception') ||
        text.contains('broken pipe') ||
        text.contains('socket is not connected') ||
        text.contains('software caused connection abort') ||
        text.contains('timed out') ||
        text.contains('timeout');
  }

  Future<void> _applyLikeState(String postId, bool liked) async {
    if (liked) {
      await _db
          .from('post_likes')
          .upsert(
            {'post_id': postId, 'user_id': userId},
            onConflict: 'post_id,user_id',
            ignoreDuplicates: true,
          );
    } else {
      await _db
          .from('post_likes')
          .delete()
          .eq('post_id', postId)
          .eq('user_id', userId);
    }
  }

  /// Applies the requested state, queueing only likely connectivity failures.
  /// The payload is a desired state, not a toggle, so retries are idempotent.
  Future<void> setLikeState(String postId, bool liked) async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) throw AuthException('Please sign in again.');

    try {
      await _applyLikeState(postId, liked);
      final pending = await _cache.pending(uid);
      for (final item in pending) {
        if (item['operation'] == 'set_like' &&
            item['payload'] is Map &&
            item['payload']['post_id'] == postId) {
          await _cache.removePending(item['id'].toString());
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!_looksLikeNetworkFailure(error)) rethrow;
      await _cache.enqueue(uid, 'set_like', {
        'post_id': postId,
        'liked': liked,
      });
    }
    await _updateCachedLike(postId, liked);
  }

  /// Kept for existing callers: currentlyLiked is the state before the tap.
  Future<void> toggleLike(String postId, bool currentlyLiked) async {
    await setLikeState(postId, !currentlyLiked);
  }

  Future<void> _updateCachedLike(String postId, bool liked) async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;
    final cached = await _cache.get(uid, 'feed');
    if (cached is! List) return;

    final updated = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (final raw in cached) {
      if (raw is! Map) continue;
      final post = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);
      if (post['id']?.toString() == postId) {
        final likes = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
          (post['post_likes'] as List? ?? const []).whereType<Map>().map(
            (row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row),
          ),
        );
        likes.removeWhere((row) => row['user_id']?.toString() == uid);
        if (liked) likes.add({'user_id': uid});
        post['post_likes'] = likes;
      }
      updated.add(post);
    }
    await _cache.put(uid, 'feed', updated);
  }

  /// Replays queued likes and comments for the signed-in account.
  Future<void> syncPendingLikes() async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;

    final pending = await _cache.pending(uid);
    for (final item in pending) {
      if (item['operation'] != 'set_like' &&
          item['operation'] != 'add_comment') {
        continue;
      }
      try {
        final payload = Map<String, dynamic>.from(item['payload'] as Map);
        if (item['operation'] == 'add_comment') {
          await _db
              .from('comments')
              .upsert(payload, onConflict: 'id', ignoreDuplicates: true)
              .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
          await _cache.removePending(item['id'].toString());
          continue;
        }
        final postId = payload['post_id']?.toString();
        if (postId == null || postId.isEmpty) {
          await _cache.removePending(item['id'].toString());
          continue;
        }
        final liked = payload['liked'] == true;
        await _applyLikeState(postId, liked);
        await _updateCachedLike(postId, liked);
        await _cache.removePending(item['id'].toString());
      } catch (error) {
        await _cache.markFailed(item['id'].toString(), error);
        if (_looksLikeNetworkFailure(error)) break;
        // A permanent policy/schema error should not block unrelated queued
        // operations. Keep the row for diagnostics and continue with the next.
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> toggleSaved(String postId, bool saved) async {
    if (saved) {
      await _db
          .from('saved_posts')
          .delete()
          .eq('post_id', postId)
          .eq('user_id', userId);
    } else {
      await _db
          .from('saved_posts')
          .upsert(
            {'post_id': postId, 'user_id': userId},
            onConflict: 'user_id,post_id',
            ignoreDuplicates: true,
          );
    }
  }

  Future<String> publishPost(
    String caption,
    List<AssetEntity> assets, {
    String visibility = 'public',
  }) async {
    final text = caption.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty && assets.isEmpty) {
      throw const FormatException('Add a caption or select media.');
    }
    final created = await _db
        .from('posts')
        .insert({'user_id': userId, 'caption': text, 'visibility': visibility})
        .select('id')
        .single();
    final postId = created['id'].toString();
    final uploadedPaths = <String>[];
    try {
      var position = 0;
      for (final asset in assets) {
        final file = await asset.file;
        if (file == null) continue;
        final ext = file.path.split('.').last.toLowerCase();
        final type = asset.type == AssetType.video
            ? 'video'
            : (ext == 'gif' ? 'gif' : 'image');
        final objectPath =
            '$userId/$postId/${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}_$position.$ext';
        await _db.storage
            .from('post-media')
            .upload(
              objectPath,
              file,
              fileOptions: FileOptions(contentType: _mime(ext), upsert: false),
            );
        uploadedPaths.add(objectPath);

        String? thumbnailPath;
        if (type == 'video') {
          try {
            final bytes = await VideoThumbnail.thumbnailData(
              video: file.path,
              imageFormat: ImageFormat.JPEG,
              maxWidth: 720,
              quality: 78,
            );
            if (bytes != null && bytes.isNotEmpty) {
              final candidate =
                  '$userId/$postId/${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}_${position}_thumb.jpg';
              await _db.storage
                  .from('post-media')
                  .uploadBinary(
                    candidate,
                    bytes,
                    fileOptions: const FileOptions(
                      contentType: 'image/jpeg',
                      upsert: false,
                    ),
                  );
              uploadedPaths.add(candidate);
              thumbnailPath = candidate;
            }
          } catch (_) {
            // Thumbnail extraction is optional; preserve the video upload.
          }
        }

        await _db.from('post_media').insert({
          'post_id': postId,
          'media_url': objectPath,
          'thumbnail_url': thumbnailPath,
          'media_type': type,
          'position': position,
        });
        position++;
      }
      return postId;
    } catch (_) {
      // Avoid leaving a half-created post or orphaned storage objects.
      if (uploadedPaths.isNotEmpty) {
        try {
          await _db.storage.from('post-media').remove(uploadedPaths);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      await _db.from('posts').delete().eq('id', postId);
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> loadStories() async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('stories')
        .select('id,user_id,media_url,media_type,caption,created_at,expires_at')
        .gt('expires_at', DateTime.now().toUtc().toIso8601String())
        .order('created_at', ascending: true);

    final stories = (rows as List)
        .map((row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row as Map))
        .toList();

    if (stories.isEmpty) return stories;

    final ids = stories
        .map((story) => story['user_id'].toString())
        .toSet()
        .toList();

    final profiles = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id,username,display_name,avatar_url')
        .inFilter('id', ids);

    // BOOTFIX: resolve all avatars and story media with batched requests
    // (this used to be one sequential HTTP request per story).
    final profileRows = (profiles as List)
        .map((raw) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map))
        .toList();
    final avatarUrls = await _resolvePaths('post-media', [
      for (final row in profileRows)
        if (_isStoragePath((row['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim()))
          (row['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
    ]);
    final byId = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
    for (final row in profileRows) {
      final path = (row['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      row['avatar_object_path'] = _isStoragePath(path) ? path : '';
      row['avatar_url'] = _isStoragePath(path) ? (avatarUrls[path] ?? '') : path;
      byId[row['id'].toString()] = row;
    }

    final storyUrls = await _resolvePaths('stories', [
      for (final story in stories)
        if (_isStoragePath((story['media_url'] ?? '').toString()))
          (story['media_url'] ?? '').toString(),
    ]);
    for (final story in stories) {
      story['profiles'] = byId[story['user_id'].toString()] ?? {};
      final path = (story['media_url'] ?? '').toString();
      story['resolved_url'] = _isStoragePath(path)
          ? (storyUrls[path] ?? '')
          : (path == 'pending' ? '' : path);
    }

    return stories;
  }

  Future<void> publishStory(AssetEntity asset, String caption) async {
    final file = await asset.file;
    if (file == null) {
      throw Exception('Could not read the selected story media.');
    }

    final ext = file.path.split('.').last.toLowerCase();
    final storyId = await _db
        .from('stories')
        .insert({
          'user_id': userId,
          'media_url': 'pending',
          'media_type': asset.type == AssetType.video ? 'video' : 'image',
          'caption': caption.trim(),
        })
        .select('id')
        .single();

    final id = storyId['id'].toString();
    final objectPath =
        '$userId/$id/${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}.$ext';

    try {
      await _db.storage
          .from('stories')
          .upload(
            objectPath,
            file,
            fileOptions: FileOptions(contentType: _mime(ext), upsert: false),
          );

      await _db.from('stories').update({'media_url': objectPath}).eq('id', id);
    } catch (_) {
      try {
        await _db.storage.from('stories').remove([objectPath]);
      } catch (_) {}
      try {
        await _db.from('stories').delete().eq('id', id);
      } catch (_) {}
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  String _mime(String ext) => switch (ext) {
    'jpg' => 'image/jpeg',
    'jpeg' => 'image/jpeg',
    'jpe' => 'image/jpeg',
    'png' => 'image/png',
    'webp' => 'image/webp',
    'gif' => 'image/gif',
    'mp4' => 'video/mp4',
    'm4v' => 'video/x-m4v',
    'mov' => 'video/quicktime',
    'webm' => 'video/webm',
    'mkv' => 'video/x-matroska',
    '3gp' => 'video/3gpp',
    'heic' => 'image/heic',
    'heif' => 'image/heif',
    'avif' => 'image/avif',
    _ => 'application/octet-stream',
  };

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> search(String query) async {
    final q = query.trim();
    if (q.isEmpty) return [];
    final safe = q
        .replaceAll('%', r'\%')
        .replaceAll('_', r'\_')
        .replaceAll(',', ' ')
        .replaceAll('(', ' ')
        .replaceAll(')', ' ');
    final results = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    final byUsername = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id,username,display_name,bio,avatar_url,is_private')
        .ilike('username', '%$safe%')
        .limit(20);
    final byName = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id,username,display_name,bio,avatar_url,is_private')
        .ilike('display_name', '%$safe%')
        .limit(20);
    final usersById = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
    for (final row in [...byUsername, ...byName]) {
      final user = Map<String, dynamic>.from(row as Map);
      usersById[user['id'].toString()] = user;
    }
    results.addAll(usersById.values.map((e) => {...e, 'result_type': 'user'}));
    final posts = await _db
        .from('posts')
        .select(
          'id,user_id,caption,created_at,profiles!posts_user_id_fkey(username,display_name,avatar_url)',
        )
        .ilike('caption', '%$safe%')
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .limit(20);
    results.addAll(
      (posts as List).map(
        (e) => {...Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map), 'result_type': 'post'},
      ),
    );
    return results;
  }

  Future<String> getFollowLabel(String profileId) async {
    if (profileId.isEmpty || profileId == userId) return '';

    final outgoing = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('status')
        .eq('follower_id', userId)
        .eq('following_id', profileId)
        .maybeSingle();

    final incoming = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('status')
        .eq('follower_id', profileId)
        .eq('following_id', userId)
        .maybeSingle();

    final outgoingStatus = (outgoing?['status'] ?? '').toString();
    final incomingStatus = (incoming?['status'] ?? '').toString();

    if (outgoingStatus == 'pending') return 'Requested';
    final followsMe = incomingStatus == 'accepted';
    final iFollow = outgoingStatus == 'accepted';

    if (iFollow && followsMe) return 'Connected';
    if (iFollow) return 'Following';
    if (followsMe) return 'Follow Back';
    return 'Follow';
  }

  Future<bool> isFollowing(String profileId) async =>
      await _db
          .from('follows')
          .select('follower_id')
          .eq('follower_id', userId)
          .eq('following_id', profileId)
          .eq('status', 'accepted')
          .maybeSingle() !=
      null;

  Future<bool> isConnected(String profileId) async {
    final outgoing = await isFollowing(profileId);
    if (!outgoing) return false;
    final incoming = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('follower_id')
        .eq('follower_id', profileId)
        .eq('following_id', userId)
        .eq('status', 'accepted')
        .maybeSingle();
    return incoming != null;
  }

  Future<bool> isPrivateAccount(String profileId) async {
    final row = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('is_private')
        .eq('id', profileId)
        .maybeSingle();
    return row?['is_private'] == true;
  }

  Future<void> follow(String profileId, {required bool privateAccount}) async {
    if (profileId == userId) {
      throw ArgumentError('You cannot follow your own account.');
    }

    final existing = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('follower_id')
        .eq('follower_id', userId)
        .eq('following_id', profileId)
        .maybeSingle();

    if (existing != null) return;

    try {
      await _db.from('follows').insert({
        'follower_id': userId,
        'following_id': profileId,
        'status': privateAccount ? 'pending' : 'accepted',
      });
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      // A concurrent tap may have created the same relationship already.
      if (e.code == '23505') return;
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> unfollow(String profileId) async {
    await _db
        .from('follows')
        .delete()
        .eq('follower_id', userId)
        .eq('following_id', profileId);
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> followProfiles({
    required String profileId,
    required bool followers,
  }) async {
    final relationshipColumn = followers ? 'following_id' : 'follower_id';
    final resultColumn = followers ? 'follower_id' : 'following_id';

    final relations = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select(resultColumn)
        .eq(relationshipColumn, profileId)
        .eq('status', 'accepted');

    final ids = (relations as List)
        .map((row) => (row[resultColumn] ?? '').toString())
        .where((id) => id.isNotEmpty)
        .toSet()
        .toList();

    if (ids.isEmpty) return [];

    final rows = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id,display_name,username,avatar_url,is_private')
        .inFilter('id', ids)
        .order('display_name');

    final profiles = (rows as List)
        .map((row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row as Map))
        .toList();

    final currentUserId = userId;
    final outgoingRows = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('following_id,status')
        .eq('follower_id', currentUserId)
        .inFilter('following_id', ids);
    final outgoingStatus = <String, String>{};
    for (final row in outgoingRows as List) {
      outgoingStatus[(row['following_id'] ?? '').toString()] =
          (row['status'] ?? '').toString();
    }

    for (final profile in profiles) {
      final id = (profile['id'] ?? '').toString();
      final status = outgoingStatus[id];
      profile['is_following_back'] = status == 'accepted';
      profile['follow_request_pending'] = status == 'pending';
      profile['is_connected'] = id.isNotEmpty ? await isConnected(id) : false;
      profile['is_current_user'] = id == currentUserId;
    }

    return Future.wait(profiles.map(_resolveProfileAvatar));
  }

  Future<int> commentCount(String postId) async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('comments')
        .select('id')
        .eq('post_id', postId)
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
    return (rows as List).length;
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> comments(String postId) async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) throw AuthException('Please sign in again.');
    try {
      final rows = await _db
          .from('comments')
          .select(
            'id,post_id,user_id,parent_id,body,created_at,profiles!comments_user_id_fkey(id,username,display_name,avatar_url)',
          )
          .eq('post_id', postId)
          .order('created_at')
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
      final result = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      for (final raw in rows as List) {
        final row = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map);
        final rawProfile = row['profiles'];
        if (rawProfile is Map) {
          final profile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawProfile);
          if (profile.isNotEmpty) {
            row['profiles'] = await _resolveProfileAvatar(profile);
          }
        } else if (rawProfile is List && rawProfile.isNotEmpty) {
          final profile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawProfile.first as Map);
          row['profiles'] = await _resolveProfileAvatar(profile);
        }
        result.add(row);
      }
      await _cache.put(uid, 'comments', result, id: postId);
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      if (_looksLikeNetworkFailure(error)) {
        return cachedComments(postId);
      }
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> cachedComments(String postId) async {
    final value = await _cache.get(userId, 'comments', id: postId);
    if (value is! List) return [];
    return value.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList();
  }

  String _newCommentId() {
    final random = Random.secure();
    final bytes = List<int>.generate(16, (_) => random.nextInt(256));
    bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
    bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
    final hex = bytes.map((b) => b.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0')).join();
    return '${hex.substring(0, 8)}-${hex.substring(8, 12)}-'
        '${hex.substring(12, 16)}-${hex.substring(16, 20)}-${hex.substring(20)}';
  }

  /// Returns true when confirmed by Supabase; false when safely queued offline.
  Future<bool> addComment(
    String postId,
    String body, {
    String? commentId,
  }) async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) throw AuthException('Please sign in again.');
    final text = body.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return true;
    final id = commentId ?? _newCommentId();

    // Use the cached profile for immediate/offline comments. If the profile
    // has not been cached yet, fall back to available auth metadata.
    final cachedProfile = await _cache.get(uid, 'profile');
    final user = _db.auth.currentUser!;
    final metadata = user.userMetadata ?? const <String, dynamic>{};
    final authorProfile = cachedProfile is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(cachedProfile)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    authorProfile['id'] ??= uid;
    authorProfile['username'] ??=
        (metadata['username'] ?? user.email?.split('@').first ?? 'user')
            .toString();
    authorProfile['display_name'] ??=
        (metadata['display_name'] ??
                metadata['name'] ??
                metadata['full_name'] ??
                authorProfile['username'])
            .toString();

    final payload = <String, dynamic>{
      'id': id,
      'post_id': postId,
      'user_id': uid,
      'body': text,
    };
    try {
      await _db
          .from('comments')
          .insert(payload)
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
      final pending = await _cache.pending(uid);
      for (final item in pending) {
        if (item['operation'] == 'add_comment' &&
            item['payload'] is Map &&
            item['payload']['id'] == id) {
          await _cache.removePending(item['id'].toString());
        }
      }
      final cached = await _cache.get(uid, 'comments', id: postId);
      final rows = cached is List
          ? cached.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList()
          : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      if (!rows.any((row) => row['id']?.toString() == id)) {
        rows.add({
          ...payload,
          'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
          'profiles': authorProfile,
        });
        await _cache.put(uid, 'comments', rows, id: postId);
      }
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      if (!_looksLikeNetworkFailure(error)) rethrow;
      await _cache.enqueue(uid, 'add_comment', payload);
      final cached = await _cache.get(uid, 'comments', id: postId);
      final rows = cached is List
          ? cached.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList()
          : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      if (!rows.any((row) => row['id']?.toString() == id)) {
        rows.add({
          ...payload,
          'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
          'profiles': authorProfile,
          '_queued': true,
        });
        await _cache.put(uid, 'comments', rows, id: postId);
      }
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> notifications() async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('notifications')
        .select(
          'id,type,is_read,created_at,profiles!notifications_actor_id_fkey(username,display_name,avatar_url),posts(caption)',
        )
        .eq('recipient_id', userId)
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .limit(50);
    return (rows as List)
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
        .toList();
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> myPosts() async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('posts')
        .select(
          'id,user_id,caption,created_at,post_media(media_url,media_type,position)',
        )
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .limit(100);
    return (rows as List)
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
        .toList();
  }

  Future<int> count(String table, String column, String value) async {
    final rows = await _db.from(table).select(column).eq(column, value);
    return (rows as List).length;
  }

  Future<String> createConversation(String otherUserId) async {
    final session = _db.auth.currentSession;
    if (session == null) {
      throw AuthException('Your session has expired. Please sign in again.');
    }

    // Validate the active access token with Supabase before writing.
    final verified = await _db.auth.getUser();
    final verifiedUser = verified.user;
    if (verifiedUser == null) {
      throw AuthException(
        'Could not verify your account. Please sign in again.',
      );
    }
    final uid = verifiedUser.id;

    if (uid != session.user.id) {
      throw AuthException(
        'Authentication identity mismatch. Please sign out and sign in again.',
      );
    }

    if (otherUserId == uid) {
      throw const FormatException('You cannot message yourself.');
    }

    final existing = await _db
        .from('conversation_members')
        .select('conversation_id')
        .eq('user_id', uid);

    for (final row in (existing as List)) {
      final id = row['conversation_id'].toString();
      final other = await _db
          .from('conversation_members')
          .select('user_id')
          .eq('conversation_id', id)
          .eq('user_id', otherUserId)
          .maybeSingle();
      if (other != null) return id;
    }

    final created = await _db
        .from('conversations')
        .insert({'created_by': uid, 'is_group': false})
        .select('id')
        .single();

    final id = created['id'].toString();

    await _db.from('conversation_members').insert([
      {'conversation_id': id, 'user_id': uid},
      {'conversation_id': id, 'user_id': otherUserId},
    ]);

    return id;
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> conversations() async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('conversation_members')
        .select(
          'conversation_id,last_read_at,conversations(id,title,is_group,created_at)',
        )
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .order('joined_at', ascending: false);
    return (rows as List)
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
        .toList();
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> messages(String conversationId) async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('messages')
        .select(
          'id,conversation_id,sender_id,body,media_url,media_type,created_at',
        )
        .eq('conversation_id', conversationId)
        .isFilter('deleted_at', null)
        .order('created_at')
        .limit(200);
    return (rows as List)
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
        .toList();
  }

  Future<void> sendMessage(String conversationId, String body) async {
    if (body.trim().isEmpty) return;
    await _db.from('messages').insert({
      'conversation_id': conversationId,
      'sender_id': userId,
      'body': body.trim(),
    });
  }
}

# Twice

Twice is a Flutter social-media UI prototype with a C++ native core.

## Current scope

- Home feed with local demo posts
- Story strip and profile cards
- Local like/unlike interactions
- Explore search across demo content
- Create-post UI with in-memory demo publishing
- Profile and activity screens
- C++ library accessed through Dart FFI
- GitHub Actions workflow for an Android debug APK

## Backend

Supabase is intentionally not configured yet. No Supabase keys,
database tables, authentication, or remote storage are included.

## Build

```bash
flutter pub get
flutter analyze
flutter test
flutter build apk --debug
```

The GitHub Actions workflow runs the checks and uploads `app-debug.apk`
as the `Twice-debug-APK` workflow artifact.

FILE: README_CONNECTED_ARCHITECTURE.md
==========================================================================================
# Twice — Supabase integration update

This update removes the hard-coded sample feed, sample story strip, demo activity rows, and placeholder profile identity from the active UI. It introduces a Supabase repository boundary at `lib/data/social_repository.dart` and connects the primary UI flows to the existing schema.

## Connected in this update

- Existing Google/Supabase authentication remains in place.
- Profile bootstrap uses the authenticated user and existing `public.profiles` row; display name and `@username` are loaded from Supabase.
- Profile editing updates `display_name`, `username`, and `bio` with client-side username validation.
- Feed reads real `posts`, author profiles, media rows, and likes under the database's RLS policies.
- Like/unlike updates `post_likes` with optimistic UI and refresh-on-error.
- Composer publishes real posts; selected photos/videos upload to the private `post-media` bucket at `user_id/post_id/filename`, and media metadata is written to `post_media`.
- Private post media is resolved through short-lived signed URLs.
- Search returns real profiles and posts.
- Comments read/write `public.comments`.
- Activity reads `public.notifications`.
- Existing conversations and messages are read from `conversation_members`, `conversations`, and `messages`; a direct conversation can be started from a user search result.
- Native C++ library and Android build configuration are retained.

## Not represented as finished

This is a source integration pass, not a claim of production certification. I could not run Flutter/Dart analysis or an Android build in this environment. The GitHub Actions workflow should be used to compile and test this exact source before installing it.

The following still need implementation/verification in subsequent passes: story creation/viewing and expiry cleanup, avatar upload and profile photo picker, notification generation and read-state updates, live realtime subscriptions, media attachments in chat, pagination/infinite scrolling, post deletion/editing and save-state display, complete follow-request approval UI, privacy settings UI, and end-to-end RLS testing with multiple real accounts. Chat-media policy migration 005 is included but not automatically applied.

## Storage object conventions

- Post media: `post-media/{auth.uid}/{post_uuid}/{filename}`. `post_media.media_url` stores the object path, not a public URL.
- Story media (for a future story uploader): `stories/{auth.uid}/{story_uuid}/{filename}`.
- Chat media (for a future attachment uploader): `chat-media/{uploader_uid}/{conversation_uuid}/{filename}`.
- Avatar bucket remains public by existing project configuration; avatar upload is not implemented in this update.

Never put the Supabase service-role key or access token in Flutter source. The mobile app uses only the publishable/anon client key and relies on RLS.

## Supabase migration

Migrations `001`–`004` were reported applied before this source bundle was prepared. Migration `005` changes chat-media read policy so any member of a conversation can read an object stored under that conversation's path, while writes/deletes remain uploader-folder restricted. Apply it only after reviewing the policy and confirming the object path convention:

```bash
cd ~/Twice
supabase db query --linked --output-format json "$(cat supabase/migrations/20261019000500_twice_chat_media_member_access.sql)"
```

## Validate

From GitHub Actions, run the existing workflow's `flutter analyze`, `flutter test`, and ARM64 release build. If it fails, send the complete failing step output; do not rotate toolchain versions to work around errors.

FILE: TWICE_CONNECTIVITY_FIXES_README.txt
==========================================================================================
TWICE CONNECTIVITY / MEDIA / OFFLINE CACHE UPDATE
================================================

Files changed
-------------
- lib/main.dart
  * Media picker queries image and video assets separately and de-duplicates them.
  * Post comments render optimistically and stop waiting after a bounded timeout.
  * Video/image feed rendering supports persistent local file URIs.
- lib/data/social_repository.dart
  * Comment reads use an explicit comments -> profiles FK relation.
  * Comment requests have a 15-second timeout and expose non-network errors.
  * Offline comments are stored in the existing local outbox and replayed on launch.
  * Feed media and profile avatars are warmed into persistent app storage in the
    background; cached feed rows are updated to file:// URIs after successful downloads.
- lib/data/offline_media_cache.dart
  * New persistent media file cache with bounded image/video download sizes.
- pubspec.yaml / pubspec.lock
  * Declare http and path_provider as direct dependencies.
- supabase/migrations/20261021000100_twice_media_bucket_formats.sql
  * Allows common phone-captured formats in the private post-media and stories
    buckets while keeping each bucket private.

Apply the source update in Termux
---------------------------------
The full ZIP contains a top-level `Twice/` directory. From Termux run:

  unzip -o ~/storage/downloads/Twice-connected-fixes-full-project.zip -d ~

Then return to the project:

  cd ~/Twice

This overlays updated source files without deleting your existing Git history.
The archive intentionally omits generated build caches and Supabase's local
`.temp` metadata.

Supabase migration
------------------
The SQL migration is included but is NOT automatically executed by the Android
build workflow. Review and run
`supabase/migrations/20261021000100_twice_media_bucket_formats.sql`
in Supabase Dashboard -> SQL Editor if you want uploads of HEIC/HEIF/AVIF,
MOV/QuickTime, M4V, 3GP, and Matroska files. Existing JPG/PNG/WebP/GIF and
MP4/WebM uploads remain supported by the current bucket settings.

Build and verify
----------------
This environment did not have Flutter/Dart installed and cannot run a real
Android build or authenticate to your Supabase project. After applying the ZIP,
push the changes to your GitHub repository and inspect both GitHub Actions jobs:
`Build Android APK` and `Verify Dart code and tests`. If either job fails, send
the full log; do not assume the APK is validated until CI succeeds.

Offline behavior and limits
---------------------------
- Feed/profile/comment metadata is cached per signed-in account in SQLite.
- Up to 12 feed media items per refresh are warmed in the background, including
  video posters when available. Each video cache is capped at 80 MiB and each
  image/poster/avatar at 18 MiB; oversized or unavailable files remain online-only.
- A queued comment is shown immediately with an offline-pending label and retried
  when the signed-in app starts with connectivity.
- A permanent Supabase policy/schema error is shown to the user instead of being
  silently treated as a successful comment.
- Local cache is account-scoped; logging out purges that account's SQLite cache.

TWICE NATIVE GOOGLE SIGN-IN FIX

Files in this ZIP replace files in your existing ~/Twice project. This changes Google login from browser OAuth to the native Google Sign-In account chooser, then signs in to Supabase using the Google ID token.

INSTALL IN TERMUX
1. Copy this ZIP into ~/storage/downloads.
2. Run: cd ~/Twice && unzip -o ~/storage/downloads/Twice_Native_Google_SignIn_Fix.zip
3. Review: git diff --check
4. Commit/push: git add lib/main.dart pubspec.yaml .github/workflows/android.yml && git commit -m "Use native Google account chooser for sign in" && git push origin main

REQUIRED GITHUB SECRET
Add GOOGLE_SERVER_CLIENT_ID in repository Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions. Its value must be the Google OAuth CLIENT ID of type Web application (not the Android client ID). The same Web client ID must be configured in Supabase Authentication > Sign In / Providers > Google. Do not put a client secret in the app or in Dart defines.

GOOGLE CLOUD SETUP
Create/configure an Android OAuth client for package com.twice.app (confirm applicationId in android/app/build.gradle.kts) and add the SHA-1 fingerprint of the signing certificate used by your GitHub Actions build. Since the current release is debug-signed, use the debug keystore SHA-1 for that CI build.

NOTES
- The native account chooser is provided by Google Play services; it is not an embedded web page.
- Supabase Google provider must be enabled.
- Supabase's allowed redirect URLs no longer control this native ID-token login path.
- The ZIP does not include secrets. pubspec.lock is intentionally not replaced; GitHub Actions runs flutter pub get and updates dependency resolution on its runner.
- This patch has not been run through your GitHub Actions build here. Check CI output before installing the APK.

#include <jni.h>
#include <android/log.h>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdint>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <string>

#define LOG_TAG "TwiceNative"
#define LOGI(...) __android_log_print(ANDROID_LOG_INFO, LOG_TAG, __VA_ARGS__)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Basic arithmetic (kept for existing Dart FFI lookup)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
extern "C" JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL
twice_native_add(JNIEnv *, jobject, jint a, jint b) {
    return a + b;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Fast image downscale helper (nearest-neighbour) for offline cache thumbnails.
// Called from Dart via FFI when generating small avatars / list thumbnails.
// RGBA8888 in → RGBA8888 out. Returns 0 on success, -1 on bad args.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
extern "C" JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL
twice_native_resize_rgba(
    JNIEnv *env,
    jobject,
    jbyteArray src,
    jint srcW,
    jint srcH,
    jbyteArray dst,
    jint dstW,
    jint dstH
) {
    if (srcW <= 0 || srcH <= 0 || dstW <= 0 || dstH <= 0) return -1;
    const jsize srcLen = env->GetArrayLength(src);
    const jsize dstLen = env->GetArrayLength(dst);
    if (srcLen < srcW * srcH * 4) return -1;
    if (dstLen < dstW * dstH * 4) return -1;

    jbyte *s = env->GetByteArrayElements(src, nullptr);
    jbyte *d = env->GetByteArrayElements(dst, nullptr);
    if (!s || !d) {
        if (s) env->ReleaseByteArrayElements(src, s, JNI_ABORT);
        if (d) env->ReleaseByteArrayElements(dst, d, JNI_ABORT);
        return -1;
    }

    for (int y = 0; y < dstH; ++y) {
        const int sy = (y * srcH) / dstH;
        for (int x = 0; x < dstW; ++x) {
            const int sx = (x * srcW) / dstW;
            const int si = (sy * srcW + sx) * 4;
            const int di = (y * dstW + x) * 4;
            d[di]     = s[si];
            d[di + 1] = s[si + 1];
            d[di + 2] = s[si + 2];
            d[di + 3] = s[si + 3];
        }
    }

    env->ReleaseByteArrayElements(src, s, JNI_ABORT);
    env->ReleaseByteArrayElements(dst, d, 0);
    return 0;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CRC32 (fast integrity check for offline media cache files)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
static uint32_t crc_table[256];
static bool crc_ready = false;

static void init_crc() {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
        uint32_t c = i;
        for (int k = 0; k < 8; ++k)
            c = (c & 1) ? (0xEDB88320u ^ (c >> 1)) : (c >> 1);
        crc_table[i] = c;
    }
    crc_ready = true;
}

extern "C" JNIEXPORT jlong JNICALL
twice_native_crc32(JNIEnv *env, jobject, jbyteArray data) {
    if (!crc_ready) init_crc();
    const jsize len = env->GetArrayLength(data);
    jbyte *buf = env->GetByteArrayElements(data, nullptr);
    if (!buf) return 0;
    uint32_t crc = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    for (jsize i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
        crc = crc_table[(crc ^ static_cast<uint8_t>(buf[i])) & 0xFF] ^ (crc >> 8);
    }
    env->ReleaseByteArrayElements(data, buf, JNI_ABORT);
    return static_cast<jlong>(crc ^ 0xFFFFFFFFu);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Simple frame-drop soft limiter: returns recommended skip count for a
// given target FPS vs measured frame time (microseconds). Used by video
// feed to avoid jank when many players are attached.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
extern "C" JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL
twice_native_frame_skip(JNIEnv *, jobject, jlong frameUs, jint targetFps) {
    if (targetFps <= 0) return 0;
    const jlong budget = 1000000L / targetFps;
    if (frameUs <= budget) return 0;
    const jint skip = static_cast<jint>((frameUs / budget) - 1);
    return skip > 4 ? 4 : skip;
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

/// Central AdMob configuration for Twice.
///
/// Debug / profile builds ALWAYS use Google's official test ad unit so your own
/// account is never at risk of invalid-traffic flags. Release builds use your
/// real native ad unit. To force live ads in a debug build (not recommended):
///   flutter run --dart-define=TWICE_LIVE_ADS=true
class TwiceAdConfig {
  TwiceAdConfig._();

  /// AdMob App ID (also declared in AndroidManifest.xml).
  static const String appId = 'ca-app-pub-2388362234538140~1307597758';

  /// Your real native ad unit.
  static const String liveNativeUnitId =
      'ca-app-pub-2388362234538140/2313557661';

  /// Google's official "Native Advanced Video" test unit (Android).
  static const String testNativeVideoUnitId =
      'ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/1044960115';

  /// Google's official "Native Advanced" test unit for Native Templates (Android).
  static const String testNativeUnitId =
      'ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/2247696110';

  static const bool _forceLive = bool.fromEnvironment('TWICE_LIVE_ADS');

  static String get nativeUnitId =>
      (kReleaseMode || _forceLive) ? liveNativeUnitId : testNativeUnitId;

  /// One ad after every [feedInterval] organic posts (recommended 5 to 7).
  static const int feedInterval = 4;

  /// Hard cap so a very long feed never builds unlimited ad slots.
  static const int maxAdSlots = 12;

  /// An ad that has been loaded this long is considered stale and re-requested.
  static const Duration adTtl = Duration(minutes: 50);

  /// After a failed request, wait this long before asking again for that slot.
  static const Duration failureBackoff = Duration(seconds: 60);

  /// Height reserved for the native ad media block (skeleton and ad share it,
  /// so nothing jumps when the ad fades in).
  static const double adHeight = 380;

  /// Add your phone's test-device hash here (it is printed in logcat as
  /// "Use RequestConfiguration.Builder().setTestDeviceIds(...)") if you ever
  /// need to tap live ads on your own device safely.
  static const List<String> testDeviceIds = <String>[];
}

FILE: backup/chat_ads_comments_fix_extract/Twice-Ads-Comments-Fix/lib/data/social_repository.dart
