                                      : const Icon(
                                          Icons.person_rounded,
                                          size: 54,
                                          color: muted,
                                        ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                            Positioned(
                              right: 0,
                              bottom: 0,
                              child: Material(
                                color: violet,
                                shape: const CircleBorder(),
                                child: InkWell(
                                  customBorder: const CircleBorder(),
                                  onTap: _choosePhoto,
                                  child: const Padding(
                                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(10),
                                    child: Icon(
                                      Icons.add_rounded,
                                      color: Colors.white,
                                      size: 22,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        TextButton.icon(
                          onPressed: _choosePhoto,
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.photo_outlined),
                          label: const Text('Change profile photo'),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 24),
                  TextField(
                    controller: display,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                    maxLength: 60,
                    decoration: _decoration(
                      'Display name',
                      Icons.person_outline_rounded,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  TextField(
                    controller: username,
                    autocorrect: false,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.none,
                    decoration: _decoration(
                      '@Username',
                      Icons.alternate_email_rounded,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  TextField(
                    controller: bio,
                    maxLines: 4,
                    maxLength: 160,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                    decoration: _decoration('Bio', Icons.notes_rounded),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 12, 20, 16),
              decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                color: igBlack,
                border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF363636))),
              ),
              child: SizedBox(
                width: double.infinity,
                height: 54,
                child: FilledButton(
                  onPressed: saving ? null : _save,
                  style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: violet,
                    foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: saving
                      ? const SizedBox(
                          width: 22,
                          height: 22,
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                            strokeWidth: 2,
                            color: Colors.white,
                          ),
                        )
                      : const Text(
                          'Save Changes',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 16,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          ),
                        ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class FollowListPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const FollowListPage({
    super.key,
    required this.profileId,
    required this.followers,
  });

  final String profileId;
  final bool followers;

  @override
  State<FollowListPage> createState() => _FollowListPageState();
}

class _FollowListPageState extends State<FollowListPage> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> users = [];
  final Set<String> _busyUsers = {};
  bool loading = true;
  String? error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        loading = true;
        error = null;
      });
    }
    try {
      final result = await SocialRepository.instance.followProfiles(
        profileId: widget.profileId,
        followers: widget.followers,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        users = result;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        error = e.toString();
        loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  Widget _followAction(Map<String, dynamic> user) {
    final id = (user['id'] ?? '').toString();
    final connected = user['is_connected'] == true;
    final followingBack = user['is_following_back'] == true;
    final busy = _busyUsers.contains(id);

    final label = connected
        ? 'Connected'
        : followingBack
        ? 'Following'
        : user['follow_request_pending'] == true
        ? 'Requested'
        : 'Follow back';

    return OutlinedButton(
      onPressed: busy || id.isEmpty || connected || followingBack
          ? null
          : () async {
              setState(() => _busyUsers.add(id));
              try {
                final repo = SocialRepository.instance;
                final privateAccount = await repo.isPrivateAccount(id);
                await repo.follow(id, privateAccount: privateAccount);
                if (!mounted) return;
                await _load();
              } catch (e) {
                if (mounted) {
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                    SnackBar(content: Text('Could not follow user: $e')),
                  );
                }
              } finally {
                if (mounted) setState(() => _busyUsers.remove(id));
              }
            },
      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
        foregroundColor: connected ? Colors.green.shade700 : violet,
        side: BorderSide(
          color: connected ? Colors.green.shade300 : const Color(0xFF363636),
        ),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 9),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13)),
      ),
      child: busy
          ? const SizedBox(
              width: 16,
              height: 16,
              child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: violet),
            )
          : Text(
              label,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
            ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final title = widget.followers ? 'Followers' : 'Following';
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: canvas,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        leading: IconButton(
          tooltip: 'Back',
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
        ),
        title: Text(
          title,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
        ),
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: loading
            ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: violet))
            : error != null
            ? Center(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      const Icon(
                        Icons.cloud_off_rounded,
                        size: 42,
                        color: muted,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      const Text(
                        'Could not load users',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          fontSize: 17,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Text(
                        error!,
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        style: const TextStyle(color: muted),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      FilledButton.icon(
                        onPressed: _load,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded),
                        label: const Text('Try again'),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              )
            : users.isEmpty
            ? Center(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                        color: Color(0xFF262626),
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      ),
                      child: const Icon(
                        Icons.people_outline_rounded,
                        size: 36,
                        color: violet,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    Text(
                      widget.followers
                          ? 'No followers yet'
                          : 'Not following anyone yet',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 17,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 5),
                    const Text(
                      'People will appear here when available.',
                      style: TextStyle(color: muted),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              )
            : RefreshIndicator(
                color: violet,
                onRefresh: _load,
                child: ListView.separated(
                  physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 24),
                  itemCount: users.length,
                  separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  itemBuilder: (_, index) {
                    final user = users[index];
                    final name = (user['display_name'] ?? '').toString().trim();
                    final username = (user['username'] ?? '').toString().trim();
                    final avatar = (user['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
                    return GestureDetector(
                      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                      onTap: () => _openUserProfile(
                        context,
                        userId: (user['id'] ?? '').toString(),
                        profile: user,
                      ),
                      child: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 14,
                          vertical: 12,
                        ),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: igSurface,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                          border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF363636)),
                        ),
                        child: Row(
                          children: [
                            CircleAvatar(
                              radius: 27,
                              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF262626),
                              backgroundImage: avatar.isNotEmpty
                                  ? _twiceAvatarProvider(avatar)
                                  : null,
                              child: avatar.isEmpty
                                  ? const Icon(
                                      Icons.person_rounded,
                                      color: violet,
                                      size: 28,
                                    )
                                  : null,
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 13),
                            Expanded(
                              child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                children: [
                                  Text(
                                    name.isEmpty ? username : name,
                                    maxLines: 1,
                                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                      fontSize: 15,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 3),
                                  Text(
                                    username.isEmpty ? '@user' : '@$username',
                                    maxLines: 1,
                                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                      color: muted,
                                      fontSize: 13,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                            if (widget.followers &&
                                user['is_current_user'] != true) ...[
                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                              _followAction(user),
                            ],
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ProfilePageState extends State<ProfilePage> {
  bool _accountMenuOpen = false;

  int selectedTab = 0;
  int followersCount = 0;
  int followingCount = 0;
  bool _countsLoading = true;
  List<SocialPost>? _loadedPosts;
  bool _postsLoading = true;
  String? _postsError;

  String get _uid =>
      Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id ??
      (widget.profile['id'] ?? '').toString();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadFollowCounts();
    _loadOwnPosts();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant ProfilePage oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.profile['id'] != widget.profile['id']) {
      _countsLoading = true;
      _loadFollowCounts();
      _loadOwnPosts();
    } else if (!identical(oldWidget.posts, widget.posts)) {
      _loadOwnPosts(silent: true);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadOwnPosts({bool silent = false}) async {
    final id = _uid;
    if (id.isEmpty) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _postsLoading = false);
      return;
    }
    if (!silent && mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _postsLoading = true;
        _postsError = null;
      });
    }
    try {
      final rows = await SocialRepository.instance.userPosts(id);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _loadedPosts = rows.map(SocialPost.new).toList();
        _postsLoading = false;
        _postsError = null;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _postsLoading = false;
        _postsError = _posts.isEmpty ? _searchError(e) : null;
      });
    }
  }

  // Own posts: the complete list when loaded, otherwise the cached feed.
  List<SocialPost> get _posts =>
      _loadedPosts ??
      widget.posts.where((p) => p.data['user_id'] == _uid).toList();

  bool _isPhoto(SocialPost p) => p.media.any((m) {
    final t = (m['media_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
    return t == 'image' || t == 'gif';
  });

  bool _isVideo(SocialPost p) => p.media.any(
    (m) => (m['media_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() == 'video',
  );

  List<SocialPost> get _visiblePosts => selectedTab == 1
      ? _posts.where(_isPhoto).toList()
      : selectedTab == 2
      ? _posts.where(_isVideo).toList()
      : _posts;

  Future<void> _logout() async {
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
        title: const Text('Log out of Twice?'),
        content: const Text(
          'You will be signed out of your account on this device.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFD92D20),
            ),
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
            child: const Text('Log out'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirmed != true || !mounted) return;

    try {
      await Supabase.instance.client.auth.signOut(scope: SignOutScope.local);
      // TwiceAuthGate listens to onAuthStateChange and returns to sign-in.
    } catch (_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('Could not log out. Please try again.')),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadFollowCounts() async {
    final id = (widget.profile['id'] ?? '').toString();
    if (id.isEmpty) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _countsLoading = false);
      return;
    }
    try {
      final db = Supabase.instance.client;
      final values = await Future.wait<List<dynamic>>([
        db
            .from('follows')
            .select('follower_id')
            .eq('following_id', id)
            .eq('status', 'accepted'),
        db
            .from('follows')
            .select('following_id')
            .eq('follower_id', id)
            .eq('status', 'accepted'),
      ]);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        followersCount = values[0].length;
        followingCount = values[1].length;
        _countsLoading = false;
      });
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _countsLoading = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _edit() async {
    await Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => EditProfilePage(
          profile: Map<String, dynamic>.from(widget.profile),
          onSaved: widget.onRefresh,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _shareProfile() async {
    final username = (widget.profile['username'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (username.isEmpty || !mounted) return;

    final profileUrl = 'https://twice.app/@$username';
    final avatarUrl = (widget.profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final displayName = (widget.profile['display_name'] ?? '')
        .toString()
        .trim();
    final brightness = ScreenBrightness();

    try {
      await brightness.setApplicationScreenBrightness(1.0);
      if (!mounted) {
        await brightness.resetApplicationScreenBrightness();
        return;
      }

      await showDialog<void>(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: true,
        builder: (dialogContext) => Dialog(
          insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: 20,
            vertical: 24,
          ),
          backgroundColor: igElevated,
          elevation: 18,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(32),
          ),
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 24),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Align(
                    alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                    child: IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Close',
                      onPressed: () => Navigator.of(dialogContext).pop(),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded),
                    ),
                  ),
                  Container(
                    width: 76,
                    height: 76,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      border: Border.all(
                        color: const Color(0xFF262626),
                        width: 3,
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: CircleAvatar(
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF262626),
                      backgroundImage: avatarUrl.isNotEmpty
                          ? _twiceAvatarProvider(avatarUrl)
                          : null,
                      child: avatarUrl.isEmpty
                          ? const Icon(Icons.person_rounded, size: 38)
                          : null,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Text(
                    displayName.isNotEmpty ? displayName : '@$username',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: ink,
                      fontSize: 21,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    '@$username',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: const TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 14),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 22),
                  Center(
                    child: Container(
                      width: 292,
                      height: 292,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26),
                        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF363636)),
                        boxShadow: const [
                          BoxShadow(
                            color: Color(0x12000000),
                            blurRadius: 22,
                            offset: Offset(0, 8),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      child: QrImageView(
                        data: profileUrl,
                        version: QrVersions.auto,
                        size: 272,
                        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
                        errorCorrectionLevel: QrErrorCorrectLevel.H,
                        embeddedImage: avatarUrl.isNotEmpty
                            ? _twiceAvatarProvider(avatarUrl)
                            : null,
                        embeddedImageStyle: const QrEmbeddedImageStyle(
                          size: Size(58, 58),
                        ),
                        embeddedImageEmitsError: true,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 18),
                  const Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        Icons.qr_code_scanner_rounded,
                        size: 18,
                        color: violet,
                      ),
                      SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Flexible(
                        child: Text(
                          'Scan to find this profile on Twice',
                          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: muted,
                            fontSize: 13,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 22),
                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    height: 52,
                    child: FilledButton.icon(
                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: violet,
                        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(17),
                        ),
                      ),
                      onPressed: () async {
                        await Clipboard.setData(
                          ClipboardData(text: profileUrl),
                        );
                        if (dialogContext.mounted) {
                          Navigator.of(dialogContext).pop();
                        }
                        if (mounted) {
                          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                            const SnackBar(
                              content: Text('Profile link copied'),
                            ),
                          );
                        }
                      },
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.copy_rounded),
                      label: const Text(
                        'Copy profile link',
                        style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      await brightness.resetApplicationScreenBrightness();
    }
  }

  void _openFollowList(bool followers) {
    if (_countsLoading) return;
    Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => FollowListPage(
          profileId: (widget.profile['id'] ?? _uid).toString(),
          followers: followers,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _openPost(SocialPost post) async {
    await Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => PostDetailPage(post: post, authorTappable: false),
      ),
    );
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Widget _headerCard() {
    final profile = widget.profile;
    final avatar = (profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString();
    final username = (profile['username'] ?? '').toString();
    final displayName = (profile['display_name'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final shownName = displayName.isEmpty ? username : displayName;
    final bio = (profile['bio'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final isPrivate = profile['is_private'] == true;
    return _IgProfileHeader(
      avatar: avatar,
      name: shownName,
      bio: bio,
      isPrivate: isPrivate,
      posts: _postsLoading && _posts.isEmpty
          ? '…'
          : _compactCount(_posts.length),
      followers: _countsLoading ? '…' : _compactCount(followersCount),
      following: _countsLoading ? '…' : _compactCount(followingCount),
      onFollowers: () => _openFollowList(true),
      onFollowing: () => _openFollowList(false),
      actions: [
        Expanded(
          child: _IgProfileButton(label: 'Edit profile', onPressed: _edit),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        Expanded(
          child: _IgProfileButton(
            label: 'Share profile',
            onPressed: _shareProfile,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _tabBar() {
    return Container(
      height: 52,
      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
        color: canvas,
        border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: igBorder, width: 0.5)),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          _igProfileTab(
            icon: Icons.grid_on_rounded,
            active: selectedTab == 0,
            onTap: () => setState(() => selectedTab = 0),
          ),
          _igProfileTab(
            icon: Icons.photo_outlined,
            active: selectedTab == 1,
            onTap: () => setState(() => selectedTab = 1),
          ),
          _igProfileTab(
            icon: Icons.play_circle_outline_rounded,
            active: selectedTab == 2,
            onTap: () => setState(() => selectedTab = 2),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  List<Widget> _content() {
    final items = _visiblePosts;
    if (_postsLoading && _posts.isEmpty) {
      return [
        SliverPadding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
          sliver: SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: SizedBox(
              height: 330,
              child: _Pulse(
                child: GridView.count(
                  physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                  crossAxisCount: 3,
                  mainAxisSpacing: 1.5,
                  crossAxisSpacing: 1.5,
                  children: List.generate(
                    9,
                    (_) => DecoratedBox(
                      decoration: const BoxDecoration(color: Color(0xFF262626)),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ];
    }
    if (_postsError != null && _posts.isEmpty) {
      return [
        SliverToBoxAdapter(
          child: SizedBox(
            height: 300,
            child: _SearchEmpty(
              icon: Icons.cloud_off_rounded,
              title: 'Could not load posts',
              subtitle: _postsError!,
              actionLabel: 'Try again',
              onAction: _loadOwnPosts,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ];
    }
    if (items.isEmpty) {
      return [
        SliverToBoxAdapter(
          child: SizedBox(
            height: 300,
            child: _SearchEmpty(
              icon: selectedTab == 2
                  ? Icons.play_circle_outline_rounded
                  : selectedTab == 1
                  ? Icons.photo_library_outlined
                  : Icons.grid_on_rounded,
              title: selectedTab == 2
                  ? 'No videos yet'
                  : selectedTab == 1
                  ? 'No photos yet'
                  : 'No posts yet',
              subtitle: 'Share a moment and it will appear here.',
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ];
    }
    return [
      SliverPadding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
        sliver: SliverGrid(
          gridDelegate: SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
            crossAxisCount: 3,
            mainAxisSpacing: 1.5,
            crossAxisSpacing: 1.5,
            childAspectRatio: selectedTab == 2 ? 0.72 : 1,
          ),
          delegate: SliverChildBuilderDelegate(
            (_, i) => _MediaGridTile(
              post: items[i],
              onTap: () => _openPost(items[i]),
            ),
            childCount: items.length,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ];
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final topPad = MediaQuery.of(context).padding.top;
    final username = (widget.profile['username'] ?? '').toString();
    return RefreshIndicator(
      color: violet,
      onRefresh: () async {
        await widget.onRefresh();
        await Future.wait<void>([
          _loadOwnPosts(silent: true),
          _loadFollowCounts(),
        ]);
      },
      child: CustomScrollView(
        physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
        slivers: [
          SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: Column(

class MessagesPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const MessagesPage({super.key});
  @override
  State<MessagesPage> createState() => _MessagesPageState();
}

class _MessagesPageState extends State<MessagesPage> {
  late Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> future;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    future = SocialRepository.instance.conversations();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Messages')),
    body: FutureBuilder<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      future: future,
      builder: (_, s) {
        if (s.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
          return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
        }
        if (s.hasError) {
          return Center(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: Text('Could not load conversations: ${s.error}'),
            ),
          );
        }
        final rows = s.data ?? [];
        if (rows.isEmpty) {
          return const Center(child: Text('No conversations yet'));
        }
        return ListView.builder(
          itemCount: rows.length,
          itemBuilder: (_, i) {
            final r = rows[i];
            final c = r['conversations'] as Map? ?? {};
            return ListTile(
              leading: const CircleAvatar(child: Icon(Icons.person)),
              title: Text((c['title'] ?? 'Conversation').toString()),
              subtitle: const Text('Open conversation'),
              onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).push(
                MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                  builder: (_) => ConversationPage(
                    id: r['conversation_id'].toString(),
                    title: (c['title'] ?? 'Conversation').toString(),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    ),
  );
}

class ConversationPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ConversationPage({super.key, required this.id, required this.title});
  final String id, title;
  @override
  State<ConversationPage> createState() => _ConversationPageState();
}

class _ConversationPageState extends State<ConversationPage> {
  final controller = TextEditingController();
  late Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> future;
  bool sending = false;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    future = SocialRepository.instance.messages(widget.id);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _send() async {
    final body = controller.text.trim();
    if (body.isEmpty || sending) return;
    setState(() => sending = true);
    try {
      await SocialRepository.instance.sendMessage(widget.id, body);
      if (!mounted) return;
      controller.clear();
      setState(() => future = SocialRepository.instance.messages(widget.id));
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
            .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Message failed: $e')));
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => sending = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.title)),
    body: Column(
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: FutureBuilder<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
            future: future,
            builder: (_, s) {
              if (s.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
                return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
              }
              if (s.hasError) {
                return Center(
                  child: Text('Could not load messages: ${s.error}'),
                );
              }
              final rows = s.data ?? [];
              return ListView.builder(
                reverse: false,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                itemCount: rows.length,
                itemBuilder: (_, i) {
                  final r = rows[i];
                  final own =
                      r['sender_id'] ==
                      Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
                  return Align(
                    alignment: own
                        ? Alignment.centerRight
                        : Alignment.centerLeft,
                    child: Container(
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: own ? igBlue : igElevated,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                      ),
                      child: Text((r['body'] ?? '').toString()),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
        SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: TextField(
                    controller: controller,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(hintText: 'Message…'),
                  ),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  onPressed: sending ? null : _send,
                  icon: sending
                      ? const SizedBox(
                          width: 18,
                          height: 18,
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                        )
                      : const Icon(Icons.send, color: violet),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

class _ProfileNavAvatar extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ProfileNavAvatar({
    required this.url,
    required this.fallback,
    required this.selected,
  });

  final String url;
  final String fallback;
  final bool selected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final imageSource = url.trim();
    final initial = fallback.trim().isNotEmpty
        ? fallback.trim().characters.first.toUpperCase()
        : 'U';
    final hasImage = _isImageSource(imageSource);

    return Container(
      width: 29,
      height: 29,
      padding: EdgeInsets.all(selected ? 2 : 0),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        shape: BoxShape.circle,
        border: selected ? Border.all(color: Colors.white, width: 1.5) : null,
      ),
      child: ClipOval(
        child: hasImage
            ? Image(
                image: _twiceAvatarProvider(imageSource),
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                width: 29,
                height: 29,
                errorBuilder: (context, error, stackTrace) =>
                    _fallback(initial),
              )
            : _fallback(initial),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _fallback(String initial) {
    return ColoredBox(
      color: const Color(0xFF262626),
      child: Center(
        child: Text(
          initial,
          style: const TextStyle(
            color: Color(0xFF0095F6),
            fontSize: 13,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

enum _SocialNavKind { home, search, create, activity, plus }

class _SocialNavIcon extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SocialNavIcon({required this.kind, this.selected = false});

  final _SocialNavKind kind;
  final bool selected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const color = Colors.white;
    final stroke = selected
        ? (kind == _SocialNavKind.search ? 3.0 : 2.35)
        : 1.75;

    return SizedBox(
      width: 27,
      height: 27,
      child: CustomPaint(
        painter: _SocialNavPainter(
          kind: kind,
          color: color,
          stroke: stroke,
          selected: selected,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _SocialNavPainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _SocialNavPainter({
    required this.kind,
    required this.color,
    required this.stroke,
    required this.selected,
  });

  final _SocialNavKind kind;
  final Color color;
  final double stroke;
  final bool selected;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final paint = Paint()
      ..color = color
      ..style = selected ? PaintingStyle.fill : PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = stroke
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round
      ..strokeJoin = StrokeJoin.round;

    final outline = Paint()
      ..color = color
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = stroke
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round
      ..strokeJoin = StrokeJoin.round;

    switch (kind) {
      case _SocialNavKind.home:
        final path = Path()
          ..moveTo(3, 12)
          ..lineTo(13.5, 3.5)
          ..lineTo(24, 12)
          ..lineTo(22, 12)
          ..lineTo(22, 23)
          ..lineTo(15.8, 23)
          ..lineTo(15.8, 16.5)
          ..lineTo(11.2, 16.5)
          ..lineTo(11.2, 23)
          ..lineTo(5, 23)
          ..lineTo(5, 12)
          ..close();
        if (selected) {
          canvas.drawPath(path, paint);
          canvas.drawRect(
            const Rect.fromLTWH(11.2, 16.5, 4.6, 6.5),
            Paint()..color = igBlack,
          );
        } else {
          canvas.drawPath(path, outline);
        }

      case _SocialNavKind.search:
        canvas.drawCircle(const Offset(11, 11), 7, outline);
        canvas.drawLine(
          const Offset(16.2, 16.2),
          const Offset(23, 23),
          outline,
        );

      case _SocialNavKind.create:
        final back = RRect.fromRectAndRadius(
          const Rect.fromLTWH(3, 2.5, 17, 19),
          const Radius.circular(3.5),
        );
        final front = RRect.fromRectAndRadius(
          const Rect.fromLTWH(7, 5.5, 17, 19),
          const Radius.circular(3.5),
        );
        canvas.drawRRect(back, outline);
        if (selected) {
          canvas.drawRRect(front, paint);
          final cutout = Paint()..color = igBlack;
          final triangle = Path()
            ..moveTo(13, 11)
            ..lineTo(13, 19)
            ..lineTo(19, 15)
            ..close();
          canvas.drawPath(triangle, cutout);
        } else {
          canvas.drawRRect(front, outline);
          final triangle = Path()
            ..moveTo(13, 11)
            ..lineTo(13, 19)
            ..lineTo(19, 15)
            ..close();
          canvas.drawPath(triangle, outline);
        }

      case _SocialNavKind.plus:
        canvas.drawRRect(
          RRect.fromRectAndRadius(
            const Rect.fromLTWH(3, 3, 21, 21),
            const Radius.circular(6),
          ),
          outline,
        );
        final plusPaint = Paint()
          ..color = color
          ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
          ..strokeWidth = stroke
          ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round;
        canvas.drawLine(
          const Offset(13.5, 8.5),
          const Offset(13.5, 18.5),
          plusPaint,
        );
        canvas.drawLine(
          const Offset(8.5, 13.5),
          const Offset(18.5, 13.5),
          plusPaint,
        );

      case _SocialNavKind.activity:
        final heart = Path()
          ..moveTo(13.5, 23)
          ..cubicTo(11.5, 21, 3, 15, 3, 9)
          ..cubicTo(3, 3, 10, 2, 13.5, 7)
          ..cubicTo(17, 2, 24, 3, 24, 9)
          ..cubicTo(24, 15, 15.5, 21, 13.5, 23)
          ..close();
        canvas.drawPath(heart, selected ? paint : outline);
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _SocialNavPainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.kind != kind ||
      oldDelegate.color != color ||
      oldDelegate.stroke != stroke ||
      oldDelegate.selected != selected;
}

// ignore_for_file: use_build_context_synchronously
//
// Twice "Videos" tab — Facebook Reels style.
// This file is a `part` of lib/main.dart so it can reuse the app's private
// helpers (_UserAvatar, _timeAgo, _openUserProfile, SocialPost, ...).

    ..showSnackBar(

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Data
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _VideoFeedData {
  static SupabaseClient get _db => Supabase.instance.client;

  // post_media!inner + the eq() below = only posts that contain a video.
  static const String _columns =
      'id,user_id,caption,visibility,comments_enabled,created_at,'
      'profiles!posts_user_id_fkey(id,username,display_name,avatar_url),'
      'post_media!inner(id,media_url,thumbnail_url,media_type,position),'
      'post_likes(user_id),saved_posts(user_id),comments(count)';

  static bool _isPath(String v) =>
      v.isNotEmpty &&
      v != 'pending' &&
      !v.startsWith('http://') &&
      !v.startsWith('https://');

  static Future<Map<String, String>> _sign(Set<String> paths) async {
    final result = <String, String>{};
    final list = paths.where((p) => p.isNotEmpty).toList();
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i += 100) {
      final chunk = list.sublist(i, min(i + 100, list.length));
      try {
        final signed = await _db.storage
            .from('post-media')
            // ignore: deprecated_member_use
            .createSignedUrls(chunk, 3600)
            .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
        for (final item in signed) {
          final url = item.signedUrl;
          if (url.contains('token=')) result[item.path.toString()] = url;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('Videos: signing failed: $e');
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> page({
    required int offset,
    int limit = 10,
  }) async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('posts')
        .select(_columns)
        .eq('post_media.media_type', 'video')
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .range(offset, offset + limit - 1)
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 25));

    final posts = (rows as List)
        .map((raw) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map))
        .toList();

    final needed = <String>{};
    for (final post in posts) {
      final author = post['profiles'];
      if (author is Map) {
        final path = (author['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        if (_isPath(path)) needed.add(path);
      }
      for (final media in (post['post_media'] as List? ?? const [])) {
        if (media is! Map) continue;
        for (final key in const ['media_url', 'thumbnail_url']) {
          final path = (media[key] ?? '').toString().trim();
          if (_isPath(path)) needed.add(path);
        }
      }
    }
    final urls = await _sign(needed);
    String resolve(String path) {
      if (path.isEmpty) return '';
      if (!_isPath(path)) return path;
      return urls[path] ?? '';
    }

    for (final post in posts) {
      final authorRaw = post['profiles'];
      if (authorRaw is Map) {
        final author = Map<String, dynamic>.from(authorRaw);
        final path = (author['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        author['avatar_object_path'] = _isPath(path) ? path : '';
        author['avatar_url'] = resolve(path);
        post['profiles'] = author;
      }
      final media =
          (post['post_media'] as List? ?? const [])
              .whereType<Map>()
              .map((raw) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw))
              .where(
                (m) =>
                    (m['media_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() == 'video',
              )
              .toList()
            ..sort(
              (a, b) => (int.tryParse('${a['position']}') ?? 0).compareTo(
                int.tryParse('${b['position']}') ?? 0,
              ),
            );
      post['media_resolved'] = media.map((item) {
        item['resolved_url'] = resolve(
          (item['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
        );
        item['resolved_thumbnail_url'] = resolve(
          (item['thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
        );
        return item;
      }).toList();
    }
    return posts
        .where((p) => (p['media_resolved'] as List).isNotEmpty)
        .toList();
  }
}

class VideosPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const VideosPage({
    super.key,
    required this.active,
    required this.profile,
    required this.onCreate,
  });

  final bool active;
  final Map<String, dynamic> profile;
  final VoidCallback onCreate;

  @override
  State<VideosPage> createState() => _VideosPageState();
}

class _VideosPageState extends State<VideosPage> with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  static const int _pageSize = 10;

  final PageController _pager = PageController();
  final List<SocialPost> _posts = <SocialPost>[];
  bool _started = false;
  bool _loading = false;
  bool _loadingMore = false;
  bool _hasMore = true;
  bool _appResumed = true;
  String? _error;
  int _index = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    if (widget.active) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (mounted) _ensureStarted();
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant VideosPage oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.active && !oldWidget.active) _ensureStarted();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final resumed = state == AppLifecycleState.resumed;
    if (resumed != _appResumed) setState(() => _appResumed = resumed);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    _pager.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _ensureStarted() {
    if (_started) return;
    _started = true;
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final rows = await _VideoFeedData.page(offset: 0, limit: _pageSize);
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (_pager.hasClients) _pager.jumpToPage(0);
      setState(() {
        _posts
          ..clear()
          ..addAll(rows.map(SocialPost.new));
        _index = 0;
        _hasMore = rows.length >= _pageSize;
        _loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _loading = false;
        _error = e.toString();
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadMore() async {
    if (_loadingMore || !_hasMore || _loading) return;
    _loadingMore = true;
    try {
      final rows = await _VideoFeedData.page(
        offset: _posts.length,
        limit: _pageSize,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      final known = _posts.map((p) => p.id).toSet();
      setState(() {
        for (final row in rows) {
          final post = SocialPost(row);
          if (known.add(post.id)) _posts.add(post);
        }
        _hasMore = rows.length >= _pageSize;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Videos: load more failed: $e');
    } finally {
      _loadingMore = false;
    }
  }

  void _onPage(int i) {
    setState(() => _index = i);
    if (i >= _posts.length - 3) _loadMore();
  }

  bool _next() {
    if (!_pager.hasClients || _index >= _posts.length - 1) return false;
    _pager.nextPage(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 320),
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
    );
    return true;
  }

  void _openSearch() {
    Navigator.of(context).push<void>(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Search')),
          body: const SearchPage(),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final top = MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).top;
    final Widget body;
    if (_loading && _posts.isEmpty) {
      body = const Center(
        child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: Colors.white),
      );
    } else if (_error != null && _posts.isEmpty) {
      body = _VideosMessage(
        icon: Icons.wifi_off_rounded,
        title: 'Couldn’t load videos',
        subtitle: _error!,
        actionLabel: 'Try again',
        onAction: _load,
      );
    } else if (_posts.isEmpty) {
      body = _VideosMessage(
        icon: Icons.video_library_outlined,
        title: 'No videos yet',
        subtitle: 'Videos that people post on Twice will show up here.',
        actionLabel: 'Create a video',
        onAction: widget.onCreate,
      );
    } else {
      final entries = interleaveAds<SocialPost>(
        _posts, interval: 5, maxAds: TwiceAdConfig.maxAdSlots,
      );
      body = PageView.builder(
        scrollDirection: Axis.vertical,
        controller: _pager,
        itemCount: entries.length,
        onPageChanged: (page) {
          final entry = entries[page];
          if (entry.isAd) {
            setState(() => _index = -1);
            return;
          }
          final postIndex = entries.take(page + 1).where((e) => !e.isAd).length - 1;
          _onPage(postIndex);
        },
        itemBuilder: (context, page) {
          final entry = entries[page];
          if (entry.isAd) {
            return ColoredBox(
              color: Colors.black,
              child: Center(
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  child: FeedNativeAdCard(
                    key: ValueKey<String>('video-ad-${entry.adSlot}'),
                    slot: entry.adSlot!,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            );
          }
          final post = entry.item!;
          final postIndex = entries.take(page + 1).where((e) => !e.isAd).length - 1;
          return _VideoReel(
            key: ValueKey<String>(post.id),
            post: post,
            myProfile: widget.profile,
            topInset: top,
            playing: widget.active && _appResumed && postIndex == _index,
            preload: postIndex == _index ||
                (widget.active && (postIndex - _index).abs() <= 1),
            onNext: _next,
          );
        },
      );
    }

    return AnnotatedRegion<SystemUiOverlayStyle>(
      value: SystemUiOverlayStyle.light,
      child: ColoredBox(
        color: Colors.black,
        child: Stack(
          children: [
            Positioned.fill(child: body),
            Positioned(
              top: 0,
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              child: Container(
                padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, top + 6, 6, 14),
                decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                    begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                    end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                    colors: [Color(0x99000000), Color(0x00000000)],
                  ),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    const Text(
                      'Videos',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        fontSize: 24,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                        shadows: _reelShadow,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const Spacer(),
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Create',
                      onPressed: widget.onCreate,
                      icon: const Icon(
                        Icons.add_circle_outline_rounded,
                        color: Colors.white,
                        shadows: _reelShadow,
                      ),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Search',
                      onPressed: _openSearch,
                      icon: const Icon(
                        Icons.search_rounded,
                        color: Colors.white,
                        shadows: _reelShadow,
                      ),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Video settings',
                      onPressed: () =>
                          _showVideoSettings(context, onRefresh: _load),
                      icon: const Icon(
                        Icons.more_horiz_rounded,
                        color: Colors.white,
                        shadows: _reelShadow,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Settings sheet (speed, auto-scroll, sound)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Future<void> _showVideoSettings(
  BuildContext context, {
  VoidCallback? onRefresh,
}) {
  const speeds = <double>[0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 2.0];
  String label(double s) => s == s.roundToDouble() ? '${s.toInt()}x' : '${s}x';
  return showModalBottomSheet<void>(
    context: context,
    backgroundColor: igSurface,
    shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(22)),
    ),
    builder: (sheetContext) => SafeArea(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 12),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Center(
              child: Container(
                width: 38,
                height: 4,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.black26,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            const Text(
              'Video settings',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            const Text(
              'Playback speed',
              style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: muted),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            ValueListenableBuilder<double>(
              valueListenable: _videoSpeed,
              builder: (context, current, child) => Wrap(
                spacing: 8,
                runSpacing: 4,
                children: [
                  for (final s in speeds)
                    ChoiceChip(
                      label: Text(label(s)),
                      selected: current == s,
                      selectedColor: const Color(0xFF363636),
                      onSelected: (_) => _videoSpeed.value = s,
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            ValueListenableBuilder<bool>(
              valueListenable: _videoMuted,
              builder: (context, muted, child) => SwitchListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                title: const Text('Sound on'),
                value: !muted,
                onChanged: (on) => _videoMuted.value = !on,
              ),
            ),
            ValueListenableBuilder<bool>(
              valueListenable: _videoAutoNext,
              builder: (context, auto, child) => SwitchListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                title: const Text('Auto-scroll to next video'),
                subtitle: const Text('Move on when a video finishes'),
                value: auto,
                onChanged: (v) => _videoAutoNext.value = v,
              ),
            ),
            if (onRefresh != null)
              ListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                leading: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded),
                title: const Text('Refresh videos'),
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                  onRefresh();
                },
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// One reel (full page)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _Burst {
  _Burst(this.id, this.pos);
  final int id;
  final Offset pos;
}

class _VideoReel extends StatefulWidget {
  const _VideoReel({
    super.key,
    required this.post,
    required this.myProfile,
    required this.topInset,
    required this.playing,
    required this.preload,
    required this.onNext,
  });

  final SocialPost post;
  final Map<String, dynamic> myProfile;
  final double topInset;
  final bool playing;
  final bool preload;
  final bool Function() onNext;

  @override
  State<_VideoReel> createState() => _VideoReelState();
}

class _VideoReelState extends State<_VideoReel> {
  VideoPlayerController? _c;
  String _source = '';
  bool _initializing = false;
  bool _failed = false;
  bool _hasFrame = false;
  bool _userPaused = false;
  bool _routePaused = false;
  bool _boost = false;
  bool _advanced = false;
  bool _likePop = false;
  bool _showPauseIcon = false;
  double? _scrubValue;
  Timer? _iconTimer;
  Offset _tapPos = Offset.zero;
  int _burstSeq = 0;
  final List<_Burst> _bursts = <_Burst>[];

  Map<String, dynamic> get _video =>
      widget.post.media.isEmpty ? <String, dynamic>{} : widget.post.media.first;
  String? _urlOverride; // fresh signed URL after a refresh
  String get _url =>
      _urlOverride ?? (_video['resolved_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
  String get _thumb =>
      (_video['resolved_thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
  String get _authorId =>
      (widget.post.data['user_id'] ?? widget.post.author['id'] ?? '')
          .toString();
  String? get _myId => Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _videoMuted.addListener(_applyVolume);
    _videoSpeed.addListener(_applySpeed);
    _videoAutoNext.addListener(_applyLoop);
    if (widget.preload) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (mounted) _ensureController();
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant _VideoReel oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.playing && !widget.playing) _userPaused = false;
    if (widget.preload && _c == null && !_failed) {
      _ensureController();
    } else if (!widget.preload && _c != null) {
      _release();
    }
    _sync();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _videoMuted.removeListener(_applyVolume);
    _videoSpeed.removeListener(_applySpeed);
    _videoAutoNext.removeListener(_applyLoop);
    _iconTimer?.cancel();
    final c = _c;
    _c = null;
    c?.removeListener(_onTick);
    c?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // ---- player ------------------------------------------------------------
  Future<void> _ensureController({bool allowRefresh = true}) async {
    if (_c != null || _initializing) return;
    if (_url.isEmpty) {
      if (allowRefresh && await _refreshUrl()) return;
      if (mounted) setState(() => _failed = true);
      return;
    }
    _initializing = true;
    if (mounted) setState(() {});

    var source = _url;
    if (source.startsWith('http')) {
      final local = await TwiceMedia.cachedFileUri(source);
      if (local != null) source = local;
    }
    if (!mounted) return;

    final controller = source.startsWith('file://')
        ? VideoPlayerController.file(File.fromUri(Uri.parse(source)))
        : VideoPlayerController.networkUrl(Uri.parse(source));
    _c = controller;
    _source = source;
    controller.addListener(_onTick);
    try {
      await controller.initialize();
      await controller.setLooping(!_videoAutoNext.value);
      await controller.setVolume(_videoMuted.value ? 0 : 1);
      await controller.setPlaybackSpeed(_videoSpeed.value);
      if (!mounted || !identical(_c, controller)) {
        controller.removeListener(_onTick);
        await controller.dispose();
        return;
      }
      _initializing = false;
      setState(() {});
      _sync();
    } catch (_) {
      controller.removeListener(_onTick);
      await controller.dispose();
      if (identical(_c, controller)) _c = null;
      _initializing = false;
      if (allowRefresh && await _refreshUrl()) return;
      if (mounted) setState(() => _failed = true);
    } finally {
      _initializing = false;
    }
  }

  Future<bool> _refreshUrl() async {
    final path = (_video['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (path.isEmpty || path.startsWith('http')) return false;
    try {
      final fresh = await SocialRepository.instance.refreshMediaUrl(
        path,
        bucket: 'post-media',
      );
      if (fresh == null || fresh.isEmpty || !mounted) return false;
      _urlOverride = fresh;
      setState(() => _failed = false);
      await _ensureController(allowRefresh: false);
      return _c != null && _c!.value.isInitialized;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  void _release() {
    final c = _c;
    if (c == null) return;
    _c = null;
    _hasFrame = false;
    c.removeListener(_onTick);
    c.pause();
    c.dispose();
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  void _onTick() {
    final c = _c;
    if (!mounted || c == null) return;
    final v = c.value;
    if (!_hasFrame && v.isInitialized && v.position > Duration.zero) {
      setState(() => _hasFrame = true);
    }
    if (_videoAutoNext.value && v.isInitialized && v.duration > Duration.zero) {
      final nearEnd =
          v.position >= v.duration - const Duration(milliseconds: 250);
      if (nearEnd && !_advanced && widget.playing) {
        _advanced = true;
        if (!widget.onNext()) {
          c.seekTo(Duration.zero);
          c.play();
        }
      } else if (!nearEnd &&
          v.position < v.duration - const Duration(seconds: 1)) {
        _advanced = false;
      }
    }
  }

  void _sync() {
    final c = _c;
    if (c == null || !c.value.isInitialized) return;
    final shouldPlay = widget.playing && !_userPaused && !_routePaused;
    if (shouldPlay) {
      if (!c.value.isPlaying) {
        c.play();
        if (_source.startsWith('http')) {
          unawaited(TwiceMedia.cacheVideo(_source));
        }
      }
    } else if (c.value.isPlaying) {
      c.pause();
    }
  }

  void _applyVolume() => _c?.setVolume(_videoMuted.value ? 0 : 1);
  void _applySpeed() {
    if (!_boost) _c?.setPlaybackSpeed(_videoSpeed.value);
  }

  void _applyLoop() {
    _advanced = false;
    _c?.setLooping(!_videoAutoNext.value);
  }

  // ---- gestures ----------------------------------------------------------
  void _togglePause() {
    final c = _c;
    if (c == null || !c.value.isInitialized) return;
    setState(() {
      _userPaused = !_userPaused;
      _showPauseIcon = true;
    });
    _sync();
    _iconTimer?.cancel();
    _iconTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 700), () {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _showPauseIcon = false);
    });
  }

  void _doubleTapLike() {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    final id = ++_burstSeq;
    setState(() => _bursts.add(_Burst(id, _tapPos)));
    Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 800), () {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _bursts.removeWhere((b) => b.id == id));
    });
    _setLiked(true);
  }

  void _startBoost() {
    final c = _c;
    if (c == null || !c.value.isInitialized || _userPaused) return;
    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    setState(() => _boost = true);
    c.setPlaybackSpeed(2.0);
  }

  void _endBoost() {
    if (!_boost) return;
    setState(() => _boost = false);
    _c?.setPlaybackSpeed(_videoSpeed.value);
  }

  void _scrubStart(double fraction) => setState(() => _scrubValue = fraction);
  void _scrubUpdate(double fraction) {
    if (_scrubValue != null) setState(() => _scrubValue = fraction);
  }

  void _scrubEnd() {
    final value = _scrubValue;
    final c = _c;
    if (value != null && c != null && c.value.isInitialized) {
      c.seekTo(
        Duration(
          milliseconds: (c.value.duration.inMilliseconds * value).round(),
        ),
      );
    }
    if (mounted) setState(() => _scrubValue = null);
  }

  // ---- actions -----------------------------------------------------------
  Future<void> _setLiked(bool like) async {
    final post = widget.post;
    final uid = _myId;
    if (uid == null || post.liked == like) return;
    final wasLiked = post.liked;
    setState(() {
      final rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
        post.data['post_likes'] as List? ?? const [],
      );
      if (wasLiked) {
        rows.removeWhere((e) => e['user_id'] == uid);
      } else {
        rows.add(<String, dynamic>{'user_id': uid});
      }
      post.data['post_likes'] = rows;
      _likePop = true;
    });
    Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 180), () {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _likePop = false);
    });
    try {
      await SocialRepository.instance.toggleLike(post.id, wasLiked);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        final rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
          post.data['post_likes'] as List? ?? const [],
        );
        rows.removeWhere((row) => row['user_id'] == uid);
        if (wasLiked) rows.add(<String, dynamic>{'user_id': uid});
        post.data['post_likes'] = rows;
      });
      _videoSnack(context, 'Like could not sync: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _toggleSave() async {
    final post = widget.post;
    final uid = _myId;
    if (uid == null) return;
    final was = post.saved;
    setState(() {
      post.data['saved_posts'] = was
          ? <Map<String, dynamic>>[]
          : <Map<String, dynamic>>[
              <String, dynamic>{'user_id': uid},
            ];
    });
    try {
      await SocialRepository.instance.toggleSaved(post.id, was);
      if (mounted) {
        _videoSnack(context, was ? 'Removed from saved' : 'Video saved');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        post.data['saved_posts'] = was
            ? <Map<String, dynamic>>[
                <String, dynamic>{'user_id': uid},
              ]
            : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      });
      _videoSnack(context, 'Could not update saved: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _share() async {
    final p = widget.post;
    final text = StringBuffer('${p.name} (@${p.username}) on Twice');
    if (p.caption.trim().isNotEmpty) text.write(': ${p.caption.trim()}');
    try {
      await SharePlus.instance.share(ShareParams(text: text.toString()));
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) _videoSnack(context, 'Could not share: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openComments({bool focus = false}) async {
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => _VideoCommentsSheet(
        post: widget.post,
        myProfile: widget.myProfile,
        autofocus: focus,
        onCountChanged: (n) {
          if (!mounted) return;
          setState(() {
            widget.post.data['comments'] = <Map<String, dynamic>>[
              <String, dynamic>{'count': n},
            ];
          });
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _openProfile() async {
    if (_authorId.isEmpty) return;
    setState(() => _routePaused = true);
    _sync();
    await _openUserProfile(
      context,
      userId: _authorId,
      profile: Map<String, dynamic>.from(widget.post.author),
    );
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _routePaused = false);
    _sync();
  }

  void _openMore() {
    final post = widget.post;
    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: igSurface,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(22)),
      ),
      builder: (sheetContext) => SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Container(
              width: 38,
              height: 4,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.black26,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            ListTile(
              leading: Icon(
                post.saved
                    ? Icons.bookmark_rounded
                    : Icons.bookmark_border_rounded,
              ),
              title: Text(post.saved ? 'Remove from saved' : 'Save video'),
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                _toggleSave();
              },
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.ios_share_rounded),
              title: const Text('Share'),
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                _share();
              },
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.person_outline_rounded),
              title: Text('View ${post.name}’s profile'),
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                _openProfile();
              },
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.speed_rounded),
              title: const Text('Playback speed & settings'),
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                _showVideoSettings(context);
              },
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ---- UI ----------------------------------------------------------------
  Widget _videoLayer() {
    final c = _c;
    final poster = TwiceVideoPoster(
      videoUrl: _url,
      thumbnailUrl: _thumb,
      imageProviderFor: _twiceImageProvider,
      fit: BoxFit.contain,
      showPlayIcon: false,
    );
    return Stack(
      fit: StackFit.expand,
      children: [
        if (!(_hasFrame && c != null)) poster,
        if (c != null && c.value.isInitialized)
          AnimatedOpacity(
            opacity: _hasFrame ? 1 : 0,
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
            child: Builder(
              builder: (context) {
                final size = c.value.size;
                final ratio = size.height <= 0 ? 1.0 : size.width / size.height;
                return FittedBox(
                  fit: ratio < 0.85 ? BoxFit.cover : BoxFit.contain,
                  clipBehavior: Clip.hardEdge,
                  child: SizedBox(
                    width: size.width,
                    height: size.height,
                    child: VideoPlayer(c),
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _railButton({
    required IconData icon,
    required String label,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
    Color color = Colors.white,
    bool pop = false,
    Widget? customIcon,
  }) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
    child: GestureDetector(
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      onTap: onTap,
      child: SizedBox(
        width: 58,
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            AnimatedScale(
              scale: pop ? 1.3 : 1,
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 150),
              child:
                  customIcon ??
                  Icon(icon, color: color, size: 31, shadows: _reelShadow),
            ),
            if (label.isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 3),
              Text(
                label,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  shadows: _reelShadow,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );

  Widget _rail() {
    final post = widget.post;
    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        _railButton(
          icon: post.liked
              ? Icons.favorite_rounded
              : Icons.favorite_border_rounded,
          color: post.liked ? _reelHeart : Colors.white,
          label: _compactCount(post.likes),
          pop: _likePop,
          onTap: () => _setLiked(!post.liked),
        ),
        _railButton(
          icon: Icons.mode_comment_outlined,
          customIcon: IgComment(size: 31, color: Colors.white),
          label: post.data['comments_enabled'] == false
              ? ''
              : _compactCount(post.commentCount),
          onTap: _openComments,
        ),
        _railButton(
          icon: Icons.ios_share_rounded,
          customIcon: IgShare(size: 31, color: Colors.white),
          label: 'Share',
          onTap: _share,
        ),
        _railButton(
          icon: post.saved
              ? Icons.bookmark_rounded
              : Icons.bookmark_border_rounded,
          label: post.saved ? 'Saved' : 'Save',
          onTap: _toggleSave,
        ),
        _railButton(
          icon: Icons.more_horiz_rounded,
          label: '',
          onTap: _openMore,
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _info() {
    final post = widget.post;
    final visibility = (post.data['visibility'] ?? 'public').toString();
    final visIcon = visibility == 'public'
        ? Icons.public_rounded
        : visibility == 'followers'
        ? Icons.group_rounded
        : Icons.lock_rounded;
    final time = _timeAgo(post.data['created_at']);
    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            GestureDetector(
              onTap: _openProfile,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(1.5),
                decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                ),
                child: _UserAvatar(
                  url: post.avatarUrl ?? '',
                  name: post.name,
                  size: 38,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(
              child: GestureDetector(
                behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                onTap: _openProfile,
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      post.name,
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        fontSize: 15,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                        shadows: _reelShadow,
                      ),
                    ),
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Flexible(
                          child: Text(
                            post.handle,
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              color: Colors.white70,
                              fontSize: 12,
                              shadows: _reelShadow,
                            ),
                          ),
