                        if (time.isNotEmpty)
                          Text(
                            '  ·  $time  ·  ',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              color: Colors.white70,
                              fontSize: 12,
                              shadows: _reelShadow,
                            ),
                          ),

            if (_authorId.isNotEmpty && _authorId != _myId)
              _ReelFollowButton(profileId: _authorId),
          ],

        Row(
          children: [
            const Icon(Icons.music_note_rounded, size: 15, color: Colors.white),
            const SizedBox(width: 4),
            Flexible(
              child: Text(
                'Original audio · ${post.name}',
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  fontSize: 13,
                  shadows: _reelShadow,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        if (post.caption.trim().isNotEmpty) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          _ReelCaption(text: post.caption.trim()),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _commentBand() {
    final me = widget.myProfile;
    final myName = (me['display_name'] ?? me['username'] ?? 'You').toString();
    final disabled = widget.post.data['comments_enabled'] == false;
    return Container(
      color: Colors.black,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 8, 12, 10),
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: disabled ? null : () => _openComments(focus: true),
        child: Container(
          height: 42,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
            border: Border.all(color: Colors.white54),
          ),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  disabled
                      ? 'Comments are turned off'
                      : 'Add a comment as $myName',
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 15),
                ),
              ),
              if (!disabled) ...const [
                Icon(
                  Icons.alternate_email_rounded,
                  size: 20,
                  color: Colors.white70,
                ),
                SizedBox(width: 12),
                Icon(
                  Icons.sentiment_satisfied_alt_rounded,
                  size: 21,
                  color: Colors.white70,
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = _c;
    final buffering =
        _initializing ||
        (c != null && c.value.isInitialized && c.value.isBuffering);
    final scrub = _scrubValue;

    final stage = LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, box) => Stack(
        fit: StackFit.expand,
        children: [
          _videoLayer(),
          // Gesture layer: tap = play/pause, double tap = heart,
          // long press = 2x, horizontal drag = seek.
          Positioned.fill(
            child: GestureDetector(
              behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
              onTap: _togglePause,
              onDoubleTapDown: (d) => _tapPos = d.localPosition,
              onDoubleTap: _doubleTapLike,
              onLongPressStart: (_) => _startBoost(),
              onLongPressEnd: (_) => _endBoost(),
              onLongPressCancel: _endBoost,
              onHorizontalDragStart: (d) {
                final cc = _c;
                if (cc == null || !cc.value.isInitialized) return;
                final total = cc.value.duration.inMilliseconds;
                _scrubStart(
                  total <= 0
                      ? 0
                      : (cc.value.position.inMilliseconds / total).clamp(
                          0.0,
                          1.0,
                        ),
                );
              },
              onHorizontalDragUpdate: (d) {
                final current = _scrubValue;
                if (current == null) return;
                _scrubUpdate(
                  (current + d.delta.dx / max(box.maxWidth * 0.9, 1)).clamp(
                    0.0,
                    1.0,
                  ),
                );
              },
              onHorizontalDragEnd: (_) => _scrubEnd(),
              onHorizontalDragCancel: _scrubEnd,
              child: const SizedBox.expand(),
            ),
          ),
          const IgnorePointer(
            child: Align(
              alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
              child: SizedBox(
                height: 280,
                width: double.infinity,
                child: DecoratedBox(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    gradient: LinearGradient(
                      begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                      end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                      colors: [Color(0x00000000), Color(0xB3000000)],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          if (buffering)
            const IgnorePointer(
              child: Center(
                child: SizedBox(
                  width: 34,
                  height: 34,
                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                    strokeWidth: 3,
                    color: Colors.white,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (_failed)
            Center(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  const Icon(
                    Icons.error_outline_rounded,
                    color: Colors.white70,
                    size: 44,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  const Text(
                    'Couldn’t play this video',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  OutlinedButton(
                    onPressed: () {
                      setState(() => _failed = false);
                      _ensureController();
                    },
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                      foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                      side: const BorderSide(color: Colors.white54),
                    ),
                    child: const Text('Retry'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          IgnorePointer(
            child: Center(
              child: AnimatedOpacity(
                opacity: _showPauseIcon ? 1 : 0,
                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                    color: Color(0x66000000),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),
                  child: Icon(
                    _userPaused
                        ? Icons.pause_rounded
                        : Icons.play_arrow_rounded,
                    color: Colors.white,
                    size: 44,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          if (_boost)
            Positioned(
              top: widget.topInset + 62,
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              child: const IgnorePointer(child: Center(child: _SpeedChip())),
            ),
          if (scrub != null && c != null && c.value.isInitialized)
            Positioned(
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              bottom: 150,
              child: IgnorePointer(
                child: Center(
                  child: Text(
                    '${_formatClock((c.value.duration.inSeconds * scrub).round())}'
                    '  /  ${_formatClock(c.value.duration.inSeconds)}',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      fontSize: 22,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      shadows: _reelShadow,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          // Mute toggle
          Positioned(
            right: 12,
            top: widget.topInset + 62,
            child: ValueListenableBuilder<bool>(
              valueListenable: _videoMuted,
              builder: (context, muted, child) => GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => _videoMuted.value = !muted,
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                    color: Color(0x66000000),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),
                  child: Icon(
                    muted ? Icons.volume_off_rounded : Icons.volume_up_rounded,
                    color: Colors.white,
                    size: 20,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          for (final b in _bursts)
            Positioned(
              key: ValueKey<int>(b.id),
              left: b.pos.dx - 48,
              top: b.pos.dy - 48,
              child: IgnorePointer(
                child: TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
                  tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0, end: 1),
                  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 750),
                  builder: (context, t, child) {
                    final scale = t < 0.3
                        ? 0.4 + (t / 0.3) * 0.9
                        : 1.3 - (t - 0.3) * 0.3;
                    final opacity = t < 0.6 ? 1.0 : (1 - (t - 0.6) / 0.4);
                    return Opacity(
                      opacity: opacity.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                      child: Transform.scale(scale: scale, child: child),
                    );
                  },
                  child: const Icon(
                    Icons.favorite_rounded,
                    size: 96,
                    color: _reelHeart,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          Positioned(left: 12, right: 76, bottom: 30, child: _info()),
          Positioned(right: 6, bottom: 24, child: _rail()),
          Positioned(
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            child: _ReelProgress(
              controller: c,
              scrubValue: scrub,
              onScrubStart: _scrubStart,
              onScrubUpdate: _scrubUpdate,
              onScrubEnd: _scrubEnd,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    return ColoredBox(
      color: Colors.black,
      child: Column(
        children: [
          Expanded(child: stage),
          _commentBand(),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Progress / seek bar
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _ReelProgress extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ReelProgress({
    required this.controller,
    required this.scrubValue,
    required this.onScrubStart,
    required this.onScrubUpdate,
    required this.onScrubEnd,
  });

  final VideoPlayerController? controller;
  final double? scrubValue;
  final ValueChanged<double> onScrubStart;
  final ValueChanged<double> onScrubUpdate;
  final VoidCallback onScrubEnd;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = controller;
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, box) {
        final width = box.maxWidth;
        double frac(double dx) =>
            width <= 0 ? 0.0 : (dx / width).clamp(0.0, 1.0);

        Widget track(double f) {
          final scrubbing = scrubValue != null;
          final h = scrubbing ? 5.0 : 2.5;
          return SizedBox(
            height: h,
            width: width,
            child: Stack(
              clipBehavior: Clip.none,
              children: [
                Container(color: Colors.white24),
                FractionallySizedBox(
                  widthFactor: f.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                  alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                  child: Container(color: Colors.white),
                ),
                if (scrubbing)
                  Positioned(
                    left: (width * f - 6).clamp(0.0, max(width - 12, 0.0)),
                    top: -3.5,
                    child: Container(
                      width: 12,
                      height: 12,
                      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        }

        return GestureDetector(
          behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
          onTapUp: (d) {
            onScrubStart(frac(d.localPosition.dx));
            onScrubEnd();
          },
          onHorizontalDragStart: (d) => onScrubStart(frac(d.localPosition.dx)),
          onHorizontalDragUpdate: (d) =>
              onScrubUpdate(frac(d.localPosition.dx)),
          onHorizontalDragEnd: (_) => onScrubEnd(),
          onHorizontalDragCancel: onScrubEnd,
          child: SizedBox(
            height: 22,
            child: Align(
              alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
              child: c == null
                  ? track(0)
                  : ValueListenableBuilder<VideoPlayerValue>(
                      valueListenable: c,
                      builder: (context, value, child) {
                        final total = value.duration.inMilliseconds;
                        final played = total <= 0
                            ? 0.0
                            : (value.position.inMilliseconds / total).clamp(
                                0.0,
                                1.0,
                              );
                        return track(scrubValue ?? played);
                      },
                    ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Caption with "… more"
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _ReelCaption extends StatefulWidget {
  const _ReelCaption({required this.text});
  final String text;

  @override
  State<_ReelCaption> createState() => _ReelCaptionState();
}

class _ReelCaptionState extends State<_ReelCaption> {
  bool _expanded = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const style = TextStyle(
      color: Colors.white,
      fontSize: 14,
      height: 1.3,
      shadows: _reelShadow,
    );
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, box) {
        final painter = TextPainter(
          text: TextSpan(text: widget.text, style: style),
          maxLines: 2,
          textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
        )..layout(maxWidth: box.maxWidth);
        final overflows = painter.didExceedMaxLines;
        if (_expanded) {
          return GestureDetector(
            onTap: () => setState(() => _expanded = false),
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxHeight: 170),
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                child: Text(widget.text, style: style),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }
        return GestureDetector(
          onTap: overflows ? () => setState(() => _expanded = true) : null,
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(
                widget.text,
                maxLines: 2,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: style,
              ),
              if (overflows)
                const Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 2),
                  child: Text(
                    'more',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      fontSize: 14,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      shadows: _reelShadow,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Follow button (Facebook reel style: outlined white pill)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _ReelFollowButton extends StatefulWidget {
  const _ReelFollowButton({required this.profileId});
  final String profileId;

  @override
  State<_ReelFollowButton> createState() => _ReelFollowButtonState();
}

class _ReelFollowButtonState extends State<_ReelFollowButton> {
  String _label = '';
  bool _loading = true;
  bool _busy = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    try {
      final label = await SocialRepository.instance.getFollowLabel(
        widget.profileId,
      );
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _label = label;
          _loading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _label = '';
          _loading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _tap() async {
    if (_busy || _label.isEmpty) return;
    final previous = _label;
    final repo = SocialRepository.instance;
    setState(() => _busy = true);
    try {
      if (previous == 'Following' ||
          previous == 'Connected' ||
          previous == 'Requested') {
        setState(() => _label = 'Follow');
        await repo.unfollow(widget.profileId);
      } else {
        final isPrivate = await repo.isPrivateAccount(widget.profileId);
        setState(() => _label = isPrivate ? 'Requested' : 'Following');
        await repo.follow(widget.profileId, privateAccount: isPrivate);
      }
      await _load();
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _label = previous);
        _videoSnack(context, 'Could not update follow: $e');
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_loading || _label.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final active = _label == 'Following' || _label == 'Connected';
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 8),
      child: SizedBox(
        height: 30,
        child: OutlinedButton(
          onPressed: _busy ? null : _tap,
          style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
            foregroundColor: Colors.white,
            disabledForegroundColor: Colors.white54,
            side: BorderSide(color: active ? Colors.white38 : Colors.white),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
            minimumSize: const Size(0, 30),
            tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
            ),
          ),
          child: Text(
            _label,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
              color: active ? Colors.white70 : Colors.white,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Comments sheet: Facebook look, heart reactions, replies
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _VideoCommentsSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const _VideoCommentsSheet({
    required this.post,
    required this.myProfile,
    required this.onCountChanged,
    this.autofocus = false,
  });

  final SocialPost post;
  final Map<String, dynamic> myProfile;
  final ValueChanged<int> onCountChanged;
  final bool autofocus;

  @override
  State<_VideoCommentsSheet> createState() => _VideoCommentsSheetState();
}

class _VideoCommentsSheetState extends State<_VideoCommentsSheet> {
  final TextEditingController _input = TextEditingController();
  final FocusNode _focus = FocusNode();
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  final Map<String, int> _likeCounts = <String, int>{};
  final Set<String> _myLikes = <String>{};
  final Set<String> _expanded = <String>{};
  bool _loading = true;
  bool _newestFirst = false;
  bool _sending = false;
  String? _error;
  Map<String, dynamic>? _replyTo; // top-level comment being replied to
  String _replyName = '';

  SupabaseClient get _db => Supabase.instance.client;
  String? get _uid => _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
  bool get _commentsOff => widget.post.data['comments_enabled'] == false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
    if (widget.autofocus && !_commentsOff) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (mounted) _focus.requestFocus();
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _input.dispose();
    _focus.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final data = await SocialRepository.instance.comments(widget.post.id);
      final likeCounts = <String, int>{};
      final mine = <String>{};
      final ids = data.map((r) => r['id'].toString()).toList();
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i += 50) {
        final chunk = ids.sublist(i, min(i + 50, ids.length));
        try {
          final likes = await _db
              .from('comment_likes')
              .select('comment_id,user_id')
              .inFilter('comment_id', chunk)
              .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
          for (final raw in likes as List) {
            final row = raw as Map;
            final cid = row['comment_id'].toString();
            likeCounts[cid] = (likeCounts[cid] ?? 0) + 1;
            if (row['user_id'] == _uid) mine.add(cid);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          debugPrint('Videos: comment likes unavailable: $e');
        }
      }
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _rows
          ..clear()
          ..addAll(data);
        _likeCounts
          ..clear()
          ..addAll(likeCounts);
        _myLikes
          ..clear()
          ..addAll(mine);
        _loading = false;
      });
      widget.onCountChanged(_rows.length);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _loading = false;
        _error = e.toString();
      });
    }
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> _profileOf(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
    final raw = row['profiles'];
    if (raw is Map) return Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);
    if (raw is List && raw.isNotEmpty && raw.first is Map) {
      return Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw.first as Map);
    }
    return <String, dynamic>{};
  }

  DateTime _dateOf(Map<String, dynamic> row) =>
      DateTime.tryParse('${row['created_at']}') ??
      DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(0);

  int _likesOf(Map<String, dynamic> row) =>
      _likeCounts[row['id'].toString()] ?? 0;

  Future<void> _toggleLike(Map<String, dynamic> row) async {
    final uid = _uid;
    final id = row['id'].toString();
    if (uid == null || row['_pending'] == true) return;
    final liked = _myLikes.contains(id);
    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    setState(() {
      if (liked) {
        _myLikes.remove(id);
        _likeCounts[id] = max(0, (_likeCounts[id] ?? 1) - 1);
      } else {
        _myLikes.add(id);
        _likeCounts[id] = (_likeCounts[id] ?? 0) + 1;
      }
    });
    try {
      if (liked) {
        await _db
            .from('comment_likes')
            .delete()
            .eq('comment_id', id)
            .eq('user_id', uid);
      } else {
        await _db
            .from('comment_likes')
            .upsert(
              <String, dynamic>{'comment_id': id, 'user_id': uid},
              onConflict: 'comment_id,user_id',
              ignoreDuplicates: true,
            );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        if (liked) {
          _myLikes.add(id);
          _likeCounts[id] = (_likeCounts[id] ?? 0) + 1;
        } else {
          _myLikes.remove(id);
          _likeCounts[id] = max(0, (_likeCounts[id] ?? 1) - 1);
        }
      });
      _videoSnack(context, 'Heart could not sync: $e');
    }
  }

  void _startReply(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
    final parentId = row['parent_id']?.toString();
    final top = parentId == null
        ? row
        : _rows.firstWhere(
            (r) => r['id'].toString() == parentId,
            orElse: () => row,
          );
    final p = _profileOf(row);
    final name = (p['display_name'] ?? p['username'] ?? 'Twice user')
        .toString();
    setState(() {
      _replyTo = top;
      _replyName = name;
    });
    if (parentId != null) {
      final username = (p['username'] ?? '').toString();
      if (username.isNotEmpty) {
        _input.text = '@$username ';
        _input.selection = TextSelection.collapsed(offset: _input.text.length);
      }
    }
    _focus.requestFocus();
  }

  Future<void> _send() async {
    if (_sending) return;
    final text = _input.text.trim();
    final uid = _uid;
    if (text.isEmpty || uid == null) return;
    final parent = _replyTo;
    final parentId = parent?['id']?.toString();
    final id = _newTwiceUuid();
    final me = widget.myProfile;
    final optimistic = <String, dynamic>{
      'id': id,
      'post_id': widget.post.id,
      'user_id': uid,
      'parent_id': parentId,
      'body': text,
      'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
      'profiles': <String, dynamic>{
        'id': uid,
        'username': me['username'],
        'display_name': me['display_name'] ?? me['username'] ?? 'You',
        'avatar_url': me['avatar_url'],
      },
      '_pending': true,
      '_fresh': true,
    };
    setState(() {
      _rows.add(optimistic);
      if (parentId != null) _expanded.add(parentId);
      _replyTo = null;
      _replyName = '';
      _sending = true;
    });
    _input.clear();
    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    widget.onCountChanged(_rows.length);

    try {
      if (parentId == null) {
        final synced = await SocialRepository.instance.addComment(
          widget.post.id,
          text,
          commentId: id,
        );
        if (mounted && !synced) {
          setState(() => optimistic['_queued'] = true);
          _videoSnack(
            context,
            'Saved offline. It will sync when you reconnect.',
          );
        }
      } else {
        await _db
            .from('comments')
            .insert(<String, dynamic>{
              'id': id,
              'post_id': widget.post.id,
              'user_id': uid,
              'parent_id': parentId,
              'body': text,
            })
            .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
      }
      if (mounted) setState(() => optimistic.remove('_pending'));
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        optimistic.remove('_pending');
        optimistic['_failed'] = true;
      });
      _videoSnack(context, 'Comment could not be sent: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _sending = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _delete(Map<String, dynamic> row) async {
    final id = row['id'].toString();
    final removedIds = <String>{id};
    for (final r in _rows) {
      if (r['parent_id']?.toString() == id) removedIds.add(r['id'].toString());
    }
    final backup = _rows
        .where((r) => removedIds.contains(r['id'].toString()))
        .toList();
    setState(
      () => _rows.removeWhere((r) => removedIds.contains(r['id'].toString())),
    );
    widget.onCountChanged(_rows.length);
    try {
      await _db.from('comments').delete().eq('id', id);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _rows.addAll(backup));
      widget.onCountChanged(_rows.length);
      _videoSnack(context, 'Could not delete comment: $e');
    }
  }

  void _commentMenu(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
    final mine = row['user_id']?.toString() == _uid;
    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: igSurface,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
      ),
      builder: (sheetContext) => SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            ListTile(
              leading: Icon(
                _myLikes.contains(row['id'].toString())
                    ? Icons.favorite_rounded
                    : Icons.favorite_border_rounded,
                color: _reelHeart,
              ),
              title: Text(
                _myLikes.contains(row['id'].toString())
                    ? 'Remove heart'
                    : 'Heart',
              ),
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                _toggleLike(row);
              },
            ),
            if (!_commentsOff)
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.reply_rounded),
                title: const Text('Reply'),
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                  _startReply(row);
                },
              ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.copy_rounded),
              title: const Text('Copy'),
              onTap: () {
                Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: '${row['body']}'));
                Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
              },
            ),
            if (mine)
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(
                  Icons.delete_outline_rounded,
                  color: Colors.red,
                ),
                title: const Text(
                  'Delete',
                  style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red),
                ),
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                  _delete(row);
                },
              ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _openCommenter(Map<String, dynamic> row) async {
    final p = _profileOf(row);
    await _openUserProfile(
      context,
      userId: (p['id'] ?? row['user_id'] ?? '').toString(),
      profile: p,
    );
  }

  Widget _tile(Map<String, dynamic> row, {required bool isReply}) {
    final p = _profileOf(row);
    final id = row['id'].toString();
    final name = (p['display_name'] ?? p['username'] ?? 'Twice user')
        .toString();
    final avatar = (p['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString();
    final isAuthor =
        row['user_id']?.toString() == widget.post.data['user_id']?.toString();
    final liked = _myLikes.contains(id);
    final likes = _likesOf(row);
    final pending = row['_pending'] == true;
    final failed = row['_failed'] == true;
    final queued = row['_queued'] == true;
    final status = failed
        ? 'Not sent'
        : queued
        ? 'Waiting to sync'
        : pending
        ? 'Sending…'
        : _timeAgo(row['created_at']);

    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12, left: isReply ? 46 : 0),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          GestureDetector(
            onTap: () => _openCommenter(row),
            child: _UserAvatar(
              url: avatar,
              name: name,
              size: isReply ? 28 : 36,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                GestureDetector(
                  onLongPress: () => _commentMenu(row),
                  onDoubleTap: () => _toggleLike(row),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 8, 12, 9),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: _fbGrey,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                    ),
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Row(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            Flexible(
                              child: GestureDetector(
                                onTap: () => _openCommenter(row),
                                child: Text(
                                  name,
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 13.5,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                    color: ink,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                            if (isAuthor) ...[
                              const SizedBox(width: 6),
                              Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  horizontal: 6,
                                  vertical: 1,
                                ),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: const Color(0xFF363636),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                                ),
                                child: const Text(
                                  'Author',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 10.5,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                    color: violet,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ],
                        ),
                        Text(
                          '@${(p['username'] ?? 'user').toString().replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^@'), '')}',
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: muted),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 3),
                        Text(
                          '${row['body']}',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 15,
                            height: 1.25,
                            color: ink,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 5, 0, 0),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        status,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12,
                          color: failed ? Colors.red : muted,
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (!_commentsOff && !pending) ...[
                        const SizedBox(width: 16),
                        GestureDetector(
                          behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                          onTap: () => _startReply(row),
                          child: const Padding(
                            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
                            child: Text(
                              'Reply',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                color: muted,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          // Heart on the right, like Facebook Reels comments.
          GestureDetector(
            behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
            onTap: () => _toggleLike(row),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 8, top: 8, right: 2),
              child: SizedBox(
                width: 30,
                child: Column(
                  children: [
                    AnimatedSwitcher(
                      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 160),
                      transitionBuilder: (child, anim) =>
                          ScaleTransition(scale: anim, child: child),
                      child: Icon(
                        liked
                            ? Icons.favorite_rounded
                            : Icons.favorite_border_rounded,
                        key: ValueKey<bool>(liked),
                        size: 20,
                        color: liked ? _reelHeart : muted,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (likes > 0)
                      Text(
                        _compactCount(likes),
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,

  List<Widget> _thread() {
    final ids = _rows.map((r) => r['id'].toString()).toSet();
    final children = <String, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>{};
    final top = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (final r in _rows) {
      final pid = r['parent_id']?.toString();
      if (pid == null || pid.isEmpty || pid == 'null' || !ids.contains(pid)) {
        top.add(r);
      } else {
        children.putIfAbsent(pid, () => <Map<String, dynamic>>[]).add(r);
      }
    }
    top.sort((a, b) {
      final fa = a['_fresh'] == true, fb = b['_fresh'] == true;
      if (fa != fb) return fa ? -1 : 1;
      if (_newestFirst) return _dateOf(b).compareTo(_dateOf(a));
      final byLikes = _likesOf(b).compareTo(_likesOf(a));
      return byLikes != 0 ? byLikes : _dateOf(a).compareTo(_dateOf(b));
    });

    final widgets = <Widget>[];
    for (final r in top) {
      final id = r['id'].toString();
      widgets.add(_tile(r, isReply: false));
      final replies = (children[id] ?? <Map<String, dynamic>>[])
        ..sort((a, b) => _dateOf(a).compareTo(_dateOf(b)));
      if (replies.isEmpty) continue;
      if (_expanded.contains(id)) {
        for (final reply in replies) {
          widgets.add(_tile(reply, isReply: true));
        }
        widgets.add(
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 46, bottom: 12),
            child: GestureDetector(
              onTap: () => setState(() => _expanded.remove(id)),
              child: const Text(
                'Hide replies',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 12.5,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  color: muted,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      } else {
        widgets.add(
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 46, bottom: 12),
            child: GestureDetector(
              onTap: () => setState(() => _expanded.add(id)),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Container(width: 22, height: 1, color: Colors.black26),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Text(
                    replies.length == 1
                        ? 'View 1 reply'
                        : 'View ${replies.length} replies',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      color: muted,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      }
    }
    return widgets;
  }

  Widget _composer() {
    if (_commentsOff) {
      return const Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Text(
          'Comments are turned off for this video.',
          style: TextStyle(color: muted),
        ),
      );
    }
    final me = widget.myProfile;
    final myName = (me['display_name'] ?? me['username'] ?? 'You').toString();
    return Container(
      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
        color: igSurface,
        border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF363636), width: 0.5)),
      ),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 8, 8, 10),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          if (_replyTo != null)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6, left: 4),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      'Replying to $_replyName',
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: muted),
                    ),
                  ),
                  GestureDetector(
                    onTap: () {
                      setState(() {
                        _replyTo = null;
                        _replyName = '';
                      });
                      _input.clear();
                    },
                    child: const Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.all(4),
                      child: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 18, color: muted),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
            children: [
              _UserAvatar(
                url: (me['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString(),
                name: myName,
                size: 34,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: TextField(
                  controller: _input,
                  focusNode: _focus,
                  minLines: 1,
                  maxLines: 4,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    hintText: _replyTo == null
                        ? 'Comment as $myName…'
                        : 'Reply to $_replyName…',
                    filled: true,
                    fillColor: _fbGrey,
                    isDense: true,
                    contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                      horizontal: 14,
                      vertical: 11,
                    ),
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
                      borderSide: BorderSide.none,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              ValueListenableBuilder<TextEditingValue>(
                valueListenable: _input,
                builder: (context, value, child) {
                  final can = value.text.trim().isNotEmpty && !_sending;
                  return IconButton(
                    onPressed: can ? _send : null,
                    icon: Icon(
                      Icons.send_rounded,
                      color: can ? violet : Colors.black26,
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final media = MediaQuery.of(context);
    final inset = media.viewInsets.bottom;
    final height = min(
      media.size.height * 0.76,
      media.size.height - inset - media.padding.top - 12,
    );
    final thread = _thread();
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: inset),
      child: Container(
        height: max(height, 240),
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          color: igSurface,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(22)),
        ),
        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
        child: Column(
          children: [
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Container(
              width: 38,
              height: 4,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.black26,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99),
              ),
            ),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 4, 0),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      _rows.length == 1
                          ? '1 comment'
                          : '${_rows.length} comments',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 17,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  PopupMenuButton<bool>(
                    tooltip: 'Sort comments',
                    onSelected: (newest) =>
                        setState(() => _newestFirst = newest),
                    itemBuilder: (_) => const [
                      PopupMenuItem<bool>(
                        value: false,
                        child: Text('Most relevant'),
                      ),
                      PopupMenuItem<bool>(value: true, child: Text('Newest')),
                    ],
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 6,
                        vertical: 8,
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            _newestFirst ? 'Newest' : 'Most relevant',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 13,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              color: muted,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const Icon(
                            Icons.arrow_drop_down_rounded,
                            color: muted,
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const Divider(height: 1),
            Expanded(
              child: _loading
                  ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                  : _error != null
                  ? Center(
                      child: Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                        child: Column(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            const Text('Could not load comments'),
                            const SizedBox(height: 6),
                            Text(
                              _error!,
                              maxLines: 3,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                color: muted,
                                fontSize: 12,
                              ),
                            ),
                            TextButton(
                              onPressed: _load,
                              child: const Text('Retry'),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    )
                  : thread.isEmpty
                  ? const Center(
                      child: Padding(
                        padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
                        child: Column(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            Icon(
                              Icons.mode_comment_outlined,
                              size: 44,
                              color: muted,
                            ),
                            SizedBox(height: 10),
                            Text(
                              'No comments yet',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 17,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                              ),
                            ),
                            SizedBox(height: 4),
                            Text(
                              'Be the first to comment.',
                              style: TextStyle(color: muted),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    )
                  : ListView(
                      keyboardDismissBehavior:
                          ScrollViewKeyboardDismissBehavior.onDrag,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 14, 10, 8),
                      children: thread,
                    ),
            ),
            _composer(),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

TWICE CHATROOM PATCH PACKAGE
============================

Included:
- lib/messages_page.dart (extracted from the supplied TWICE_ALL_SOURCE_CODE.txt)
- lib/data/social_repository_chat_patch.dart (reference patch from the supplied archive)
- Supabase migration reference files copied from the supplied archive where available

Important:
1. The message screen preserves the existing dark UI and composer styling.
2. Adds a subtle entry animation for message bubbles and a native click sound before text sends.
3. The supplied archive's repository query orders messages by created_at ascending, which is the correct oldest-to-newest ordering for a conventional non-reversed chat list.
4. This package has NOT been run through Flutter analyzer/build because this environment has no Flutter SDK. Please validate via your existing GitHub Actions workflow.
5. Story replies in the supplied repository currently send only the text prefix "Replied to your story: ...". The archive does not contain a complete story metadata-to-message attachment implementation. This patch does NOT pretend that story thumbnail/title metadata is implemented. That requires changing the story viewer callback, messages schema/repository, and UI together.
6. Make a backup before copying files. Do not apply the repository reference patch blindly; it is a reference file, not a complete replacement for social_repository.dart.

/*
  // ---------- Instagram-style conversations ----------

  /// Full inbox rows: other participant profile + last message + unread flag.
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> conversationsDetailed() async {
    final uid = userId;

    // 1) Memberships for me
    final memberships = await _db
        .from('conversation_members')
        .select('conversation_id,last_read_at,joined_at')
        .eq('user_id', uid)
        .order('joined_at', ascending: false)
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));

    final list = (memberships as List)
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
        .toList();
    if (list.isEmpty) return [];

    final convIds = list.map((e) => e['conversation_id'].toString()).toList();

    // 2) Other members in those conversations
    final members = await _db
        .from('conversation_members')
        .select('conversation_id,user_id')
        .inFilter('conversation_id', convIds)
        .neq('user_id', uid)
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));

    final otherByConv = <String, String>{};
    for (final raw in (members as List)) {
      final m = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map);
      otherByConv[m['conversation_id'].toString()] = m['user_id'].toString();
    }

    final otherIds = otherByConv.values.toSet().toList();
    final profiles = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
    if (otherIds.isNotEmpty) {
      final prows = await _db
          .from('profiles')
          .select('id,username,display_name,avatar_url')
          .inFilter('id', otherIds)
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
      for (final raw in (prows as List)) {
        final p = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map);
        final resolved = await _resolveProfileAvatar(p);
        profiles[resolved['id'].toString()] = resolved;
      }
    }

    // 3) Latest message per conversation (simple approach; good enough for <200 chats)
    final lastByConv = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
    for (final id in convIds) {
      try {
        final rows = await _db
            .from('messages')
            .select('id,body,media_type,sender_id,created_at')
            .eq('conversation_id', id)
            .isFilter('deleted_at', null)
            .order('created_at', ascending: false)
            .limit(1)
            .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 8));
        if ((rows as List).isNotEmpty) {
          lastByConv[id] = Map<String, dynamic>.from(rows.first as Map);
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    final out = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (final m in list) {
      final cid = m['conversation_id'].toString();
      final otherId = otherByConv[cid] ?? '';
      final profile = profiles[otherId] ?? {};
      final last = lastByConv[cid];
      final lastAt = last == null
          ? null
          : DateTime.tryParse((last['created_at'] ?? '').toString());
      final lastRead = DateTime.tryParse((m['last_read_at'] ?? '').toString());
      final unread = last != null &&
          last['sender_id'] != uid &&
          (lastRead == null ||
              (lastAt != null && lastAt.isAfter(lastRead)));

      out.add({
        'conversation_id': cid,
        'last_read_at': m['last_read_at'],
        'other_user_id': otherId,
        'other_name': (profile['display_name'] ?? profile['username'] ?? 'User')
            .toString(),
        'other_username': (profile['username'] ?? '').toString(),
        'other_avatar': (profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString(),
        'last_body': (last?['body'] ?? '').toString(),
        'last_media_type': (last?['media_type'] ?? '').toString(),
        'last_at': lastAt,
        'unread': unread,
      });
    }

    // Sort by last message time (newest first)
    out.sort((a, b) {
      final aa = a['last_at'] as DateTime?;
      final bb = b['last_at'] as DateTime?;
      if (aa == null && bb == null) return 0;
      if (aa == null) return 1;
      if (bb == null) return -1;
      return bb.compareTo(aa);
    });
    return out;
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> messagesDetailed(
    String conversationId,
  ) async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('messages')
        .select(
          'id,conversation_id,sender_id,body,media_url,media_type,created_at',
        )
        .eq('conversation_id', conversationId)
        .isFilter('deleted_at', null)
        .order('created_at')
        .limit(300)
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 20));

    final list = (rows as List)
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
        .toList();

    // Resolve media + attach sender profiles
    final needed = <String>{};
    final senderIds = <String>{};
    for (final m in list) {
      senderIds.add((m['sender_id'] ?? '').toString());
      final path = (m['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (_isStoragePath(path)) needed.add(path);
    }

    final urls = await _resolvePaths('chat-media', needed, strict: false);

    final profiles = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
    if (senderIds.isNotEmpty) {
      final prows = await _db
          .from('profiles')
          .select('id,username,display_name,avatar_url')
          .inFilter('id', senderIds.toList());
      for (final raw in (prows as List)) {
        final p = await _resolveProfileAvatar(
          Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map),
        );
        profiles[p['id'].toString()] = p;
      }
    }

    for (final m in list) {
      final path = (m['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (_isStoragePath(path)) {
        m['resolved_media_url'] = urls[path] ?? '';
      } else {
        m['resolved_media_url'] = path;
      }
      m['sender_profile'] = profiles[(m['sender_id'] ?? '').toString()];
    }
    return list;
  }

  Future<void> sendMessage(String conversationId, String body) async {
    if (body.trim().isEmpty) return;
    await _db.from('messages').insert({
      'conversation_id': conversationId,
      'sender_id': userId,
      'body': body.trim(),
    });
  }

  Future<void> sendMediaMessage({
    required String conversationId,
    required File file,
    required String mediaType, // 'image' | 'video'
  }) async {
    final ext = p.extension(file.path).toLowerCase();
    final objectPath =
        '$userId/$conversationId/${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}$ext';
    await _db.storage.from('chat-media').upload(
          objectPath,
          file,
          fileOptions: FileOptions(
            contentType: mediaType == 'video'
                ? 'video/mp4'
                : 'image/jpeg',
            upsert: false,
          ),
        );
    await _db.from('messages').insert({
      'conversation_id': conversationId,
      'sender_id': userId,
      'body': '',
      'media_url': objectPath,
      'media_type': mediaType,
    });
  }

  // Keep the original simple helpers for backward compatibility:
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> conversations() async {
    return conversationsDetailed();
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> messages(String conversationId) async {
    return messagesDetailed(conversationId);
  }
*/

// Design tokens (match main.dart dark IG theme)
const _igBlack = Color(0xFF000000);
const _igSurface = Color(0xFF121212);
const _igElevated = Color(0xFF262626);
const _igBlue = Color(0xFF0095F6);
const _igMuted = Color(0xFFA8A8A8);
const _igBubbleMe = Color(0xFF3797F0);
const _igBubbleThem = Color(0xFF262626);

ImageProvider<Object>? _avatarProvider(String? source) {
  final v = (source ?? '').trim();
  if (v.isEmpty) return null;
  if (v.startsWith('file://')) {
    return FileImage(File.fromUri(Uri.parse(v)));
  }
  if (v.startsWith('/')) return FileImage(File(v));
  if (v.startsWith('http')) return NetworkImage(v);
  return null;
}

String _relativeTime(DateTime? dt) {
  if (dt == null) return '';
  final d = DateTime.now().difference(dt);
  if (d.inMinutes < 1) return 'now';
  if (d.inMinutes < 60) return '${d.inMinutes}m';
  if (d.inHours < 24) return '${d.inHours}h';
  if (d.inDays < 7) return '${d.inDays}d';
  return '${dt.month}/${dt.day}';
}

class MessagesPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const MessagesPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<MessagesPage> createState() => _MessagesPageState();
}

class _MessagesPageState extends State<MessagesPage> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _rows = [];
  bool _loading = true;
  String? _error;
  final _search = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    InboxController.instance.viewing = true;
    InboxController.instance.markAllRead();
    _load();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    InboxController.instance.viewing = false;
    _search.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final rows = await SocialRepository.instance.conversationsDetailed();
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _rows = rows;
        _loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _error = e.toString();
        _loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get _filtered {
    final q = _search.text.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (q.isEmpty) return _rows;
    return _rows.where((r) {
      final name = (r['other_name'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
      final user = (r['other_username'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
      final preview = (r['last_body'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
      return name.contains(q) || user.contains(q) || preview.contains(q);
    }).toList();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: _igBlack,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: _igBlack,
        elevation: 0,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back, color: Colors.white),
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
        title: const Text(
          'Messages',
          style: TextStyle(
            color: Colors.white,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
            fontSize: 22,
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_outlined, color: Colors.white),
            onPressed: () {
              // New message — open people picker (re-use existing start flow)
              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                const SnackBar(
                  content: Text('Open a profile and tap Message to start a chat'),
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          // Search bar
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 4, 16, 12),
            child: TextField(
              controller: _search,
              onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 15),
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'Search',
                hintStyle: const TextStyle(color: _igMuted),
                prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search, color: _igMuted, size: 22),
                filled: true,
                fillColor: _igElevated,
                contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 0),
                border: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  borderSide: BorderSide.none,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(child: _body()),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _body() {
    if (_loading) return const InboxSkeleton();
    if (_error != null) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Text(
                'Could not load conversations\n$_error',
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: const TextStyle(color: _igMuted),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              TextButton(onPressed: _load, child: const Text('Retry')),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    final list = _filtered;
    if (list.isEmpty) {
      return const Center(
        child: Text(
          'No messages yet.\nStart a conversation from a profile.',
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          style: TextStyle(color: _igMuted, height: 1.5),
        ),
      );
    }
    return RefreshIndicator(
      color: _igBlue,
      backgroundColor: _igSurface,
      onRefresh: _load,
      child: ListView.builder(
        itemCount: list.length,
        itemBuilder: (_, i) => _ConversationTile(
          data: list[i],
          onOpen: () async {
            final r = list[i];
            await Navigator.of(context).push(
              MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                builder: (_) => ConversationPage(
                  conversationId: r['conversation_id'].toString(),
                  title: (r['other_name'] ?? r['other_username'] ?? 'Chat')
                      .toString(),
                  otherUserId: (r['other_user_id'] ?? '').toString(),
                  otherAvatar: (r['other_avatar'] ?? '').toString(),
                  otherUsername: (r['other_username'] ?? '').toString(),
                ),
              ),
            );
            if (mounted) _load();
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ConversationTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ConversationTile({required this.data, required this.onOpen});
  final Map<String, dynamic> data;
  final VoidCallback onOpen;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final name = (data['other_name'] ?? data['other_username'] ?? 'User')
        .toString();
    final username = (data['other_username'] ?? '')
        .toString()
        .trim()
        .replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^@'), '');
    final avatar = (data['other_avatar'] ?? '').toString();
    final preview = (data['last_body'] ?? '').toString();
    final mediaType = (data['last_media_type'] ?? '').toString();
    final unread = data['unread'] == true;
    final lastAt = data['last_at'] is DateTime
        ? data['last_at'] as DateTime
        : DateTime.tryParse('${data['last_at'] ?? ''}');

    String subtitle;
    if (mediaType == 'image') {
      subtitle = '📷 Photo';
    } else if (mediaType == 'video') {
      subtitle = '🎬 Video';
    } else if (preview.isNotEmpty) {
      subtitle = preview;
    } else {
      subtitle = 'Tap to open';
    }

    final prov = _avatarProvider(avatar);

    return InkWell(
      onTap: onOpen,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 10),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            CircleAvatar(
              radius: 28,
              backgroundColor: _igElevated,
              backgroundImage: prov,
              onBackgroundImageError: prov == null
                  ? null
                  : (exception, stackTrace) {},
              child: prov == null
                  ? Text(
                      name.isNotEmpty ? name[0].toUpperCase() : '?',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        fontSize: 20,
                      ),
                    )
                  : null,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 14),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    name,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      fontSize: 15,
                      fontWeight: unread ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (username.isNotEmpty) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      '@$username',
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        color: _igMuted,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                  const SizedBox(height: 3),
                  Text(
                    subtitle,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: unread ? Colors.white : _igMuted,
                      fontSize: 13.5,
                      fontWeight: unread ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w400,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
              children: [
                Text(
                  _relativeTime(lastAt),
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: unread ? _igBlue : _igMuted,
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: unread ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w400,
                  ),
                ),
                if (unread) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Container(
                    width: 10,
                    height: 10,
                    decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                      color: _igBlue,
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
