class ConversationPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ConversationPage({
    super.key,
    required this.conversationId,
    required this.title,
    this.otherUserId = '',
    this.otherAvatar = '',
    this.otherUsername = '',
  });

  final String conversationId;
  final String title;
  final String otherUserId;
  final String otherAvatar;
  final String otherUsername;

  @override
  State<ConversationPage> createState() => _ConversationPageState();
}

class _ConversationPageState extends State<ConversationPage> {
  final _controller = TextEditingController();
  final _scroll = ScrollController();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _messages = [];
  bool _loading = true;
  bool _sending = false;
  String? _error;
  RealtimeChannel? _channel;
  final Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> _senderCache = {};
  bool _attachmentRefreshScheduled = false;

  void _scheduleAttachmentRefresh() {
    if (_attachmentRefreshScheduled) return;
    _attachmentRefreshScheduled = true;
    Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 300), () {
      _attachmentRefreshScheduled = false;
      if (mounted) unawaited(_refreshMessagesQuietly());
    });
  }

  String get _myId => Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id ?? '';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
    _subscribe();
    InboxController.instance.markConversationRead(widget.conversationId);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    _scroll.dispose();
    final ch = _channel;
    if (ch != null) {
      unawaited(Supabase.instance.client.removeChannel(ch));
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _subscribe() {
    _channel = Supabase.instance.client
        .channel('chat-${widget.conversationId}')
        .onPostgresChanges(
          event: PostgresChangeEvent.insert,
          schema: 'public',
          table: 'messages',
          filter: PostgresChangeFilter(
            type: PostgresChangeFilterType.eq,
            column: 'conversation_id',
            value: widget.conversationId,
          ),
          callback: (payload) {
            final row = Map<String, dynamic>.from(payload.newRecord);
            if (_messages.any((m) => m['id'] == row['id'])) return;
            unawaited(_refreshMessagesQuietly());
          },
        )
        .onPostgresChanges(
          event: PostgresChangeEvent.insert,
          schema: 'public',
          table: 'message_attachments',
          filter: PostgresChangeFilter(
            type: PostgresChangeFilterType.eq,
            column: 'conversation_id',
            value: widget.conversationId,
          ),
          callback: (_) => _scheduleAttachmentRefresh(),
        )
        .subscribe();
  }

  Future<void> _refreshMessagesQuietly() async {
    try {
      final rows = await SocialRepository.instance
          .messagesDetailed(widget.conversationId);
      if (!mounted) return;

      for (final r in rows) {
        final sid = (r['sender_id'] ?? '').toString();
        final profile = r['sender_profile'];
        if (sid.isNotEmpty && profile is Map) {
          _senderCache[sid] = Map<String, dynamic>.from(profile);
        }
      }

      setState(() => _messages = rows);
      InboxController.instance
          .markConversationRead(widget.conversationId);
      _scrollToBottom();
    } catch (e) {
      // Keep the current conversation visible if a quiet refresh fails.
    }
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final rows = await SocialRepository.instance
          .messagesDetailed(widget.conversationId);
      if (!mounted) return;
      // Pre-cache sender profiles that came back
      for (final r in rows) {
        final sid = (r['sender_id'] ?? '').toString();
        final p = r['sender_profile'];
        if (sid.isNotEmpty && p is Map) {
          _senderCache[sid] = Map<String, dynamic>.from(p);
        }
      }
      setState(() {
        _messages = rows;
        _loading = false;
      });
      _scrollToBottom(jump: true);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _error = e.toString();
        _loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  void _scrollToBottom({bool jump = false}) {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (!_scroll.hasClients) return;
      if (jump) {
        _scroll.jumpTo(_scroll.position.maxScrollExtent);
      } else {
        _scroll.animateTo(
          _scroll.position.maxScrollExtent,
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
          curve: Curves.easeOut,
        );
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _sendText() async {
    final body = _controller.text.trim();
    if (body.isEmpty || _sending) return;
    setState(() => _sending = true);
    try {
      // Lightweight native send feedback; uses Flutter's built-in sound API.
      await SystemSound.play(SystemSoundType.click);
      await SocialRepository.instance.sendMessage(
        widget.conversationId,
        body,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      _controller.clear();
      // Realtime will append; also force a quiet reload if needed.
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Send failed: $e')),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _sending = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pickAndSendMedia({required bool video}) async {
    final permitted = await PhotoManager.requestPermissionExtend();
    if (!permitted.isAuth && !permitted.hasAccess) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Photo library permission required')),
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    final paths = await PhotoManager.getAssetPathList(
      type: video ? RequestType.video : RequestType.image,
      onlyAll: true,
    );
    if (paths.isEmpty) return;

    final assets = await paths.first.getAssetListPaged(page: 0, size: 100);
    if (!mounted || assets.isEmpty) return;

    final selected = <AssetEntity>[];
    final chosen = await showModalBottomSheet<List<AssetEntity>>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: _igSurface,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (sheetContext) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (sheetContext, setSheetState) => SizedBox(
          height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(sheetContext).height * 0.65,
          child: Column(
            children: [
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 10),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        video
                            ? 'Choose a video'
                            : 'Choose photos (${selected.length}/10)',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          fontSize: 16,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (!video)
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: selected.isEmpty
                            ? null
                            : () => Navigator.pop(
                                  sheetContext,
                                  List<AssetEntity>.from(selected),
                                ),
                        child: const Text('Next'),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              Expanded(
                child: GridView.builder(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  gridDelegate:
                      const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
                    crossAxisCount: 3,
                    mainAxisSpacing: 4,
                    crossAxisSpacing: 4,
                  ),
                  itemCount: assets.length,
                  itemBuilder: (_, index) {
                    final asset = assets[index];
                    final isSelected =
                        selected.any((item) => item.id == asset.id);

                    return FutureBuilder<File?>(
                      future: asset.file,
                      builder: (_, snapshot) {
                        final file = snapshot.data;
                        return GestureDetector(
                          onTap: () {
                            if (video) {
                              Navigator.pop(sheetContext, [asset]);
                              return;
                            }

                            setSheetState(() {
                              if (isSelected) {
                                selected.removeWhere(
                                  (item) => item.id == asset.id,
                                );
                              } else if (selected.length < 10) {
                                selected.add(asset);
                              } else {
                                ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                                  const SnackBar(
                                    content: Text(
                                      'You can select up to 10 photos.',
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                );
                              }
                            });
                          },
                          child: Stack(
                            fit: StackFit.expand,
                            children: [
                              if (file == null)
                                Container(color: _igElevated)
                              else
                                Image.file(file, fit: BoxFit.cover),
                              if (isSelected)
                                Container(
                                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.35),
                                  alignment: Alignment.topRight,
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                                  child: CircleAvatar(
                                    radius: 12,
                                    backgroundColor: _igBlue,
                                    child: Text(
                                      '${selected.indexWhere(
                                            (item) => item.id == asset.id,
                                          ) + 1}',
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                        color: Colors.white,
                                        fontSize: 12,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              if (video)
                                const Positioned(
                                  right: 6,
                                  bottom: 6,
                                  child: Icon(
                                    Icons.play_circle_fill,
                                    color: Colors.white,
                                  ),
                                ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
              if (!video)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  child: SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    child: ElevatedButton(
                      onPressed: selected.isEmpty
                          ? null
                          : () => Navigator.pop(
                                sheetContext,
                                List<AssetEntity>.from(selected),
                              ),
                      child: Text('Send ${selected.length} photo(s)'),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );

    if (chosen == null || chosen.isEmpty || !mounted) return;

    setState(() => _sending = true);
    try {
      final files = <File>[];
      for (final asset in chosen) {
        final file = await asset.file;
        if (file != null) files.add(file);
      }
      if (files.isEmpty) {
        throw StateError('Could not read the selected media.');
      }

      if (!video && files.length > 1) {
        await SocialRepository.instance.sendMediaAlbum(
          conversationId: widget.conversationId,
          files: files,
        );
      } else {
        await SocialRepository.instance.sendMediaMessage(
          conversationId: widget.conversationId,
          file: files.first,
          mediaType: video ? 'video' : 'image',
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Upload failed: $e')),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _sending = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final otherProv = _avatarProvider(widget.otherAvatar);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: _igBlack,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: _igBlack,
        elevation: 0,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back, color: Colors.white),
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
        titleSpacing: 0,
        title: Row(
          children: [
            CircleAvatar(
              radius: 20,
              backgroundColor: _igElevated,
              backgroundImage: otherProv,
              onBackgroundImageError: otherProv == null
                  ? null
                  : (exception, stackTrace) {},
              child: otherProv == null
                  ? Text(
                      widget.title.isNotEmpty
                          ? widget.title[0].toUpperCase()
                          : '?',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.white),
                    )
                  : null,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    widget.title,
                    maxLines: 1,

                      color: Colors.white,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,

          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          Expanded(child: _thread()),
          _composer(),
        ],
      ),

  Widget _thread() {
    if (_loading) return const ChatSkeleton();
    if (_error != null) {
      return Center(
        child: TextButton(onPressed: _load, child: Text('Retry\n$_error')),
      );
    }
    if (_messages.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            CircleAvatar(
              radius: 40,
              backgroundColor: _igElevated,
              backgroundImage: _avatarProvider(widget.otherAvatar),
              child: _avatarProvider(widget.otherAvatar) == null
                  ? const Icon(Icons.person, size: 40, color: _igMuted)
                  : null,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
              widget.title,
              style: const TextStyle(
                color: Colors.white,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                fontSize: 18,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            const Text(
              'Say hello 👋',
              style: TextStyle(color: _igMuted),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    return ListView.builder(
      key: PageStorageKey<String>('twice-chat-${widget.conversationId}'),
      controller: _scroll,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 18),
      itemCount: _messages.length,
      itemBuilder: (_, i) {
        final m = _messages[i];
        final own = (m['sender_id'] ?? '') == _myId;
        final prevOwn = i > 0 &&
            (_messages[i - 1]['sender_id'] ?? '') == (m['sender_id'] ?? '');
        return TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
          key: ValueKey<String>('chat-message-${m['id'] ?? '${m['created_at'] ?? i}'}'),
          tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0, end: 1),
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 190),
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
          builder: (context, value, child) => Opacity(
            opacity: value,
            child: Transform.translate(
              offset: Offset(own ? 14 * (1 - value) : -8 * (1 - value), 8 * (1 - value)),
              child: child,
            ),
          ),
          child: _Bubble(
            message: m,
            own: own,
            showAvatar: !own && !prevOwn,
            senderProfile: _senderCache[(m['sender_id'] ?? '').toString()],
            fallbackAvatar: widget.otherAvatar,
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _composer() {
    return SafeArea(
      top: false,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(10, 9, 10, 10),
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          color: _igBlack,
          border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: _igElevated, width: 0.5)),
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            IconButton(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.camera_alt, color: _igBlue),
              onPressed: _sending ? null : () => _pickAndSendMedia(video: false),
            ),
            Expanded(
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 15),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: const Color(0xFF1D1D1D),
                  border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF303030), width: 0.7),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: TextField(
                        controller: _controller,
                        style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 15),
                        minLines: 1,
                        maxLines: 5,
                        textInputAction: TextInputAction.send,
                        onSubmitted: (_) => _sendText(),
                        decoration: const InputDecoration(
                          hintText: 'Message...',
                          hintStyle: TextStyle(color: _igMuted),
                          border: InputBorder.none,
                          isDense: true,
                          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.image_outlined, color: _igMuted, size: 22),
                      onPressed:
                          _sending ? null : () => _pickAndSendMedia(video: false),
                      visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.videocam_outlined, color: _igMuted, size: 22),
                      onPressed:
                          _sending ? null : () => _pickAndSendMedia(video: true),
                      visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 4),
            IconButton(
              icon: _sending
                  ? const SizedBox(
                      width: 22,
                      height: 22,
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                        strokeWidth: 2,
                        color: _igBlue,
                      ),
                    )

              onPressed: _sending ? null : _sendText,
            ),

        ),
      ),
    );
  }

class _Bubble extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Bubble({
    required this.message,
    required this.own,
    required this.showAvatar,
    this.senderProfile,
    this.fallbackAvatar = '',
  });

  final Map<String, dynamic> message;
  final bool own;
  final bool showAvatar;
  final Map<String, dynamic>? senderProfile;
  final String fallbackAvatar;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final body = (message['body'] ?? '').toString();
    final mediaUrl = (message['resolved_media_url'] ??
            message['media_url'] ??
            '')
        .toString();
    final mediaType = (message['media_type'] ?? '').toString();
    final createdAt = DateTime.tryParse(
      (message['created_at'] ?? '').toString(),
    )?.toLocal();
    final timeLabel = createdAt == null
        ? ''
        : '${createdAt.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:'
          '${createdAt.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
    final isRead = own && message['read_at'] != null;
    final hasMedia = mediaUrl.isNotEmpty &&
        (mediaUrl.startsWith('http') || mediaUrl.startsWith('file'));
    final rawAttachments = message['resolved_attachments'];
    final attachments = rawAttachments is List
        ? rawAttachments
            .whereType<Map>()
            .map((a) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(a))
            .where((a) {
              final url = (a['resolved_media_url'] ?? '').toString();
              return url.startsWith('http') || url.startsWith('file');
            })
            .toList()
        : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    final hasAlbum = attachments.length > 1;

    final avatarUrl = (senderProfile?['avatar_url'] ?? fallbackAvatar).toString();
    final prov = _avatarProvider(avatarUrl);

    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(
        top: showAvatar ? 10 : 2,
        bottom: 2,
        left: own ? 48 : 0,
        right: own ? 0 : 48,
      ),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
        mainAxisAlignment:
            own ? MainAxisAlignment.end : MainAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          if (!own) ...[
            if (showAvatar)
              CircleAvatar(
                radius: 14,
                backgroundColor: _igElevated,
                backgroundImage: prov,
                onBackgroundImageError: prov == null
                    ? null
                    : (exception, stackTrace) {},
                child: prov == null
                    ? const Icon(Icons.person, size: 14, color: _igMuted)
                    : null,
              )
            else
              const SizedBox(width: 28),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
          ],
          Flexible(
            child: Container(
              constraints: BoxConstraints(
                maxWidth: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width * 0.72,
              ),
              padding: hasMedia
                  ? EdgeInsets.zero
                  : const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: own ? _igBubbleMe : _igBubbleThem,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
                  topLeft: const Radius.circular(20),
                  topRight: const Radius.circular(20),
                  bottomLeft: Radius.circular(own ? 20 : 5),
                  bottomRight: Radius.circular(own ? 5 : 20),
                ),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  if (hasAlbum)
                    _AlbumGrid(attachments: attachments)
                  else if (hasMedia)
                    _media(mediaUrl, mediaType),
                  if (body.isNotEmpty)
                    Padding(
                      padding: hasMedia
                          ? const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 8, 12, 10)
                          : EdgeInsets.zero,
                      child: Text(
                        body,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          fontSize: 15,
                          height: 1.35,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  if (timeLabel.isNotEmpty || isRead)
                    Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                        hasMedia ? 8 : 0,
                        6,
                        hasMedia ? 8 : 0,
                        2,
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
                        children: [
                          if (timeLabel.isNotEmpty)
                            Text(
                              timeLabel,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white60,
                                fontSize: 10,
                              ),
                            ),
                          if (isRead) ...[
                            const SizedBox(width: 6),
                            const Text(
                              'Seen',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white70,
                                fontSize: 10,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _media(String url, String type) {
    if (type == 'video') {
      return _InlineVideo(url: url);
    }
    return ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      child: Image(
        image: _avatarProvider(url) ?? const NetworkImage(''),
        fit: BoxFit.cover,
        width: 220,
        height: 280,
        errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => Container(
          width: 220,
          height: 160,
          color: _igElevated,
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: const Icon(Icons.broken_image, color: _igMuted),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _AlbumGrid extends StatelessWidget {
  const _AlbumGrid({required this.attachments});

  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> attachments;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final visible = attachments.take(4).toList();

    return ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
      child: SizedBox(
        width: 240,
        height: visible.length == 2 ? 132 : 220,
        child: GridView.builder(
          physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
          padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
          itemCount: visible.length,
          gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
            crossAxisCount: 2,
            mainAxisSpacing: 2,
            crossAxisSpacing: 2,
          ),
          itemBuilder: (_, index) {
            final item = visible[index];
            final url = (item['resolved_media_url'] ?? '').toString();
            final remaining = attachments.length - 4;

            return Stack(
              fit: StackFit.expand,
              children: [
                Image(
                  image: _avatarProvider(url) ?? const NetworkImage(''),
                  fit: BoxFit.cover,
                  errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => Container(
                    color: _igElevated,
                    alignment: Alignment.center,
                    child: const Icon(
                      Icons.broken_image_outlined,
                      color: _igMuted,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                if (index == 3 && remaining > 0)
                  Container(
                    color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.58),
                    alignment: Alignment.center,
                    child: Text(
                      '+$remaining',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        fontSize: 24,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _InlineVideo extends StatefulWidget {
  const _InlineVideo({required this.url});
  final String url;

  @override
  State<_InlineVideo> createState() => _InlineVideoState();
}

class _InlineVideoState extends State<_InlineVideo> {
  VideoPlayerController? _c;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final uri = Uri.parse(widget.url);
    _c = widget.url.startsWith('file')
        ? VideoPlayerController.file(File.fromUri(uri))
        : VideoPlayerController.networkUrl(uri);
    _c!.initialize().then((_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _c?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = _c;
    if (c == null || !c.value.isInitialized) {
      return Container(
        width: 220,
        height: 280,
        color: _igElevated,
        child: const Center(
          child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: Colors.white, strokeWidth: 2),
        ),
      );
    }
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        if (c.value.isPlaying) {
          c.pause();
        } else {
          c.play();
        }
        setState(() {});
      },
      child: ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        child: SizedBox(
          width: 220,
          height: 280,
          child: Stack(
            alignment: Alignment.center,
            children: [
              FittedBox(
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                child: SizedBox(
                  width: c.value.size.width,
                  height: c.value.size.height,
                  child: VideoPlayer(c),
                ),
              ),
              if (!c.value.isPlaying)
                const Icon(Icons.play_circle_fill, color: Colors.white70, size: 48),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

ImageProvider<Object> _twiceImageProvider(
  String source, {
  int maxDimension = 1080,
}) {
  final value = source.trim();
  if (value.startsWith('file://')) {
    return ResizeImage.resizeIfNeeded(
      maxDimension,
      null,
      FileImage(File.fromUri(Uri.parse(value))),
    );
  }
  if (value.startsWith('/')) {
    return ResizeImage.resizeIfNeeded(maxDimension, null, FileImage(File(value)));
  }
  return TwiceNetworkImage(value, maxDimension: maxDimension);
}

ImageProvider<Object> _twiceAvatarProvider(String source) =>
    _twiceImageProvider(source, maxDimension: 256);

String _formatClock(int seconds) =>
    '${seconds ~/ 60}:${(seconds % 60).toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

// A usable image source is a network URL OR a saved local copy (file:// or a
// device path). Saved avatars become file:// after they are cached.
bool _isImageSource(String value) {
  final v = value.trim();
  return v.startsWith('http') || v.startsWith('file://') || v.startsWith('/');
}

String _newTwiceUuid() {
  final random = Random.secure();
  final bytes = List<int>.generate(16, (_) => random.nextInt(256));
  bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
  bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
  final hex = bytes.map((b) => b.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0')).join();
  return '${hex.substring(0, 8)}-${hex.substring(8, 12)}-'
      '${hex.substring(12, 16)}-${hex.substring(16, 20)}-${hex.substring(20)}';
}

const ink = Color(0xFF171923);
const muted = Color(0xFF7B8191);
const violet = Color(0xFF7257F5);
const canvas = Color(0xFFF7F7FB);

const supabaseUrl = String.fromEnvironment('SUPABASE_URL');
const supabasePublishableKey= [REDACTED]
  'SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY',
);

bool get supabaseConfigured =>
    supabaseUrl.startsWith('https://') && supabasePublishableKey.isNotEmpty;

// True only after Supabase has initialized successfully. If configuration is
// missing or initialization fails, the app still starts and shows its setup
// screen instead of remaining on Android's Flutter splash screen.
bool supabaseReady = false;
String? supabaseStartupError;

// BOOTFIX: the first frame is drawn immediately. Supabase starts in the
// background and the gate swaps from the splash to the app when it is ready.
final ValueNotifier<bool> supabaseBootFinished = ValueNotifier<bool>(false);

Future<void> _bootSupabase() async {
  final watch = Stopwatch()..start();
  if (!supabaseConfigured) {
    final missing = <String>[
      if (!supabaseUrl.startsWith('https://')) 'SUPABASE_URL',
      if (supabasePublishableKey.isEmpty) 'SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY',
    ];
    supabaseStartupError =
        'Missing or invalid build configuration: ${missing.join(', ')}. '
        'Check GitHub Repository secrets and rebuild the APK.';
  } else {
    try {
      await Supabase.initialize(
        url: supabaseUrl,
        publishableKey: [REDACTED],
      );
      supabaseReady = true;
    } catch (error, stackTrace) {
      debugPrint('Twice Supabase startup failed: $error');
      debugPrintStack(stackTrace: stackTrace);
      supabaseReady = false;
      final details = error
          .toString()
          .replaceAll(supabaseUrl, '[Supabase URL hidden]')
          .replaceAll(supabasePublishableKey, '[key hidden]');
      supabaseStartupError =
          'Supabase initialization failed (${error.runtimeType}): $details';
    }
  }
  debugPrint(
    'TWICE_BOOT supabase ready=$supabaseReady in ${watch.elapsedMilliseconds}ms',
  );
  supabaseBootFinished.value = true;
}

Future<void> main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  TwiceMedia.configure();
  runApp(const TwiceApp());
  unawaited(_bootSupabase());
  unawaited(TwiceMedia.trimDiskCache());
}

class NativeCore {
  NativeCore._() {
    try {
      final lib = DynamicLibrary.open('libtwice_native.so');
      _add = lib
          .lookupFunction<Int32 Function(Int32, Int32), int Function(int, int)>(
            'twice_native_add',
          );
    } catch (_) {
      // Keeps Flutter tests and non-Android preview environments usable.
      _add = null;
    }
  }

  static final NativeCore instance = NativeCore._();

  late final int Function(int, int)? _add;

  int add(int a, int b) => _add?.call(a, b) ?? a + b;

  bool get isLoaded => _add != null;
}

class TwiceApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const TwiceApp({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      title: 'Twice',
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
      theme: ThemeData(
        useMaterial3: true,
        scaffoldBackgroundColor: canvas,
        colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(
          seedColor: violet,
          brightness: Brightness.light,
        ),
        fontFamily: 'Roboto',
        textTheme: ThemeData.light().textTheme.apply(fontFamily: 'Roboto'),
        primaryTextTheme: ThemeData.light().primaryTextTheme.apply(
          fontFamily: 'Roboto',
        ),
        appBarTheme: const AppBarTheme(
          backgroundColor: canvas,
          foregroundColor: ink,
          elevation: 0,
          centerTitle: false,
        ),
      ),
      home: const TwiceAuthGate(),
    );
  }
}

class TwiceAuthGate extends StatelessWidget {
  const TwiceAuthGate({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ValueListenableBuilder<bool>(
      valueListenable: supabaseBootFinished,
      builder: (context, finished, _) {
        if (!finished && supabaseConfigured) return const _TwiceSplash();
        if (!supabaseReady) {
          return TwiceSignInPage(
            configurationMissing: true,
            startupError: supabaseStartupError,
          );
        }
        return StreamBuilder<AuthState>(
          stream: Supabase.instance.client.auth.onAuthStateChange,
          builder: (context, snapshot) {
            final session = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentSession;
            if (session != null) return const TwiceShell();
            return const TwiceSignInPage();
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _TwiceSplash extends StatefulWidget {
  const _TwiceSplash();

  @override
  State<_TwiceSplash> createState() => _TwiceSplashState();
}

class _TwiceSplashState extends State<_TwiceSplash> {
  bool _slow = false;
  Timer? _timer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _timer = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 8), () {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _slow = true);
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: canvas,
      body: Center(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            ShaderMask(
              shaderCallback: (bounds) => const LinearGradient(
                colors: [Color(0xFFFF5FA2), Color(0xFFFF2D75), Color(0xFFD946EF)],
              ).createShader(bounds),
              child: const Text(
                'Twice',
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                  fontSize: 46,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 18),
            AnimatedOpacity(
              opacity: _slow ? 1 : 0,
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
              child: const Text(
                'Still connecting… check your internet.',
                style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 13),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
