                      ),
                    ),
                    if (isPrivate) ...[
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      const Icon(Icons.lock_rounded, size: 16, color: muted),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Text(
                  username.isEmpty ? '' : '@$username',
                  style: const TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 14.5),
                ),
                if (bio.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  Text(
                    bio,
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: const TextStyle(color: ink, height: 1.4),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                _stat(statsLoaded ? _compactCount(postCount) : '…', 'Posts'),
                _divider(),
                _stat(
                  statsLoaded || followers > 0 ? _compactCount(followers) : '…',
                  'Followers',
                  onTap: () => _openFollowList(true),
                ),
                _divider(),
                _stat(
                  statsLoaded || following > 0 ? _compactCount(following) : '…',
                  'Following',
                  onTap: () => _openFollowList(false),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 10, 16, 18),
            child: isSelf
                ? Container(
                    height: 46,
                    alignment: Alignment.center,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: const Color(0xFFEDE9FF),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
                    ),
                    child: const Text(
                      'This is your profile',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: violet,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      ),
                    ),
                  )
                : Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(child: _followButton()),
                      const SizedBox(width: 10),
                      SizedBox(
                        height: 46,
                        child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                          onPressed: messageBusy ? null : _message,
                          style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                            foregroundColor: ink,
                            side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFDAD7E8)),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18),
                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
                            ),
                          ),
                          icon: messageBusy
                              ? const SizedBox(
                                  width: 16,
                                  height: 16,
                                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                                )
                              : const Icon(Icons.send_outlined, size: 18),
                          label: const Text(
                            'Message',
                            style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _tabBar() {
    Widget item(int index, IconData icon, String label) {
      final active = tab == index;
      return Expanded(
        child: InkWell(
          onTap: () => setState(() => tab = index),
          child: Container(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              border: Border(
                bottom: BorderSide(
                  color: active ? violet : Colors.transparent,
                  width: 3,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            child: Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
              children: [
                Icon(icon, size: 20, color: active ? violet : muted),
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                Text(
                  label,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: active ? FontWeight.w900 : FontWeight.w600,
                    color: active ? ink : muted,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Container(
      color: canvas,
      child: Row(
        children: [
          item(0, Icons.grid_on_rounded, 'Posts'),
          item(1, Icons.photo_outlined, 'Photos'),
          item(2, Icons.play_circle_outline_rounded, 'Videos'),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _emptyBox(IconData icon, String title, String subtitle) => SizedBox(
    height: 300,
    child: _SearchEmpty(icon: icon, title: title, subtitle: subtitle),
  );

  List<Widget> _content() {
    if (notFound) {
      return [
        SliverToBoxAdapter(
          child: _emptyBox(
            Icons.person_off_rounded,
            'Profile not available',
            'This account doesn’t exist or can’t be shown.',
          ),
        ),
      ];
    }
    if (locked) {
      return [
        SliverToBoxAdapter(
          child: _emptyBox(
            Icons.lock_rounded,
            'This account is private',
            'Follow ${shownName.isEmpty ? 'this account' : shownName} to see their posts, photos and videos.',
          ),
        ),
      ];
    }
    if (postsLoading && posts.isEmpty) {
      return [
        SliverPadding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 6, 12, 0),
          sliver: SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: SizedBox(
              height: 330,
              child: _Pulse(
                child: GridView.count(
                  physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                  crossAxisCount: 3,
                  mainAxisSpacing: 4,
                  crossAxisSpacing: 4,
                  children: List.generate(
                    9,
                    (_) => DecoratedBox(
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: const Color(0xFFE9E7F3),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ];
    }
    if (postsError != null && posts.isEmpty) {
      return [
        SliverToBoxAdapter(
          child: SizedBox(
            height: 300,
            child: _SearchEmpty(
              icon: Icons.cloud_off_rounded,
              title: 'Could not load posts',
              subtitle: postsError!,
              actionLabel: 'Try again',
              onAction: _loadPosts,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ];
    }
    final items = _visible;
    if (items.isEmpty) {
      return [
        SliverToBoxAdapter(
          child: _emptyBox(
            tab == 2
                ? Icons.play_circle_outline_rounded
                : tab == 1
                ? Icons.photo_library_outlined
                : Icons.grid_on_rounded,
            tab == 2
                ? 'No videos yet'
                : tab == 1
                ? 'No photos yet'
                : 'No posts yet',
            isSelf
                ? 'Share a moment and it will appear here.'
                : '${shownName.isEmpty ? 'This user' : shownName} hasn’t shared anything here yet.',
          ),
        ),
      ];
    }
    return [
      SliverPadding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 6, 12, 0),
        sliver: SliverGrid(
          gridDelegate: SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
            crossAxisCount: 3,
            mainAxisSpacing: 4,
            crossAxisSpacing: 4,
            childAspectRatio: tab == 2 ? 0.72 : 1,
          ),
          delegate: SliverChildBuilderDelegate(
            (_, i) => _MediaGridTile(
              post: items[i],
              onTap: () => _openPost(items[i]),
            ),
            childCount: items.length,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ];
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final bottom = MediaQuery.of(context).padding.bottom;
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: canvas,
      body: RefreshIndicator(
        color: violet,
        onRefresh: _load,
        child: CustomScrollView(
          physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
          slivers: [
            SliverAppBar(
              pinned: true,
              backgroundColor: canvas,
              surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
              elevation: 0,
              scrolledUnderElevation: 0,
              leading: IconButton(
                tooltip: 'Back',
                onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
              ),
              title: Text(
                username.isEmpty ? 'Profile' : '@$username',
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
              ),
              actions: [
                IconButton(
                  tooltip: 'Copy profile link',
                  onPressed: _copyLink,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.ios_share_rounded),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            if (profile.isEmpty && profileLoading)
              const SliverFillRemaining(
                hasScrollBody: false,
                child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: violet)),
              )
            else ...[
              if (!notFound) SliverToBoxAdapter(child: _header()),
              if (!notFound && !locked)
                SliverPersistentHeader(
                  pinned: true,
                  delegate: _ProfileTabsDelegate(child: _tabBar()),
                ),
              ..._content(),
              SliverToBoxAdapter(child: SizedBox(height: 28 + bottom)),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class CommentsSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const CommentsSheet({super.key, required this.post});
  final SocialPost post;
  @override
  State<CommentsSheet> createState() => _CommentsSheetState();
}

class _CommentsSheetState extends State<CommentsSheet> {
  final controller = TextEditingController();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows = [];
  bool busy = true;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String? loadError;
  bool sending = false;

  Future<void> _load() async {
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        busy = true;
        loadError = null;
      });
    }
    try {
      final data = await SocialRepository.instance.comments(widget.post.id);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          rows = data;
          busy = false;
          loadError = null;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          busy = false;
          loadError = e.toString();
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _send() async {
    if (sending) return;
    final text = controller.text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return;

    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();

    final optimistic = <String, dynamic>{
      'id': _newTwiceUuid(),
      'post_id': widget.post.id,
      'user_id': Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id ?? '',
      'body': text,
      'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
      'profiles': <String, dynamic>{'display_name': 'You'},
      '_pending': true,
    };

    // Render immediately and clear the composer before network work begins.
    setState(() {
      rows = [...rows, optimistic];
      controller.clear();
      loadError = null;
      busy = false;
      sending = true;
    });

    // Persist in the background; no comments refresh or feed reload.
    try {
      final synced = await SocialRepository.instance.addComment(
        widget.post.id,
        text,
        commentId: optimistic['id'].toString(),
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        optimistic.remove('_pending');
        if (!synced) optimistic['_queued'] = true;
      });
      if (!synced) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              'Saved offline. This comment will sync when you reconnect.',
            ),
            behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        optimistic['_failed'] = true;
        optimistic.remove('_pending');
      });
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('Comment is visible but could not sync: $e'),
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => sending = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Container(
    height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * .78,
    decoration: const BoxDecoration(
      color: Colors.white,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
    ),
    child: Column(
      children: [
        const SizedBox(height: 10),
        Container(
          width: 38,
          height: 4,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Colors.black26,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99),
          ),
        ),
        const Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
          child: Text(
            'Comments',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
          ),
        ),
        Expanded(
          child: busy
              ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
              : loadError != null
              ? Center(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                    child: Column(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        const Text('Could not load comments'),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        Text(loadError!, textAlign: TextAlign.center),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        TextButton(
                          onPressed: _load,
                          child: const Text('Retry'),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                )
              : rows.isEmpty
              ? const Center(child: Text('No comments yet'))
              : ListView.builder(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 4, 16, 16),
                  itemCount: rows.length,
                  itemBuilder: (_, i) {
                    final r = rows[i];
                    final p = r['profiles'] as Map? ?? {};
                    final name = (p['display_name'] ?? p['username'] ?? 'User')
                        .toString();
                    return Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                      child: Row(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          GestureDetector(
                            behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                            onTap: () => _openUserProfile(
                              context,
                              userId: (p['id'] ?? r['user_id'] ?? '').toString(),
                              profile: Map<String, dynamic>.from(p),
                            ),
                            child: Builder(
                            builder: (context) {
                              final avatar = (p['avatar_url'] ?? '')
                                  .toString()
                                  .trim();
                              final hasAvatar =
                                  _isImageSource(avatar) ||
                                  avatar.startsWith('file://') ||
                                  avatar.startsWith('/');
                              return CircleAvatar(
                                radius: 17,
                                backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFEDE7FF),
                                backgroundImage: hasAvatar
                                    ? _twiceAvatarProvider(avatar)
                                    : null,
                                child: hasAvatar
                                    ? null
                                    : Text(
                                        name.isNotEmpty
                                            ? name[0].toUpperCase()
                                            : 'U',
                                        style: const TextStyle(
                                          color: violet,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                              );
                            },
                          ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 10),
                          Flexible(
                            child: Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 14,
                                vertical: 10,
                              ),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: const Color(0xFFF3F3F6),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                              ),
                              child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                children: [
                                  GestureDetector(
                                    behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                                    onTap: () => _openUserProfile(
                                      context,
                                      userId: (p['id'] ?? r['user_id'] ?? '')
                                          .toString(),
                                      profile: Map<String, dynamic>.from(p),
                                    ),
                                    child: Column(
                                      crossAxisAlignment:
                                          CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                      children: [
                                        Text(
                                          name,
                                          style: const TextStyle(
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                            fontSize: 13,
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                        const SizedBox(height: 2),
                                        Text(
                                          '@${(p['username'] ?? 'user').toString().replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^@'), '')}  ·  ${_timeAgo(r['created_at'])}',
                                          style: const TextStyle(
                                            color: muted,
                                            fontSize: 11,
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                      ],
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 5),
                                  Text((r['body'] ?? '').toString()),
                                  if (r['_queued'] == true)
                                    const Padding(
                                      padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                                      child: Text(
                                        'Saved offline · waiting to sync',
                                        style: TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 11,
                                          color: muted,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  if (r['_failed'] == true)
                                    const Padding(
                                      padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                                      child: Text(
                                        'Not synced · check connection and retry',
                                        style: TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 11,
                                          color: Colors.redAccent,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
        ),
        SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              14,
              8,
              14,
              10 + MediaQuery.viewInsetsOf(context).bottom,
            ),
            child: Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Container(
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: const Color(0xFFF3F3F6),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26),
                      border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFE5E3EC)),
                    ),
                    child: TextField(
                      controller: controller,
                      minLines: 1,
                      maxLines: 4,
                      textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                      textInputAction: TextInputAction.send,
                      onSubmitted: (_) => _send(),
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        hintText: 'Write a comment…',
                        contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 18,
                          vertical: 12,
                        ),
                        border: InputBorder.none,
                        enabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                        focusedBorder: InputBorder.none,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Material(
                  color: violet,
                  shape: const CircleBorder(),
                  child: InkWell(
                    customBorder: const CircleBorder(),
                    onTap: sending ? null : _send,
                    child: SizedBox(
                      width: 46,
                      height: 46,
                      child: Center(
                        child: sending
                            ? const SizedBox(
                                width: 20,
                                height: 20,
                                child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                  strokeWidth: 2,
                                  color: Colors.white,
                                ),
                              )
                            : const Icon(
                                Icons.send_rounded,
                                color: Colors.white,
                                size: 21,
                              ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

/// Crisp bell icon (outline, or filled when selected) for the Inbox tab.
class _InboxBellIcon extends StatelessWidget {
  const _InboxBellIcon({
    required this.size,
    required this.color,
    this.filled = false,
  });

  final double size;
  final Color color;
  final bool filled;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => CustomPaint(
    size: Size.square(size),
    painter: _InboxBellPainter(color, filled),
  );
}

class _InboxBellPainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _InboxBellPainter(this.color, this.filled);

  final Color color;
  final bool filled;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    canvas.scale(size.width / 24);
    final body = Path()
      ..moveTo(18, 8)
      ..arcToPoint(const Offset(6, 8), radius: const Radius.circular(6), clockwise: false)
      ..relativeCubicTo(0, 7, -3, 9, -3, 9)
      ..relativeLineTo(18, 0)
      ..relativeCubicTo(0, 0, -3, -2, -3, -9)
      ..close();
    final clapper = Path()
      ..moveTo(13.73, 21)
      ..arcToPoint(const Offset(10.27, 21), radius: const Radius.circular(2));
    final stroke = Paint()
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = 2
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round
      ..strokeJoin = StrokeJoin.round
      ..color = color;
    if (filled) {
      canvas.drawPath(body, Paint()..style = PaintingStyle.fill..color = color);
    }
    canvas.drawPath(body, stroke);
    canvas.drawPath(clapper, stroke);
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _InboxBellPainter old) =>
      old.color != color || old.filled != filled;
}

/// Bell + red unread counter, live from [InboxController].
class _InboxNavIcon extends StatelessWidget {
  const _InboxNavIcon({required this.selected});

  final bool selected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ListenableBuilder(
      listenable: InboxController.instance,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final count = InboxController.instance.unread;
        return Badge(
          isLabelVisible: count > 0,
          label: Text(count > 99 ? '99+' : '$count'),
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFFF3040),
          textColor: Colors.white,
          offset: const Offset(4, -4),
          child: _InboxBellIcon(
            size: 25,
            color: selected ? ink : const Color(0xFF5B5E6C),
            filled: selected,
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class ActivityPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ActivityPage({super.key, this.active = false});

  final bool active;

  @override
  State<ActivityPage> createState() => _ActivityPageState();
}

class _ActivityPageState extends State<ActivityPage> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>>? rows;
  String? loadError;
  Set<String> _newIds = {};
  int _seenVersion = InboxController.instance.version;
  Timer? _markTimer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    InboxController.instance.addListener(_onInbox);
    if (widget.active) _activate();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant ActivityPage old) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(old);
    if (widget.active && !old.active) {
      _activate();
    } else if (!widget.active && old.active) {
      InboxController.instance.viewing = false;
      _markTimer?.cancel();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _activate() async {
    InboxController.instance.viewing = true;
    _newIds = {};
    await _load();
    _markTimer?.cancel();
    _markTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 1500), () {
      if (mounted && widget.active) InboxController.instance.markAllRead();
    });
  }

  void _onInbox() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final v = InboxController.instance.version;
    if (v != _seenVersion) {
      _seenVersion = v;
      if (widget.active || rows != null) _load();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    try {
      final data = await SocialRepository.instance.inbox();
      if (!mounted) return;
      final previous = {for (final r in rows ?? const []) r['id'].toString()};
      setState(() {
        for (final r in data) {
          final id = r['id'].toString();
          if (r['is_read'] != true || (previous.isNotEmpty && !previous.contains(id))) {
            _newIds.add(id);
          }
        }
        rows = data;
        loadError = null;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && rows == null) setState(() => loadError = e.toString());
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    InboxController.instance.removeListener(_onInbox);
    InboxController.instance.viewing = false;
    _markTimer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  (IconData, Color) _badgeFor(String type) {
    switch (type) {
      case 'like':
        return (Icons.favorite_rounded, const Color(0xFFFF2D55));
      case 'story_reaction':
        return (Icons.favorite_rounded, const Color(0xFFFF2D55));
      case 'comment':
      case 'reply':
        return (Icons.mode_comment_rounded, const Color(0xFF2F80ED));
      case 'story_reply':
      case 'message':
        return (Icons.reply_rounded, const Color(0xFF7C4DFF));
      default:
        return (Icons.person_add_alt_1_rounded, const Color(0xFF7C4DFF));
    }
  }

  String _action(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
    final comment = (row['body'] ?? row['comment_text'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final quoted = comment.isEmpty ? '' : ': “$comment”';
    switch ((row['type'] ?? '').toString()) {
      case 'like':
        return 'liked your post.';
      case 'comment':
        return 'commented on your post$quoted';
      case 'reply':
        return 'replied to your comment$quoted';
      case 'follow':
        return 'started following you.';
      case 'follow_request':
        return 'requested to follow you.';
      case 'story_reaction':
        return 'liked your story.';
      case 'story_reply':
        return 'replied to your story$quoted';
      case 'message':
        return 'sent you a message.';
      default:
        return 'interacted with you.';
    }
  }

  Widget _tile(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
    final actor = Map<String, dynamic>.from(row['profiles'] as Map? ?? const {});
    final name = (actor['display_name'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty
        ? actor['display_name'].toString()
        : (actor['username'] ?? 'Someone').toString();
    final avatar = (row['actor_avatar'] ?? '').toString();
    final thumb = (row['post_thumb'] ?? '').toString();
    final isNew = _newIds.contains(row['id'].toString());
    final (icon, tint) = _badgeFor((row['type'] ?? '').toString());
    return GestureDetector(
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      onTap: () => _openUserProfile(
        context,
        userId: (actor['id'] ?? '').toString(),
        profile: actor.isEmpty
            ? null
            : {...actor, 'avatar_url': avatar},
      ),
      child: Container(
      color: isNew ? const Color(0xFFF0EBFF) : Colors.transparent,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Stack(
            clipBehavior: Clip.none,
            children: [
              CircleAvatar(
                radius: 25,
                backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE9E7F5),
                backgroundImage: _isImageSource(avatar)
                    ? _twiceAvatarProvider(avatar)
                    : null,
                child: _isImageSource(avatar)
                    ? null
                    : const Icon(Icons.person_rounded, color: muted),
              ),
              Positioned(
                right: -4,
                bottom: -4,
                child: Container(
                  width: 22,
                  height: 22,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: tint,
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    border: Border.all(color: Colors.white, width: 2),
                  ),
                  child: Icon(icon, size: 12, color: Colors.white),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 14),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text.rich(
                  TextSpan(
                    children: [
                      TextSpan(
                        text: name,
                        style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                      ),
                      TextSpan(text: ' ${_action(row)}'),
                    ],
                  ),
                  maxLines: 3,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14.5, height: 1.3),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 3),
                Text(
                  _timeAgo(row['created_at']),
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: isNew ? const Color(0xFF6A3DF0) : muted,
                    fontSize: 12.5,
                    fontWeight: isNew ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w400,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          if (_isImageSource(thumb)) ...[
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              child: SizedBox(
                width: 48,
                height: 48,
                child: Image(
                  image: _twiceImageProvider(thumb, maxDimension: 200),
                  fit: BoxFit.cover,
                  gaplessPlayback: true,
                  errorBuilder: (_, _, _) =>
                      const ColoredBox(color: Color(0xFFE9E7F5)),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ] else if (isNew) ...[
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            const CircleAvatar(radius: 5, backgroundColor: Color(0xFF6A3DF0)),
          ],
        ],
      ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final list = rows;
    if (list == null && loadError == null) {
      return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
    }
    if (list == null) {
      return RefreshIndicator(
        onRefresh: _load,
        child: ListView(
          physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
          children: [
            const SizedBox(height: 160),
            Center(child: Text('Could not load inbox\n$loadError', textAlign: TextAlign.center)),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }
    if (list.isEmpty) {
      return RefreshIndicator(
        onRefresh: _load,
        child: ListView(
          physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
          children: const [
            SizedBox(height: 150),
            Icon(Icons.notifications_none_rounded, size: 64, color: muted),
            SizedBox(height: 12),
            Center(
              child: Text(
                'No notifications yet',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: ink),
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(height: 6),
            Center(
              child: Text(
                'Likes, comments, follows and story\nreplies will show up here.',
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: TextStyle(color: muted),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }
    final fresh = list.where((r) => _newIds.contains(r['id'].toString())).toList();
    final earlier = list.where((r) => !_newIds.contains(r['id'].toString())).toList();
    Widget header(String text) => Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 6),
      child: Text(
        text,
        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: ink),
      ),
    );
    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: _load,
      child: ListView(
        physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 24),
        children: [
          if (fresh.isNotEmpty) ...[header('New'), ...fresh.map(_tile)],
          if (earlier.isNotEmpty) ...[
            header(fresh.isEmpty ? 'Recent' : 'Earlier'),
            ...earlier.map(_tile),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class ProfilePage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ProfilePage({
    super.key,
    required this.profile,
    required this.posts,
    required this.onRefresh,
  });

  final Map<String, dynamic> profile;
  final List<SocialPost> posts;
  final Future<void> Function() onRefresh;

  @override
  State<ProfilePage> createState() => _ProfilePageState();
}

class EditProfilePage extends StatefulWidget {
  const EditProfilePage({
    super.key,
    required this.profile,
    required this.onSaved,
  });

  final Map<String, dynamic> profile;
  final Future<void> Function() onSaved;

  @override
  State<EditProfilePage> createState() => _EditProfilePageState();
}

class _EditProfilePageState extends State<EditProfilePage> {
  late final TextEditingController display;
  late final TextEditingController username;
  late final TextEditingController bio;
  AssetEntity? photo;
  bool saving = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    display = TextEditingController(
      text: (widget.profile['display_name'] ?? '').toString(),
    );
    username = TextEditingController(
      text: (widget.profile['username'] ?? '').toString(),
    );
    bio = TextEditingController(text: (widget.profile['bio'] ?? '').toString());
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    display.dispose();
    username.dispose();
    bio.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _choosePhoto() async {
    List<AssetEntity> photos;
    try {
      photos = await _loadSelectableMedia(size: 150);
      photos.removeWhere((asset) => asset.type != AssetType.image);
    } catch (error) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Could not open media library: $error')),
        );
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    final picked = await showModalBottomSheet<List<AssetEntity>>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (_) => _MediaPicker(assets: photos),
    );
    if (picked != null && picked.isNotEmpty && mounted) {
      setState(() => photo = picked.first);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    if (saving) return;
    if (display.text.trim().isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
          .showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Enter a display name.')));
      return;
    }
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      await SocialRepository.instance.updateProfile(
        displayName: display.text,
        username: username.text,
        bio: bio.text,
        avatarAsset: photo,
      );
      await widget.onSaved();
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Profile updated successfully')),
        );
        Navigator.of(context).pop();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Could not save profile: $e')));
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  InputDecoration _decoration(String label, IconData icon) => InputDecoration(
    labelText: label,
    prefixIcon: Icon(icon, color: violet),
    filled: true,
    fillColor: Colors.white,
    contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 17),
    border: OutlineInputBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
      borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFE8E8F0)),
    ),
    enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
      borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFE8E8F0)),
    ),
    focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
      borderSide: const BorderSide(color: violet, width: 1.5),
    ),
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final avatar = (widget.profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString();
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: canvas,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        leading: IconButton(
          tooltip: 'Back',
          onPressed: saving ? null : () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
        ),
        title: const Text(
          'Edit Profile',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
        ),
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 22, 22, 24),
                children: [
                  Center(
                    child: Column(
                      children: [
                        Stack(
                          clipBehavior: Clip.none,
                          children: [
                            Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                                color: Colors.white,
                                border: Border.all(
                                  color: const Color(0xFFE5DFFF),
                                  width: 2,
                                ),
                              ),
                              child: ClipOval(
                                child: SizedBox(
                                  width: 112,
                                  height: 112,
                                  child: photo != null
                                      ? FutureBuilder<Uint8List?>(
                                          future: photo!.thumbnailDataWithSize(
                                            const ThumbnailSize(360, 360),
                                          ),
                                          builder: (_, snap) =>
                                              snap.data == null
                                              ? const Center(
                                                  child:
                                                      CircularProgressIndicator(),
                                                )
                                              : Image.memory(
                                                  snap.data!,
                                                  fit: BoxFit.cover,
                                                ),
                                        )
                                      : avatar.isNotEmpty
                                      ? Image(
                                          image: _twiceAvatarProvider(avatar),
                                          fit: BoxFit.cover,
                                          errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => const Icon(
                                            Icons.person_rounded,
                                            size: 54,
                                          ),
                                        )
                                      : const Icon(
                                          Icons.person_rounded,
                                          size: 54,
                                          color: muted,
                                        ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                            Positioned(
                              right: 0,
                              bottom: 0,
                              child: Material(
                                color: violet,
                                shape: const CircleBorder(),
                                child: InkWell(
                                  customBorder: const CircleBorder(),
                                  onTap: _choosePhoto,
                                  child: const Padding(
                                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(10),
                                    child: Icon(
                                      Icons.add_rounded,
                                      color: Colors.white,
                                      size: 22,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        TextButton.icon(
                          onPressed: _choosePhoto,
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.photo_outlined),
                          label: const Text('Change profile photo'),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 24),
                  TextField(
                    controller: display,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                    maxLength: 60,
                    decoration: _decoration(
                      'Display name',
                      Icons.person_outline_rounded,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  TextField(
                    controller: username,
                    autocorrect: false,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.none,
                    decoration: _decoration(
                      '@Username',
                      Icons.alternate_email_rounded,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  TextField(
                    controller: bio,
                    maxLines: 4,
                    maxLength: 160,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                    decoration: _decoration('Bio', Icons.notes_rounded),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 12, 20, 16),
              decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white,
                border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFECECF2))),
              ),
              child: SizedBox(
                width: double.infinity,
                height: 54,
                child: FilledButton(
                  onPressed: saving ? null : _save,
                  style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: violet,
                    foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: saving
                      ? const SizedBox(
                          width: 22,
                          height: 22,
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                            strokeWidth: 2,
                            color: Colors.white,
                          ),
                        )
                      : const Text(
                          'Save Changes',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 16,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          ),
                        ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class FollowListPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const FollowListPage({
    super.key,
    required this.profileId,
    required this.followers,
  });

  final String profileId;
  final bool followers;

  @override
  State<FollowListPage> createState() => _FollowListPageState();
}

class _FollowListPageState extends State<FollowListPage> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> users = [];
  final Set<String> _busyUsers = {};
  bool loading = true;
  String? error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        loading = true;
        error = null;
      });
    }
    try {
      final result = await SocialRepository.instance.followProfiles(
        profileId: widget.profileId,
        followers: widget.followers,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        users = result;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        error = e.toString();
        loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  Widget _followAction(Map<String, dynamic> user) {
    final id = (user['id'] ?? '').toString();
    final connected = user['is_connected'] == true;
    final followingBack = user['is_following_back'] == true;
    final busy = _busyUsers.contains(id);

    final label = connected
        ? 'Connected'
        : followingBack
        ? 'Following'
        : user['follow_request_pending'] == true
        ? 'Requested'
        : 'Follow back';

    return OutlinedButton(
      onPressed: busy || id.isEmpty || connected || followingBack
          ? null
          : () async {
              setState(() => _busyUsers.add(id));
              try {
                final repo = SocialRepository.instance;
                final privateAccount = await repo.isPrivateAccount(id);
                await repo.follow(id, privateAccount: privateAccount);
                if (!mounted) return;
                await _load();
              } catch (e) {
                if (mounted) {
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                    SnackBar(content: Text('Could not follow user: $e')),
                  );
                }
              } finally {
                if (mounted) setState(() => _busyUsers.remove(id));
              }
            },
      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
        foregroundColor: connected ? Colors.green.shade700 : violet,
        side: BorderSide(
          color: connected ? Colors.green.shade300 : const Color(0xFFDCD6FF),
        ),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 9),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13)),
      ),
      child: busy
          ? const SizedBox(
              width: 16,
              height: 16,
              child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: violet),
            )
          : Text(
              label,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
            ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final title = widget.followers ? 'Followers' : 'Following';
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: canvas,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        leading: IconButton(
          tooltip: 'Back',
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
        ),
        title: Text(
          title,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
        ),
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: loading
            ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: violet))
            : error != null
            ? Center(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      const Icon(
                        Icons.cloud_off_rounded,
                        size: 42,
                        color: muted,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      const Text(
                        'Could not load users',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          fontSize: 17,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Text(
                        error!,
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        style: const TextStyle(color: muted),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      FilledButton.icon(
                        onPressed: _load,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded),
                        label: const Text('Try again'),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              )
            : users.isEmpty
            ? Center(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                        color: Color(0xFFEDE9FF),
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      ),
                      child: const Icon(
                        Icons.people_outline_rounded,
                        size: 36,
                        color: violet,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    Text(
                      widget.followers
                          ? 'No followers yet'
                          : 'Not following anyone yet',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 17,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 5),
                    const Text(
                      'People will appear here when available.',
                      style: TextStyle(color: muted),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              )
            : RefreshIndicator(
                color: violet,
                onRefresh: _load,
                child: ListView.separated(
                  physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 24),
                  itemCount: users.length,
                  separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  itemBuilder: (_, index) {
                    final user = users[index];
                    final name = (user['display_name'] ?? '').toString().trim();
                    final username = (user['username'] ?? '').toString().trim();
                    final avatar = (user['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
                    return GestureDetector(
                      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                      onTap: () => _openUserProfile(
                        context,
                        userId: (user['id'] ?? '').toString(),
                        profile: user,
                      ),
                      child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 14,
                        vertical: 12,
                      ),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFECECF2)),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          CircleAvatar(
                            radius: 27,
                            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFEDE9FF),
                            backgroundImage: avatar.isNotEmpty
                                ? _twiceAvatarProvider(avatar)
                                : null,
                            child: avatar.isEmpty
                                ? const Icon(
                                    Icons.person_rounded,
                                    color: violet,
                                    size: 28,
                                  )
                                : null,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 13),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: [
                                Text(
                                  name.isEmpty ? username : name,
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                    fontSize: 15,
                                  ),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(height: 3),
                                Text(
                                  username.isEmpty ? '@user' : '@$username',
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    color: muted,
                                    fontSize: 13,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                          if (widget.followers &&
                              user['is_current_user'] != true) ...[
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            _followAction(user),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ProfilePageState extends State<ProfilePage> {
  bool _accountMenuOpen = false;

  int selectedTab = 0;
  int followersCount = 0;
  int followingCount = 0;
  bool _countsLoading = true;
  List<SocialPost>? _loadedPosts;
  bool _postsLoading = true;
  String? _postsError;

  String get _uid =>
      Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id ??
      (widget.profile['id'] ?? '').toString();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadFollowCounts();
    _loadOwnPosts();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant ProfilePage oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.profile['id'] != widget.profile['id']) {
      _countsLoading = true;
      _loadFollowCounts();
      _loadOwnPosts();
    } else if (!identical(oldWidget.posts, widget.posts)) {
      _loadOwnPosts(silent: true);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadOwnPosts({bool silent = false}) async {
    final id = _uid;
    if (id.isEmpty) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _postsLoading = false);
      return;
    }
    if (!silent && mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _postsLoading = true;
        _postsError = null;
      });
    }
    try {
      final rows = await SocialRepository.instance.userPosts(id);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _loadedPosts = rows.map(SocialPost.new).toList();
        _postsLoading = false;
        _postsError = null;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _postsLoading = false;
        _postsError = _posts.isEmpty ? _searchError(e) : null;
      });
    }
  }

  // Own posts: the complete list when loaded, otherwise the cached feed.
  List<SocialPost> get _posts =>
      _loadedPosts ??
      widget.posts.where((p) => p.data['user_id'] == _uid).toList();

  bool _isPhoto(SocialPost p) => p.media.any((m) {
    final t = (m['media_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
    return t == 'image' || t == 'gif';
  });

  bool _isVideo(SocialPost p) => p.media.any(
    (m) => (m['media_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() == 'video',
  );

  List<SocialPost> get _visiblePosts => selectedTab == 1
      ? _posts.where(_isPhoto).toList()
      : selectedTab == 2
      ? _posts.where(_isVideo).toList()
      : _posts;

  Future<void> _logout() async {
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
        title: const Text('Log out of Twice?'),
        content: const Text(
          'You will be signed out of your account on this device.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFD92D20),
            ),
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
            child: const Text('Log out'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirmed != true || !mounted) return;

    try {
      await Supabase.instance.client.auth.signOut(scope: SignOutScope.local);
      // TwiceAuthGate listens to onAuthStateChange and returns to sign-in.
    } catch (_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('Could not log out. Please try again.')),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadFollowCounts() async {
    final id = (widget.profile['id'] ?? '').toString();
    if (id.isEmpty) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _countsLoading = false);
      return;
    }
    try {
      final db = Supabase.instance.client;
      final values = await Future.wait<List<dynamic>>([
        db
            .from('follows')
            .select('follower_id')
            .eq('following_id', id)
            .eq('status', 'accepted'),
        db
            .from('follows')
            .select('following_id')
            .eq('follower_id', id)
            .eq('status', 'accepted'),
      ]);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        followersCount = values[0].length;
        followingCount = values[1].length;
        _countsLoading = false;
      });
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _countsLoading = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _edit() async {
    await Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => EditProfilePage(
          profile: Map<String, dynamic>.from(widget.profile),
          onSaved: widget.onRefresh,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _shareProfile() async {
    final username = (widget.profile['username'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (username.isEmpty || !mounted) return;

    final profileUrl = 'https://twice.app/@$username';
    final avatarUrl = (widget.profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final displayName = (widget.profile['display_name'] ?? '')
        .toString()
        .trim();
    final brightness = ScreenBrightness();

    try {
      await brightness.setApplicationScreenBrightness(1.0);
      if (!mounted) {
        await brightness.resetApplicationScreenBrightness();
        return;
      }

      await showDialog<void>(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: true,
        builder: (dialogContext) => Dialog(
          insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: 20,
            vertical: 24,
          ),
          backgroundColor: Colors.white,
          elevation: 18,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(32),
          ),
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 24),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Align(
                    alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                    child: IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Close',
                      onPressed: () => Navigator.of(dialogContext).pop(),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded),
                    ),
                  ),
                  Container(
                    width: 76,
                    height: 76,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      border: Border.all(
                        color: const Color(0xFFEAE7FF),
                        width: 3,
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: CircleAvatar(
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF0F2F5),
                      backgroundImage: avatarUrl.isNotEmpty
                          ? _twiceAvatarProvider(avatarUrl)
                          : null,
                      child: avatarUrl.isEmpty
                          ? const Icon(Icons.person_rounded, size: 38)
                          : null,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Text(
                    displayName.isNotEmpty ? displayName : '@$username',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: ink,
                      fontSize: 21,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    '@$username',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: const TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 14),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 22),
                  Center(
                    child: Container(
                      width: 292,
                      height: 292,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26),
                        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFECEAF5)),
                        boxShadow: const [
                          BoxShadow(
                            color: Color(0x12000000),
                            blurRadius: 22,
                            offset: Offset(0, 8),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      child: QrImageView(
                        data: profileUrl,
                        version: QrVersions.auto,
                        size: 272,
                        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
                        errorCorrectionLevel: QrErrorCorrectLevel.H,
                        embeddedImage: avatarUrl.isNotEmpty
                            ? _twiceAvatarProvider(avatarUrl)
                            : null,
                        embeddedImageStyle: const QrEmbeddedImageStyle(
                          size: Size(58, 58),
                        ),
                        embeddedImageEmitsError: true,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 18),
                  const Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        Icons.qr_code_scanner_rounded,
                        size: 18,
                        color: violet,
                      ),
                      SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Flexible(
                        child: Text(
                          'Scan to find this profile on Twice',
                          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: muted,
                            fontSize: 13,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 22),
                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    height: 52,
                    child: FilledButton.icon(
                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: violet,
                        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(17),
                        ),
                      ),
                      onPressed: () async {
                        await Clipboard.setData(
                          ClipboardData(text: profileUrl),
                        );
                        if (dialogContext.mounted) {
                          Navigator.of(dialogContext).pop();
                        }
                        if (mounted) {
                          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                            const SnackBar(
                              content: Text('Profile link copied'),
                            ),
                          );
                        }
                      },
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.copy_rounded),
                      label: const Text(
                        'Copy profile link',
                        style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      await brightness.resetApplicationScreenBrightness();
    }
  }

  void _openFollowList(bool followers) {
    if (_countsLoading) return;
    Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => FollowListPage(
          profileId: (widget.profile['id'] ?? _uid).toString(),
          followers: followers,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _openPost(SocialPost post) async {
    await Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => PostDetailPage(post: post, authorTappable: false),
      ),
    );
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Widget _statCell(String value, String label, {VoidCallback? onTap}) =>
      Expanded(
        child: InkWell(
          onTap: onTap,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
            child: Column(
              children: [
                Text(
                  value,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 19,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                    color: ink,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Text(
                  label,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    color: muted,
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );

  Widget _statDivider() =>
      Container(width: 1, height: 30, color: const Color(0xFFECEAF5));

  Widget _headerCard() {
    final profile = widget.profile;
    final avatar = (profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString();
    final username = (profile['username'] ?? '').toString();
    final displayName = (profile['display_name'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final shownName = displayName.isEmpty ? username : displayName;
    final bio = (profile['bio'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final isPrivate = profile['is_private'] == true;
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 2, 14, 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFEFEDF7)),
        boxShadow: const [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Color(0x0F4B3AA8),
            blurRadius: 22,
            offset: Offset(0, 8),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
      child: Column(
        children: [
          Stack(
            clipBehavior: Clip.none,
            children: [
              Container(
                height: 96,
                decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                    begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                    end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                    colors: [
                      Color(0xFF8E7BFF),
                      Color(0xFF7257F5),
                      Color(0xFFB58CFF),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              Positioned(
                left: 0,
                right: 0,
                bottom: -48,
                child: Center(
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                    decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    ),
                    child: _UserAvatar(url: avatar, name: shownName, size: 96),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 58),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20),
            child: Column(
              children: [
                Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    Flexible(
                      child: Text(
                        shownName.isEmpty ? ' ' : shownName,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 22,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                          color: ink,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (isPrivate) ...[
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      const Icon(Icons.lock_rounded, size: 16, color: muted),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Text(
                  username.isEmpty ? '' : '@$username',
                  style: const TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 14.5),
                ),
                if (bio.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  Text(
                    bio,
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: const TextStyle(color: ink, height: 1.4),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                _statCell(
                  _postsLoading && _posts.isEmpty
                      ? '…'
                      : _compactCount(_posts.length),
                  'Posts',
                ),
                _statDivider(),
                _statCell(
                  _countsLoading ? '…' : _compactCount(followersCount),
                  'Followers',
                  onTap: () => _openFollowList(true),
                ),
                _statDivider(),
                _statCell(
                  _countsLoading ? '…' : _compactCount(followingCount),
                  'Following',
                  onTap: () => _openFollowList(false),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 10, 16, 18),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: SizedBox(
                    height: 46,
                    child: FilledButton.icon(
                      onPressed: _edit,
                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: violet,
                        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
                        ),
                      ),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_rounded, size: 18),
                      label: const Text(
                        'Edit profile',
                        style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: SizedBox(
                    height: 46,
                    child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                      onPressed: _shareProfile,
                      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                        foregroundColor: ink,
                        side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFDAD7E8)),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
                        ),
                      ),

  Widget _tabBar() {
    Widget item(int index, IconData icon, String label) {
      final active = selectedTab == index;
      return Expanded(
        child: InkWell(
          onTap: () => setState(() => selectedTab = index),
          child: Container(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              border: Border(
                bottom: BorderSide(
                  color: active ? violet : Colors.transparent,
                  width: 3,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            child: Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
              children: [
                Icon(icon, size: 20, color: active ? violet : muted),
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                Text(
                  label,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: active ? FontWeight.w900 : FontWeight.w600,
                    color: active ? ink : muted,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Container(
      color: canvas,
      height: 52,
      child: Row(
        children: [
          item(0, Icons.grid_on_rounded, 'Posts'),
          item(1, Icons.photo_outlined, 'Photos'),
          item(2, Icons.play_circle_outline_rounded, 'Videos'),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  List<Widget> _content() {
    final items = _visiblePosts;
    if (_postsLoading && _posts.isEmpty) {
      return [
        SliverPadding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 6, 12, 0),
          sliver: SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: SizedBox(
              height: 330,
              child: _Pulse(
                child: GridView.count(
                  physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                  crossAxisCount: 3,
                  mainAxisSpacing: 4,

                      ),
                    ),
