  }

  Future<bool> myStoryLike(String storyId) async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('story_reactions')
        .select('story_id')
        .eq('story_id', storyId)
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .limit(1)
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
    return (rows as List).isNotEmpty;
  }

  Future<void> setStoryLike(String storyId, bool liked) async {
    if (liked) {
      await _db.from('story_reactions').upsert({
        'story_id': storyId,
        'user_id': userId,
        'reaction': '❤️',
      }, onConflict: 'story_id,user_id', ignoreDuplicates: true);
    } else {
      await _db
          .from('story_reactions')
          .delete()
          .eq('story_id', storyId)
          .eq('user_id', userId);
    }
  }

  /// Sends the reply as a direct message to the story owner.
  Future<void> replyToStory(String ownerId, String text) async {
    final conversationId = await createConversation(ownerId);
    await sendMessage(conversationId, 'Replied to your story: ${text.trim()}');
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> storyViewers(String storyId) async {
    final views = await _db
        .from('story_views')
        .select('viewer_id,viewed_at')
        .eq('story_id', storyId)
        .order('viewed_at', ascending: false)
        .limit(300)
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
    final viewRows = (views as List)
        .map((raw) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map))
        .toList();
    if (viewRows.isEmpty) return [];
    final ids = viewRows.map((v) => v['viewer_id'].toString()).toList();

    final profileRows = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id,username,display_name,avatar_url')
        .inFilter('id', ids)
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
    final reactions = await _db
        .from('story_reactions')
        .select('user_id')
        .eq('story_id', storyId)
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
    final likedBy = {
      for (final r in reactions as List) (r as Map)['user_id'].toString(),
    };

    final profiles = {
      for (final raw in profileRows as List)
        (raw as Map)['id'].toString(): Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw),
    };
    final avatarUrls = await _resolvePaths('post-media', [
      for (final p in profiles.values)
        if (_isStoragePath((p['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim()))
          (p['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
    ]);
    return [
      for (final v in viewRows)
        () {
          final profile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
            profiles[v['viewer_id'].toString()] ?? const {},
          );
          final path = (profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
          if (_isStoragePath(path)) profile['avatar_url'] = avatarUrls[path] ?? '';
          return <String, dynamic>{
            'profile': profile,
            'viewed_at': v['viewed_at'],
            'liked': likedBy.contains(v['viewer_id'].toString()),
          };
        }(),
    ];
  }

  Future<void> publishStory(AssetEntity asset, String caption) async {
    if (asset.type == AssetType.video && asset.duration > 60) {
      throw Exception('Stories can be up to 60 seconds long.');
    }
    final file = await asset.file;
    if (file == null) {
      throw Exception('Could not read the selected story media.');
    }

    final ext = file.path.split('.').last.toLowerCase();
    final storyId = await _db
        .from('stories')
        .insert({
          'user_id': userId,
          'media_url': 'pending',
          'media_type': asset.type == AssetType.video ? 'video' : 'image',
          'caption': caption.trim(),
        })
        .select('id')
        .single();

    final id = storyId['id'].toString();
    final objectPath =
        '$userId/$id/${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}.$ext';

    try {
      await _db.storage
          .from('stories')
          .upload(
            objectPath,
            file,
            fileOptions: FileOptions(contentType: _mime(ext), upsert: false),
          );

      await _db.from('stories').update({'media_url': objectPath}).eq('id', id);
    } catch (_) {
      try {
        await _db.storage.from('stories').remove([objectPath]);
      } catch (_) {}
      try {
        await _db.from('stories').delete().eq('id', id);
      } catch (_) {}
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  String _mime(String ext) => switch (ext) {
    'jpg' => 'image/jpeg',
    'jpeg' => 'image/jpeg',
    'jpe' => 'image/jpeg',
    'png' => 'image/png',
    'webp' => 'image/webp',
    'gif' => 'image/gif',
    'mp4' => 'video/mp4',
    'm4v' => 'video/x-m4v',
    'mov' => 'video/quicktime',
    'webm' => 'video/webm',
    'mkv' => 'video/x-matroska',
    '3gp' => 'video/3gpp',
    'heic' => 'image/heic',
    'heif' => 'image/heif',
    'avif' => 'image/avif',
    _ => 'application/octet-stream',
  };

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> search(String query) async {
    final q = query.trim();
    if (q.isEmpty) return [];
    final safe = q
        .replaceAll('%', r'\%')
        .replaceAll('_', r'\_')
        .replaceAll(',', ' ')
        .replaceAll('(', ' ')
        .replaceAll(')', ' ');
    final results = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    final byUsername = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id,username,display_name,bio,avatar_url,is_private')
        .ilike('username', '%$safe%')
        .limit(20);
    final byName = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id,username,display_name,bio,avatar_url,is_private')
        .ilike('display_name', '%$safe%')
        .limit(20);
    final usersById = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
    for (final row in [...byUsername, ...byName]) {
      final user = Map<String, dynamic>.from(row as Map);
      usersById[user['id'].toString()] = user;
    }
    results.addAll(usersById.values.map((e) => {...e, 'result_type': 'user'}));
    final posts = await _db
        .from('posts')
        .select(
          'id,user_id,caption,created_at,profiles!posts_user_id_fkey(username,display_name,avatar_url)',
        )
        .ilike('caption', '%$safe%')
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .limit(20);
    results.addAll(
      (posts as List).map(
        (e) => {...Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map), 'result_type': 'post'},
      ),
    );
    return results;
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Search & public profiles ─────────────────────────

  static const String _profileColumns =
      'id,username,display_name,bio,avatar_url,is_private';
  static const String _postColumns =
      'id,user_id,caption,visibility,comments_enabled,created_at,'
      'profiles!posts_user_id_fkey(id,username,display_name,avatar_url),'
      'post_media(id,media_url,thumbnail_url,media_type,position),'
      'post_likes(user_id),saved_posts(user_id),comments(count)';

  String _likeSafe(String query) {
    var q = query.trim();
    if (q.startsWith('@')) q = q.substring(1);
    return q
        .replaceAll('%', r'\%')
        .replaceAll('_', r'\_')
        .replaceAll(',', ' ')
        .replaceAll('(', ' ')
        .replaceAll(')', ' ')
        .trim();
  }

  /// Adds follower / following counts, the viewer's follow state and a usable
  /// avatar URL (local cache first, then one batched signing request).
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _decorateProfiles(
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> profiles,
  ) async {
    if (profiles.isEmpty) return profiles;
    final me = userId;
    final ids = profiles.map((p) => p['id'].toString()).toList();

    final values = await Future.wait<List<dynamic>>([
      _db
          .from('follows')
          .select('follower_id,following_id')
          .inFilter('following_id', ids)
          .eq('status', 'accepted'),
      _db
          .from('follows')
          .select('follower_id,following_id')
          .inFilter('follower_id', ids)
          .eq('status', 'accepted'),
      _db
          .from('follows')
          .select('following_id,status')
          .eq('follower_id', me)
          .inFilter('following_id', ids),
      _db
          .from('follows')
          .select('follower_id')
          .eq('following_id', me)
          .eq('status', 'accepted')
          .inFilter('follower_id', ids),
    ]).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 20));

    final followers = <String, int>{};
    for (final row in values[0]) {
      final id = (row as Map)['following_id'].toString();
      followers[id] = (followers[id] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    final following = <String, int>{};
    for (final row in values[1]) {
      final id = (row as Map)['follower_id'].toString();
      following[id] = (following[id] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    final outgoing = <String, String>{};
    for (final row in values[2]) {
      final map = row as Map;
      outgoing[map['following_id'].toString()] = (map['status'] ?? '')
          .toString();
    }
    final followsMe = <String>{
      for (final row in values[3]) (row as Map)['follower_id'].toString(),
    };

    final paths = <String>{};
    for (final p in profiles) {
      final raw = (p['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (_isStoragePath(raw)) paths.add(raw);
    }
    final urls = await _resolvePaths('post-media', paths);

    for (final p in profiles) {
      final id = p['id'].toString();
      final raw = (p['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      final storage = _isStoragePath(raw);
      p['avatar_raw'] = raw;
      p['avatar_object_path'] = storage ? raw : '';
      p['avatar_url'] = storage ? (urls[raw] ?? '') : raw;
      p['followers_count'] = followers[id] ?? 0;
      p['following_count'] = following[id] ?? 0;
      final status = outgoing[id] ?? '';
      p['follow_label'] = id == me
          ? ''
          : status == 'pending'
          ? 'Requested'
          : status == 'accepted'
          ? 'Following'
          : followsMe.contains(id)
          ? 'Follow Back'
          : 'Follow';
    }
    return profiles;
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _asMapList(dynamic value) => value is List
      ? value.whereType<Map>().map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e)).toList()
      : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];

  /// People search by name or @username. Best matches first.
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> searchPeople(
    String query, {
    int limit = 30,
  }) async {
    final safe = _likeSafe(query);
    if (safe.isEmpty) return [];
    final lower = safe.toLowerCase();
    try {
      final responses = await Future.wait<List<dynamic>>([
        _db
            .from('profiles')
            .select(_profileColumns)
            .ilike('username', '%$safe%')
            .limit(limit),
        _db
            .from('profiles')
            .select(_profileColumns)
            .ilike('display_name', '%$safe%')
            .limit(limit),
      ]).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 20));
      final byId = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
      for (final list in responses) {
        for (final row in list) {
          final map = Map<String, dynamic>.from(row as Map);
          byId[map['id'].toString()] = map;
        }
      }
      int rank(Map<String, dynamic> p) {
        final u = (p['username'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
        final n = (p['display_name'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
        if (u == lower || n == lower) return 0;
        if (u.startsWith(lower)) return 1;
        if (n.startsWith(lower)) return 2;
        return 3;
      }

      final sorted = byId.values.toList()
        ..sort((a, b) {
          final r = rank(a).compareTo(rank(b));
          if (r != 0) return r;
          return (a['username'] ?? '').toString().compareTo(
            (b['username'] ?? '').toString(),
          );
        });
      final out = await _decorateProfiles(sorted.take(limit).toList());
      unawaited(
        _cache
            .put(userId, 'search_people', out, id: lower)
            .catchError((Object _) {}),
      );
      return out;
    } catch (e) {
      if (_looksLikeNetworkFailure(e)) {
        final cached = _asMapList(
          await _cache.get(userId, 'search_people', id: lower),
        );
        if (cached.isNotEmpty) return cached;
      }
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// People the viewer may want to follow (newest accounts first).
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> suggestedPeople({int limit = 20}) async {
    try {
      final rows = await _db
          .from('profiles')
          .select(_profileColumns)
          .neq('id', userId)
          .order('created_at', ascending: false)
          .limit(60)
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 20));
      final profiles = _asMapList(rows);
      final decorated = await _decorateProfiles(profiles);
      final out = decorated
          .where(
            (p) =>
                p['follow_label'] != 'Following' &&
                p['follow_label'] != 'Requested',
          )
          .take(limit)
          .toList();
      unawaited(
        _cache
            .put(userId, 'search_suggested', out)
            .catchError((Object _) {}),
      );
      return out;
    } catch (e) {
      if (_looksLikeNetworkFailure(e)) {
        return _asMapList(await _cache.get(userId, 'search_suggested'));
      }
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _rawRecents() async =>
      _asMapList(await _cache.get(userId, 'search_recent'));

  /// Recently opened profiles, resolved to a usable (cached) avatar.
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> recentSearchProfiles() async {
    final list = await _rawRecents();
    final paths = <String>{
      for (final p in list)
        if (_isStoragePath((p['avatar_raw'] ?? '').toString().trim()))
          (p['avatar_raw'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
    };
    final urls = paths.isEmpty
        ? <String, String>{}
        : await _resolvePaths('post-media', paths);
    for (final p in list) {
      final raw = (p['avatar_raw'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      p['avatar_url'] = _isStoragePath(raw) ? (urls[raw] ?? '') : raw;
    }
    return list;
  }

  Future<void> addRecentSearchProfile(Map<String, dynamic> profile) async {
    final id = (profile['id'] ?? '').toString();
    if (id.isEmpty) return;
    final list = await _rawRecents();
    list.removeWhere((p) => p['id'].toString() == id);
    list.insert(0, {
      'id': id,
      'username': profile['username'],
      'display_name': profile['display_name'],
      'avatar_raw': (profile['avatar_raw'] ?? profile['avatar_object_path'] ?? '')
          .toString(),
      'is_private': profile['is_private'] == true,
    });
    await _cache.put(userId, 'search_recent', list.take(12).toList());
  }

  Future<void> removeRecentSearchProfile(String id) async {
    final list = await _rawRecents();
    list.removeWhere((p) => p['id'].toString() == id);
    await _cache.put(userId, 'search_recent', list);
  }

  Future<void> clearRecentSearchProfiles() async =>
      _cache.put(userId, 'search_recent', <Map<String, dynamic>>[]);

  /// Signs media for a batch of post rows and shapes them like feed() rows.
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _hydratePosts(
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> posts,
  ) async {
    final needed = <String>{};
    for (final post in posts) {
      final author = post['profiles'];
      if (author is Map) {
        final path = (author['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        if (_isStoragePath(path)) needed.add(path);
      }
      for (final media in (post['post_media'] as List? ?? const [])) {
        if (media is! Map) continue;
        for (final key in const ['media_url', 'thumbnail_url']) {
          final path = (media[key] ?? '').toString().trim();
          if (_isStoragePath(path)) needed.add(path);
        }
      }
    }
    final urls = await _resolvePaths('post-media', needed);
    String resolve(String path) {
      if (path.isEmpty) return '';
      if (!_isStoragePath(path)) return path;
      return urls[path] ?? '';
    }

    for (final post in posts) {
      final authorRaw = post['profiles'];
      if (authorRaw is Map) {
        final author = Map<String, dynamic>.from(authorRaw);
        final path = (author['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        author['avatar_object_path'] = _isStoragePath(path) ? path : '';
        author['avatar_url'] = resolve(path);
        post['profiles'] = author;
      }
      final media = (post['post_media'] as List? ?? const [])
          .whereType<Map>()
          .map((raw) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw))
          .toList()
        ..sort(
          (a, b) => (int.tryParse('${a['position']}') ?? 0).compareTo(
            int.tryParse('${b['position']}') ?? 0,
          ),
        );
      post['media_resolved'] = media.map((item) {
        item['resolved_url'] = resolve(
          (item['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
        );
        item['resolved_thumbnail_url'] = resolve(
          (item['thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
        );
        return item;
      }).toList();
    }
    return posts;
  }

  static bool _postHasMedia(Map<String, dynamic> post, {required bool video}) {
    for (final m in (post['post_media'] as List? ?? const [])) {
      if (m is! Map) continue;
      final t = (m['media_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
      if (video ? t == 'video' : (t == 'image' || t == 'gif')) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  /// Posts matching [query] (caption). With an empty query this is the explore
  /// feed. [kind] is 'all', 'photos' or 'videos'.
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> searchPosts(
    String query, {
    String kind = 'all',
    int limit = 40,
  }) async {
    final safe = _likeSafe(query);
    var request = _db.from('posts').select(_postColumns);
    if (safe.isNotEmpty) request = request.ilike('caption', '%$safe%');
    final rows = await request
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .limit(kind == 'all' ? limit : 120)
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 25));
    var posts = _asMapList(rows);
    if (kind == 'photos') {
      posts = posts.where((p) => _postHasMedia(p, video: false)).toList();
    } else if (kind == 'videos') {
      posts = posts.where((p) => _postHasMedia(p, video: true)).toList();
    }
    return _hydratePosts(posts.take(limit).toList());
  }

  /// Fresh profile row (avatar resolved) for any user.
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> profileById(String id) async {
    final row = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select(_profileColumns)
        .eq('id', id)
        .maybeSingle()
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
    if (row == null) return null;
    final profile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(row);
    final raw = (profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    profile['avatar_raw'] = raw;
    return _resolveProfileAvatar(profile);
  }

  /// Followers, following and post counts that the viewer is allowed to see.
  Future<Map<String, int>> profileStats(String id) async {
    final values = await Future.wait<List<dynamic>>([
      _db
          .from('follows')
          .select('follower_id')
          .eq('following_id', id)
          .eq('status', 'accepted'),
      _db
          .from('follows')
          .select('following_id')
          .eq('follower_id', id)
          .eq('status', 'accepted'),
      _db.from('posts').select('id').eq('user_id', id),
    ]).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 20));
    return {
      'followers': values[0].length,
      'following': values[1].length,
      'posts': values[2].length,
    };
  }

  /// Every post of [profileId] the viewer is allowed to see (RLS enforced).
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> userPosts(
    String profileId, {
    int limit = 120,
  }) async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('posts')
        .select(_postColumns)
        .eq('user_id', profileId)
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .limit(limit)
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 25));
    return _hydratePosts(_asMapList(rows));
  }

  Future<String> getFollowLabel(String profileId) async {
    if (profileId.isEmpty || profileId == userId) return '';

    final outgoing = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('status')
        .eq('follower_id', userId)
        .eq('following_id', profileId)
        .maybeSingle();

    final incoming = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('status')
        .eq('follower_id', profileId)
        .eq('following_id', userId)
        .maybeSingle();

    final outgoingStatus = (outgoing?['status'] ?? '').toString();
    final incomingStatus = (incoming?['status'] ?? '').toString();

    if (outgoingStatus == 'pending') return 'Requested';
    final followsMe = incomingStatus == 'accepted';
    final iFollow = outgoingStatus == 'accepted';

    if (iFollow && followsMe) return 'Connected';
    if (iFollow) return 'Following';
    if (followsMe) return 'Follow Back';
    return 'Follow';
  }

  Future<bool> isFollowing(String profileId) async =>
      await _db
          .from('follows')
          .select('follower_id')
          .eq('follower_id', userId)
          .eq('following_id', profileId)
          .eq('status', 'accepted')
          .maybeSingle() !=
      null;

  Future<bool> isConnected(String profileId) async {
    final outgoing = await isFollowing(profileId);
    if (!outgoing) return false;
    final incoming = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('follower_id')
        .eq('follower_id', profileId)
        .eq('following_id', userId)
        .eq('status', 'accepted')
        .maybeSingle();
    return incoming != null;
  }

  Future<bool> isPrivateAccount(String profileId) async {
    final row = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('is_private')
        .eq('id', profileId)
        .maybeSingle();
    return row?['is_private'] == true;
  }

  Future<void> follow(String profileId, {required bool privateAccount}) async {
    if (profileId == userId) {
      throw ArgumentError('You cannot follow your own account.');
    }

    final existing = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('follower_id')
        .eq('follower_id', userId)
        .eq('following_id', profileId)
        .maybeSingle();

    if (existing != null) return;

    try {
      await _db.from('follows').insert({
        'follower_id': userId,
        'following_id': profileId,
        'status': privateAccount ? 'pending' : 'accepted',
      });
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      // A concurrent tap may have created the same relationship already.
      if (e.code == '23505') return;
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> unfollow(String profileId) async {
    await _db
        .from('follows')
        .delete()
        .eq('follower_id', userId)
        .eq('following_id', profileId);
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> followProfiles({
    required String profileId,
    required bool followers,
  }) async {
    final relationshipColumn = followers ? 'following_id' : 'follower_id';
    final resultColumn = followers ? 'follower_id' : 'following_id';

    final relations = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select(resultColumn)
        .eq(relationshipColumn, profileId)
        .eq('status', 'accepted');

    final ids = (relations as List)
        .map((row) => (row[resultColumn] ?? '').toString())
        .where((id) => id.isNotEmpty)
        .toSet()
        .toList();

    if (ids.isEmpty) return [];

    final rows = await _db
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id,display_name,username,avatar_url,is_private')
        .inFilter('id', ids)
        .order('display_name');

    final profiles = (rows as List)
        .map((row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row as Map))
        .toList();

    final currentUserId = userId;
    final outgoingRows = await _db
        .from('follows')
        .select('following_id,status')
        .eq('follower_id', currentUserId)
        .inFilter('following_id', ids);
    final outgoingStatus = <String, String>{};
    for (final row in outgoingRows as List) {
      outgoingStatus[(row['following_id'] ?? '').toString()] =
          (row['status'] ?? '').toString();
    }

    for (final profile in profiles) {
      final id = (profile['id'] ?? '').toString();
      final status = outgoingStatus[id];
      profile['is_following_back'] = status == 'accepted';
      profile['follow_request_pending'] = status == 'pending';
      profile['is_connected'] = id.isNotEmpty ? await isConnected(id) : false;
      profile['is_current_user'] = id == currentUserId;
    }

    return Future.wait(profiles.map(_resolveProfileAvatar));
  }

  Future<int> commentCount(String postId) async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('comments')
        .select('id')
        .eq('post_id', postId)
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
    return (rows as List).length;
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> comments(String postId) async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) throw AuthException('Please sign in again.');
    try {
      final rows = await _db
          .from('comments')
          .select(
            'id,post_id,user_id,parent_id,body,created_at,profiles!comments_user_id_fkey(id,username,display_name,avatar_url)',
          )
          .eq('post_id', postId)
          .order('created_at')
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
      final result = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      for (final raw in rows as List) {
        final row = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map);
        final rawProfile = row['profiles'];
        if (rawProfile is Map) {
          final profile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawProfile);
          if (profile.isNotEmpty) {
            row['profiles'] = await _resolveProfileAvatar(profile);
          }
        } else if (rawProfile is List && rawProfile.isNotEmpty) {
          final profile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawProfile.first as Map);
          row['profiles'] = await _resolveProfileAvatar(profile);
        }
        result.add(row);
      }
      await _cache.put(uid, 'comments', result, id: postId);
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      if (_looksLikeNetworkFailure(error)) {
        return cachedComments(postId);
      }
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> cachedComments(String postId) async {
    final value = await _cache.get(userId, 'comments', id: postId);
    if (value is! List) return [];
    return value.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList();
  }

  String _newCommentId() {
    final random = Random.secure();
    final bytes = List<int>.generate(16, (_) => random.nextInt(256));
    bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
    bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
    final hex = bytes.map((b) => b.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0')).join();
    return '${hex.substring(0, 8)}-${hex.substring(8, 12)}-'
        '${hex.substring(12, 16)}-${hex.substring(16, 20)}-${hex.substring(20)}';
  }

  /// Returns true when confirmed by Supabase; false when safely queued offline.
  Future<bool> addComment(
    String postId,
    String body, {
    String? commentId,
  }) async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) throw AuthException('Please sign in again.');
    final text = body.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return true;
    final id = commentId ?? _newCommentId();

    // Use the cached profile for immediate/offline comments. If the profile
    // has not been cached yet, fall back to available auth metadata.
    final cachedProfile = await _cache.get(uid, 'profile');
    final user = _db.auth.currentUser!;
    final metadata = user.userMetadata ?? const <String, dynamic>{};
    final authorProfile = cachedProfile is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(cachedProfile)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    authorProfile['id'] ??= uid;
    authorProfile['username'] ??=
        (metadata['username'] ?? user.email?.split('@').first ?? 'user')
            .toString();
    authorProfile['display_name'] ??=
        (metadata['display_name'] ??
                metadata['name'] ??
                metadata['full_name'] ??
                authorProfile['username'])
            .toString();

    final payload = <String, dynamic>{
      'id': id,
      'post_id': postId,
      'user_id': uid,
      'body': text,
    };
    try {
      await _db
          .from('comments')
          .insert(payload)
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
      final pending = await _cache.pending(uid);
      for (final item in pending) {
        if (item['operation'] == 'add_comment' &&
            item['payload'] is Map &&
            item['payload']['id'] == id) {
          await _cache.removePending(item['id'].toString());
        }
      }
      final cached = await _cache.get(uid, 'comments', id: postId);
      final rows = cached is List
          ? cached.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList()
          : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      if (!rows.any((row) => row['id']?.toString() == id)) {
        rows.add({
          ...payload,
          'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
          'profiles': authorProfile,
        });
        await _cache.put(uid, 'comments', rows, id: postId);
      }
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      if (!_looksLikeNetworkFailure(error)) rethrow;
      await _cache.enqueue(uid, 'add_comment', payload);
      final cached = await _cache.get(uid, 'comments', id: postId);
      final rows = cached is List
          ? cached.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList()
          : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      if (!rows.any((row) => row['id']?.toString() == id)) {
        rows.add({
          ...payload,
          'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
          'profiles': authorProfile,
          '_queued': true,
        });
        await _cache.put(uid, 'comments', rows, id: postId);
      }
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> inbox() async {
    const base =
        'id,type,is_read,created_at,post_id,story_id,'
        'profiles!notifications_actor_id_fkey(id,username,display_name,avatar_url),'
        'posts(caption,post_media(media_url,thumbnail_url,media_type,position)),'
        'comments(body)';
    dynamic rows;
    try {
      rows = await _db
          .from('notifications')
          .select('$base,body')
          .eq('recipient_id', userId)
          .order('created_at', ascending: false)
          .limit(80)
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 20));
    } on PostgrestException {
      // The inbox SQL migration has not been run yet: load without `body`.
      rows = await _db
          .from('notifications')
          .select(base)
          .eq('recipient_id', userId)
          .order('created_at', ascending: false)
          .limit(80)
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 20));
    }
    final list = (rows as List)
        .map((raw) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map))
        .toList();

    String thumbPathOf(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
      final post = row['posts'];
      if (post is! Map) return '';
      final media = (post['post_media'] as List? ?? const [])
          .whereType<Map>()
          .toList();
      if (media.isEmpty) return '';
      media.sort(
        (a, b) => (int.tryParse('${a['position']}') ?? 0).compareTo(
          int.tryParse('${b['position']}') ?? 0,
        ),
      );
      final first = media.first;
      final thumb = (first['thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (_isStoragePath(thumb)) return thumb;
      final isVideo = (first['media_type'] ?? '').toString() == 'video';
      final path = (first['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      return (!isVideo && _isStoragePath(path)) ? path : '';
    }

    final needed = <String>{};
    for (final row in list) {
      final actor = row['profiles'];
      if (actor is Map) {
        final path = (actor['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        if (_isStoragePath(path)) needed.add(path);
      }
      final t = thumbPathOf(row);
      if (t.isNotEmpty) needed.add(t);
    }
    final urls = await _resolvePaths('post-media', needed);

    for (final row in list) {
      final actor = row['profiles'];
      final path = actor is Map
          ? (actor['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim()
          : '';
      row['actor_avatar'] = _isStoragePath(path) ? (urls[path] ?? '') : path;
      final t = thumbPathOf(row);
      row['post_thumb'] = t.isEmpty ? '' : (urls[t] ?? '');
      final comment = row['comments'];
      row['comment_text'] = comment is Map
          ? (comment['body'] ?? '').toString()
          : '';
    }
    return list;
  }

  Future<int> count(String table, String column, String value) async {

  Future<String> createConversation(String otherUserId) async {
    final session = _db.auth.currentSession;
    if (session == null) {
      throw AuthException('Your session has expired. Please sign in again.');
    }

    // Validate the active access token with Supabase before writing.
    final verified = await _db.auth.getUser();
    final verifiedUser = verified.user;
    if (verifiedUser == null) {
      throw AuthException(
        'Could not verify your account. Please sign in again.',
      );
    }
    final uid = verifiedUser.id;

    if (uid != session.user.id) {
      throw AuthException(
        'Authentication identity mismatch. Please sign out and sign in again.',
      );
    }

    if (otherUserId == uid) {
      throw const FormatException('You cannot message yourself.');
    }

    final existing = await _db
        .from('conversation_members')
        .select('conversation_id')
        .eq('user_id', uid);

    for (final row in (existing as List)) {
      final id = row['conversation_id'].toString();
      final other = await _db
          .from('conversation_members')
          .select('user_id')
          .eq('conversation_id', id)
          .eq('user_id', otherUserId)
          .maybeSingle();
      if (other != null) return id;
    }

    final created = await _db
        .from('conversations')
        .insert({'created_by': uid, 'is_group': false})
        .select('id')
        .single();

    final id = created['id'].toString();

    await _db.from('conversation_members').insert([
      {'conversation_id': id, 'user_id': uid},
      {'conversation_id': id, 'user_id': otherUserId},
    ]);

    return id;
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> conversations() async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('conversation_members')
        .select(
          'conversation_id,last_read_at,conversations(id,title,is_group,created_at)',
        )
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .order('joined_at', ascending: false);
    return (rows as List)
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
        .toList();
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> messages(String conversationId) async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('messages')
        .select(
          'id,conversation_id,sender_id,body,media_url,media_type,created_at',
        )
        .eq('conversation_id', conversationId)
        .isFilter('deleted_at', null)
        .order('created_at')
        .limit(200);
    return (rows as List)
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
        .toList();
  }

  Future<void> sendMessage(String conversationId, String body) async {
    if (body.trim().isEmpty) return;
    await _db.from('messages').insert({
      'conversation_id': conversationId,
      'sender_id': userId,
      'body': body.trim(),
    });
  }
}

// ignore_for_file: use_build_context_synchronously
//
// Twice "Videos" tab — Facebook Reels style.
// This file is a `part` of lib/main.dart so it can reuse the app's private
// helpers (_UserAvatar, _timeAgo, _openUserProfile, SocialPost, ...).
part of 'main.dart';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Shared player settings (kept while the app is open)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
final ValueNotifier<bool> _videoMuted = ValueNotifier<bool>(false);
final ValueNotifier<double> _videoSpeed = ValueNotifier<double>(1.0);
final ValueNotifier<bool> _videoAutoNext = ValueNotifier<bool>(false);

const Color _reelHeart = Color(0xFFFF3B5C);
const Color _fbGrey = Color(0xFFF0F2F5);
const List<Shadow> _reelShadow = <Shadow>[
  Shadow(color: Color(0x99000000), blurRadius: 8, offset: Offset(0, 1)),
];

void _videoSnack(BuildContext context, String message) {
  ScaffoldMessenger.maybeOf(context)
    ?..hideCurrentSnackBar()
    ..showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(content: Text(message), behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating),
    );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Data
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _VideoFeedData {
  static SupabaseClient get _db => Supabase.instance.client;

  // post_media!inner + the eq() below = only posts that contain a video.
  static const String _columns =
      'id,user_id,caption,visibility,comments_enabled,created_at,'
      'profiles!posts_user_id_fkey(id,username,display_name,avatar_url),'
      'post_media!inner(id,media_url,thumbnail_url,media_type,position),'
      'post_likes(user_id),saved_posts(user_id),comments(count)';

  static bool _isPath(String v) =>
      v.isNotEmpty &&
      v != 'pending' &&
      !v.startsWith('http://') &&
      !v.startsWith('https://');

  static Future<Map<String, String>> _sign(Set<String> paths) async {
    final result = <String, String>{};
    final list = paths.where((p) => p.isNotEmpty).toList();
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i += 100) {
      final chunk = list.sublist(i, min(i + 100, list.length));
      try {
        final signed = await _db.storage
            .from('post-media')
            // ignore: deprecated_member_use
            .createSignedUrls(chunk, 3600)
            .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
        for (final item in signed) {
          final url = item.signedUrl;
          if (url.contains('token=')) result[item.path.toString()] = url;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('Videos: signing failed: $e');
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> page({
    required int offset,
    int limit = 10,
  }) async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('posts')
        .select(_columns)
        .eq('post_media.media_type', 'video')
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .range(offset, offset + limit - 1)
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 25));

    final posts = (rows as List)
        .map((raw) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map))
        .toList();

    final needed = <String>{};
    for (final post in posts) {
      final author = post['profiles'];
      if (author is Map) {
        final path = (author['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        if (_isPath(path)) needed.add(path);
      }
      for (final media in (post['post_media'] as List? ?? const [])) {
        if (media is! Map) continue;
        for (final key in const ['media_url', 'thumbnail_url']) {
          final path = (media[key] ?? '').toString().trim();
          if (_isPath(path)) needed.add(path);
        }
      }
    }
    final urls = await _sign(needed);
    String resolve(String path) {
      if (path.isEmpty) return '';
      if (!_isPath(path)) return path;
      return urls[path] ?? '';
    }

    for (final post in posts) {
      final authorRaw = post['profiles'];
      if (authorRaw is Map) {
        final author = Map<String, dynamic>.from(authorRaw);
        final path = (author['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        author['avatar_object_path'] = _isPath(path) ? path : '';
        author['avatar_url'] = resolve(path);
        post['profiles'] = author;
      }
      final media = (post['post_media'] as List? ?? const [])
          .whereType<Map>()
          .map((raw) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw))
          .where(
            (m) =>
                (m['media_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() == 'video',
          )
          .toList()
        ..sort(
          (a, b) => (int.tryParse('${a['position']}') ?? 0).compareTo(
            int.tryParse('${b['position']}') ?? 0,
          ),
        );
      post['media_resolved'] = media.map((item) {
        item['resolved_url'] = resolve(
          (item['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
        );
        item['resolved_thumbnail_url'] = resolve(
          (item['thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
        );
        return item;
      }).toList();
    }
    return posts.where((p) => (p['media_resolved'] as List).isNotEmpty).toList();
  }
}

class VideosPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const VideosPage({
    super.key,
    required this.active,
    required this.profile,
    required this.onCreate,
  });

  final bool active;
  final Map<String, dynamic> profile;
  final VoidCallback onCreate;

  @override
  State<VideosPage> createState() => _VideosPageState();
}

class _VideosPageState extends State<VideosPage> with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  static const int _pageSize = 10;

  final PageController _pager = PageController();
  final List<SocialPost> _posts = <SocialPost>[];
  bool _started = false;
  bool _loading = false;
  bool _loadingMore = false;
  bool _hasMore = true;
  bool _appResumed = true;
  String? _error;
  int _index = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    if (widget.active) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (mounted) _ensureStarted();
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant VideosPage oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.active && !oldWidget.active) _ensureStarted();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final resumed = state == AppLifecycleState.resumed;
    if (resumed != _appResumed) setState(() => _appResumed = resumed);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    _pager.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _ensureStarted() {
    if (_started) return;
    _started = true;
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final rows = await _VideoFeedData.page(offset: 0, limit: _pageSize);
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (_pager.hasClients) _pager.jumpToPage(0);
      setState(() {
        _posts
          ..clear()
          ..addAll(rows.map(SocialPost.new));
        _index = 0;
        _hasMore = rows.length >= _pageSize;
        _loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _loading = false;
        _error = e.toString();
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadMore() async {
    if (_loadingMore || !_hasMore || _loading) return;
    _loadingMore = true;
    try {
      final rows = await _VideoFeedData.page(
        offset: _posts.length,
        limit: _pageSize,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      final known = _posts.map((p) => p.id).toSet();
      setState(() {
        for (final row in rows) {
          final post = SocialPost(row);
          if (known.add(post.id)) _posts.add(post);
        }
        _hasMore = rows.length >= _pageSize;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Videos: load more failed: $e');
    } finally {
      _loadingMore = false;
    }
  }

  void _onPage(int i) {
    setState(() => _index = i);
    if (i >= _posts.length - 3) _loadMore();
  }

  bool _next() {
    if (!_pager.hasClients || _index >= _posts.length - 1) return false;
    _pager.nextPage(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 320),
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
    );
    return true;
  }

  void _openSearch() {
    Navigator.of(context).push<void>(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Search')),
          body: const SearchPage(),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final top = MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).top;
    final Widget body;
    if (_loading && _posts.isEmpty) {
      body = const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: Colors.white));
    } else if (_error != null && _posts.isEmpty) {
      body = _VideosMessage(
        icon: Icons.wifi_off_rounded,
        title: 'Couldn’t load videos',
        subtitle: _error!,
        actionLabel: 'Try again',
        onAction: _load,
      );
    } else if (_posts.isEmpty) {
      body = _VideosMessage(
        icon: Icons.video_library_outlined,
        title: 'No videos yet',
        subtitle: 'Videos that people post on Twice will show up here.',
        actionLabel: 'Create a video',
        onAction: widget.onCreate,
      );
    } else {
      body = PageView.builder(
        scrollDirection: Axis.vertical,
        controller: _pager,
        itemCount: _posts.length,
        onPageChanged: _onPage,
        itemBuilder: (context, i) => _VideoReel(
          key: ValueKey<String>(_posts[i].id),
          post: _posts[i],
          myProfile: widget.profile,
          topInset: top,
          playing: widget.active && _appResumed && i == _index,
          preload: i == _index || (widget.active && (i - _index).abs() <= 1),
          onNext: _next,
        ),
      );
    }

    return AnnotatedRegion<SystemUiOverlayStyle>(
      value: SystemUiOverlayStyle.light,
      child: ColoredBox(
        color: Colors.black,
        child: Stack(
          children: [
            Positioned.fill(child: body),
            Positioned(
              top: 0,
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              child: Container(
                padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, top + 6, 6, 14),
                decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                    begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                    end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                    colors: [Color(0x99000000), Color(0x00000000)],
                  ),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    const Text(
                      'Videos',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        fontSize: 24,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                        shadows: _reelShadow,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const Spacer(),
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Create',
                      onPressed: widget.onCreate,
                      icon: const Icon(
                        Icons.add_circle_outline_rounded,
                        color: Colors.white,
                        shadows: _reelShadow,
                      ),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Search',
                      onPressed: _openSearch,
                      icon: const Icon(
                        Icons.search_rounded,
                        color: Colors.white,
                        shadows: _reelShadow,
                      ),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Video settings',
                      onPressed: () =>
                          _showVideoSettings(context, onRefresh: _load),
                      icon: const Icon(
                        Icons.more_horiz_rounded,
                        color: Colors.white,
                        shadows: _reelShadow,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

Future<void> _showVideoSettings(
  BuildContext context, {
  VoidCallback? onRefresh,
}) {
  const speeds = <double>[0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 2.0];
  String label(double s) => s == s.roundToDouble() ? '${s.toInt()}x' : '${s}x';
  return showModalBottomSheet<void>(
    context: context,
    backgroundColor: Colors.white,
    shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(22)),
    ),
    builder: (sheetContext) => SafeArea(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 12),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Center(
              child: Container(
                width: 38,
                height: 4,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.black26,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            const Text(
              'Video settings',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            const Text(
              'Playback speed',
              style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: muted),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            ValueListenableBuilder<double>(
              valueListenable: _videoSpeed,
              builder: (context, current, child) => Wrap(
                spacing: 8,
                runSpacing: 4,
                children: [
                  for (final s in speeds)
                    ChoiceChip(
                      label: Text(label(s)),
                      selected: current == s,
                      selectedColor: const Color(0xFFECE7FF),
                      onSelected: (_) => _videoSpeed.value = s,
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            ValueListenableBuilder<bool>(
              valueListenable: _videoMuted,
              builder: (context, muted, child) => SwitchListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                title: const Text('Sound on'),
                value: !muted,
                onChanged: (on) => _videoMuted.value = !on,
              ),
            ),
            ValueListenableBuilder<bool>(
              valueListenable: _videoAutoNext,
              builder: (context, auto, child) => SwitchListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                title: const Text('Auto-scroll to next video'),
                subtitle: const Text('Move on when a video finishes'),
                value: auto,
                onChanged: (v) => _videoAutoNext.value = v,
              ),
            ),
            if (onRefresh != null)
              ListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                leading: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded),
                title: const Text('Refresh videos'),
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                  onRefresh();
                },
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// One reel (full page)

class _Burst {
  _Burst(this.id, this.pos);
  final int id;
  final Offset pos;
}

class _VideoReel extends StatefulWidget {
  const _VideoReel({
    super.key,
    required this.post,
    required this.myProfile,
    required this.topInset,
    required this.playing,
    required this.preload,
    required this.onNext,
  });

  final SocialPost post;
  final Map<String, dynamic> myProfile;
  final double topInset;
  final bool playing;
  final bool preload;
  final bool Function() onNext;

  @override
  State<_VideoReel> createState() => _VideoReelState();
}

class _VideoReelState extends State<_VideoReel> {
  VideoPlayerController? _c;
  String _source = '';
  bool _initializing = false;
  bool _failed = false;
  bool _hasFrame = false;
  bool _userPaused = false;
  bool _routePaused = false;
  bool _boost = false;
  bool _advanced = false;
  bool _likePop = false;
  bool _showPauseIcon = false;
  double? _scrubValue;
  Timer? _iconTimer;
  Offset _tapPos = Offset.zero;
  int _burstSeq = 0;
  final List<_Burst> _bursts = <_Burst>[];

  Map<String, dynamic> get _video => widget.post.media.isEmpty
      ? <String, dynamic>{}
      : widget.post.media.first;
  String? _urlOverride; // fresh signed URL after a refresh
  String get _url =>
      _urlOverride ?? (_video['resolved_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
  String get _thumb => (_video['resolved_thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
  String get _authorId =>
      (widget.post.data['user_id'] ?? widget.post.author['id'] ?? '')
          .toString();
  String? get _myId => Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _videoMuted.addListener(_applyVolume);
    _videoSpeed.addListener(_applySpeed);
    _videoAutoNext.addListener(_applyLoop);
    if (widget.preload) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (mounted) _ensureController();
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant _VideoReel oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.playing && !widget.playing) _userPaused = false;
    if (widget.preload && _c == null && !_failed) {
      _ensureController();
    } else if (!widget.preload && _c != null) {
      _release();
    }
    _sync();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _videoMuted.removeListener(_applyVolume);
    _videoSpeed.removeListener(_applySpeed);
    _videoAutoNext.removeListener(_applyLoop);
    _iconTimer?.cancel();
    final c = _c;
    _c = null;
    c?.removeListener(_onTick);
    c?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // ---- player ------------------------------------------------------------
  Future<void> _ensureController({bool allowRefresh = true}) async {
    if (_c != null || _initializing) return;
    if (_url.isEmpty) {
      if (allowRefresh && await _refreshUrl()) return;
      if (mounted) setState(() => _failed = true);
      return;
    }
    _initializing = true;
    if (mounted) setState(() {});

    var source = _url;
    if (source.startsWith('http')) {
      final local = await TwiceMedia.cachedFileUri(source);
      if (local != null) source = local;
    }
    if (!mounted) return;

    final controller = source.startsWith('file://')
        ? VideoPlayerController.file(File.fromUri(Uri.parse(source)))
        : VideoPlayerController.networkUrl(Uri.parse(source));
    _c = controller;
    _source = source;
    controller.addListener(_onTick);
    try {
      await controller.initialize();
      await controller.setLooping(!_videoAutoNext.value);
      await controller.setVolume(_videoMuted.value ? 0 : 1);
      await controller.setPlaybackSpeed(_videoSpeed.value);
      if (!mounted || !identical(_c, controller)) {
        controller.removeListener(_onTick);
        await controller.dispose();
        return;
      }
      _initializing = false;
      setState(() {});
      _sync();
    } catch (_) {
      controller.removeListener(_onTick);
      await controller.dispose();
      if (identical(_c, controller)) _c = null;
      _initializing = false;
      if (allowRefresh && await _refreshUrl()) return;
      if (mounted) setState(() => _failed = true);
    } finally {
      _initializing = false;
    }
  }

  Future<bool> _refreshUrl() async {
    final path = (_video['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (path.isEmpty || path.startsWith('http')) return false;
    try {
      final fresh = await SocialRepository.instance.refreshMediaUrl(
        path,
        bucket: 'post-media',
      );
      if (fresh == null || fresh.isEmpty || !mounted) return false;
      _urlOverride = fresh;
      setState(() => _failed = false);
      await _ensureController(allowRefresh: false);
      return _c != null && _c!.value.isInitialized;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  void _release() {
    final c = _c;
    if (c == null) return;
    _c = null;
    _hasFrame = false;
    c.removeListener(_onTick);
    c.pause();
    c.dispose();
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  void _onTick() {
    final c = _c;
    if (!mounted || c == null) return;
    final v = c.value;
    if (!_hasFrame && v.isInitialized && v.position > Duration.zero) {
      setState(() => _hasFrame = true);
    }
    if (_videoAutoNext.value && v.isInitialized && v.duration > Duration.zero) {
      final nearEnd = v.position >= v.duration - const Duration(milliseconds: 250);
      if (nearEnd && !_advanced && widget.playing) {
        _advanced = true;
        if (!widget.onNext()) {
          c.seekTo(Duration.zero);
          c.play();
        }
      } else if (!nearEnd && v.position < v.duration - const Duration(seconds: 1)) {
        _advanced = false;
      }
    }
  }

  void _sync() {
    final c = _c;
    if (c == null || !c.value.isInitialized) return;
    final shouldPlay = widget.playing && !_userPaused && !_routePaused;
    if (shouldPlay) {
      if (!c.value.isPlaying) {
        c.play();
        if (_source.startsWith('http')) {
          unawaited(TwiceMedia.cacheVideo(_source));
        }
      }
    } else if (c.value.isPlaying) {
      c.pause();
    }
  }

  void _applyVolume() => _c?.setVolume(_videoMuted.value ? 0 : 1);
  void _applySpeed() {
    if (!_boost) _c?.setPlaybackSpeed(_videoSpeed.value);
  }

  void _applyLoop() {
    _advanced = false;
    _c?.setLooping(!_videoAutoNext.value);
  }

  // ---- gestures ----------------------------------------------------------
  void _togglePause() {
    final c = _c;
    if (c == null || !c.value.isInitialized) return;
    setState(() {
      _userPaused = !_userPaused;
      _showPauseIcon = true;
    });
    _sync();
    _iconTimer?.cancel();
    _iconTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 700), () {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _showPauseIcon = false);
    });
  }

  void _doubleTapLike() {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    final id = ++_burstSeq;
    setState(() => _bursts.add(_Burst(id, _tapPos)));
    Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 800), () {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _bursts.removeWhere((b) => b.id == id));
    });
    _setLiked(true);
  }

  void _startBoost() {
    final c = _c;
    if (c == null || !c.value.isInitialized || _userPaused) return;
    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    setState(() => _boost = true);
    c.setPlaybackSpeed(2.0);
  }

  void _endBoost() {
    if (!_boost) return;
    setState(() => _boost = false);
    _c?.setPlaybackSpeed(_videoSpeed.value);
  }

  void _scrubStart(double fraction) => setState(() => _scrubValue = fraction);
  void _scrubUpdate(double fraction) {
    if (_scrubValue != null) setState(() => _scrubValue = fraction);
  }

  void _scrubEnd() {
    final value = _scrubValue;
    final c = _c;
    if (value != null && c != null && c.value.isInitialized) {
      c.seekTo(
        Duration(milliseconds: (c.value.duration.inMilliseconds * value).round()),
      );
    }
    if (mounted) setState(() => _scrubValue = null);
  }

  // ---- actions -----------------------------------------------------------
  Future<void> _setLiked(bool like) async {
    final post = widget.post;
    final uid = _myId;
    if (uid == null || post.liked == like) return;
    final wasLiked = post.liked;
    setState(() {
      final rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
        post.data['post_likes'] as List? ?? const [],
      );
      if (wasLiked) {
        rows.removeWhere((e) => e['user_id'] == uid);
      } else {
        rows.add(<String, dynamic>{'user_id': uid});
      }
      post.data['post_likes'] = rows;
      _likePop = true;
    });
    Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 180), () {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _likePop = false);
    });
    try {
      await SocialRepository.instance.toggleLike(post.id, wasLiked);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        final rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
          post.data['post_likes'] as List? ?? const [],
        );
        rows.removeWhere((row) => row['user_id'] == uid);
        if (wasLiked) rows.add(<String, dynamic>{'user_id': uid});
        post.data['post_likes'] = rows;
      });
      _videoSnack(context, 'Like could not sync: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _toggleSave() async {
    final post = widget.post;
    final uid = _myId;
    if (uid == null) return;
    final was = post.saved;
    setState(() {
      post.data['saved_posts'] = was
          ? <Map<String, dynamic>>[]
          : <Map<String, dynamic>>[
              <String, dynamic>{'user_id': uid},
            ];
    });
    try {
      await SocialRepository.instance.toggleSaved(post.id, was);
      if (mounted) {
        _videoSnack(context, was ? 'Removed from saved' : 'Video saved');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        post.data['saved_posts'] = was
            ? <Map<String, dynamic>>[
                <String, dynamic>{'user_id': uid},
              ]
            : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      });
      _videoSnack(context, 'Could not update saved: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _share() async {
    final p = widget.post;
    final text = StringBuffer('${p.name} (@${p.username}) on Twice');
    if (p.caption.trim().isNotEmpty) text.write(': ${p.caption.trim()}');
    try {
      await SharePlus.instance.share(ShareParams(text: text.toString()));
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) _videoSnack(context, 'Could not share: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openComments({bool focus = false}) async {
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => _VideoCommentsSheet(
        post: widget.post,
        myProfile: widget.myProfile,
        autofocus: focus,
        onCountChanged: (n) {
          if (!mounted) return;
          setState(() {
            widget.post.data['comments'] = <Map<String, dynamic>>[
              <String, dynamic>{'count': n},
            ];
          });
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _openProfile() async {
    if (_authorId.isEmpty) return;
    setState(() => _routePaused = true);
    _sync();
    await _openUserProfile(
      context,
      userId: _authorId,
      profile: Map<String, dynamic>.from(widget.post.author),
    );
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _routePaused = false);
    _sync();
  }

  void _openMore() {
    final post = widget.post;
    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.white,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(22)),
      ),
      builder: (sheetContext) => SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Container(
              width: 38,
              height: 4,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.black26,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            ListTile(
              leading: Icon(
                post.saved
                    ? Icons.bookmark_rounded
                    : Icons.bookmark_border_rounded,
              ),
              title: Text(post.saved ? 'Remove from saved' : 'Save video'),
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                _toggleSave();
              },
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.ios_share_rounded),
              title: const Text('Share'),
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                _share();
              },
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.person_outline_rounded),
              title: Text('View ${post.name}’s profile'),
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                _openProfile();
              },
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.speed_rounded),
              title: const Text('Playback speed & settings'),
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                _showVideoSettings(context);
              },
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ---- UI ----------------------------------------------------------------
  Widget _videoLayer() {
    final c = _c;
    final poster = TwiceVideoPoster(
      videoUrl: _url,
      thumbnailUrl: _thumb,
      imageProviderFor: _twiceImageProvider,
      fit: BoxFit.contain,
      showPlayIcon: false,
    );
    return Stack(
      fit: StackFit.expand,
      children: [
        if (!(_hasFrame && c != null)) poster,
        if (c != null && c.value.isInitialized)
          AnimatedOpacity(
            opacity: _hasFrame ? 1 : 0,
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
            child: Builder(
              builder: (context) {
                final size = c.value.size;
                final ratio = size.height <= 0 ? 1.0 : size.width / size.height;
                return FittedBox(
                  fit: ratio < 0.85 ? BoxFit.cover : BoxFit.contain,
                  clipBehavior: Clip.hardEdge,
                  child: SizedBox(
                    width: size.width,
                    height: size.height,
                    child: VideoPlayer(c),
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _railButton({

              scale: pop ? 1.3 : 1,
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 150),

              Text(
                label,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white,

                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  shadows: _reelShadow,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );

  Widget _rail() {
    final post = widget.post;
    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [

        ),

          icon: Icons.mode_comment_outlined,

              ? ''

              ? Icons.bookmark_rounded

        ),
        _railButton(
          icon: Icons.more_horiz_rounded,
          label: '',
          onTap: _openMore,
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _info() {

    final visibility = (post.data['visibility'] ?? 'public').toString();
    final visIcon = visibility == 'public'
        ? Icons.public_rounded
        : visibility == 'followers'
        ? Icons.group_rounded
        : Icons.lock_rounded;
    final time = _timeAgo(post.data['created_at']);
    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            GestureDetector(
              onTap: _openProfile,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(1.5),
                decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                ),
                child: _UserAvatar(
                  url: post.avatarUrl ?? '',
                  name: post.name,
                  size: 38,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(
              child: GestureDetector(
                behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                onTap: _openProfile,
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      post.name,
                      maxLines: 1,

                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,

  Widget _commentBand() {
    final me = widget.myProfile;
    final myName = (me['display_name'] ?? me['username'] ?? 'You').toString();
    final disabled = widget.post.data['comments_enabled'] == false;
    return Container(
      color: Colors.black,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 8, 12, 10),
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: disabled ? null : () => _openComments(focus: true),
        child: Container(
          height: 42,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
            border: Border.all(color: Colors.white54),
          ),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  disabled ? 'Comments are turned off' : 'Add a comment as $myName',
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 15),
                ),
              ),
              if (!disabled) ...const [
                Icon(Icons.alternate_email_rounded, size: 20, color: Colors.white70),
                SizedBox(width: 12),
                Icon(Icons.sentiment_satisfied_alt_rounded, size: 21, color: Colors.white70),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = _c;
    final buffering =
        _initializing || (c != null && c.value.isInitialized && c.value.isBuffering);
    final scrub = _scrubValue;

    final stage = LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, box) => Stack(
        fit: StackFit.expand,
        children: [
          _videoLayer(),
          // Gesture layer: tap = play/pause, double tap = heart,
          // long press = 2x, horizontal drag = seek.
          Positioned.fill(
            child: GestureDetector(
              behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
              onTap: _togglePause,
              onDoubleTapDown: (d) => _tapPos = d.localPosition,
              onDoubleTap: _doubleTapLike,
              onLongPressStart: (_) => _startBoost(),
              onLongPressEnd: (_) => _endBoost(),
              onLongPressCancel: _endBoost,
              onHorizontalDragStart: (d) {
                final cc = _c;
                if (cc == null || !cc.value.isInitialized) return;
                final total = cc.value.duration.inMilliseconds;
                _scrubStart(
                  total <= 0
                      ? 0
                      : (cc.value.position.inMilliseconds / total).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                );
              },
              onHorizontalDragUpdate: (d) {
                final current = _scrubValue;
                if (current == null) return;
                _scrubUpdate(
                  (current + d.delta.dx / max(box.maxWidth * 0.9, 1)).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                );
              },
              onHorizontalDragEnd: (_) => _scrubEnd(),
              onHorizontalDragCancel: _scrubEnd,
              child: const SizedBox.expand(),
            ),
          ),
          const IgnorePointer(
            child: Align(
              alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
              child: SizedBox(
                height: 280,
                width: double.infinity,
                child: DecoratedBox(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    gradient: LinearGradient(
                      begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                      end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                      colors: [Color(0x00000000), Color(0xB3000000)],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          if (buffering)
            const IgnorePointer(
              child: Center(
                child: SizedBox(
                  width: 34,
                  height: 34,
                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                    strokeWidth: 3,
                    color: Colors.white,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (_failed)
            Center(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  const Icon(Icons.error_outline_rounded, color: Colors.white70, size: 44),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  const Text(
                    'Couldn’t play this video',
                    style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  OutlinedButton(
                    onPressed: () {
                      setState(() => _failed = false);
                      _ensureController();
                    },
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                      foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                      side: const BorderSide(color: Colors.white54),
                    ),
                    child: const Text('Retry'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          IgnorePointer(
            child: Center(
              child: AnimatedOpacity(
                opacity: _showPauseIcon ? 1 : 0,
                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                    color: Color(0x66000000),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),
                  child: Icon(
                    _userPaused ? Icons.pause_rounded : Icons.play_arrow_rounded,
                    color: Colors.white,
                    size: 44,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          if (_boost)
            Positioned(
              top: widget.topInset + 62,
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              child: const IgnorePointer(
                child: Center(child: _SpeedChip()),
              ),
            ),
          if (scrub != null && c != null && c.value.isInitialized)
            Positioned(
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              bottom: 150,
              child: IgnorePointer(
                child: Center(
                  child: Text(
                    '${_formatClock((c.value.duration.inSeconds * scrub).round())}'
                    '  /  ${_formatClock(c.value.duration.inSeconds)}',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      fontSize: 22,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      shadows: _reelShadow,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          // Mute toggle
          Positioned(
            right: 12,
            top: widget.topInset + 62,
            child: ValueListenableBuilder<bool>(
              valueListenable: _videoMuted,
              builder: (context, muted, child) => GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => _videoMuted.value = !muted,
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                    color: Color(0x66000000),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),
                  child: Icon(
                    muted ? Icons.volume_off_rounded : Icons.volume_up_rounded,
                    color: Colors.white,
                    size: 20,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          for (final b in _bursts)
            Positioned(
              key: ValueKey<int>(b.id),
              left: b.pos.dx - 48,
              top: b.pos.dy - 48,
              child: IgnorePointer(
                child: TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
                  tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0, end: 1),
                  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 750),
                  builder: (context, t, child) {
                    final scale = t < 0.3 ? 0.4 + (t / 0.3) * 0.9 : 1.3 - (t - 0.3) * 0.3;
                    final opacity = t < 0.6 ? 1.0 : (1 - (t - 0.6) / 0.4);
                    return Opacity(
                      opacity: opacity.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                      child: Transform.scale(scale: scale, child: child),
                    );
                  },
                  child: const Icon(
                    Icons.favorite_rounded,
                    size: 96,
                    color: _reelHeart,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          Positioned(left: 12, right: 76, bottom: 30, child: _info()),
          Positioned(right: 6, bottom: 24, child: _rail()),
          Positioned(
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            child: _ReelProgress(
              controller: c,
              scrubValue: scrub,
              onScrubStart: _scrubStart,
              onScrubUpdate: _scrubUpdate,
              onScrubEnd: _scrubEnd,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    return ColoredBox(
      color: Colors.black,
      child: Column(
        children: [
          Expanded(child: stage),
          _commentBand(),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
