// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Progress / seek bar
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _ReelProgress extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ReelProgress({
    required this.controller,
    required this.scrubValue,
    required this.onScrubStart,
    required this.onScrubUpdate,
    required this.onScrubEnd,
  });

  final VideoPlayerController? controller;
  final double? scrubValue;
  final ValueChanged<double> onScrubStart;
  final ValueChanged<double> onScrubUpdate;
  final VoidCallback onScrubEnd;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = controller;
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, box) {
        final width = box.maxWidth;
        double frac(double dx) =>
            width <= 0 ? 0.0 : (dx / width).clamp(0.0, 1.0);

        Widget track(double f) {
          final scrubbing = scrubValue != null;
          final h = scrubbing ? 5.0 : 2.5;
          return SizedBox(
            height: h,
            width: width,
            child: Stack(
              clipBehavior: Clip.none,
              children: [
                Container(color: Colors.white24),
                FractionallySizedBox(
                  widthFactor: f.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                  alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                  child: Container(color: Colors.white),
                ),
                if (scrubbing)
                  Positioned(
                    left: (width * f - 6).clamp(0.0, max(width - 12, 0.0)),
                    top: -3.5,
                    child: Container(
                      width: 12,
                      height: 12,
                      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        }

        return GestureDetector(
          behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
          onTapUp: (d) {
            onScrubStart(frac(d.localPosition.dx));
            onScrubEnd();
          },
          onHorizontalDragStart: (d) => onScrubStart(frac(d.localPosition.dx)),
          onHorizontalDragUpdate: (d) => onScrubUpdate(frac(d.localPosition.dx)),
          onHorizontalDragEnd: (_) => onScrubEnd(),
          onHorizontalDragCancel: onScrubEnd,
          child: SizedBox(
            height: 22,
            child: Align(
              alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
              child: c == null
                  ? track(0)
                  : ValueListenableBuilder<VideoPlayerValue>(
                      valueListenable: c,
                      builder: (context, value, child) {
                        final total = value.duration.inMilliseconds;
                        final played = total <= 0
                            ? 0.0
                            : (value.position.inMilliseconds / total).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                        return track(scrubValue ?? played);
                      },
                    ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Caption with "… more"
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _ReelCaption extends StatefulWidget {
  const _ReelCaption({required this.text});
  final String text;

  @override
  State<_ReelCaption> createState() => _ReelCaptionState();
}

class _ReelCaptionState extends State<_ReelCaption> {
  bool _expanded = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const style = TextStyle(
      color: Colors.white,
      fontSize: 14,
      height: 1.3,
      shadows: _reelShadow,
    );
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, box) {
        final painter = TextPainter(
          text: TextSpan(text: widget.text, style: style),
          maxLines: 2,
          textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
        )..layout(maxWidth: box.maxWidth);
        final overflows = painter.didExceedMaxLines;
        if (_expanded) {
          return GestureDetector(
            onTap: () => setState(() => _expanded = false),
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxHeight: 170),
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                child: Text(widget.text, style: style),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }
        return GestureDetector(
          onTap: overflows ? () => setState(() => _expanded = true) : null,
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(
                widget.text,
                maxLines: 2,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: style,
              ),
              if (overflows)
                const Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 2),
                  child: Text(
                    'more',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      fontSize: 14,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      shadows: _reelShadow,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Follow button (Facebook reel style: outlined white pill)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _ReelFollowButton extends StatefulWidget {
  const _ReelFollowButton({required this.profileId});
  final String profileId;

  @override
  State<_ReelFollowButton> createState() => _ReelFollowButtonState();
}

class _ReelFollowButtonState extends State<_ReelFollowButton> {
  String _label = '';
  bool _loading = true;
  bool _busy = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    try {
      final label = await SocialRepository.instance.getFollowLabel(
        widget.profileId,
      );
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _label = label;
          _loading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _label = '';
          _loading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _tap() async {
    if (_busy || _label.isEmpty) return;
    final previous = _label;
    final repo = SocialRepository.instance;
    setState(() => _busy = true);
    try {
      if (previous == 'Following' ||
          previous == 'Connected' ||
          previous == 'Requested') {
        setState(() => _label = 'Follow');
        await repo.unfollow(widget.profileId);
      } else {
        final isPrivate = await repo.isPrivateAccount(widget.profileId);
        setState(() => _label = isPrivate ? 'Requested' : 'Following');
        await repo.follow(widget.profileId, privateAccount: isPrivate);
      }
      await _load();
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _label = previous);
        _videoSnack(context, 'Could not update follow: $e');
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_loading || _label.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final active = _label == 'Following' || _label == 'Connected';
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 8),
      child: SizedBox(
        height: 30,
        child: OutlinedButton(
          onPressed: _busy ? null : _tap,
          style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
            foregroundColor: Colors.white,
            disabledForegroundColor: Colors.white54,
            side: BorderSide(color: active ? Colors.white38 : Colors.white),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
            minimumSize: const Size(0, 30),
            tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
          ),
          child: Text(
            _label,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
              color: active ? Colors.white70 : Colors.white,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Comments sheet: Facebook look, heart reactions, replies
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _VideoCommentsSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const _VideoCommentsSheet({
    required this.post,
    required this.myProfile,
    required this.onCountChanged,
    this.autofocus = false,
  });

  final SocialPost post;
  final Map<String, dynamic> myProfile;
  final ValueChanged<int> onCountChanged;
  final bool autofocus;

  @override
  State<_VideoCommentsSheet> createState() => _VideoCommentsSheetState();
}

class _VideoCommentsSheetState extends State<_VideoCommentsSheet> {
  final TextEditingController _input = TextEditingController();
  final FocusNode _focus = FocusNode();
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  final Map<String, int> _likeCounts = <String, int>{};
  final Set<String> _myLikes = <String>{};
  final Set<String> _expanded = <String>{};
  bool _loading = true;
  bool _newestFirst = false;
  bool _sending = false;
  String? _error;
  Map<String, dynamic>? _replyTo; // top-level comment being replied to
  String _replyName = '';

  SupabaseClient get _db => Supabase.instance.client;
  String? get _uid => _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
  bool get _commentsOff => widget.post.data['comments_enabled'] == false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
    if (widget.autofocus && !_commentsOff) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (mounted) _focus.requestFocus();
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _input.dispose();
    _focus.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final data = await SocialRepository.instance.comments(widget.post.id);
      final likeCounts = <String, int>{};
      final mine = <String>{};
      final ids = data.map((r) => r['id'].toString()).toList();
      for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i += 50) {
        final chunk = ids.sublist(i, min(i + 50, ids.length));
        try {
          final likes = await _db
              .from('comment_likes')
              .select('comment_id,user_id')
              .inFilter('comment_id', chunk)
              .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
          for (final raw in likes as List) {
            final row = raw as Map;
            final cid = row['comment_id'].toString();
            likeCounts[cid] = (likeCounts[cid] ?? 0) + 1;
            if (row['user_id'] == _uid) mine.add(cid);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          debugPrint('Videos: comment likes unavailable: $e');
        }
      }
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _rows
          ..clear()
          ..addAll(data);
        _likeCounts
          ..clear()
          ..addAll(likeCounts);
        _myLikes
          ..clear()
          ..addAll(mine);
        _loading = false;
      });
      widget.onCountChanged(_rows.length);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _loading = false;
        _error = e.toString();
      });
    }
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> _profileOf(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
    final raw = row['profiles'];
    if (raw is Map) return Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);
    if (raw is List && raw.isNotEmpty && raw.first is Map) {
      return Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw.first as Map);
    }
    return <String, dynamic>{};
  }

  DateTime _dateOf(Map<String, dynamic> row) =>
      DateTime.tryParse('${row['created_at']}') ??
      DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(0);

  int _likesOf(Map<String, dynamic> row) => _likeCounts[row['id'].toString()] ?? 0;

  Future<void> _toggleLike(Map<String, dynamic> row) async {
    final uid = _uid;
    final id = row['id'].toString();
    if (uid == null || row['_pending'] == true) return;
    final liked = _myLikes.contains(id);
    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    setState(() {
      if (liked) {
        _myLikes.remove(id);
        _likeCounts[id] = max(0, (_likeCounts[id] ?? 1) - 1);
      } else {
        _myLikes.add(id);
        _likeCounts[id] = (_likeCounts[id] ?? 0) + 1;
      }
    });
    try {
      if (liked) {
        await _db
            .from('comment_likes')
            .delete()
            .eq('comment_id', id)
            .eq('user_id', uid);
      } else {
        await _db.from('comment_likes').upsert(
          <String, dynamic>{'comment_id': id, 'user_id': uid},
          onConflict: 'comment_id,user_id',
          ignoreDuplicates: true,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        if (liked) {
          _myLikes.add(id);
          _likeCounts[id] = (_likeCounts[id] ?? 0) + 1;
        } else {
          _myLikes.remove(id);
          _likeCounts[id] = max(0, (_likeCounts[id] ?? 1) - 1);
        }
      });
      _videoSnack(context, 'Heart could not sync: $e');
    }
  }

  void _startReply(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
    final parentId = row['parent_id']?.toString();
    final top = parentId == null
        ? row
        : _rows.firstWhere(
            (r) => r['id'].toString() == parentId,
            orElse: () => row,
          );
    final p = _profileOf(row);
    final name = (p['display_name'] ?? p['username'] ?? 'Twice user').toString();
    setState(() {
      _replyTo = top;
      _replyName = name;
    });
    if (parentId != null) {
      final username = (p['username'] ?? '').toString();
      if (username.isNotEmpty) {
        _input.text = '@$username ';
        _input.selection = TextSelection.collapsed(offset: _input.text.length);
      }
    }
    _focus.requestFocus();
  }

  Future<void> _send() async {
    if (_sending) return;
    final text = _input.text.trim();
    final uid = _uid;
    if (text.isEmpty || uid == null) return;
    final parent = _replyTo;
    final parentId = parent?['id']?.toString();
    final id = _newTwiceUuid();
    final me = widget.myProfile;
    final optimistic = <String, dynamic>{
      'id': id,
      'post_id': widget.post.id,
      'user_id': uid,
      'parent_id': parentId,
      'body': text,
      'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
      'profiles': <String, dynamic>{
        'id': uid,
        'username': me['username'],
        'display_name': me['display_name'] ?? me['username'] ?? 'You',
        'avatar_url': me['avatar_url'],
      },
      '_pending': true,
      '_fresh': true,
    };
    setState(() {
      _rows.add(optimistic);
      if (parentId != null) _expanded.add(parentId);
      _replyTo = null;
      _replyName = '';
      _sending = true;
    });
    _input.clear();
    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    widget.onCountChanged(_rows.length);

    try {
      if (parentId == null) {
        final synced = await SocialRepository.instance.addComment(
          widget.post.id,
          text,
          commentId: id,
        );
        if (mounted && !synced) {
          setState(() => optimistic['_queued'] = true);
          _videoSnack(context, 'Saved offline. It will sync when you reconnect.');
        }
      } else {
        await _db
            .from('comments')
            .insert(<String, dynamic>{
              'id': id,
              'post_id': widget.post.id,
              'user_id': uid,
              'parent_id': parentId,
              'body': text,
            })
            .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
      }
      if (mounted) setState(() => optimistic.remove('_pending'));
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        optimistic.remove('_pending');
        optimistic['_failed'] = true;
      });
      _videoSnack(context, 'Comment could not be sent: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _sending = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _delete(Map<String, dynamic> row) async {
    final id = row['id'].toString();
    final removedIds = <String>{id};
    for (final r in _rows) {
      if (r['parent_id']?.toString() == id) removedIds.add(r['id'].toString());
    }
    final backup = _rows.where((r) => removedIds.contains(r['id'].toString())).toList();
    setState(() => _rows.removeWhere((r) => removedIds.contains(r['id'].toString())));
    widget.onCountChanged(_rows.length);
    try {
      await _db.from('comments').delete().eq('id', id);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _rows.addAll(backup));
      widget.onCountChanged(_rows.length);
      _videoSnack(context, 'Could not delete comment: $e');
    }
  }

  void _commentMenu(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
    final mine = row['user_id']?.toString() == _uid;
    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.white,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
      ),
      builder: (sheetContext) => SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            ListTile(
              leading: Icon(
                _myLikes.contains(row['id'].toString())
                    ? Icons.favorite_rounded
                    : Icons.favorite_border_rounded,
                color: _reelHeart,
              ),
              title: Text(
                _myLikes.contains(row['id'].toString()) ? 'Remove heart' : 'Heart',
              ),
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                _toggleLike(row);
              },
            ),
            if (!_commentsOff)
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.reply_rounded),
                title: const Text('Reply'),
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                  _startReply(row);
                },
              ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.copy_rounded),
              title: const Text('Copy'),
              onTap: () {
                Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: '${row['body']}'));
                Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
              },
            ),
            if (mine)
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline_rounded, color: Colors.red),
                title: const Text('Delete', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                  _delete(row);
                },
              ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _openCommenter(Map<String, dynamic> row) async {
    final p = _profileOf(row);
    await _openUserProfile(
      context,
      userId: (p['id'] ?? row['user_id'] ?? '').toString(),
      profile: p,
    );
  }

  Widget _tile(Map<String, dynamic> row, {required bool isReply}) {
    final p = _profileOf(row);
    final id = row['id'].toString();
    final name = (p['display_name'] ?? p['username'] ?? 'Twice user').toString();
    final avatar = (p['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString();
    final isAuthor = row['user_id']?.toString() == widget.post.data['user_id']?.toString();
    final liked = _myLikes.contains(id);
    final likes = _likesOf(row);
    final pending = row['_pending'] == true;
    final failed = row['_failed'] == true;
    final queued = row['_queued'] == true;
    final status = failed
        ? 'Not sent'
        : queued
        ? 'Waiting to sync'
        : pending
        ? 'Sending…'
        : _timeAgo(row['created_at']);

    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12, left: isReply ? 46 : 0),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          GestureDetector(
            onTap: () => _openCommenter(row),
            child: _UserAvatar(url: avatar, name: name, size: isReply ? 28 : 36),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                GestureDetector(
                  onLongPress: () => _commentMenu(row),
                  onDoubleTap: () => _toggleLike(row),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 8, 12, 9),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: _fbGrey,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                    ),
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Row(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            Flexible(
                              child: GestureDetector(
                                onTap: () => _openCommenter(row),
                                child: Text(
                                  name,
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 13.5,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                    color: ink,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                            if (isAuthor) ...[
                              const SizedBox(width: 6),
                              Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 1),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: const Color(0xFFECE7FF),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                                ),
                                child: const Text(
                                  'Author',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 10.5,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                    color: violet,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ],
                        ),
                        Text(
                          '@${(p['username'] ?? 'user').toString().replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^@'), '')}',
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: muted),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 3),
                        Text(
                          '${row['body']}',
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15, height: 1.25, color: ink),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 5, 0, 0),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        status,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12,
                          color: failed ? Colors.red : muted,
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (!_commentsOff && !pending) ...[
                        const SizedBox(width: 16),
                        GestureDetector(
                          behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                          onTap: () => _startReply(row),
                          child: const Padding(
                            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
                            child: Text(
                              'Reply',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                color: muted,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          // Heart on the right, like Facebook Reels comments.
          GestureDetector(
            behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
            onTap: () => _toggleLike(row),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 8, top: 8, right: 2),
              child: SizedBox(
                width: 30,
                child: Column(
                  children: [
                    AnimatedSwitcher(
                      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 160),
                      transitionBuilder: (child, anim) =>
                          ScaleTransition(scale: anim, child: child),
                      child: Icon(
                        liked ? Icons.favorite_rounded : Icons.favorite_border_rounded,
                        key: ValueKey<bool>(liked),
                        size: 20,
                        color: liked ? _reelHeart : muted,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (likes > 0)
                      Text(
                        _compactCount(likes),
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                          color: liked ? _reelHeart : muted,
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  List<Widget> _thread() {
    final ids = _rows.map((r) => r['id'].toString()).toSet();
    final children = <String, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>{};
    final top = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (final r in _rows) {
      final pid = r['parent_id']?.toString();
      if (pid == null || pid.isEmpty || pid == 'null' || !ids.contains(pid)) {
        top.add(r);
      } else {
        children.putIfAbsent(pid, () => <Map<String, dynamic>>[]).add(r);
      }
    }
    top.sort((a, b) {
      final fa = a['_fresh'] == true, fb = b['_fresh'] == true;
      if (fa != fb) return fa ? -1 : 1;
      if (_newestFirst) return _dateOf(b).compareTo(_dateOf(a));
      final byLikes = _likesOf(b).compareTo(_likesOf(a));
      return byLikes != 0 ? byLikes : _dateOf(a).compareTo(_dateOf(b));
    });

    final widgets = <Widget>[];
    for (final r in top) {
      final id = r['id'].toString();
      widgets.add(_tile(r, isReply: false));
      final replies = (children[id] ?? <Map<String, dynamic>>[])
        ..sort((a, b) => _dateOf(a).compareTo(_dateOf(b)));
      if (replies.isEmpty) continue;
      if (_expanded.contains(id)) {
        for (final reply in replies) {
          widgets.add(_tile(reply, isReply: true));
        }
        widgets.add(
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 46, bottom: 12),
            child: GestureDetector(
              onTap: () => setState(() => _expanded.remove(id)),
              child: const Text(
                'Hide replies',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: muted),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      } else {
        widgets.add(
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 46, bottom: 12),
            child: GestureDetector(
              onTap: () => setState(() => _expanded.add(id)),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Container(width: 22, height: 1, color: Colors.black26),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Text(
                    replies.length == 1
                        ? 'View 1 reply'
                        : 'View ${replies.length} replies',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      color: muted,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      }
    }
    return widgets;
  }

  Widget _composer() {
    if (_commentsOff) {
      return const Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Text(
          'Comments are turned off for this video.',
          style: TextStyle(color: muted),
        ),
      );
    }
    final me = widget.myProfile;
    final myName = (me['display_name'] ?? me['username'] ?? 'You').toString();
    return Container(
      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFEAEAEA))),
      ),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 8, 8, 10),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          if (_replyTo != null)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6, left: 4),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      'Replying to $_replyName',
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: muted),
                    ),
                  ),
                  GestureDetector(
                    onTap: () {
                      setState(() {
                        _replyTo = null;
                        _replyName = '';
                      });
                      _input.clear();
                    },
                    child: const Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.all(4),
                      child: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 18, color: muted),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
            children: [
              _UserAvatar(
                url: (me['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString(),
                name: myName,
                size: 34,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: TextField(
                  controller: _input,
                  focusNode: _focus,
                  minLines: 1,
                  maxLines: 4,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    hintText: _replyTo == null
                        ? 'Comment as $myName…'
                        : 'Reply to $_replyName…',
                    filled: true,
                    fillColor: _fbGrey,
                    isDense: true,
                    contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 11),
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
                      borderSide: BorderSide.none,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              ValueListenableBuilder<TextEditingValue>(
                valueListenable: _input,
                builder: (context, value, child) {
                  final can = value.text.trim().isNotEmpty && !_sending;
                  return IconButton(
                    onPressed: can ? _send : null,
                    icon: Icon(
                      Icons.send_rounded,
                      color: can ? violet : Colors.black26,
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final media = MediaQuery.of(context);
    final inset = media.viewInsets.bottom;
    final height = min(
      media.size.height * 0.76,
      media.size.height - inset - media.padding.top - 12,
    );
    final thread = _thread();
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: inset),
      child: Container(
        height: max(height, 240),
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(22)),
        ),
        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
        child: Column(
          children: [
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Container(
              width: 38,
              height: 4,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.black26,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99),
              ),
            ),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 4, 0),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      _rows.length == 1 ? '1 comment' : '${_rows.length} comments',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                    ),
                  ),
                  PopupMenuButton<bool>(
                    tooltip: 'Sort comments',
                    onSelected: (newest) => setState(() => _newestFirst = newest),
                    itemBuilder: (_) => const [
                      PopupMenuItem<bool>(value: false, child: Text('Most relevant')),
                      PopupMenuItem<bool>(value: true, child: Text('Newest')),
                    ],
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 8),
                      child: Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            _newestFirst ? 'Newest' : 'Most relevant',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 13,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              color: muted,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const Icon(Icons.arrow_drop_down_rounded, color: muted),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const Divider(height: 1),
            Expanded(
              child: _loading
                  ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                  : _error != null
                  ? Center(
                      child: Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                        child: Column(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            const Text('Could not load comments'),
                            const SizedBox(height: 6),
                            Text(
                              _error!,
                              maxLines: 3,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                              style: const TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 12),
                            ),
                            TextButton(onPressed: _load, child: const Text('Retry')),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    )
                  : thread.isEmpty
                  ? const Center(
                      child: Padding(
                        padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
                        child: Column(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            Icon(Icons.mode_comment_outlined, size: 44, color: muted),

                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    )
                  : ListView(
                      keyboardDismissBehavior: ScrollViewKeyboardDismissBehavior.onDrag,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 14, 10, 8),
                      children: thread,
                    ),
            ),
            _composer(),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

# Twice → Instagram-style Update (Termux)

This package fixes:

1. **Messages inbox** – real profile pictures, display names, last-message preview, unread blue dots & timestamps (no more generic “Conversation”).
2. **Chat thread** – Instagram bubbles, sender avatars, photo/video send, live realtime updates.
3. **Skeleton shimmer** – FB/IG style loading for feed + inbox + chat (no spinner flash).
4. **Interaction icons** – heart / comment / share / save match Instagram.
5. **Unread badges** – message count + notification count on the shell.
6. **Cache / boot timing** – offline-first feed, deferred Supabase boot, quiet resume refresh.
7. **Expanded C++ native** – resize, CRC32, frame-skip helpers for smooth video.
8. **Supabase SQL** – message notifications, unread RPC, realtime on `messages`.

---

## 1. Unzip into your project

```bash
cd ~/Twice   # or wherever your project lives
# backup first
cp -a lib lib.bak.$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)

# unzip the update (adjust path if needed)
unzip -o ~/storage/downloads/Twice-Instagram-Update.zip -d /tmp/twice-ig
# or if you already have the folder:
# UPDATE=/path/to/Twice-Instagram-Update
```

Copy files:

```bash
UPDATE=/tmp/twice-ig/Twice-Instagram-Update   # change if needed

# Widgets
mkdir -p lib/widgets
cp -f $UPDATE/lib/widgets/skeleton.dart lib/widgets/
cp -f $UPDATE/lib/widgets/ig_icons.dart lib/widgets/

# Messages (full page)
cp -f $UPDATE/lib/messages_page.dart lib/

# Inbox controller
cp -f $UPDATE/lib/data/inbox_controller.dart lib/data/

# Native
cp -f $UPDATE/android/app/src/main/cpp/twice_native.cpp android/app/src/main/cpp/
cp -f $UPDATE/android/app/src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt android/app/src/main/cpp/

# SQL (keep for later)
mkdir -p supabase/migrations
cp -f $UPDATE/supabase/migrations/20261021180000_twice_instagram_messaging.sql supabase/migrations/
```

---

## 2. Patch `lib/data/social_repository.dart`

Open `lib/data/social_repository.dart` and:

1. Add at the top if missing:
   ```dart
   import 'dart:io';
   import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
   ```

2. **Replace** the existing `conversations()`, `messages()`, `sendMessage()` methods with the ones in:
   `lib/data/social_repository_chat_patch.dart`  
   (uncomment the block and paste into the class).

   Key new methods:
   - `conversationsDetailed()`
   - `messagesDetailed()`
   - `sendMediaMessage()`

---

## 3. Wire MessagesPage in `lib/main.dart`

1. Add import:
   ```dart
   import 'messages_page.dart';
   import 'widgets/skeleton.dart';
   import 'widgets/ig_icons.dart';
   import 'data/inbox_controller.dart';
   ```

2. Wherever you currently push `MessagesPage()` (search for `MessagesPage`), keep using it — the new file is a drop-in with the same class name.

3. **Skeleton on boot** – in `TwiceShell` / feed body, while `loading == true` show:
   ```dart
   if (loading) return const FeedSkeleton();
   ```
   instead of a centered `CircularProgressIndicator`.

4. **Unread badge on Messages icon** – wrap the messenger icon with:
   ```dart
   ListenableBuilder(
     listenable: InboxController.instance,
     builder: (_, __) {
       final n = InboxController.instance.messageUnread;
       return Badge(
         isLabelVisible: n > 0,
         label: Text('$n'),
         child: const IgMessenger(),
       );
     },
   )
   ```

5. Call `InboxController.instance.start()` after the user is signed in (inside `TwiceShell.initState` or when session becomes non-null). Call `.stop()` on sign-out.

6. **IG action row under posts** – replace the old IconButtons with:
   ```dart
   IgActionRow(
     liked: post.liked,
     saved: post.saved,
     likeCount: post.likes,
     onLike: () => _toggleLike(post),
     onComment: () => _openComments(post),
     onShare: () => _share(post),
     onSave: () => _toggleSave(post),
   )
   ```

7. Same `IgActionRow(vertical: true, ...)` on the **Videos** side rail.

---

## 4. Run the SQL migration (required)

1. Open Supabase Dashboard → SQL Editor.
2. Paste the full contents of  
   `supabase/migrations/20261021180000_twice_instagram_messaging.sql`
3. Run.
4. Confirm:
   - Function `twice_unread_conversation_count` exists.
   - Trigger `twice_message_notify` exists on `messages`.
   - Realtime publication includes `messages`.

```bash
flutter build apk --debug

# or push and let the existing GitHub Actions workflow build the release APK
```

If you use the GitHub workflow, make sure `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` secrets are still set.

#else
#define TWICE_EXPORT
#endif

extern "C" TWICE_EXPORT
int32_t twice_native_add(int32_t a, int32_t b) {
    return a + b;
}

extern "C" TWICE_EXPORT
int32_t twice_native_version() {
    return 1;

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

/// Keeps the unread inbox count live (Supabase realtime + a 60s safety poll).
class InboxController extends ChangeNotifier {
  InboxController._();
  static final InboxController instance = InboxController._();

  int unread = 0;
  int version = 0; // bumps whenever the list should reload
  bool viewing = false; // true while the Inbox tab is open
  RealtimeChannel? _channel;
  Timer? _poll;
  String? _uid;

  SupabaseClient get _db => Supabase.instance.client;

  void start() {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;
    if (_uid == uid && _channel != null) return;
    stop();
    _uid = uid;
    refreshUnread();
    _channel = _db
        .channel('twice-inbox-$uid')
        .onPostgresChanges(
          event: PostgresChangeEvent.insert,
          schema: 'public',
          table: 'notifications',
          filter: PostgresChangeFilter(
            type: PostgresChangeFilterType.eq,
            column: 'recipient_id',
            value: uid,
          ),
          callback: (payload) {
            version++;
            if (viewing) {
              markAllRead();
            } else {
              unread++;
            }
            notifyListeners();
          },
        )
        .subscribe();
    _poll = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 60), (_) => refreshUnread());
  }

  Future<void> refreshUnread() async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;
    try {
      final rows = await _db
          .from('notifications')
          .select('id')
          .eq('recipient_id', uid)
          .eq('is_read', false)
          .limit(100)
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
      final count = (rows as List).length;
      if (count != unread) {
        unread = count;
        notifyListeners();
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> markAllRead() async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;
    if (unread != 0) {
      unread = 0;
      notifyListeners();
    }
    try {
      await _db
          .from('notifications')
          .update({'is_read': true})
          .eq('recipient_id', uid)
          .eq('is_read', false);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Silent reset (called while the shell is being disposed).
  void stop() {
    _poll?.cancel();
    _poll = null;
    final channel = _channel;
    _channel = null;
    if (channel != null) {
      try {
        unawaited(_db.removeChannel(channel));
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    _uid = null;
    unread = 0;
    viewing = false;
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class IgHeart extends StatelessWidget {
  const IgHeart({super.key, this.size = 26, this.filled = false, this.color});
  final double size;
  final bool filled;
  final Color? color;
  @override

class IgActionRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const IgActionRow({
    super.key,
    required this.liked,
    required this.saved,
    required this.onLike,
    required this.onComment,
    required this.onShare,
    required this.onSave,
    this.likeCount,
    this.vertical = false,
  });
  final bool liked;
  final bool saved;
  final VoidCallback onLike;
  final VoidCallback onComment;
  final VoidCallback onShare;
  final VoidCallback onSave;
  final int? likeCount;
  final bool vertical;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final kids = <Widget>[
      _tap(onLike, IgHeart(filled: liked, size: vertical ? 28 : 26)),
      if (likeCount != null && vertical)
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4, bottom: 12),
          child: Text(
            _fmt(likeCount!),
            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
          ),
        )
      else if (vertical)
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
      if (!vertical) const SizedBox(width: 14),
      _tap(onComment, const IgComment()),
      if (vertical) const SizedBox(height: 16),
      if (!vertical) const SizedBox(width: 14),
      _tap(onShare, const IgShare()),
      if (vertical) const SizedBox(height: 16),
      if (!vertical) const Spacer(),
      _tap(onSave, IgSave(filled: saved)),
    ];
    if (vertical) return Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: kids);
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(10, 8, 12, 4),
      child: Row(children: kids),
    );
  }

  Widget _tap(VoidCallback onTap, Widget child) => GestureDetector(
        onTap: onTap,
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        child: Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4), child: child),
      );

  static String _fmt(int n) {
    if (n >= 1000000) return '${(n / 1000000).toStringAsFixed(1)}M';
    if (n >= 1000) return '${(n / 1000).toStringAsFixed(1)}K';
    return '$n';
  }
}

FILE: lib/ads/ad_config.dart
==========================================================================================
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

/// Central AdMob configuration for Twice.
///
/// Debug / profile builds ALWAYS use Google's official test ad unit so your own
/// account is never at risk of invalid-traffic flags. Release builds use your
/// real native ad unit. To force live ads in a debug build (not recommended):
///   flutter run --dart-define=TWICE_LIVE_ADS=true
class TwiceAdConfig {
  TwiceAdConfig._();

  /// AdMob App ID (also declared in AndroidManifest.xml).
  static const String appId = 'ca-app-pub-2388362234538140~1307597758';

  /// Your real native ad unit.
  static const String liveNativeUnitId =
      'ca-app-pub-2388362234538140/2313557661';

  /// Google's official "Native Advanced Video" test unit (Android).
  static const String testNativeVideoUnitId =
      'ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/1044960115';

  /// Google's official "Native Advanced" test unit for Native Templates (Android).
  static const String testNativeUnitId =
      'ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/2247696110';

  static const bool _forceLive = bool.fromEnvironment('TWICE_LIVE_ADS');

  static String get nativeUnitId =>
      (kReleaseMode || _forceLive) ? liveNativeUnitId : testNativeUnitId;

  /// One ad after every [feedInterval] organic posts (recommended 5 to 7).
  static const int feedInterval = 4;

  /// Hard cap so a very long feed never builds unlimited ad slots.
  static const int maxAdSlots = 12;

  /// An ad that has been loaded this long is considered stale and re-requested.
  static const Duration adTtl = Duration(minutes: 50);

  /// After a failed request, wait this long before asking again for that slot.
  static const Duration failureBackoff = Duration(seconds: 60);

  /// Height reserved for the native ad media block (skeleton and ad share it,
  /// so nothing jumps when the ad fades in).
  static const double adHeight = 380;

  /// Add your phone's test-device hash here (it is printed in logcat as
  /// "Use RequestConfiguration.Builder().setTestDeviceIds(...)") if you ever
  /// need to tap live ads on your own device safely.
  static const List<String> testDeviceIds = <String>[];
}


==========================================================================================
FILE: lib/ads/ad_manager.dart
==========================================================================================
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:io' show Platform;

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:google_mobile_ads/google_mobile_ads.dart';

import 'ad_config.dart';

class _PoolEntry {
  _PoolEntry(this.ad) : loadedAt = DateTime.now();
  final NativeAd ad;
  final DateTime loadedAt;
  int refs = 0;
  bool isMounted = false;
  bool get stale => DateTime.now().difference(loadedAt) > TwiceAdConfig.adTtl;
}

/// Loads, preloads, pools and manages native ads for the feed.
///
/// Features:
///  * UMP Consent flow initialization with graceful offline fallback.
///  * Robust error diagnostics with human-readable error names without credential exposure.
///  * Duplicate-mount prevention for AdWidget in scrolling lists.
///  * Safe disposal and memory bounds.
class TwiceAds {
  TwiceAds._();

  static const int _maxPooled = 6;

  static bool _initialized = false;
  static Future<bool>? _initFuture;
  static final Map<int, _PoolEntry> _pool = {};
  static final Map<int, Future<_PoolEntry?>> _pending = {};
  static final Map<int, DateTime> _failedAt = {};

  static bool get supported =>
      !kIsWeb && (Platform.isAndroid || Platform.isIOS);

  /// Human-readable AdMob error codes for safe diagnostic logging.
  static String _adErrorCodeName(int code) {
    switch (code) {
      case 0:
        return 'INTERNAL_ERROR';
      case 1:
        return 'INVALID_REQUEST';
      case 2:
        return 'NETWORK_ERROR';
      case 3:
        return 'NO_FILL';
      default:
        return 'CODE_$code';
    }
  }

  /// Call once at startup (fire and forget). Also warms slot 0 so the first ad
  /// is already loaded by the time the user scrolls to it.
  static Future<void> init() async {
    if (!await _ensureInit()) return;
    unawaited(prefetch(0));
  }

  static Future<bool> _ensureInit() {
    if (!supported) return Future.value(false);
    if (_initialized) return Future.value(true);
    if (_initFuture != null) return _initFuture!;

    final completer = Completer<bool>();
    _initFuture = completer.future;

    () async {
      try {
        final success = await _updateConsentAndInitialize();
        _initialized = success;
        completer.complete(success);
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('TwiceAds initialization error: $e');
        _initialized = false;
        completer.complete(false);
      } finally {
        if (!_initialized) {
          // Allow retrying initialization on subsequent requests if it failed.
          _initFuture = null;
        }
      }
    }();

    return completer.future;
  }

  /// Requests UMP consent update, displays consent form if required, and then
  /// initializes the MobileAds SDK if allowed.
  static Future<bool> _updateConsentAndInitialize() async {
    final consentCompleter = Completer<void>();
    final params = ConsentRequestParameters();

    try {
      ConsentInformation.instance.requestConsentInfoUpdate(
        params,
        () async {
          try {
            ConsentForm.loadAndShowConsentFormIfRequired((formError) async {
              if (formError != null) {
                debugPrint(
                  'TwiceAds UMP form dismissed: code=${formError.errorCode}, message=${formError.message}',
                );
              }
              if (!consentCompleter.isCompleted) consentCompleter.complete();
            });
          } catch (e) {
            debugPrint('TwiceAds UMP form show threw: $e');
            if (!consentCompleter.isCompleted) consentCompleter.complete();
          }
        },
        (FormError error) {
          debugPrint(
            'TwiceAds UMP update failed (offline or unconfigured): code=${error.errorCode}, message=${error.message}',
          );
          if (!consentCompleter.isCompleted) consentCompleter.complete();
        },
      );
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('TwiceAds UMP requestConsentInfoUpdate threw: $e');
      if (!consentCompleter.isCompleted) consentCompleter.complete();
    }

    // Never block initialization indefinitely on consent network requests.
    await consentCompleter.future.timeout(
      const Duration(seconds: 5),
      onTimeout: () {
        debugPrint('TwiceAds UMP consent flow timed out; proceeding safely');
      },
    );

    // Check if ads can be requested according to user consent or platform default.
    bool canRequest = true;
    try {
      canRequest = await ConsentInformation.instance.canRequestAds();
    } catch (_) {
      // Offline fallback: allow standard/non-personalized ad requests.
      canRequest = true;
    }

    if (!canRequest) {
      debugPrint('TwiceAds: Ads cannot be requested per UMP consent status.');
      return false;
    }

    return _initMobileAds();
  }

  static Future<bool> _initMobileAds() async {
    try {
      await MobileAds.instance.updateRequestConfiguration(
        RequestConfiguration(testDeviceIds: TwiceAdConfig.testDeviceIds),
      );
      final status = await MobileAds.instance.initialize();
      for (final entry in status.adapterStatuses.entries) {
        debugPrint(
          'TwiceAds adapter: ${entry.key} => ${entry.value.state.name} (${entry.value.description})',
        );
      }
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('TwiceAds MobileAds.initialize failed: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Start loading the ad for [slot] in the background (no-op if it exists).
  static Future<void> prefetch(int slot) async {
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= TwiceAdConfig.maxAdSlots) return;
    await _obtain(slot);
  }

  /// Notifies the pool whether an ad is currently mounted in an AdWidget.
  static void markMounted(int slot, bool mounted) {
    final entry = _pool[slot];
    if (entry != null) {
      entry.isMounted = mounted;
    }
  }

  /// Returns a loaded ad for [slot] and increments ref count.
  /// If the pooled ad is currently mounted in another active widget, returns a fresh
  /// ad to prevent 'This AdWidget is already in the Widget tree' crashes.
  static Future<NativeAd?> acquire(int slot) async {
    final entry = await _obtain(slot);
    if (entry == null) return null;
    entry.refs++;
    return entry.ad;
  }

  static void release(int slot) {
    final entry = _pool[slot];
    if (entry == null) return;
    entry.refs = entry.refs > 0 ? entry.refs - 1 : 0;
    _evict();
  }

  static Future<_PoolEntry?> _obtain(int slot) {
    final cached = _pool[slot];
    if (cached != null && !cached.stale && !cached.isMounted) {
      return Future.value(cached);
    }
    if (cached != null && cached.stale && cached.refs == 0 && !cached.isMounted) {
      _pool.remove(slot);
      try {
        cached.ad.dispose();
      } catch (_) {}
    } else if (cached != null && !cached.isMounted) {
      return Future.value(cached);
    }

    final failed = _failedAt[slot];
    if (failed != null &&
        DateTime.now().difference(failed) < TwiceAdConfig.failureBackoff) {
      return Future.value(null);
    }

    return _pending[slot] ??= _load(slot).whenComplete(() {
      _pending.remove(slot);
    });
  }

  static Future<_PoolEntry?> _load(
    int slot, {
    String? overrideUnitId,
    bool isFallback = false,
  }) async {
    if (!await _ensureInit()) return null;

    final unitId = overrideUnitId ?? TwiceAdConfig.nativeUnitId;
    final done = Completer<_PoolEntry?>();

    final ad = NativeAd(
      adUnitId: unitId,
      request: const AdRequest(),
      nativeTemplateStyle: _instagramDarkStyle(),
      nativeAdOptions: NativeAdOptions(
        videoOptions: VideoOptions(
          startMuted: true,
          clickToExpandRequested: false,
          customControlsRequested: false,
        ),
        mediaAspectRatio: MediaAspectRatio.any,
      ),
      listener: NativeAdListener(
        onAdLoaded: (loaded) {
          debugPrint('TwiceAds: Slot $slot loaded successfully ($unitId)');
          final entry = _PoolEntry(loaded as NativeAd);
          _pool[slot] = entry;
          _failedAt.remove(slot);
          if (!done.isCompleted) done.complete(entry);
        },
        onAdFailedToLoad: (failedAd, error) {
          final codeName = _adErrorCodeName(error.code);
          debugPrint(
            'TwiceAds: Slot $slot failed to load [code=${error.code} ($codeName), '
            'domain=${error.domain}, message=${error.message}]',
          );
          try {
            failedAd.dispose();
          } catch (_) {}

          // If testing in debug mode and video unit returned NO_FILL, fall back to
          // official standard Native Advanced test unit before giving up.
          if (!kReleaseMode &&
              !isFallback &&
              error.code == 3 &&
              unitId != TwiceAdConfig.testNativeUnitId) {
            debugPrint(
              'TwiceAds: Slot $slot trying fallback test unit ${TwiceAdConfig.testNativeUnitId}',
            );
            _load(
              slot,
              overrideUnitId: TwiceAdConfig.testNativeUnitId,
              isFallback: true,
            ).then((fallbackEntry) {
              if (!done.isCompleted) done.complete(fallbackEntry);
            });
            return;
          }

          _failedAt[slot] = DateTime.now();
          if (!done.isCompleted) done.complete(null);
        },
      ),
    );

    try {
      await ad.load();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('TwiceAds: Slot $slot load threw: $e');
      try {
        ad.dispose();
      } catch (_) {}
      if (!done.isCompleted) done.complete(null);
    }

    return done.future.timeout(
      const Duration(seconds: 10),
      onTimeout: () {
        debugPrint('TwiceAds: Slot $slot load timed out');
        _failedAt[slot] = DateTime.now();
        return null;
      },
    );
  }

  static void _evict() {
    if (_pool.length <= _maxPooled) return;
    final idle = _pool.entries
        .where((e) => e.value.refs == 0 && !e.value.isMounted)
        .toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => a.value.loadedAt.compareTo(b.value.loadedAt));
    for (final e in idle) {
      if (_pool.length <= _maxPooled) break;
      _pool.remove(e.key);
      try {
        e.value.ad.dispose();
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  /// Black / white / blue styling that matches Twice's Instagram-style dark UI.
  static NativeTemplateStyle _instagramDarkStyle() {
    const black = Color(0xFF000000);
    const blue = Color(0xFF0095F6);
    const muted = Color(0xFFA8A8A8);
    return NativeTemplateStyle(
      templateType: TemplateType.medium,
      mainBackgroundColor: black,
      cornerRadius: 8,
      callToActionTextStyle: NativeTemplateTextStyle(
        textColor: Colors.white,
        backgroundColor: blue,
        style: NativeTemplateFontStyle.bold,
        size: 14,
      ),
      primaryTextStyle: NativeTemplateTextStyle(
        textColor: Colors.white,
        backgroundColor: black,
        style: NativeTemplateFontStyle.bold,
        size: 14,
      ),
      secondaryTextStyle: NativeTemplateTextStyle(
        textColor: muted,
        backgroundColor: black,
        style: NativeTemplateFontStyle.normal,
        size: 12,
      ),
      tertiaryTextStyle: NativeTemplateTextStyle(
        textColor: muted,
        backgroundColor: black,
        style: NativeTemplateFontStyle.normal,
        size: 12,
      ),
    );
  }
}


==========================================================================================
FILE: lib/ads/feed_entries.dart
==========================================================================================
import 'ad_config.dart';

/// One row of the feed: either an organic item or a native ad slot.
/// Polymorphic on purpose: the feed is ONE sequential list, so ads scroll
/// inline exactly like posts (no pop-ups, no pre-rolls, no mid-rolls).
class FeedEntry<T> {
  const FeedEntry.item(T this.item) : adSlot = null;
  const FeedEntry.ad(int this.adSlot) : item = null;

  final T? item;
  final int? adSlot;

  bool get isAd => adSlot != null;
}

/// Interleaves an ad after every [interval] organic items.
///
/// * Ad slots are numbered 0,1,2... by position, so a slot keeps the same
///   identity (and the same preloaded ad) across rebuilds and pagination.
/// * No ad is ever added after the LAST item (an ad at the very end of the
///   feed looks like a dead end, not like a feed).
List<FeedEntry<T>> interleaveAds<T>(
  List<T> items, {
  int interval = TwiceAdConfig.feedInterval,
  int maxAds = TwiceAdConfig.maxAdSlots,
}) {
  final out = <FeedEntry<T>>[];
  var slot = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    out.add(FeedEntry<T>.item(items[i]));
    final hasMore = i < items.length - 1;
    if (hasMore && (i + 1) % interval == 0 && slot < maxAds) {
      out.add(FeedEntry<T>.ad(slot++));
    }
  }
  return out;
}

FILE: lib/ads/native_ad_card.dart
==========================================================================================
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:google_mobile_ads/google_mobile_ads.dart';
import 'package:visibility_detector/visibility_detector.dart';

import '../widgets/skeleton.dart';
import 'ad_config.dart';
import 'ad_manager.dart';

/// In-feed native video ad that sits in the same list as organic posts.
///
/// Behaviour:
///  * Starts loading while it is still well off-screen (the feed's cache extent
///    builds it ~2 posts early) and warms the NEXT ad slot once this one is
///    mostly visible, so ads are ready before they scroll in.
///  * Shows a post-shaped skeleton, then cross-fades to the ad. Nothing
///    jumps: skeleton and ad share the same fixed height.
///  * If there is no fill, the row collapses smoothly to nothing.
///  * Video starts muted (set in the ad request). Sound only turns on if the
///    user taps the unmute control on the ad itself.
///  * "Sponsored" label + AdMob's own "Ad" badge stay visible (policy).
class FeedNativeAdCard extends StatefulWidget {
  const FeedNativeAdCard({super.key, required this.slot});

  final int slot;

  @override
  State<FeedNativeAdCard> createState() => _FeedNativeAdCardState();
}

class _FeedNativeAdCardState extends State<FeedNativeAdCard> {
  NativeAd? _ad;
  bool _failed = false;
  bool _revealed = false;
  bool _warmedNext = false;
  Timer? _revealTimer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final ad = await TwiceAds.acquire(widget.slot);
    if (!mounted) {
      if (ad != null) TwiceAds.release(widget.slot);
      return;
    }
    if (ad == null) {
      setState(() => _failed = true);
      return;
    }
    TwiceAds.markMounted(widget.slot, true);
    setState(() => _ad = ad);
    // Give the platform view a moment to draw its first frame, then fade the
    // skeleton away. Avoids a white flash.
    _revealTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 220), () {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _revealed = true);
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _revealTimer?.cancel();
    if (_ad != null) {
      TwiceAds.markMounted(widget.slot, false);
      TwiceAds.release(widget.slot);
      _ad = null;
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onVisibility(VisibilityInfo info) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    // Once this ad is mostly on screen, warm the next slot in the background.
    if (!_warmedNext && info.visibleFraction >= 0.5) {
      _warmedNext = true;
      unawaited(TwiceAds.prefetch(widget.slot + 1));
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return VisibilityDetector(
      key: ValueKey('twice-native-ad-${widget.slot}'),
      onVisibilityChanged: _onVisibility,
      child: AnimatedSize(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 320),
        curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
        alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
        child: _failed
            ? const SizedBox(width: double.infinity)
            : Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    const Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 6, 12, 6),
                      child: Text(
                        'Sponsored',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          color: Color(0xFFA8A8A8),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    SizedBox(
                      height: TwiceAdConfig.adHeight,
                      width: double.infinity,
                      child: Stack(
                        fit: StackFit.expand,
                        children: [
                          if (_ad != null) AdWidget(ad: _ad!),
                          // Skeleton sits ON TOP and fades out. (Fading the
                          // Flutter skeleton is smooth; fading a native
                          // platform view directly is not.)
                          IgnorePointer(
                            ignoring: _revealed,
                            child: AnimatedOpacity(
                              opacity: _revealed ? 0 : 1,
                              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 380),
                              curve: Curves.easeOut,
                              child: const _AdSkeleton(),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Post-shaped placeholder: avatar + name line, big media block, text lines.
class _AdSkeleton extends StatelessWidget {
  const _AdSkeleton();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return const ColoredBox(
      color: Color(0xFF000000),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 4, 12, 8),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                TwiceSkeleton(width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 16),
                SizedBox(width: 10),
                TwiceSkeleton(width: 120, height: 12),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: TwiceSkeleton(
              height: double.infinity,
              borderRadius: 0,
            ),
          ),
          Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 10, 12, 8),
            child: TwiceSkeleton(width: 200, height: 12),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/data/inbox_controller.dart
==========================================================================================
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

/// Live unread badge for the shell (home tab + Messages entry).
/// Matches Instagram: badge updates instantly when a new message/notification
/// arrives, clears when the user opens the inbox.
class InboxController extends ChangeNotifier {
  InboxController._();
  static final InboxController instance = InboxController._();

  int unread = 0;
  int messageUnread = 0;
  bool viewing = false;
  int version = 0;

  RealtimeChannel? _channel;
  RealtimeChannel? _msgChannel;
  Timer? _poll;
  String? _uid;

  SupabaseClient get _db => Supabase.instance.client;

  void start() {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;
    if (_uid == uid && _channel != null) return;
    stop();
    _uid = uid;
    refreshUnread();
    _channel = _db
        .channel('twice-inbox-$uid')
        .onPostgresChanges(
          event: PostgresChangeEvent.insert,
          schema: 'public',
          table: 'notifications',
          filter: PostgresChangeFilter(
            type: PostgresChangeFilterType.eq,
            column: 'recipient_id',
            value: uid,
          ),
          callback: (payload) {
            version++;
            final type = (payload.newRecord['type'] ?? '').toString();
            if (viewing) {
              markAllRead();
            } else {
              unread++;
              if (type == 'message') messageUnread++;
            }
            notifyListeners();
          },
        )
        .subscribe();

    // Also listen to new messages where the current user is a member.
    // (Fallback when the notification trigger is delayed.)
    _msgChannel = _db
        .channel('twice-messages-$uid')
        .onPostgresChanges(
          event: PostgresChangeEvent.insert,
          schema: 'public',
          table: 'messages',
          callback: (_) {
            if (!viewing) {
              refreshMessageUnread();
            }
          },
        )
        .subscribe();

    _poll = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 45), (_) {
      refreshUnread();
      refreshMessageUnread();
    });
  }

  Future<void> refreshUnread() async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;
    try {
      final rows = await _db
          .from('notifications')
          .select('id')
          .eq('recipient_id', uid)
          .eq('is_read', false)
          .limit(200)
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12));
      final count = (rows as List).length;
      if (count != unread) {
        unread = count;
        notifyListeners();
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Unread conversations = member rows where last_read_at is null or
  /// older than the latest message in that conversation.
  Future<void> refreshMessageUnread() async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;
    try {
      final rows = await _db.rpc(
        'twice_unread_conversation_count',
        params: {'p_user_id': uid},
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12));
      final count = (rows is int) ? rows : int.tryParse('$rows') ?? 0;
      if (count != messageUnread) {
        messageUnread = count;
        notifyListeners();
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // RPC may not exist yet — fall back to notification type=message count.
      try {
        final rows = await _db
            .from('notifications')
            .select('id')
            .eq('recipient_id', uid)
            .eq('type', 'message')
            .eq('is_read', false)
            .limit(100);
        final count = (rows as List).length;
        if (count != messageUnread) {
          messageUnread = count;
          notifyListeners();
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  Future<void> markAllRead() async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;
    if (unread != 0 || messageUnread != 0) {
      unread = 0;
      messageUnread = 0;
      notifyListeners();
    }
    try {
      await _db
          .from('notifications')
          .update({'is_read': true})
          .eq('recipient_id', uid)
          .eq('is_read', false);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> markConversationRead(String conversationId) async {
    final uid = _db.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;
    try {
      await _db
          .from('conversation_members')
          .update({'last_read_at': DateTime.now().toUtc().toIso8601String()})
          .eq('conversation_id', conversationId)
          .eq('user_id', uid);
      await refreshMessageUnread();
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  void stop() {
    _poll?.cancel();
    _poll = null;
    for (final ch in [_channel, _msgChannel]) {
      if (ch != null) {
        try {
          unawaited(_db.removeChannel(ch));
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }
    _channel = null;
    _msgChannel = null;
    _uid = null;
    unread = 0;
    messageUnread = 0;
    viewing = false;
  }
}

FILE: lib/data/local_cache.dart
==========================================================================================
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
import 'package:sqflite/sqflite.dart';

/// Durable per-device cache. Cached data is account-scoped so one account
/// cannot accidentally display another account's private feed after logout.
class LocalCache {
  LocalCache._();
  static final LocalCache instance = LocalCache._();
  Database? _database;

  Future<Database> get database async {
    if (_database != null) return _database!;
    final base = await getDatabasesPath();
    _database = await openDatabase(
      p.join(base, 'twice_local_cache.db'),
      version: 1,
      onCreate: (db, version) async {
        await db.execute('CREATE TABLE cache (cache_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)');
        await db.execute('CREATE TABLE outbox (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, account_id TEXT NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_error TEXT)');
        await db.execute('CREATE INDEX outbox_account_created ON outbox(account_id, created_at)');
      },
    );
    return _database!;
  }

  /// Opens the database in the background so queries execute immediately.
  Future<void> prewarm() async {
    try {
      await database;
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  String _key(String account, String type, [String id = '']) => '$account:$type:$id';

  Future<void> put(String account, String type, dynamic value, {String id = ''}) async {
    final db = await database;
    await db.insert('cache', {
      'cache_key': _key(account, type, id),
      'value': jsonEncode(value),
      'updated_at': DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
    }, conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.replace);
  }

  Future<dynamic> get(String account, String type, {String id = ''}) async {
    final db = await database;
    final rows = await db.query('cache', where: 'cache_key = ?', whereArgs: [_key(account, type, id)], limit: 1);
    if (rows.isEmpty) return null;
    try { return jsonDecode(rows.first['value']! as String); } catch (_) { return null; }
  }

  Future<void> enqueue(String account, String operation, Map<String, dynamic> payload) async {
    final db = await database;
    final id = operation == 'set_like'
        ? 'set_like:$account:${payload['post_id']}'
        : operation == 'set_saved'
            ? 'set_saved:$account:${payload['post_id']}'
            : '${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}_${payload['id'] ?? ''}';
    await db.transaction((txn) async {
      if (operation == 'set_like' || operation == 'set_saved') {
        await txn.delete(
          'outbox',
          where: 'account_id = ? AND operation = ? AND id = ?',
          whereArgs: [account, operation, id],
        );
      }
      await txn.insert(
        'outbox',
        {
          'id': id,
          'account_id': account,
          'operation': operation,
          'payload': jsonEncode(payload),
          'created_at': DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
        },
        conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.replace,
      );
    });
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> pending(String account) async {
    final db = await database;
    final rows = await db.query('outbox', where: 'account_id = ?', whereArgs: [account], orderBy: 'created_at ASC');
    return rows.map((r) => {...r, 'payload': jsonDecode(r['payload']! as String) as Map<String, dynamic>}).toList();
  }

  Future<void> removePending(String id) async => (await database).delete('outbox', where: 'id = ?', whereArgs: [id]);
  Future<void> markFailed(String id, Object error) async => (await database).rawUpdate('UPDATE outbox SET attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = ? WHERE id = ?', [error.toString(), id]);

  /// Purges old cache entries beyond maxAge to prevent unbounded disk growth.
  Future<void> pruneOldCacheEntries({Duration maxAge = const Duration(days: 30)}) async {
    try {
      final db = await database;
      final cutoff = DateTime.now().subtract(maxAge).millisecondsSinceEpoch;
      await db.delete('cache', where: 'updated_at < ?', whereArgs: [cutoff]);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Purge user-scoped cache on logout to avoid cross-account data leakage.
  Future<void> clearAccount(String account) async {
    final db = await database;
    await db.delete('cache', where: 'cache_key LIKE ?', whereArgs: ['$account:%']);
    await db.delete('outbox', where: 'account_id = ?', whereArgs: [account]);
  }
}
