    final path = (m['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (_isStoragePath(path)) {
      m['resolved_media_url'] = urls[path] ?? '';
    } else {
      m['resolved_media_url'] = path;
    }
    m['sender_profile'] = profiles[(m['sender_id'] ?? '').toString()];
  }

  final attachmentsByMessage = <String, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>{};
  for (final a in attachmentRows) {
    final path = (a['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    a['resolved_media_url'] =
        _isStoragePath(path) ? (urls[path] ?? '') : path;
    final messageId = (a['message_id'] ?? '').toString();
    (attachmentsByMessage[messageId] ??= <Map<String, dynamic>>[]).add(a);
  }
  for (final m in list) {
    m['resolved_attachments'] =
        attachmentsByMessage[(m['id'] ?? '').toString()] ??
        <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  }
  return list;
}

Future<void> sendMessage(String conversationId, String body) async {
  if (body.trim().isEmpty) return;
  await _db.from('messages').insert({
    'conversation_id': conversationId,
    'sender_id': userId,
    'body': body.trim(),
  });
}

Future<void> sendMediaMessage({
  required String conversationId,
  required File file,
  required String mediaType, // 'image' | 'video'
}) async {
  final ext = p.extension(file.path).toLowerCase();
  final objectPath =
      '$userId/$conversationId/${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}$ext';
  await _db.storage.from('chat-media').upload(
        objectPath,
        file,
        fileOptions: FileOptions(
          contentType: mediaType == 'video'
              ? 'video/mp4'
              : switch (ext) {
                  '.gif' => 'image/gif',
                  '.png' => 'image/png',
                  '.webp' => 'image/webp',
                  _ => 'image/jpeg',
                },
          upsert: false,
        ),
      );
  await _db.from('messages').insert({
    'conversation_id': conversationId,
    'sender_id': userId,
    'body': '',
    'media_url': objectPath,
    'media_type': mediaType,
  });
}

Future<void> sendMediaAlbum({
  required String conversationId,
  required List<File> files,
}) async {
  if (files.isEmpty || files.length > 10) {
    throw ArgumentError('Choose between 1 and 10 photos.');
  }

  final uploadedPaths = <String>[];
  var parentInserted = false;

  String contentTypeFor(String ext) {
    switch (ext.toLowerCase()) {
      case '.png':
        return 'image/png';
      case '.webp':
        return 'image/webp';
      case '.gif':
        return 'image/gif';
      case '.jpg':
      case '.jpeg':
      default:
        return 'image/jpeg';
    }
  }

  try {
    for (var i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
      final file = files[i];
      var ext = p.extension(file.path).toLowerCase();
      if (!['.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.webp', '.gif'].contains(ext)) {
        throw StateError(
          'Unsupported photo format: ${ext.isEmpty ? '(unknown)' : ext}. '
          'Choose JPG, PNG, WebP, or GIF photos.',
        );
      }

      final objectPath =
          '$userId/$conversationId/${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}_$i$ext';
      await _db.storage.from('chat-media').upload(
        objectPath,
        file,
        fileOptions: FileOptions(
          contentType: contentTypeFor(ext),
          upsert: false,
        ),
      );
      uploadedPaths.add(objectPath);
    }

    final parent = await _db.from('messages').insert({
      'conversation_id': conversationId,
      'sender_id': userId,
      'body': '',
      'media_url': uploadedPaths.first,
      'media_type': 'image',
    }).select('id').single();

    parentInserted = true;
    final messageId = parent['id'].toString();

    await _db.from('message_attachments').insert([
      for (var i = 0; i < uploadedPaths.length; i++)
        {
          'conversation_id': conversationId,
          'message_id': messageId,
          'sender_id': userId,
          'media_url': uploadedPaths[i],
          'media_type': 'image',
          'position': i,
        },
    ]);
  } catch (_) {
    // Keep uploads if the parent message exists; it may already reference them.
    if (!parentInserted && uploadedPaths.isNotEmpty) {
      try {
        await _db.storage.from('chat-media').remove(uploadedPaths);
      } catch (_) {
        // Preserve the original send error.
      }
    }
    rethrow;
  }
}

// Keep the original simple helpers for backward compatibility:
Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> conversations() async {
  return conversationsDetailed();
}

Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> messages(String conversationId) async {
  return messagesDetailed(conversationId);
}
}

        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));

    final otherByConv = <String, String>{};
    for (final raw in (members as List)) {
      final m = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map);
      otherByConv[m['conversation_id'].toString()] = m['user_id'].toString();
    }

    final otherIds = otherByConv.values.toSet().toList();
    final profiles = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
    if (otherIds.isNotEmpty) {
      final prows = await _db
          .from('profiles')
          .select('id,username,display_name,avatar_url')
          .inFilter('id', otherIds)
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
      for (final raw in (prows as List)) {
        final p = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map);
        final resolved = await _resolveProfileAvatar(p);
        profiles[resolved['id'].toString()] = resolved;
      }
    }

    // 3) Latest message per conversation (simple approach; good enough for <200 chats)
    final lastByConv = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
    for (final id in convIds) {
      try {
        final rows = await _db
            .from('messages')
            .select('id,body,media_type,sender_id,created_at')
            .eq('conversation_id', id)
            .isFilter('deleted_at', null)
            .order('created_at', ascending: false)
            .limit(1)
            .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 8));
        if ((rows as List).isNotEmpty) {
          lastByConv[id] = Map<String, dynamic>.from(rows.first as Map);
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    final out = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (final m in list) {
      final cid = m['conversation_id'].toString();
      final otherId = otherByConv[cid] ?? '';
      final profile = profiles[otherId] ?? {};
      final last = lastByConv[cid];
      final lastAt = last == null
          ? null
          : DateTime.tryParse((last['created_at'] ?? '').toString());
      final lastRead = DateTime.tryParse((m['last_read_at'] ?? '').toString());
      final unread = last != null &&
          last['sender_id'] != uid &&
          (lastRead == null ||
              (lastAt != null && lastAt.isAfter(lastRead)));

      out.add({
        'conversation_id': cid,
        'last_read_at': m['last_read_at'],
        'other_user_id': otherId,
        'other_name': (profile['display_name'] ?? profile['username'] ?? 'User')
            .toString(),
        'other_username': (profile['username'] ?? '').toString(),
        'other_avatar': (profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString(),
        'last_body': (last?['body'] ?? '').toString(),
        'last_media_type': (last?['media_type'] ?? '').toString(),
        'last_at': lastAt,
        'unread': unread,
      });
    }

    // Sort by last message time (newest first)
    out.sort((a, b) {
      final aa = a['last_at'] as DateTime?;
      final bb = b['last_at'] as DateTime?;
      if (aa == null && bb == null) return 0;
      if (aa == null) return 1;
      if (bb == null) return -1;
      return bb.compareTo(aa);
    });
    return out;
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> messagesDetailed(
    String conversationId,
  ) async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('messages')
        .select(
          'id,conversation_id,sender_id,body,media_url,media_type,created_at',
        )
        .eq('conversation_id', conversationId)
        .isFilter('deleted_at', null)
        .order('created_at')
        .limit(300)
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 20));

    final list = (rows as List)
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
        .toList();

    // Resolve media + attach sender profiles
    final needed = <String>{};
    final senderIds = <String>{};
    for (final m in list) {
      senderIds.add((m['sender_id'] ?? '').toString());
      final path = (m['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (_isStoragePath(path)) needed.add(path);
    }

    final urls = await _resolvePaths('chat-media', needed, strict: false);

    final profiles = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
    if (senderIds.isNotEmpty) {
      final prows = await _db
          .from('profiles')
          .select('id,username,display_name,avatar_url')
          .inFilter('id', senderIds.toList());
      for (final raw in (prows as List)) {
        final p = await _resolveProfileAvatar(
          Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map),
        );
        profiles[p['id'].toString()] = p;
      }
    }

    for (final m in list) {
      final path = (m['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (_isStoragePath(path)) {
        m['resolved_media_url'] = urls[path] ?? '';
      } else {
        m['resolved_media_url'] = path;
      }
      m['sender_profile'] = profiles[(m['sender_id'] ?? '').toString()];
    }
    return list;
  }

  Future<void> sendMessage(String conversationId, String body) async {
    if (body.trim().isEmpty) return;
    await _db.from('messages').insert({
      'conversation_id': conversationId,
      'sender_id': userId,

    });

  Future<void> sendMediaMessage({

            contentType: mediaType == 'video'
                ? 'video/mp4'
                : 'image/jpeg',
            upsert: false,
          ),
        );
    await _db.from('messages').insert({
      'conversation_id': conversationId,
      'sender_id': userId,
      'body': '',
      'media_url': objectPath,
      'media_type': mediaType,
    });
  }

  // Keep the original simple helpers for backward compatibility:
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> conversations() async {
    return conversationsDetailed();
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> messages(String conversationId) async {
    return messagesDetailed(conversationId);

// Facebook-style media engine for Twice.
//
// Fixes: feed images / avatars / video posters turning blank when scrolling
// back, because (1) NetworkImage was keyed by the *signed URL* (it changes on
// every refresh) and had no disk cache, and (2) cards were rebuilt from zero.
//
// What this does:
//  * TwiceNetworkImage: ImageProvider keyed by stable bucket/object path,
//    persistent disk cache, de-duplicated downloads, retry, downscaled decode.
//  * Bigger in-memory image cache so scrolled-away images return instantly.
//  * TwiceVideoPoster: always shows a thumbnail (uploaded one, or one generated
//    from the video and cached on disk).
//  * Disk cache trimming so the cache never grows forever.
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';
import 'package:video_thumbnail/video_thumbnail.dart';
import 'package:visibility_detector/visibility_detector.dart';

import 'offline_media_cache.dart';

class _Gate {
  _Gate(this.limit);
  final int limit;
  int _running = 0;
  final List<Completer<void>> _waiters = [];

  Future<T> run<T>(Future<T> Function() task) async {
    if (_running >= limit) {
      final c = Completer<void>();
      _waiters.add(c);
      await c.future;
    }
    _running++;
    try {
      return await task();
    } finally {
      _running--;
      if (_waiters.isNotEmpty) _waiters.removeAt(0).complete();
    }
  }
}

class TwiceMedia {
  TwiceMedia._();

  static final _imageGate = _Gate(4);
  static final _thumbGate = _Gate(2);
  static final _videoGate = _Gate(1);
  static final Map<String, Future<File?>> _imageJobs = {};
  static final Map<String, Future<String?>> _thumbJobs = {};
  static final Map<String, Future<String?>> _videoJobs = {};
  static Directory? _thumbDirectory;

  /// Call once at startup.
  static void configure() {
    final cache = PaintingBinding.instance.imageCache;
    cache.maximumSizeBytes = 300 * 1024 * 1024;
    cache.maximumSize = 1500;
    VisibilityDetectorController.instance.updateInterval =
        const Duration(milliseconds: 120);
  }

  /// Stable identity of a media URL (signed URL tokens are ignored).
  static ({String bucket, String path}) identify(String url) {
    final uri = Uri.tryParse(url);
    if (uri != null) {
      final segs = uri.pathSegments;
      final i = segs.indexOf('object');
      if (i >= 0 && i + 3 < segs.length) {
        return (bucket: segs[i + 2], path: segs.sublist(i + 3).join('/'));
      }
    }
    return (bucket: '_web', path: url.split('?').first);
  }

  static String stableKey(String url) {
    final id = identify(url);
    return '${id.bucket}:${id.path}';
  }

  static String _hash(String input) {
    // Two independent 32-bit FNV-1a hashes (web/native safe, collision-resistant).
    var a = 0x811c9dc5;
    var b = 0x01000193;
    for (final unit in input.codeUnits) {
      a = ((a ^ unit) * 0x01000193) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
      b = ((b ^ unit) * 0x85ebca6b) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
    }
    return '${a.toRadixString(16)}${b.toRadixString(16)}${input.length}';
  }

  static Future<String?> cachedFileUri(String url) async {
    final id = identify(url);
    return OfflineMediaCache.instance.existingUri(id.bucket, id.path);
  }

  /// Returns the on-disk file for an image URL, downloading it once if needed.
  static Future<File?> imageFile(String url) {
    final key = stableKey(url);
    return _imageJobs.putIfAbsent(key, () async {
      try {
        final id = identify(url);
        var uri = await OfflineMediaCache.instance.existingUri(
          id.bucket,
          id.path,
        );
        if (uri == null) {
          for (var attempt = 0; attempt < 3 && uri == null; attempt++) {
            if (attempt > 0) {
              await Future<void>.delayed(Duration(milliseconds: 500 * attempt));
            }
            uri = await _imageGate.run(
              () => OfflineMediaCache.instance.cacheFromUrl(
                bucket: id.bucket,
                objectPath: id.path,
                signedUrl: url,
                isVideo: false,
              ),
            );
          }
        }
        return uri == null ? null : File.fromUri(Uri.parse(uri));
      } catch (_) {
        return null;
      } finally {
        // Keep successful results out of the map; the disk is the cache.
        unawaited(Future<void>.microtask(() => _imageJobs.remove(key)));
      }
    });
  }

  /// Raw bytes for images too large for the disk cache limit (direct fetch).
  static Future<Uint8List?> _directBytes(String url) async {
    if (!url.startsWith('http')) return null;
    try {
      final res = await http
          .get(Uri.parse(url))
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 30));
      return res.statusCode == 200 ? res.bodyBytes : null;
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  static Future<Directory> _thumbDir() async {
    final cached = _thumbDirectory;
    if (cached != null) return cached;
    final support = await getApplicationSupportDirectory();
    final dir = Directory(p.join(support.path, 'twice_media_cache', 'thumbs'));
    if (!await dir.exists()) await dir.create(recursive: true);
    return _thumbDirectory = dir;
  }

  /// A JPEG poster generated from the video itself (cached on disk).
  static Future<String?> videoThumbnailFile(String videoUrl) {
    final key = stableKey(videoUrl);
    return _thumbJobs.putIfAbsent(key, () async {
      try {
        final dir = await _thumbDir();
        final out = File(p.join(dir.path, '${_hash(key)}.jpg'));
        if (await out.exists() && await out.length() > 0) return out.path;

        var source = videoUrl;
        if (videoUrl.startsWith('file://')) {
          source = File.fromUri(Uri.parse(videoUrl)).path;
        } else {
          final local = await cachedFileUri(videoUrl);
          if (local != null) source = File.fromUri(Uri.parse(local)).path;
        }
        final bytes = await _thumbGate.run(
          () => VideoThumbnail.thumbnailData(
            video: source,
            imageFormat: ImageFormat.JPEG,
            maxWidth: 720,
            quality: 75,
            timeMs: 300,
          ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 25)),
        );
        if (bytes == null || bytes.isEmpty) {
          _thumbJobs.remove(key);
          return null;
        }
        await out.writeAsBytes(bytes, flush: true);
        return out.path;
      } catch (_) {
        _thumbJobs.remove(key);
        return null;
      }
    });
  }

  /// Background-save a video you are watching so replays are instant/offline.
  static Future<String?> cacheVideo(String videoUrl) {
    if (!videoUrl.startsWith('http')) return Future.value(null);
    final key = stableKey(videoUrl);
    return _videoJobs.putIfAbsent(key, () async {
      try {
        final id = identify(videoUrl);
        return await _videoGate.run(
          () => OfflineMediaCache.instance.cacheFromUrl(
            bucket: id.bucket,
            objectPath: id.path,
            signedUrl: videoUrl,
            isVideo: true,
          ),
        );
      } catch (_) {
        return null;
      } finally {
        unawaited(Future<void>.microtask(() => _videoJobs.remove(key)));
      }
    });
  }

  /// Keeps the on-disk cache under [maxBytes] by deleting the oldest files.
  static Future<void> trimDiskCache({int maxBytes = 600 * 1024 * 1024}) async {
    try {
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 8));
      final support = await getApplicationSupportDirectory();
      final root = Directory(p.join(support.path, 'twice_media_cache'));
      if (!await root.exists()) return;
      final files = <File>[];
      var total = 0;
      await for (final e in root.list(recursive: true, followLinks: false)) {
        if (e is File) {
          files.add(e);
          total += await e.length();
        }
      }
      if (total <= maxBytes) return;
      final stats = <File, DateTime>{};
      for (final f in files) {
        stats[f] = (await f.stat()).modified;
      }
      files.sort((a, b) => stats[a]!.compareTo(stats[b]!));
      for (final f in files) {
        if (total <= maxBytes * 0.8) break;
        final size = await f.length();
        try {
          await f.delete();
          total -= size;
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

/// ImageProvider with a stable identity + disk cache (Facebook-style).
@immutable
class TwiceNetworkImage extends ImageProvider<TwiceNetworkImage> {
  const TwiceNetworkImage(this.url, {this.maxDimension = 1080});

  final String url;
  final int maxDimension;

  String get _stable => TwiceMedia.stableKey(url);

  @override
  Future<TwiceNetworkImage> obtainKey(ImageConfiguration configuration) =>
      SynchronousFuture<TwiceNetworkImage>(this);

  @override
  ImageStreamCompleter loadImage(
    TwiceNetworkImage key,
    ImageDecoderCallback decode,
  ) {
    return MultiFrameImageStreamCompleter(
      codec: _load(key, decode),
      scale: 1.0,
      debugLabel: key._stable,
      informationCollector: () => <DiagnosticsNode>[
        DiagnosticsProperty<ImageProvider>('Image provider', this),
      ],
    );
  }

  Future<ui.Codec> _load(
    TwiceNetworkImage key,
    ImageDecoderCallback decode,
  ) async {
    Uint8List? bytes;
    final file = await TwiceMedia.imageFile(key.url);
    if (file != null) {
      bytes = await file.readAsBytes();
    } else {
      bytes = await TwiceMedia._directBytes(key.url);
    }
    if (bytes == null || bytes.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('Twice image unavailable: ${key._stable}');
    }
    final buffer = await ui.ImmutableBuffer.fromUint8List(bytes);
    final limit = key.maxDimension;
    return decode(
      buffer,
      getTargetSize: (int w, int h) {
        final longest = math.max(w, h);
        if (longest <= limit) return ui.TargetImageSize(width: w, height: h);
        final s = limit / longest;
        return ui.TargetImageSize(
          width: math.max(1, (w * s).round()),
          height: math.max(1, (h * s).round()),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is TwiceNetworkImage &&
      other._stable == _stable &&
      other.maxDimension == maxDimension;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(_stable, maxDimension);

  @override
  String toString() => 'TwiceNetworkImage($_stable)';
}

/// Always-visible video poster: uploaded thumbnail, else generated frame.
class TwiceVideoPoster extends StatefulWidget {
  const TwiceVideoPoster({
    super.key,
    required this.videoUrl,
    required this.thumbnailUrl,
    required this.imageProviderFor,
    this.fit = BoxFit.contain,
    this.showPlayIcon = true,
  });

  final String videoUrl;
  final String thumbnailUrl;
  final ImageProvider<Object> Function(String source) imageProviderFor;
  final BoxFit fit;
  final bool showPlayIcon;

  @override
  State<TwiceVideoPoster> createState() => _TwiceVideoPosterState();
}

class _TwiceVideoPosterState extends State<TwiceVideoPoster> {
  Future<String?>? _generated;

  Future<String?> _generate() =>
      _generated ??= widget.videoUrl.isEmpty
      ? Future<String?>.value(null)
      : TwiceMedia.videoThumbnailFile(widget.videoUrl);

  Widget _image(ImageProvider<Object> provider, {Widget? onError}) => Image(
    image: provider,
    fit: widget.fit,
    width: double.infinity,
    height: double.infinity,
    gaplessPlayback: true,
    errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => onError ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
  );

  Widget _generatedPoster() => FutureBuilder<String?>(
    future: _generate(),
    builder: (context, snap) {
      final path = snap.data;
      if (path == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();
      return _image(
        ResizeImage.resizeIfNeeded(1080, null, FileImage(File(path))),
      );
    },
  );

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant TwiceVideoPoster oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (TwiceMedia.stableKey(oldWidget.videoUrl) !=
        TwiceMedia.stableKey(widget.videoUrl)) {
      _generated = null;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final thumb = widget.thumbnailUrl.trim();
    return ColoredBox(
      color: const Color(0xFF101114),
      child: Stack(
        fit: StackFit.expand,
        alignment: Alignment.center,
        children: [
          if (thumb.isNotEmpty)
            _image(
              widget.imageProviderFor(thumb),
              onError: _generatedPoster(),
            )
          else
            _generatedPoster(),
          if (widget.showPlayIcon)
            const Center(
              child: DecoratedBox(
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Color(0x73000000),
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                ),
                child: Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  child: Icon(
                    Icons.play_arrow_rounded,
                    color: Colors.white,
                    size: 40,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

ImageProvider<Object> _twiceImageProvider(
  String source, {
  int maxDimension = 1080,
}) {
  final value = source.trim();
  if (value.startsWith('file://')) {
    return ResizeImage.resizeIfNeeded(
      maxDimension,
      null,
      FileImage(File.fromUri(Uri.parse(value))),
    );
  }
  if (value.startsWith('/')) {
    return ResizeImage.resizeIfNeeded(
      maxDimension,
      null,
      FileImage(File(value)),
    );
  }
  return TwiceNetworkImage(value, maxDimension: maxDimension);
}

ImageProvider<Object> _twiceAvatarProvider(String source) =>
    _twiceImageProvider(source, maxDimension: 256);

String _formatClock(int seconds) =>
    '${seconds ~/ 60}:${(seconds % 60).toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

// A usable image source is a network URL OR a saved local copy (file:// or a
// device path). Saved avatars become file:// after they are cached.
bool _isImageSource(String value) {
  final v = value.trim();
  return v.startsWith('http') || v.startsWith('file://') || v.startsWith('/');
}

String _newTwiceUuid() {
  final random = Random.secure();
  final bytes = List<int>.generate(16, (_) => random.nextInt(256));
  bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
  bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
  final hex = bytes.map((b) => b.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0')).join();
  return '${hex.substring(0, 8)}-${hex.substring(8, 12)}-'
      '${hex.substring(12, 16)}-${hex.substring(16, 20)}-${hex.substring(20)}';
}

const supabaseUrl = String.fromEnvironment('SUPABASE_URL');
const supabasePublishableKey=
    [REDACTED]'SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY');

bool get supabaseConfigured =>
    supabaseUrl.startsWith('https://') && supabasePublishableKey.isNotEmpty;

// True only after Supabase has initialized successfully. If configuration is
// missing or initialization fails, the app still starts and shows its setup
// screen instead of remaining on Android's Flutter splash screen.
bool supabaseReady = false;
String? supabaseStartupError;

// BOOTFIX: the first frame is drawn immediately. Supabase starts in the
// background and the gate swaps from the splash to the app when it is ready.
final ValueNotifier<bool> supabaseBootFinished = ValueNotifier<bool>(false);

Future<void>? _bootFuture;

Future<void> _bootSupabase({bool isRetry = false}) {
  if (_bootFuture != null && !isRetry) return _bootFuture!;
  final future = _bootSupabaseImpl();
  _bootFuture = future;
  return future;
}

Future<void> _bootSupabaseImpl() async {
  final watch = Stopwatch()..start();
  if (!supabaseConfigured) {
    final missing = <String>[
      if (!supabaseUrl.startsWith('https://')) 'SUPABASE_URL',
      if (supabasePublishableKey.isEmpty) 'SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY',
    ];
    supabaseStartupError =
        'Missing or invalid build configuration: ${missing.join(', ')}. '
        'Check GitHub Repository secrets and rebuild the APK.';
  } else {
    try {
      if (!supabaseReady) {
        await Supabase.initialize(
          url: supabaseUrl,
          publishableKey: [REDACTED],
        ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
        supabaseReady = true;
        supabaseStartupError = null;
      }
    } catch (error, stackTrace) {
      debugPrint('Twice Supabase startup failed: $error');
      debugPrintStack(stackTrace: stackTrace);
      supabaseReady = false;
      final details = error
          .toString()
          .replaceAll(supabaseUrl, '[Supabase URL hidden]')
          .replaceAll(supabasePublishableKey, '[key hidden]');
      supabaseStartupError =
          'Supabase initialization failed (${error.runtimeType}): $details';
    }
  }
  debugPrint(
    'TWICE_BOOT supabase ready=$supabaseReady in ${watch.elapsedMilliseconds}ms',
  );
  supabaseBootFinished.value = true;
}

Future<void> main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  SystemChrome.setSystemUIOverlayStyle(
    SystemUiOverlayStyle.light.copyWith(
      statusBarColor: Colors.transparent,
      systemNavigationBarColor: igBlack,
      systemNavigationBarIconBrightness: Brightness.light,
    ),
  );
  TwiceMedia.configure();
  unawaited(LocalCache.instance.prewarm());
  runApp(const TwiceApp());
  unawaited(TwiceAds.init());
  unawaited(_bootSupabase());
  unawaited(TwiceMedia.trimDiskCache());
  unawaited(LocalCache.instance.pruneOldCacheEntries());
}

class NativeCore {
  NativeCore._() {
    try {
      final lib = DynamicLibrary.open('libtwice_native.so');
      _add = lib
          .lookupFunction<Int32 Function(Int32, Int32), int Function(int, int)>(
            'twice_native_add',
          );
    } catch (_) {
      // Keeps Flutter tests and non-Android preview environments usable.
      _add = null;
    }
  }

  static final NativeCore instance = NativeCore._();

  late final int Function(int, int)? _add;

  int add(int a, int b) => _add?.call(a, b) ?? a + b;

  bool get isLoaded => _add != null;
}

class TwiceApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const TwiceApp({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      title: 'Twice',
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
      themeMode: ThemeMode.dark,
      darkTheme: _twiceDarkTheme(),
      theme: _twiceDarkTheme(),
      home: const TwiceAuthGate(),
    );
  }
}

class TwiceAuthGate extends StatelessWidget {
  const TwiceAuthGate({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ValueListenableBuilder<bool>(
      valueListenable: supabaseBootFinished,
      builder: (context, finished, _) {
        if (!finished && supabaseConfigured) return const _TwiceSplash();
        if (!supabaseReady) {
          return TwiceSignInPage(
            configurationMissing: !supabaseConfigured,
            startupError: supabaseStartupError,
            onRetryStartup: supabaseConfigured
                ? () {
                    supabaseBootFinished.value = false;
                    _bootSupabase(isRetry: true);
                  }
                : null,
          );
        }
        return StreamBuilder<AuthState>(
          stream: Supabase.instance.client.auth.onAuthStateChange,
          builder: (context, snapshot) {
            final session = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentSession;
            if (session != null) return const TwiceShell();
            return const TwiceSignInPage();
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class TwiceSignInPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const TwiceSignInPage({
    super.key,
    this.configurationMissing = false,
    this.startupError,
    this.onRetryStartup,
  });

  final bool configurationMissing;
  final String? startupError;
  final VoidCallback? onRetryStartup;

  @override
  State<TwiceSignInPage> createState() => _TwiceSignInPageState();
}

class _TwiceSignInPageState extends State<TwiceSignInPage> {
  final _emailController = TextEditingController();
  final _codeController = TextEditingController();
  bool _loading = false;
  bool _codeSent = false;
  String? _error;
  String? _message;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _emailController.dispose();
    _codeController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String get _email => _emailController.text.trim().toLowerCase();

  Future<void> _sendCode() async {
    if (widget.configurationMissing || _loading) return;
    if (!_emailController.text.trim().contains('@')) {
      setState(() => _error = 'Enter a valid email address.');
      return;
    }

    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
      _message = null;
    });

    try {
      final localPart = _email.split('@').first;
      final username = localPart
          .toLowerCase()
          .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9_]'), '_')
          .replaceAll(RegExp(r'_+'), '_');
      final safeUsername = username.isEmpty
          ? 'twice_user'
          : username.substring(0, username.length > 24 ? 24 : username.length);

      final response = await Supabase.instance.client.functions.invoke(
        'twice-email-code',
        body: {
          'action': 'send_code',
          'email': _email,
          'username': safeUsername,
          'display_name': localPart,
        },
      );

      final data = response.data;
      if (response.status < 200 ||
          response.status >= 300 ||
          data is! Map ||
          data['ok'] != true) {
        throw Exception(
          data is Map
              ? (data['error'] ?? 'Could not send the verification code.')
              : 'Could not send the verification code.',
        );
      }

      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _codeSent = true;
        _message =
            'If this address can receive mail, a code has been sent. '
            'Check your inbox and spam folder.';
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _error = 'Could not send the code. ${e.toString()}';
      });
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _verifyCode() async {
    if (widget.configurationMissing || _loading) return;
    final code = _codeController.text.trim();
    if (!RegExp(r'^\d{6}$').hasMatch(code)) {
      setState(() => _error = 'Enter the six-digit code from your email.');
      return;
    }

    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
      _message = null;
    });

    try {
      final response = await Supabase.instance.client.functions.invoke(
        'twice-email-code',
        body: {'action': 'verify_code', 'email': _email, 'code': code},
      );

      final data = response.data;
      if (response.status < 200 ||
          response.status >= 300 ||
          data is! Map ||
          data['ok'] != true ||
          data['token_hash'] is! String) {
        throw Exception(
          data is Map
              ? (data['error'] ?? 'The code could not be verified.')
              : 'The code could not be verified.',
        );
      }

      final tokenHash = data['token_hash'] as String;
      await Supabase.instance.client.auth.verifyOTP(
        tokenHash: tokenHash,
        type: OtpType.magiclink,
      );

      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _message = 'Verified! Opening Twice...';
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _error = 'Verification failed. ${e.toString()}';
      });
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: canvas,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, constraints) => SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 28, vertical: 24),
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: BoxConstraints(
                minHeight: constraints.maxHeight - 48,
              ),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  const Center(child: _TwiceLogo(size: 58)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 30),
                  const Text(
                    'Welcome to Twice',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: ink,
                      fontSize: 30,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                      letterSpacing: -0.8,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  const Text(
                    'Your people. Your moments. All in one place.',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 15, height: 1.5),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 34),
                  TextField(
                    controller: _emailController,
                    enabled: !_loading && !_codeSent,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
                    textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                    autofillHints: const [AutofillHints.email],
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Email address',
                      hintText: 'you@example.com',
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.email_outlined),
                      filled: true,
                      fillColor: igElevated,
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF363636)),
                      ),
                      enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF363636)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (_codeSent) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    TextField(
                      controller: _codeController,
                      enabled: !_loading,
                      keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                      textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                      autofillHints: const [AutofillHints.oneTimeCode],
                      maxLength: 6,
                      inputFormatters: [
                        FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly,
                        LengthLimitingTextInputFormatter(6),
                      ],
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 25,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                        letterSpacing: 10,
                      ),
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Six-digit email code',
                        hintText: '000000',
                        counterText: '',
                        filled: true,
                        fillColor: igElevated,
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                  const SizedBox(height: 18),
                  FilledButton(
                    onPressed: _loading || widget.configurationMissing
                        ? null
                        : (_codeSent ? _verifyCode : _sendCode),
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                      minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(56),
                      backgroundColor: violet,
                      foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(17),
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: _loading
                        ? const SizedBox(
                            width: 22,
                            height: 22,
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                              strokeWidth: 2.5,
                              color: Colors.white,
                            ),
                          )
                        : Text(
                            _codeSent
                                ? 'Verify and continue'
                                : 'Send email code',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 15,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                            ),
                          ),
                  ),
                  if (_codeSent) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    TextButton(
                      onPressed: _loading
                          ? null
                          : () {
                              setState(() {
                                _codeSent = false;
                                _codeController.clear();
                                _error = null;
                                _message = null;
                              });
                            },
                      child: const Text('Use a different email address'),
                    ),
                    TextButton(
                      onPressed: _loading ? null : _sendCode,
                      child: const Text('Resend code'),
                    ),
                  ],
                  if (widget.configurationMissing || widget.startupError != null) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 18),
                    _ErrorPanel(
                      message: widget.startupError ?? 'Supabase configuration is missing. Check the GitHub Actions build secrets.',
                    ),
                    if (widget.onRetryStartup != null) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                      OutlinedButton.icon(
                        onPressed: _loading ? null : widget.onRetryStartup,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded, size: 16),
                        label: const Text('Retry Connection'),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                  if (_error != null) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    _ErrorPanel(message: _error!),
                  ],
                  if (_message != null) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    Text(
                      _message!,
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        color: Color(0xFF287A45),
                        fontSize: 13,
                        height: 1.5,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                  const SizedBox(height: 30),
                  const Text(
                    'Secure email verification powered by Supabase.',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 12),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 20),
                  const Text(
                    "By continuing, you agree to Twice's Terms of Service "
                    'and Privacy Policy.',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 11, height: 1.6),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class SocialPost {
  SocialPost(this.data);
  final Map<String, dynamic> data;
  String get id => data['id'].toString();
  String get caption => (data['caption'] ?? '').toString();
  Map<String, dynamic> get author =>
      Map<String, dynamic>.from(data['profiles'] as Map? ?? const {});
  String get name =>
      (author['display_name'] ?? author['username'] ?? 'Twice user').toString();
  String get username => (author['username'] ?? 'user').toString();
  String get handle => '@$username';
  String? get avatarUrl => author['avatar_url']?.toString();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get media =>
      (data['media_resolved'] as List? ?? const [])
          .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
          .toList();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get likesRows =>
      (data['post_likes'] as List? ?? const [])
          .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
          .toList();
  bool get liked => likesRows.any(
    (e) => e['user_id'] == Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id,
  );
  int get likes => likesRows.length;
  int get commentCount {
    final raw = data['comments'];
    if (raw is List && raw.isNotEmpty && raw.first is Map) {
      return int.tryParse((raw.first as Map)['count'].toString()) ?? 0;
    }
    return 0;
  }

  bool get saved =>
      ((data['saved_posts'] as List? ?? const []).cast<Map>()).any(
        (e) => e['user_id'] == Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id,
      );
}

class TwiceShell extends StatefulWidget {
  const TwiceShell({super.key});
  @override
  State<TwiceShell> createState() => _TwiceShellState();
}

class _TwiceShellState extends State<TwiceShell> with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  final repo = SocialRepository.instance;
  int selected = 0;
  bool loading = true;
  String? error;
  Map<String, dynamic> profile = {};
  List<SocialPost> posts = [];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> stories = [];
  final GlobalKey<StoryStripState> _storyStripKey =
      GlobalKey<StoryStripState>();

  DateTime? _lastResumeRefresh;
  bool _refreshingOnResume = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    InboxController.instance.start();
    _loadAll();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    if (state != AppLifecycleState.resumed || !mounted) return;

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final previous = _lastResumeRefresh;
    if (previous != null &&
        now.difference(previous) < const Duration(seconds: 15)) {
      return;
    }

    _lastResumeRefresh = now;
    _refreshAfterResume();
  }

  Future<void> _refreshAfterResume() async {
    if (_refreshingOnResume || !mounted) return;
    _refreshingOnResume = true;

    try {
      await repo.syncPendingLikes();
      if (mounted) await _refreshQuietly();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Twice background refresh deferred: $e');
    } finally {
      _refreshingOnResume = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _refreshQuietly() async {
    if (!mounted) return;

    try {
      final values = await Future.wait<dynamic>([
        repo.myProfile(),
        repo.feed(),
        repo.loadStories(),
      ]);
      if (!mounted) return;

      final freshProfile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(values[0] as Map);
      final freshRows = values[1] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
      final freshStories = values[2] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;

      void preserveAvatar(
        Map<String, dynamic> fresh,
        Map<String, dynamic> old,
      ) {
        final freshPath = fresh['avatar_object_path']?.toString() ?? '';
        final oldPath = old['avatar_object_path']?.toString() ?? '';
        if (freshPath.isNotEmpty && freshPath == oldPath) {
          fresh['avatar_url'] = old['avatar_url'];
        }
      }

      preserveAvatar(freshProfile, profile);

      final existingPosts = <String, SocialPost>{
        for (final post in posts) post.id: post,
      };
      final mergedPosts = <SocialPost>[];

      for (final raw in freshRows) {
        final incoming = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);
        final id = (incoming['id'] ?? '').toString();
        final existing = existingPosts[id];

        if (existing != null) {
          final oldData = existing.data;
          final oldAuthor = oldData['profiles'];
          final newAuthor = incoming['profiles'];

          if (oldAuthor is Map && newAuthor is Map) {
            final oldProfile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(oldAuthor);
            final newProfile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(newAuthor);
            preserveAvatar(newProfile, oldProfile);
            incoming['profiles'] = newProfile;
          }

          final oldMedia = oldData['media_resolved'];
          final newMedia = incoming['media_resolved'];

          if (oldMedia is List && newMedia is List) {
            for (final item in newMedia) {
              if (item is! Map) continue;
              final freshMedia = Map<String, dynamic>.from(item);
              final match = oldMedia
                  .whereType<Map>()
                  .where(
                    (old) =>
                        old['id'] == freshMedia['id'] &&
                        old['media_url'] == freshMedia['media_url'],
                  )
                  .firstOrNull;

              if (match != null) {
                // Preserve offline files, never reuse potentially expired
                // signed network URLs from the previous feed snapshot.
                final cachedMediaUrl = (match['resolved_url'] ?? '').toString();
                if (cachedMediaUrl.startsWith('file://')) {
                  freshMedia['resolved_url'] = cachedMediaUrl;
                }

                final cachedThumbnailUrl =
                    (match['resolved_thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString();
                if (match['thumbnail_url'] == freshMedia['thumbnail_url'] &&
                    cachedThumbnailUrl.startsWith('file://')) {
                  freshMedia['resolved_thumbnail_url'] = cachedThumbnailUrl;
                }
              }

              final index = newMedia.indexOf(item);
              newMedia[index] = freshMedia;
            }
          }

          // Keep the SocialPost instance alive for this post ID.
          existing.data
            ..clear()
            ..addAll(incoming);
          mergedPosts.add(existing);
        } else {
          mergedPosts.add(SocialPost(incoming));
        }
      }

      final oldStoriesById = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{
        for (final story in stories) (story['id'] ?? '').toString(): story,
      };
      final mergedStories = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];

      for (final raw in freshStories) {
        final fresh = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);
        final old = oldStoriesById[(fresh['id'] ?? '').toString()];

        if (old != null) {
          if (old['media_url'] == fresh['media_url']) {
            for (final key in ['resolved_url', 'resolved_thumbnail_url']) {
              final cachedUrl = (old[key] ?? '').toString();
              // Keep only local cached files; fresh network URLs must win.
              if (cachedUrl.startsWith('file://')) {
                fresh[key] = cachedUrl;
              }
            }
          }

          final oldAuthor = old['profiles'];
          final newAuthor = fresh['profiles'];
          if (oldAuthor is Map && newAuthor is Map) {
            final author = Map<String, dynamic>.from(newAuthor);
            preserveAvatar(author, Map<String, dynamic>.from(oldAuthor));
            fresh['profiles'] = author;
          }
        }
        mergedStories.add(fresh);
      }

      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        profile = freshProfile;
        posts = mergedPosts;
        stories = mergedStories;
        error = null;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      // A failed background refresh must not blank or interrupt the feed.
      debugPrint('Twice quiet refresh deferred: $e');
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    InboxController.instance.stop();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _syncPendingLikes() async {
    try {
      await repo.syncPendingLikes();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Twice pending-like sync deferred: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadAll() async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    _syncPendingLikes(); // Replay in background; show cached content immediately.

    // 1. Render durable local cache immediately (instant cold-start paint).
    try {
      final cached = await Future.wait<dynamic>([
        repo.cachedMyProfile(),
        repo.cachedFeed(),
        repo.cachedStories(),
      ]);
      if (!mounted) return;
      final cachedProfile = cached[0];
      final cachedPosts = cached[1] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
      final cachedStories = cached[2] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
      if (cachedProfile is Map ||
          cachedPosts.isNotEmpty ||
          cachedStories.isNotEmpty) {
        setState(() {
          if (cachedProfile is Map) {
            profile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(cachedProfile);
          }
          if (cachedPosts.isNotEmpty) {
            posts = cachedPosts.map(SocialPost.new).toList();
          }
          if (cachedStories.isNotEmpty) {
            stories = cachedStories;
          }
          loading = false;
          error = null;
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {
      /* A cold install simply has an empty cache. */
    }

    if (posts.isEmpty && profile.isEmpty) {
      setState(() {
        loading = true;
        error = null;
      });
    }

    // 2. Fetch fresh data in the background and update smoothly.
    var anySuccess = false;
    Object? firstError;
    Future<void> run<T>(Future<T> work, void Function(T value) apply) async {
      try {
        final value = await work.timeout(const Duration(seconds: 25));
        if (!mounted) return;
        setState(() {
          apply(value);
          if (profile.isNotEmpty || posts.isNotEmpty) loading = false;
          error = null;
        });
        anySuccess = true;
      } catch (e) {
        firstError ??= e;
      }
    }

    await Future.wait<void>([
      run<Map<String, dynamic>>(
        repo.myProfile(),
        (value) => profile = Map<String, dynamic>.from(value),
      ),
      run<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
        repo.feed(),
        (value) => posts = value.map(SocialPost.new).toList(),
      ),
      run<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
        repo.loadStories(),
        (value) => stories = value,
      ),
    ]);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      loading = false;
      error = anySuccess || posts.isNotEmpty || profile.isNotEmpty
          ? null
          : _friendlyError(firstError ?? 'Unable to load.');
    });
  }

  String _friendlyError(Object e) {
    final text = e.toString();
    final lower = text.toLowerCase();
    if (lower.contains('socketexception') ||
        lower.contains('failed host lookup') ||
        lower.contains('clientexception') ||
        lower.contains('connection reset') ||
        lower.contains('connection refused') ||
        lower.contains('connection aborted') ||
        lower.contains('connection closed') ||
        lower.contains('connection terminated') ||
        lower.contains('network is unreachable') ||
        lower.contains('handshakeexception') ||
        lower.contains('broken pipe') ||
        lower.contains('timed out') ||
        lower.contains('timeout')) {
      return 'Unable to reach the server right now. Check your connection and retry.';
    }
    if (text.contains('duplicate key') || text.contains('23505')) {
      return 'That username is already taken. Edit your profile to choose another.';
    }
    return text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
  }

  Future<void> _like(SocialPost post) async {
    final wasLiked = post.liked;
    setState(() {
      final rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
        post.data['post_likes'] as List? ?? [],
      );
      final uid = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser!.id;
      if (wasLiked) {
        rows.removeWhere((e) => e['user_id'] == uid);
      } else {
        rows.add({'user_id': uid});
      }
      post.data['post_likes'] = rows;
    });
    try {
      await repo.toggleLike(post.id, wasLiked);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        final rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
          post.data['post_likes'] as List? ?? [],
        );
        final uid = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
        rows.removeWhere((row) => row['user_id'] == uid);
        if (wasLiked && uid != null) rows.add({'user_id': uid});
        post.data['post_likes'] = rows;
      });
      _message('Like could not sync: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _publish(
    String caption,
    List<AssetEntity> media,
    String visibility,
  ) async {
    try {
      await repo.publishPost(caption, media, visibility: visibility);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => selected = 0);
      await _loadAll();
      if (mounted) _message('Post published.');
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) _message('Could not publish: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  void _openComposer() {
    Navigator.of(context).push<void>(
      PageRouteBuilder<void>(
        transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 380),
        reverseTransitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
        pageBuilder: (_, animation, secondaryAnimation) =>
            CreatePage(onPost: _publish, profile: profile),
        transitionsBuilder: (_, animation, secondaryAnimation, child) {
          final curved = CurvedAnimation(
            parent: animation,
            curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
            reverseCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,
          );
          return FadeTransition(
            opacity: curved,
            child: ScaleTransition(
              scale: Tween<double>(begin: 0.97, end: 1).animate(curved),
              child: child,
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  void _message(String message) =>
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
          .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(message)));

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Tabs (Instagram order): Home, Search, Create (+), Reels, Profile.
    // Page index 3 is the notifications page, opened from the heart icon in
    // the top bar, so no tab is highlighted while it is open.
    final avatarUrl = (profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString();
    final avatarFallback =
        (profile['display_name'] ?? profile['username'] ?? 'U').toString();

    PreferredSizeWidget? appBar;
    if (selected == 0) {
      appBar = AppBar(
        toolbarHeight: 44,
        backgroundColor: igBlack,
        titleSpacing: 14,
        title: const _TwiceLogo(size: 30),
        actions: [
          _InboxHeartButton(onTap: () => setState(() => selected = 3)),
          IconButton(
            tooltip: 'Messages',
            onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).push(
              MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                builder: (_) => const messaging.MessagesPage(),
              ),
            ),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.send_outlined, size: 25),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 4),
        ],
      );
    } else if (selected == 3) {
      appBar = AppBar(
        toolbarHeight: 44,
        backgroundColor: igBlack,
        leading: IconButton(
          tooltip: 'Back',
          onPressed: () => setState(() => selected = 0),
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new_rounded, size: 20),
        ),
        title: const Text(
          'Notifications',
          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 20),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: igBlack,
      appBar: appBar,
      body: loading && profile.isEmpty
          ? const _FeedSkeleton()
          : error != null && profile.isEmpty
          ? _ErrorPanel(message: error!)
          : IndexedStack(
              index: selected,
              children: [
                FeedPage(
                  storyStripKey: _storyStripKey,
                  profile: profile,
                  stories: stories,
                  onCreateStory: (asset, caption) async {
                    await repo.publishStory(asset, caption);
                    await _loadAll();
                  },
                  posts: posts,
                  onLike: _like,
                  onRefresh: _loadAll,
                  onOpenComposer: _openComposer,
                  onCommentChanged: () {
                    if (mounted) setState(() {});
                  },
                ),
                const SearchPage(),
                VideosPage(
                  active: selected == 2,
                  profile: profile,
                  onCreate: _openComposer,
                ),
                ActivityPage(active: selected == 3),
                ProfilePage(
                  profile: profile,
                  posts: posts,
                  onRefresh: _loadAll,
                ),
              ],
            ),
      bottomNavigationBar: Container(
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          color: igBlack,
          border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: igBorder, width: 0.5)),
        ),
        child: SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: SizedBox(
            height: 49,
            child: Row(
              children: [
                _IgTabButton(
                  label: 'Home',
                  active: selected == 0,
                  onTap: () => setState(() => selected = 0),
                  icon: const _SocialNavIcon(kind: _SocialNavKind.home),
                  activeIcon: const _SocialNavIcon(
                    kind: _SocialNavKind.home,
                    selected: true,
                  ),
                ),
                _IgTabButton(
                  label: 'Search',
                  active: selected == 1,
                  onTap: () => setState(() => selected = 1),
                  icon: const _SocialNavIcon(kind: _SocialNavKind.search),
                  activeIcon: const _SocialNavIcon(
                    kind: _SocialNavKind.search,
                    selected: true,
                  ),
                ),
                _IgTabButton(
                  label: 'Create',
                  active: false,
                  onTap: _openComposer,
                  icon: const _SocialNavIcon(kind: _SocialNavKind.plus),
                  activeIcon: const _SocialNavIcon(
                    kind: _SocialNavKind.plus,
                    selected: true,
                  ),
                ),
                _IgTabButton(
                  label: 'Reels',
                  active: selected == 2,
                  onTap: () => setState(() => selected = 2),
                  icon: const _SocialNavIcon(kind: _SocialNavKind.create),
                  activeIcon: const _SocialNavIcon(
                    kind: _SocialNavKind.create,
                    selected: true,
                  ),
                ),
                _IgTabButton(
                  label: 'Profile',
                  active: selected == 4,
                  onTap: () => setState(() => selected = 4),
                  icon: _ProfileNavAvatar(
                    url: avatarUrl,
                    fallback: avatarFallback,
                    selected: false,
                  ),
                  activeIcon: _ProfileNavAvatar(
                    url: avatarUrl,
                    fallback: avatarFallback,
                    selected: true,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// "Twice" script logo shown top-left on the home feed.
class _TwiceLogo extends StatelessWidget {
  const _TwiceLogo({this.size = 30});

  final double size;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Text(
    'Twice',
    style: TextStyle(
      fontFamily: 'cursive',
      fontFamilyFallback: const ['Billabong', 'Dancing Script', 'serif'],
      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
      fontSize: size,
      height: 1.1,
    ),
  );
}

/// Heart icon in the top bar. Opens notifications; red badge = unread count.
class _InboxHeartButton extends StatelessWidget {
  const _InboxHeartButton({required this.onTap});

  final VoidCallback onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ListenableBuilder(
      listenable: InboxController.instance,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final count = InboxController.instance.unread;
        return IconButton(
          tooltip: 'Notifications',
          onPressed: onTap,
          icon: Badge(
            isLabelVisible: count > 0,
            label: Text(count > 99 ? '99+' : '$count'),
            backgroundColor: igRed,
            textColor: Colors.white,
            offset: const Offset(5, -5),
            child: const Icon(Icons.inbox_outlined, size: 27),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

/// Bottom tab. Tapping squeezes the icon to 90% and springs it back
/// (100 ms elastic), like the Instagram tab bar.
class _IgTabButton extends StatefulWidget {
  const _IgTabButton({
    required this.label,
    required this.active,
    required this.onTap,
    required this.icon,
    required this.activeIcon,
  });

  final String label;
  final bool active;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final Widget icon;
  final Widget activeIcon;

  @override
  State<_IgTabButton> createState() => _IgTabButtonState();
}

class _IgTabButtonState extends State<_IgTabButton>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _press = AnimationController(
    vsync: this,
    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 100),
  );
  late final Animation<double> _scale = TweenSequence<double>([
    TweenSequenceItem(
      tween: Tween(
        begin: 1.0,
        end: 0.9,
      ).chain(CurveTween(curve: Curves.easeOut)),
      weight: 35,
    ),
    TweenSequenceItem(
      tween: Tween(
        begin: 0.9,
        end: 1.0,
      ).chain(CurveTween(curve: Curves.elasticOut)),
      weight: 65,
    ),
  ]).animate(_press);

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _press.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Expanded(
    child: Semantics(
      button: true,
      selected: widget.active,
      label: widget.label,
      child: InkResponse(
        containedInkWell: true,
        highlightShape: BoxShape.rectangle,
        splashColor: Colors.transparent,
        highlightColor: Colors.transparent,
        onTap: () {
          _press.forward(from: 0);
          widget.onTap();
        },
        child: Center(
          child: ScaleTransition(
            scale: _scale,
            child: widget.active ? widget.activeIcon : widget.icon,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

class StoryStrip extends StatefulWidget {
  const StoryStrip({
    super.key,
    required this.onCreateStory,
    required this.profile,
    required this.stories,
  });

  final Future<void> Function(AssetEntity asset, String caption) onCreateStory;
  final Map<String, dynamic> profile;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> stories;

  @override
  State<StoryStrip> createState() => StoryStripState();
}

class StoryStripState extends State<StoryStrip> {
  final Set<String> _viewedStoryIds = <String>{};
  bool _viewedStoriesLoaded = false;

  String get _storyViewsCacheKey =>
      Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id ?? '';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _restoreViewedStories();
  }

  Future<void> _restoreViewedStories() async {
    final uid = _storyViewsCacheKey;
    if (uid.isEmpty) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _viewedStoriesLoaded = true);
      return;
    }
    try {
      final saved = await LocalCache.instance.get(uid, 'viewed_stories');
      if (saved is List) {
        _viewedStoryIds.addAll(
          saved.map((value) => value.toString()).where((id) => id.isNotEmpty),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Could not restore viewed stories: $e');
    }
    if (mounted) setState(() => _viewedStoriesLoaded = true);
    unawaited(_syncViewedFromServer());
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant StoryStrip oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.stories.length != widget.stories.length) {
      unawaited(_syncViewedFromServer());
    }
  }

  // The server remembers every story this account has opened, so the ring is
  // grey on all devices (and after a reinstall), like Instagram / Facebook.
  Future<void> _syncViewedFromServer() async {
    if (_storyViewsCacheKey.isEmpty || widget.stories.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      final ids = await SocialRepository.instance.myViewedStoryIds(
        widget.stories.map((s) => (s['id'] ?? '').toString()),
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      final before = _viewedStoryIds.length;
      _viewedStoryIds.addAll(ids);
      if (_viewedStoryIds.length != before) {
        setState(() {});
        _persistViewed();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Could not sync viewed stories: $e');
    }
  }

  void _persistViewed() {
    final uid = _storyViewsCacheKey;
    if (uid.isEmpty) return;
    LocalCache.instance
        .put(uid, 'viewed_stories', _viewedStoryIds.toList())
        .catchError((Object e) {
          debugPrint('Could not save viewed stories: $e');
        });
  }

  void _markStoryViewed(String storyId) {
    if (storyId.isEmpty || !_viewedStoryIds.add(storyId)) return;
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
    _persistViewed();
  }

  Future<void> openCreator() async {
    final context = this.context;
    final permission = await PhotoManager.requestPermissionExtend();
    if (!permission.isAuth && !permission.hasAccess) {
      if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('Allow photo access to create a story.'),
          ),
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    final imagePaths = await PhotoManager.getAssetPathList(
      type: RequestType.image,
      onlyAll: true,
    );
    final videoPaths = await PhotoManager.getAssetPathList(
      type: RequestType.video,
      onlyAll: true,
    );
    final assets = <AssetEntity>[];
    if (imagePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      assets.addAll(
        await imagePaths.first.getAssetListPaged(page: 0, size: 100),
      );
    }
    if (videoPaths.isNotEmpty) {
      assets.addAll(
        await videoPaths.first.getAssetListPaged(page: 0, size: 100),
      );
    }
    assets.sort(
      (a, b) => (b.createDateSecond ?? 0).compareTo(a.createDateSecond ?? 0),
    );

    if (!context.mounted) return;
    if (assets.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('No photos or videos found.')),
      );
      return;
    }

    final asset = await showModalBottomSheet<AssetEntity>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (sheetContext) => SafeArea(
        child: SizedBox(
          height: MediaQuery.of(sheetContext).size.height * .68,
          child: Column(
            children: [
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
                child: Text(
                  'Choose a photo or video (videos up to 1 min)',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                ),
              ),
              Expanded(
                child: GridView.builder(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
                    crossAxisCount: 3,
                    crossAxisSpacing: 4,
                    mainAxisSpacing: 4,
                  ),
                  itemCount: assets.length,
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                    final item = assets[index];
                    final tooLong =
                        item.type == AssetType.video && item.duration > 60;
                    return FutureBuilder<Uint8List?>(
                      future: item.thumbnailDataWithSize(
                        const ThumbnailSize(240, 240),
                      ),
                      builder: (context, snapshot) => InkWell(
                        onTap: tooLong
                            ? null
                            : () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, item),
                        child: Stack(
                          fit: StackFit.expand,
                          children: [
                            if (snapshot.data != null)
                              Image.memory(snapshot.data!, fit: BoxFit.cover)
                            else
                              const ColoredBox(
                                color: Color(0xFF262626),
                                child: Icon(Icons.image_outlined),
                              ),
                            if (item.type == AssetType.video)
                              Positioned(
                                right: 6,
                                bottom: 6,
                                child: Container(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                    horizontal: 6,
                                    vertical: 2,
                                  ),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: Colors.black54,
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                  ),
                                  child: Text(
                                    _formatClock(item.duration),
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                      color: Colors.white,
                                      fontSize: 11,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            if (tooLong)
                              const ColoredBox(
                                color: Color(0xB3000000),
                                child: Center(
                                  child: Text(
                                    'Max 1 min',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                      color: Colors.white,
                                      fontSize: 12,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (asset == null || !context.mounted) return;

    final controller = TextEditingController();
    final caption = await showModalBottomSheet<String>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (sheetContext) => Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
          16,
          20,
          16,
          MediaQuery.of(sheetContext).viewInsets.bottom + 16,
        ),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            const Text(
              'Create story',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextField(
              controller: controller,
              maxLength: 300,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'Write a caption (optional)',
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              child: FilledButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, controller.text),
                child: const Text('Share story'),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    controller.dispose();
    if (caption == null || !context.mounted) return;

    try {
      await widget.onCreateStory(asset, caption);
      if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Story shared for 24 hours.')),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
            .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Could not share story: $e')));
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final ownId = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id ?? '';
    final grouped = <String, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>{};
    for (final story in widget.stories) {
      final uid = (story['user_id'] ?? '').toString();
      if (uid.isNotEmpty) (grouped[uid] ??= []).add(story);
    }
    final ownStories = grouped.remove(ownId) ?? [];
    bool seen(List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows) => rows.every(
      (story) => _viewedStoryIds.contains((story['id'] ?? '').toString()),
    );
    // Unseen stories first, already-viewed (grey ring) ones move to the end,
    // exactly like Instagram. Order inside each group is kept stable.
    final otherIds = grouped.keys.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) {
        final sa = _viewedStoriesLoaded && seen(grouped[a]!) ? 1 : 0;
        final sb = _viewedStoriesLoaded && seen(grouped[b]!) ? 1 : 0;
        return sa.compareTo(sb);
      });

    return Container(
      height: 108,
      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
        border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: igBorder, width: 0.5)),
      ),
      child: ListView(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 8),
        children: [
          _storyCircle(
            context,
            profile: widget.profile,
            stories: ownStories,
            label: 'Your story',
            own: true,
          ),
          ...otherIds.map((uid) {
            final rows = grouped[uid]!;
            final user = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
              rows.first['profiles'] as Map? ?? const {},
            );
            final label =
                (user['display_name'] ?? user['username'] ?? 'Twice user')
                    .toString();
            return _storyCircle(
              context,
              profile: user,
              stories: rows,
              label: label,
              own: false,
            );
          }),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _storyCircle(
    BuildContext context, {
    required Map<String, dynamic> profile,
    required List<Map<String, dynamic>> stories,
    required String label,
    required bool own,
  }) {
    final avatar = (profile['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final allViewed =
        stories.isNotEmpty &&
        stories.every(
          (story) => _viewedStoryIds.contains((story['id'] ?? '').toString()),
        );
    return SizedBox(
      width: 76,
      child: InkWell(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(42),
        onTap: () {
          if (stories.isEmpty) {
            if (own) openCreator();
            return;
          }
          Navigator.of(context).push(
            PageRouteBuilder<void>(
              opaque: true,
              transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 360),
              pageBuilder: (_, animation, _) => StoryViewer(
                stories: stories,
                initialProfile: profile,
                onStoryViewed: (storyId) {
                  if (mounted) _markStoryViewed(storyId);
                },
              ),
              transitionsBuilder: (_, animation, _, child) => FadeTransition(
                opacity: animation,
                child: ScaleTransition(
                  scale: Tween<double>(begin: .88, end: 1).animate(
                    CurvedAnimation(
                      parent: animation,
                      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: child,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Stack(
              clipBehavior: Clip.none,
              children: [
                // Ring: pink/orange gradient while there is something new,
                // flat grey once every story of this person has been seen.
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(2),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    gradient:
                        stories.isNotEmpty && !allViewed && _viewedStoriesLoaded
                        ? igStoryGradient
                        : null,
                    border: stories.isEmpty
                        ? null
                        : (allViewed && _viewedStoriesLoaded)
                        ? Border.all(color: igSeenRing, width: 1.5)
                        : null,
                  ),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(2),
                    decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      color: igBlack,
                    ),
                    child: CircleAvatar(
                      radius: 28,
                      backgroundColor: igElevated,
