class ConversationPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ConversationPage({
    super.key,
    required this.conversationId,
    required this.title,
    this.otherUserId = '',
    this.otherAvatar = '',
    this.otherUsername = '',
  });

  final String conversationId;
  final String title;
  final String otherUserId;
  final String otherAvatar;
  final String otherUsername;

  @override
  State<ConversationPage> createState() => _ConversationPageState();
}

class _ConversationPageState extends State<ConversationPage> {
  final _controller = TextEditingController();
  final _scroll = ScrollController();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _messages = [];
  bool _loading = true;
  bool _sending = false;
  String? _error;
  RealtimeChannel? _channel;
  final Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> _senderCache = {};
  bool _attachmentRefreshScheduled = false;

  void _scheduleAttachmentRefresh() {
    if (_attachmentRefreshScheduled) return;
    _attachmentRefreshScheduled = true;
    Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 300), () {
      _attachmentRefreshScheduled = false;
      if (mounted) unawaited(_refreshMessagesQuietly());
    });
  }

  String get _myId => Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id ?? '';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
    _subscribe();
    InboxController.instance.markConversationRead(widget.conversationId);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    _scroll.dispose();
    final ch = _channel;
    if (ch != null) {
      unawaited(Supabase.instance.client.removeChannel(ch));
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _subscribe() {
    _channel = Supabase.instance.client
        .channel('chat-${widget.conversationId}')
        .onPostgresChanges(
          event: PostgresChangeEvent.insert,
          schema: 'public',
          table: 'messages',
          filter: PostgresChangeFilter(
            type: PostgresChangeFilterType.eq,
            column: 'conversation_id',
            value: widget.conversationId,
          ),
          callback: (payload) {
            final row = Map<String, dynamic>.from(payload.newRecord);
            if (_messages.any((m) => m['id'] == row['id'])) return;
            unawaited(_refreshMessagesQuietly());
          },
        )
        .onPostgresChanges(
          event: PostgresChangeEvent.insert,
          schema: 'public',
          table: 'message_attachments',
          filter: PostgresChangeFilter(
            type: PostgresChangeFilterType.eq,
            column: 'conversation_id',
            value: widget.conversationId,
          ),
          callback: (_) => _scheduleAttachmentRefresh(),
        )
        .subscribe();
  }

  Future<void> _refreshMessagesQuietly() async {
    try {
      final rows = await SocialRepository.instance
          .messagesDetailed(widget.conversationId);
      if (!mounted) return;

      for (final r in rows) {
        final sid = (r['sender_id'] ?? '').toString();
        final profile = r['sender_profile'];
        if (sid.isNotEmpty && profile is Map) {
          _senderCache[sid] = Map<String, dynamic>.from(profile);
        }
      }

      // Merge server rows with pending local bubbles. Never show the loading
      // skeleton during a background refresh.
      final merged = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(rows);
      final pending = _messages.where(
        (m) => (m['id'] ?? '').toString().startsWith('local-'),
      );

      for (final local in pending) {
        final localId = (local['id'] ?? '').toString();
        final localTime = DateTime.tryParse(
          (local['created_at'] ?? '').toString(),
        );
        final confirmed = merged.any((m) {
          final serverTime = DateTime.tryParse(
            (m['created_at'] ?? '').toString(),
          );
          return (m['sender_id'] ?? '').toString() ==
                  (local['sender_id'] ?? '').toString() &&
              (m['body'] ?? '').toString() ==
                  (local['body'] ?? '').toString() &&
              serverTime != null &&
              localTime != null &&
              serverTime.difference(localTime).inSeconds.abs() < 120;
        });

        if (confirmed) {
          final matchIndex = merged.indexWhere((m) {
            final serverTime = DateTime.tryParse(
              (m['created_at'] ?? '').toString(),
            );
            return (m['sender_id'] ?? '').toString() ==
                    (local['sender_id'] ?? '').toString() &&
                (m['body'] ?? '').toString() ==
                    (local['body'] ?? '').toString() &&
                serverTime != null &&
                localTime != null &&
                serverTime.difference(localTime).inSeconds.abs() < 120;
          });
          if (matchIndex >= 0) {
            merged[matchIndex]['_ui_id'] = localId;
          }
        } else if (!merged.any((m) => (m['id'] ?? '').toString() == localId)) {
          merged.add(local);
        }
      }

      merged.sort((a, b) {
        final at = DateTime.tryParse((a['created_at'] ?? '').toString()) ??
            DateTime(1970);
        final bt = DateTime.tryParse((b['created_at'] ?? '').toString()) ??
            DateTime(1970);
        return at.compareTo(bt);
      });

      final oldIds = _messages.map((m) => '${m['id']}').join('|');
      final newIds = merged.map((m) => '${m['id']}').join('|');
      if (oldIds != newIds) {
        setState(() => _messages = merged);
        _scrollToBottom();
      }

      InboxController.instance.markConversationRead(widget.conversationId);
    } catch (_) {
      // Background refresh failures must not interrupt the visible chat.
    }
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final rows = await SocialRepository.instance
          .messagesDetailed(widget.conversationId);
      if (!mounted) return;
      // Pre-cache sender profiles that came back
      for (final r in rows) {
        final sid = (r['sender_id'] ?? '').toString();
        final p = r['sender_profile'];
        if (sid.isNotEmpty && p is Map) {
          _senderCache[sid] = Map<String, dynamic>.from(p);
        }
      }
      setState(() {
        _messages = rows;
        _loading = false;
      });
      _scrollToBottom(jump: true);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _error = e.toString();
        _loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  void _scrollToBottom({bool jump = false}) {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (!mounted || !_scroll.hasClients) return;
      final target = _scroll.position.maxScrollExtent;
      if (jump) {
        _scroll.jumpTo(target);
      } else {
        _scroll.animateTo(
          target,
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 320),
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
        );
        // Recheck after the list finishes laying out the newest bubble.
        WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
          if (!mounted || !_scroll.hasClients) return;
          final latest = _scroll.position.maxScrollExtent;
          if ((_scroll.position.pixels - latest).abs() > 24) {
            _scroll.animateTo(
              latest,
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
              curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
            );
          }
        });
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _sendText() async {
    final body = _controller.text.trim();
    if (body.isEmpty || _sending) return;

    final now = DateTime.now().toUtc();
    final localId = 'local-${now.microsecondsSinceEpoch}';
    final optimistic = <String, dynamic>{
      'id': localId,
      '_ui_id': localId,
      'conversation_id': widget.conversationId,
      'sender_id': _myId,
      'body': body,
      'media_url': null,
      'media_type': null,
      'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
    };

    // Display and animate immediately; do not wait for Supabase.
    setState(() {
      _sending = true;
      _messages = [..._messages, optimistic];
    });
    _scrollToBottom();
    unawaited(SystemSound.play(SystemSoundType.click).catchError((_) {}));

    try {
      await SocialRepository.instance.sendMessage(
        widget.conversationId,
        body,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      _controller.clear();
      // Confirm in the background; Realtime and this refresh are deduplicated.
      unawaited(_refreshMessagesQuietly());
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _messages.removeWhere((m) => m['id'] == localId);
        });
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Send failed: $e')),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _sending = false);
    }
  }


  Future<void> _captureFromCamera() async {
    if (_sending) return;
    try {
      final picked = await ImagePicker().pickImage(
        source: ImageSource.camera,
        imageQuality: 92,
      );
      if (picked == null || !mounted) return;
      setState(() => _sending = true);
      await SocialRepository.instance.sendMediaMessage(
        conversationId: widget.conversationId,
        file: File(picked.path),
        mediaType: 'image',
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Camera failed: $e')),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _sending = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openGifPicker() async {
    if (_sending) return;
    final gif = await showModalBottomSheet<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: _igSurface,
      builder: (_) => const _TwiceGifPicker(),
    );
    if (gif == null || !mounted) return;
    setState(() => _sending = true);
    try {
      final file = await _TwiceGifCache.instance.downloadGif(gif);
      await SocialRepository.instance.sendMediaMessage(
        conversationId: widget.conversationId,
        file: file,
        mediaType: 'image',
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Could not send GIF: $e')),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _sending = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pickAndSendMedia({required bool video}) async {
    final permitted = await PhotoManager.requestPermissionExtend();
    if (!permitted.isAuth && !permitted.hasAccess) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Photo library permission required')),
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    final paths = await PhotoManager.getAssetPathList(
      type: video ? RequestType.video : RequestType.image,
      onlyAll: true,
    );
    if (paths.isEmpty) return;

    final assets = await paths.first.getAssetListPaged(page: 0, size: 100);
    if (!mounted || assets.isEmpty) return;

    final selected = <AssetEntity>[];
    final chosen = await showModalBottomSheet<List<AssetEntity>>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: _igSurface,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (sheetContext) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (sheetContext, setSheetState) => SizedBox(
          height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(sheetContext).height * 0.65,
          child: Column(
            children: [
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 10),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        video
                            ? 'Choose a video'
                            : 'Choose photos (${selected.length}/10)',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          fontSize: 16,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (!video)
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: selected.isEmpty
                            ? null
                            : () => Navigator.pop(
                                  sheetContext,
                                  List<AssetEntity>.from(selected),
                                ),
                        child: const Text('Next'),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              Expanded(
                child: GridView.builder(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  gridDelegate:
                      const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
                    crossAxisCount: 3,
                    mainAxisSpacing: 4,
                    crossAxisSpacing: 4,
                  ),
                  itemCount: assets.length,
                  itemBuilder: (_, index) {
                    final asset = assets[index];
                    final isSelected =
                        selected.any((item) => item.id == asset.id);

                    return FutureBuilder<File?>(
                      future: asset.file,
                      builder: (_, snapshot) {
                        final file = snapshot.data;
                        return GestureDetector(
                          onTap: () {
                            if (video) {
                              Navigator.pop(sheetContext, [asset]);
                              return;
                            }

                            setSheetState(() {
                              if (isSelected) {
                                selected.removeWhere(
                                  (item) => item.id == asset.id,
                                );
                              } else if (selected.length < 10) {
                                selected.add(asset);
                              } else {
                                ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                                  const SnackBar(
                                    content: Text(
                                      'You can select up to 10 photos.',
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                );
                              }
                            });
                          },
                          child: Stack(
                            fit: StackFit.expand,
                            children: [
                              if (file == null)
                                Container(color: _igElevated)
                              else
                                Image.file(file, fit: BoxFit.cover),
                              if (isSelected)
                                Container(
                                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.35),
                                  alignment: Alignment.topRight,
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                                  child: CircleAvatar(
                                    radius: 12,
                                    backgroundColor: _igBlue,
                                    child: Text(
                                      '${selected.indexWhere(
                                            (item) => item.id == asset.id,
                                          ) + 1}',
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                        color: Colors.white,
                                        fontSize: 12,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              if (video)
                                const Positioned(
                                  right: 6,
                                  bottom: 6,
                                  child: Icon(
                                    Icons.play_circle_fill,
                                    color: Colors.white,
                                  ),
                                ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
              if (!video)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  child: SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    child: ElevatedButton(
                      onPressed: selected.isEmpty
                          ? null
                          : () => Navigator.pop(
                                sheetContext,
                                List<AssetEntity>.from(selected),
                              ),
                      child: Text('Send ${selected.length} photo(s)'),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );

    if (chosen == null || chosen.isEmpty || !mounted) return;

    setState(() => _sending = true);
    try {
      final files = <File>[];
      for (final asset in chosen) {
        final file = await asset.file;
        if (file != null) files.add(file);
      }
      if (files.isEmpty) {
        throw StateError('Could not read the selected media.');
      }

      if (!video && files.length > 1) {
        await SocialRepository.instance.sendMediaAlbum(
          conversationId: widget.conversationId,
          files: files,
        );
      } else {
        await SocialRepository.instance.sendMediaMessage(
          conversationId: widget.conversationId,
          file: files.first,
          mediaType: video ? 'video' : 'image',
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Upload failed: $e')),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _sending = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final otherProv = _avatarProvider(widget.otherAvatar);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: _igBlack,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: _igBlack,
        elevation: 0,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back, color: Colors.white),
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
        titleSpacing: 0,
        title: Row(
          children: [
            CircleAvatar(
              radius: 20,
              backgroundColor: _igElevated,
              backgroundImage: otherProv,
              onBackgroundImageError: otherProv == null
                  ? null
                  : (exception, stackTrace) {},
              child: otherProv == null
                  ? Text(
                      widget.title.isNotEmpty
                          ? widget.title[0].toUpperCase()
                          : '?',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.white),
                    )
                  : null,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    widget.title,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      fontSize: 16,
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (widget.otherUsername.isNotEmpty)
                    Text(
                      '@${widget.otherUsername}',
                      style: const TextStyle(color: _igMuted, fontSize: 12),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.phone_outlined, color: Colors.white),
            onPressed: () {},
          ),
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.videocam_outlined, color: Colors.white),
            onPressed: () {},
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          Expanded(child: _thread()),
          _composer(),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _thread() {
    if (_loading) return const ChatSkeleton();
    if (_error != null) {
      return Center(
        child: TextButton(onPressed: _load, child: Text('Retry\n$_error')),
      );
    }
    if (_messages.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            CircleAvatar(
              radius: 40,
              backgroundColor: _igElevated,
              backgroundImage: _avatarProvider(widget.otherAvatar),
              child: _avatarProvider(widget.otherAvatar) == null
                  ? const Icon(Icons.person, size: 40, color: _igMuted)
                  : null,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
              widget.title,
              style: const TextStyle(
                color: Colors.white,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                fontSize: 18,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            const Text(
              'Say hello 👋',
              style: TextStyle(color: _igMuted),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    return ListView.builder(
      key: PageStorageKey<String>('twice-chat-${widget.conversationId}'),
      controller: _scroll,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 18),
      itemCount: _messages.length,
      itemBuilder: (_, i) {
        final m = _messages[i];
        final own = (m['sender_id'] ?? '') == _myId;
        final prevOwn = i > 0 &&
            (_messages[i - 1]['sender_id'] ?? '') == (m['sender_id'] ?? '');
        return TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
          key: ValueKey<String>(
            'chat-message-${m['_ui_id'] ?? m['id'] ?? m['created_at'] ?? i}',
          ),
          tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0, end: 1),
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 190),
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
          builder: (context, value, child) => Opacity(
            opacity: value,
            child: Transform.translate(
              offset: Offset(own ? 14 * (1 - value) : -8 * (1 - value), 8 * (1 - value)),
              child: child,
            ),
          ),
          child: _Bubble(
            message: m,
            own: own,
            showAvatar: !own && !prevOwn,
            senderProfile: _senderCache[(m['sender_id'] ?? '').toString()],
            fallbackAvatar: widget.otherAvatar,
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _composer() {
    return SafeArea(
      top: false,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(10, 9, 10, 10),
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          color: _igBlack,
          border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: _igElevated, width: 0.5)),
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            IconButton(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.camera_alt, color: _igBlue),
              onPressed: _sending ? null : _captureFromCamera,
            ),
            Expanded(
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 15),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: const Color(0xFF1D1D1D),
                  border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF303030), width: 0.7),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: TextField(
                        controller: _controller,
                        style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 15),
                        minLines: 1,
                        maxLines: 5,
                        textInputAction: TextInputAction.send,
                        onSubmitted: (_) => _sendText(),
                        decoration: const InputDecoration(
                          hintText: 'Message...',
                          hintStyle: TextStyle(color: _igMuted),
                          border: InputBorder.none,
                          isDense: true,
                          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.image_outlined, color: _igMuted, size: 22),
                      onPressed:
                          _sending ? null : () => _pickAndSendMedia(video: false),
                      visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'GIF',
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.gif_box_outlined, color: _igMuted, size: 24),
                      onPressed: _sending ? null : _openGifPicker,
                      visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 4),
            IconButton(
              icon: _sending
                  ? const SizedBox(
                      width: 22,
                      height: 22,
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                        strokeWidth: 2,
                        color: _igBlue,
                      ),
                    )
                  : const Icon(Icons.send_rounded, color: _igBlue),
              onPressed: _sending ? null : _sendText,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}


// =============================================================================
// GIPHY picker + persistent offline-first cache
// =============================================================================

const _giphyApiKey= [REDACTED]';

class _TwiceGifCache {
  _TwiceGifCache._();
  static final instance = _TwiceGifCache._();

  Future<Directory> _dir() async {
    final root = await getApplicationSupportDirectory();
    final dir = Directory(p.join(root.path, 'twice_gif_cache'));
    if (!await dir.exists()) await dir.create(recursive: true);
    return dir;
  }

  String _name(String value, String ext) {
    final encoded = base64Url.encode(utf8.encode(value)).replaceAll('=', '');
    return '${encoded.substring(0, encoded.length > 120 ? 120 : encoded.length)}.$ext';
  }

  Future<File?> cachedPreview(String url) async {
    try {
      final f = File(p.join((await _dir()).path, _name(url, 'preview.gif')));
      return await f.exists() && await f.length() > 0 ? f : null;
    } catch (_) { return null; }
  }

  Future<void> cachePreview(String url) async {
    try {
      if (await cachedPreview(url) != null) return;
      final response = await http.get(Uri.parse(url)).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12));
      if (response.statusCode != 200 || response.bodyBytes.isEmpty) return;
      final f = File(p.join((await _dir()).path, _name(url, 'preview.gif')));
      await f.writeAsBytes(response.bodyBytes, flush: true);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<File> downloadGif(Map<String, dynamic> gif) async {
    final images = gif['images'] as Map? ?? const {};
    final original = images['original'] as Map? ?? const {};
    final url = (original['url'] ?? '').toString();
    if (url.isEmpty) throw StateError('GIF URL is missing.');
    final target = File(p.join((await _dir()).path, _name(url, 'gif')));
    if (await target.exists() && await target.length() > 0) return target;
    try {
      final response = await http.get(Uri.parse(url)).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 25));
      if (response.statusCode != 200 || response.bodyBytes.isEmpty) {
        throw HttpException('GIPHY returned ${response.statusCode}');
      }
      await target.writeAsBytes(response.bodyBytes, flush: true);
      return target;
    } catch (_) {
      // If offline, send the already-cached animated preview for this GIF.
      final previewUrl = (images['fixed_width'] as Map?)?['url']?.toString()
          ?? (images['preview_gif'] as Map?)?['url']?.toString();
      if (previewUrl != null) {
        final cached = await cachedPreview(previewUrl);
        if (cached != null) return cached;
      }
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> cachedResults() async {
    try {
      final f = File(p.join((await _dir()).path, 'results.json'));
      if (!await f.exists()) return [];
      final decoded = jsonDecode(await f.readAsString());
      return decoded is List
          ? decoded.whereType<Map>().map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e)).toList()
          : [];
    } catch (_) { return []; }
  }

  Future<void> saveResults(List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows) async {
    try {
      final f = File(p.join((await _dir()).path, 'results.json'));
      await f.writeAsString(jsonEncode(rows), flush: true);
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

class _TwiceGifPicker extends StatefulWidget {
  const _TwiceGifPicker();
  @override
  State<_TwiceGifPicker> createState() => _TwiceGifPickerState();
}

class _TwiceGifPickerState extends State<_TwiceGifPicker> {
  final _search = TextEditingController();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _gifs = [];
  bool _loading = true;
  String? _error;
  Timer? _debounce;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadOfflineFirst();
    _search.addListener(_onSearchChanged);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _debounce?.cancel();
    _search.removeListener(_onSearchChanged);
    _search.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onSearchChanged() {
    _debounce?.cancel();
    _debounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 350), () {
      _fetch(_search.text.trim());
    });
  }

  Future<void> _loadOfflineFirst() async {
    final cached = await _TwiceGifCache.instance.cachedResults();
    if (mounted && cached.isNotEmpty) {
      setState(() { _gifs = cached; _loading = false; });
    }
    await _fetch('');
  }

  Future<void> _fetch(String query) async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() { _loading = _gifs.isEmpty; _error = null; });
    try {
      final endpoint = query.isEmpty ? 'trending' : 'search';
      final uri = Uri.https('api.giphy.com', '/v1/gifs/$endpoint', {
        'api_key': _giphyApiKey,
        'limit': '40',
        'rating': 'pg-13',
        if (query.isNotEmpty) 'q': query,
      });
      final response = await http.get(uri).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12));
      if (response.statusCode != 200) throw HttpException('GIPHY ${response.statusCode}');
      final decoded = jsonDecode(response.body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
      final data = (decoded['data'] as List? ?? const [])
          .whereType<Map>().map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e)).toList();
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() { _gifs = data; _loading = false; });
      if (query.isEmpty) await _TwiceGifCache.instance.saveResults(data);
      for (final gif in data.take(18)) {
        final images = gif['images'] as Map? ?? const {};
        final preview = (images['fixed_width'] as Map?)?['url']?.toString()
            ?? (images['preview_gif'] as Map?)?['url']?.toString();
        if (preview != null && preview.isNotEmpty) {
          unawaited(_TwiceGifCache.instance.cachePreview(preview));
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() { _loading = false; _error = 'Offline: showing cached GIFs'; });
    }
  }

  String? _previewUrl(Map<String, dynamic> gif) {
    final images = gif['images'] as Map? ?? const {};
    return (images['fixed_width'] as Map?)?['url']?.toString()
        ?? (images['preview_gif'] as Map?)?['url']?.toString();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return SafeArea(
      child: SizedBox(
        height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * .82,
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 12),
              child: Row(children: [
                const Text('GIFs', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 19, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                const Spacer(),
                IconButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context), icon: const Icon(Icons.close, color: Colors.white)),
              ]),
            ),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 0, 14, 12),
              child: TextField(
                controller: _search,
                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white),
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  hintText: 'Search for GIFs',
                  hintStyle: const TextStyle(color: _igMuted),
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search, color: _igMuted),
                  filled: true, fillColor: const Color(0xFF242424),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16), borderSide: BorderSide.none),
                  contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            if (_error != null)
              Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8), child: Text(_error!, style: const TextStyle(color: _igMuted, fontSize: 12))),
            Expanded(
              child: _loading && _gifs.isEmpty
                  ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: _igBlue))
                  : _gifs.isEmpty
                      ? const Center(child: Text('No GIFs found', style: TextStyle(color: _igMuted)))
                      : GridView.builder(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                          gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(crossAxisCount: 2, mainAxisSpacing: 6, crossAxisSpacing: 6, childAspectRatio: 1.15),
                          itemCount: _gifs.length,
                          itemBuilder: (_, index) {
                            final gif = _gifs[index];
                            final preview = _previewUrl(gif);
                            return GestureDetector(
                              onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context, gif),
                              child: ClipRRect(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                                child: preview == null
                                    ? Container(color: _igElevated)
                                    : FutureBuilder<File?>(
                                        future: _TwiceGifCache.instance.cachedPreview(preview),
                                        builder: (_, snap) {
                                          if (snap.data != null) return Image.file(snap.data!, fit: BoxFit.cover, gaplessPlayback: true);
                                          return Image.network(preview, fit: BoxFit.cover, gaplessPlayback: true,
                                            errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => Container(color: _igElevated));
                                        },
                                      ),
                              ),
                            );
                          },
                        ),
            ),
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(8),
              child: Text('Powered by GIPHY', style: TextStyle(color: _igMuted, fontSize: 11)),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Bubble extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Bubble({
    required this.message,
    required this.own,
    required this.showAvatar,
    this.senderProfile,
    this.fallbackAvatar = '',
  });

  final Map<String, dynamic> message;
  final bool own;
  final bool showAvatar;
  final Map<String, dynamic>? senderProfile;
  final String fallbackAvatar;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final body = (message['body'] ?? '').toString();
    final mediaUrl = (message['resolved_media_url'] ??
            message['media_url'] ??
            '')
        .toString();
    final mediaType = (message['media_type'] ?? '').toString();
    final createdAt = DateTime.tryParse(
      (message['created_at'] ?? '').toString(),
    )?.toLocal();
    final timeLabel = createdAt == null
        ? ''
        : '${createdAt.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:'
          '${createdAt.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
    final isRead = own && message['read_at'] != null;
    final hasMedia = mediaUrl.isNotEmpty &&
        (mediaUrl.startsWith('http') || mediaUrl.startsWith('file'));
    final rawAttachments = message['resolved_attachments'];
    final attachments = rawAttachments is List
        ? rawAttachments
            .whereType<Map>()
            .map((a) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(a))
            .where((a) {
              final url = (a['resolved_media_url'] ?? '').toString();
              return url.startsWith('http') || url.startsWith('file');
            })
            .toList()
        : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    final hasAlbum = attachments.length > 1;

    final avatarUrl = (senderProfile?['avatar_url'] ?? fallbackAvatar).toString();
    final prov = _avatarProvider(avatarUrl);

    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(
        top: showAvatar ? 10 : 2,
        bottom: 2,
        left: own ? 48 : 0,
        right: own ? 0 : 48,
      ),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
        mainAxisAlignment:
            own ? MainAxisAlignment.end : MainAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          if (!own) ...[
            if (showAvatar)
              CircleAvatar(
                radius: 14,
                backgroundColor: _igElevated,
                backgroundImage: prov,
                onBackgroundImageError: prov == null
                    ? null
                    : (exception, stackTrace) {},
                child: prov == null
                    ? const Icon(Icons.person, size: 14, color: _igMuted)
                    : null,
              )
            else
              const SizedBox(width: 28),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
          ],
          Flexible(
            child: Container(
              constraints: BoxConstraints(
                maxWidth: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width * 0.72,
              ),
              padding: hasMedia
                  ? EdgeInsets.zero
                  : const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: own ? _igBubbleMe : _igBubbleThem,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
                  topLeft: const Radius.circular(20),
                  topRight: const Radius.circular(20),
                  bottomLeft: Radius.circular(own ? 20 : 5),
                  bottomRight: Radius.circular(own ? 5 : 20),
                ),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  if (hasAlbum)
                    _AlbumGrid(attachments: attachments)
                  else if (hasMedia)
                    _media(mediaUrl, mediaType),
                  if (body.isNotEmpty)
                    Padding(
                      padding: hasMedia
                          ? const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 8, 12, 10)
                          : EdgeInsets.zero,
                      child: Text(
                        body,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          fontSize: 15,
                          height: 1.35,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  if (timeLabel.isNotEmpty || isRead)
                    Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                        hasMedia ? 8 : 0,
                        6,
                        hasMedia ? 8 : 0,
                        2,
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
                        children: [
                          if (timeLabel.isNotEmpty)
                            Text(
                              timeLabel,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white60,
                                fontSize: 10,
                              ),
                            ),
                          if (isRead) ...[
                            const SizedBox(width: 6),
                            const Text(
                              'Seen',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white70,
                                fontSize: 10,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _media(String url, String type) {
    if (type == 'video') {
      return _InlineVideo(url: url);
    }
    return ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      child: Image(
        image: _avatarProvider(url) ?? const NetworkImage(''),
        fit: BoxFit.cover,
        width: 220,
        height: 280,
        errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => Container(
          width: 220,
          height: 160,
          color: _igElevated,
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: const Icon(Icons.broken_image, color: _igMuted),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _AlbumGrid extends StatelessWidget {
  const _AlbumGrid({required this.attachments});

  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> attachments;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final visible = attachments.take(4).toList();

    return ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
      child: SizedBox(
        width: 240,
        height: visible.length == 2 ? 132 : 220,
        child: GridView.builder(
          physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
          padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
          itemCount: visible.length,
          gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
            crossAxisCount: 2,
            mainAxisSpacing: 2,
            crossAxisSpacing: 2,
          ),
          itemBuilder: (_, index) {
            final item = visible[index];
            final url = (item['resolved_media_url'] ?? '').toString();
            final remaining = attachments.length - 4;

            return Stack(
              fit: StackFit.expand,
              children: [
                Image(
                  image: _avatarProvider(url) ?? const NetworkImage(''),
                  fit: BoxFit.cover,
                  errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => Container(
                    color: _igElevated,
                    alignment: Alignment.center,
                    child: const Icon(
                      Icons.broken_image_outlined,
                      color: _igMuted,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                if (index == 3 && remaining > 0)
                  Container(
                    color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.58),
                    alignment: Alignment.center,
                    child: Text(
                      '+$remaining',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        fontSize: 24,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _InlineVideo extends StatefulWidget {
  const _InlineVideo({required this.url});
  final String url;

  @override
  State<_InlineVideo> createState() => _InlineVideoState();
}

class _InlineVideoState extends State<_InlineVideo> {
  VideoPlayerController? _c;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final uri = Uri.parse(widget.url);
    _c = widget.url.startsWith('file')
        ? VideoPlayerController.file(File.fromUri(uri))
        : VideoPlayerController.networkUrl(uri);
    _c!.initialize().then((_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _c?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = _c;
    if (c == null || !c.value.isInitialized) {
      return Container(
        width: 220,
        height: 280,
        color: _igElevated,
        child: const Center(
          child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: Colors.white, strokeWidth: 2),
        ),
      );
    }
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        if (c.value.isPlaying) {
          c.pause();
        } else {
          c.play();
        }
        setState(() {});
      },
      child: ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        child: SizedBox(
          width: 220,
          height: 280,
          child: Stack(
            alignment: Alignment.center,
            children: [
              FittedBox(
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                child: SizedBox(
                  width: c.value.size.width,
                  height: c.value.size.height,
                  child: VideoPlayer(c),
                ),
              ),
              if (!c.value.isPlaying)
                const Icon(Icons.play_circle_fill, color: Colors.white70, size: 48),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ignore_for_file: use_build_context_synchronously
//
// Twice "Videos" tab — Facebook Reels style.
// This file is a `part` of lib/main.dart so it can reuse the app's private
// helpers (_UserAvatar, _timeAgo, _openUserProfile, SocialPost, ...).
part of 'main.dart';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Shared player settings (kept while the app is open)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
final ValueNotifier<bool> _videoMuted = ValueNotifier<bool>(false);
final ValueNotifier<double> _videoSpeed = ValueNotifier<double>(1.0);
final ValueNotifier<bool> _videoAutoNext = ValueNotifier<bool>(false);

const Color _reelHeart = Color(0xFFFF3040);
const Color _fbGrey = Color(0xFF262626);
const List<Shadow> _reelShadow = <Shadow>[
  Shadow(color: Color(0x99000000), blurRadius: 8, offset: Offset(0, 1)),
];

void _videoSnack(BuildContext context, String message) {
  ScaffoldMessenger.maybeOf(context)
    ?..hideCurrentSnackBar()
    ..showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(content: Text(message), behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating),
    );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Data
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _VideoFeedData {
  static SupabaseClient get _db => Supabase.instance.client;

  // post_media!inner + the eq() below = only posts that contain a video.
  static const String _columns =
      'id,user_id,caption,visibility,comments_enabled,created_at,'
      'profiles!posts_user_id_fkey(id,username,display_name,avatar_url),'
      'post_media!inner(id,media_url,thumbnail_url,media_type,position),'
      'post_likes(user_id),saved_posts(user_id),comments(count)';

  static bool _isPath(String v) =>
      v.isNotEmpty &&
      v != 'pending' &&
      !v.startsWith('http://') &&
      !v.startsWith('https://');

  static Future<Map<String, String>> _sign(Set<String> paths) async {
    final result = <String, String>{};
    final list = paths.where((p) => p.isNotEmpty).toList();
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i += 100) {
      final chunk = list.sublist(i, min(i + 100, list.length));
      try {
        final signed = await _db.storage
            .from('post-media')
            // ignore: deprecated_member_use
            .createSignedUrls(chunk, 3600)
            .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
        for (final item in signed) {
          final url = item.signedUrl;
          if (url.contains('token=')) result[item.path.toString()] = url;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('Videos: signing failed: $e');
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> page({
    required int offset,
    int limit = 10,
  }) async {
    final rows = await _db
        .from('posts')
        .select(_columns)
        .eq('post_media.media_type', 'video')
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .range(offset, offset + limit - 1)
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 25));

    final posts = (rows as List)
        .map((raw) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map))
        .toList();

    final needed = <String>{};
    for (final post in posts) {
      final author = post['profiles'];
      if (author is Map) {
        final path = (author['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        if (_isPath(path)) needed.add(path);
      }
      for (final media in (post['post_media'] as List? ?? const [])) {
        if (media is! Map) continue;
        for (final key in const ['media_url', 'thumbnail_url']) {
          final path = (media[key] ?? '').toString().trim();
          if (_isPath(path)) needed.add(path);
        }
      }
    }
    final urls = await _sign(needed);
    String resolve(String path) {
      if (path.isEmpty) return '';
      if (!_isPath(path)) return path;
      return urls[path] ?? '';
    }

    for (final post in posts) {
      final authorRaw = post['profiles'];
      if (authorRaw is Map) {
        final author = Map<String, dynamic>.from(authorRaw);
        final path = (author['avatar_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        author['avatar_object_path'] = _isPath(path) ? path : '';
        author['avatar_url'] = resolve(path);
        post['profiles'] = author;
      }
      final media =
          (post['post_media'] as List? ?? const [])
              .whereType<Map>()
              .map((raw) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw))
              .where(
                (m) =>
                    (m['media_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() == 'video',
              )
              .toList()
            ..sort(
              (a, b) => (int.tryParse('${a['position']}') ?? 0).compareTo(
                int.tryParse('${b['position']}') ?? 0,
              ),
            );
      post['media_resolved'] = media.map((item) {
        item['resolved_url'] = resolve(
          (item['media_url'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
        );
        item['resolved_thumbnail_url'] = resolve(
          (item['thumbnail_url'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
        );
        return item;
      }).toList();
    }
    return posts
        .where((p) => (p['media_resolved'] as List).isNotEmpty)
        .toList();
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Videos tab (vertical pager)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class VideosPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const VideosPage({
    super.key,
    required this.active,
    required this.profile,
    required this.onCreate,
  });

  final bool active;
  final Map<String, dynamic> profile;
  final VoidCallback onCreate;

  @override
  State<VideosPage> createState() => _VideosPageState();
}

class _VideosPageState extends State<VideosPage> with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  static const int _pageSize = 10;

  final PageController _pager = PageController();
  final List<SocialPost> _posts = <SocialPost>[];
  bool _started = false;
  bool _loading = false;
  bool _loadingMore = false;
  bool _hasMore = true;
  bool _appResumed = true;
  String? _error;
  int _index = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    if (widget.active) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (mounted) _ensureStarted();
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant VideosPage oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.active && !oldWidget.active) _ensureStarted();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final resumed = state == AppLifecycleState.resumed;
    if (resumed != _appResumed) setState(() => _appResumed = resumed);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    _pager.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _ensureStarted() {
    if (_started) return;
    _started = true;
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final rows = await _VideoFeedData.page(offset: 0, limit: _pageSize);
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (_pager.hasClients) _pager.jumpToPage(0);
      setState(() {
        _posts
          ..clear()
          ..addAll(rows.map(SocialPost.new));
        _index = 0;
        _hasMore = rows.length >= _pageSize;
        _loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _loading = false;
        _error = e.toString();
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadMore() async {
    if (_loadingMore || !_hasMore || _loading) return;
    _loadingMore = true;
    try {
      final rows = await _VideoFeedData.page(
        offset: _posts.length,
        limit: _pageSize,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      final known = _posts.map((p) => p.id).toSet();
      setState(() {
        for (final row in rows) {
          final post = SocialPost(row);
          if (known.add(post.id)) _posts.add(post);
        }
        _hasMore = rows.length >= _pageSize;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Videos: load more failed: $e');
    } finally {
      _loadingMore = false;
    }
  }

  void _onPage(int i) {
    setState(() => _index = i);
    if (i >= _posts.length - 3) _loadMore();
  }

  bool _next() {
    if (!_pager.hasClients || _index >= _posts.length - 1) return false;
    _pager.nextPage(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 320),
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
    );
    return true;
  }

  void _openSearch() {
    Navigator.of(context).push<void>(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Search')),
          body: const SearchPage(),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final top = MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).top;
    final Widget body;
    if (_loading && _posts.isEmpty) {
      body = const Center(
        child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: Colors.white),
      );
    } else if (_error != null && _posts.isEmpty) {
      body = _VideosMessage(
        icon: Icons.wifi_off_rounded,
        title: 'Couldn’t load videos',
        subtitle: _error!,
        actionLabel: 'Try again',
        onAction: _load,
      );
    } else if (_posts.isEmpty) {
      body = _VideosMessage(
        icon: Icons.video_library_outlined,
        title: 'No videos yet',
        subtitle: 'Videos that people post on Twice will show up here.',
        actionLabel: 'Create a video',
        onAction: widget.onCreate,
      );
    } else {
      final entries = interleaveAds<SocialPost>(
        _posts, interval: 5, maxAds: TwiceAdConfig.maxAdSlots,
      );
      body = PageView.builder(
        scrollDirection: Axis.vertical,
        controller: _pager,
        itemCount: entries.length,
        onPageChanged: (page) {
          final entry = entries[page];
          if (entry.isAd) {
            setState(() => _index = -1);
            return;
          }
          final postIndex = entries.take(page + 1).where((e) => !e.isAd).length - 1;
          _onPage(postIndex);
        },
        itemBuilder: (context, page) {
          final entry = entries[page];
          if (entry.isAd) {
            return ColoredBox(
              color: Colors.black,
              child: Center(
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  child: FeedNativeAdCard(
                    key: ValueKey<String>('video-ad-${entry.adSlot}'),
                    slot: entry.adSlot!,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            );
          }
          final post = entry.item!;
          final postIndex = entries.take(page + 1).where((e) => !e.isAd).length - 1;
          return _VideoReel(
            key: ValueKey<String>(post.id),
            post: post,
            myProfile: widget.profile,
            topInset: top,
            playing: widget.active && _appResumed && postIndex == _index,
            preload: postIndex == _index ||
                (widget.active && (postIndex - _index).abs() <= 1),
            onNext: _next,
          );
        },
      );
    }

    return AnnotatedRegion<SystemUiOverlayStyle>(
      value: SystemUiOverlayStyle.light,
      child: ColoredBox(
        color: Colors.black,
        child: Stack(
          children: [
            Positioned.fill(child: body),
            Positioned(
              top: 0,
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              child: Container(
                padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, top + 6, 6, 14),
                decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                    begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                    end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                    colors: [Color(0x99000000), Color(0x00000000)],
                  ),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    const Text(
                      'Videos',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        fontSize: 24,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                        shadows: _reelShadow,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const Spacer(),
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Create',
                      onPressed: widget.onCreate,
                      icon: const Icon(
                        Icons.add_circle_outline_rounded,
                        color: Colors.white,
                        shadows: _reelShadow,
                      ),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Search',
                      onPressed: _openSearch,
                      icon: const Icon(
                        Icons.search_rounded,
                        color: Colors.white,
                        shadows: _reelShadow,
                      ),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Video settings',
                      onPressed: () =>
                          _showVideoSettings(context, onRefresh: _load),
                      icon: const Icon(
                        Icons.more_horiz_rounded,
                        color: Colors.white,
                        shadows: _reelShadow,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
