  }
}

class MessagesPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const MessagesPage({super.key});
  @override
  State<MessagesPage> createState() => _MessagesPageState();
}

class _MessagesPageState extends State<MessagesPage> {
  late Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> future;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    future = SocialRepository.instance.conversations();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Messages')),
    body: FutureBuilder<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      future: future,
      builder: (_, s) {
        if (s.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
          return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
        }
        if (s.hasError) {
          return Center(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: Text('Could not load conversations: ${s.error}'),
            ),
          );
        }
        final rows = s.data ?? [];
        if (rows.isEmpty) {
          return const Center(child: Text('No conversations yet'));
        }
        return ListView.builder(
          itemCount: rows.length,
          itemBuilder: (_, i) {
            final r = rows[i];
            final c = r['conversations'] as Map? ?? {};
            return ListTile(
              leading: const CircleAvatar(child: Icon(Icons.person)),
              title: Text((c['title'] ?? 'Conversation').toString()),
              subtitle: const Text('Open conversation'),
              onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).push(
                MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                  builder: (_) => ConversationPage(
                    id: r['conversation_id'].toString(),
                    title: (c['title'] ?? 'Conversation').toString(),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    ),
  );
}

class ConversationPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ConversationPage({super.key, required this.id, required this.title});
  final String id, title;
  @override
  State<ConversationPage> createState() => _ConversationPageState();
}

class _ConversationPageState extends State<ConversationPage> {
  final controller = TextEditingController();
  late Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> future;
  bool sending = false;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    future = SocialRepository.instance.messages(widget.id);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _send() async {
    final body = controller.text.trim();
    if (body.isEmpty || sending) return;
    setState(() => sending = true);
    try {
      await SocialRepository.instance.sendMessage(widget.id, body);
      if (!mounted) return;
      controller.clear();
      setState(() => future = SocialRepository.instance.messages(widget.id));
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
            .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Message failed: $e')));
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => sending = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.title)),
    body: Column(
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: FutureBuilder<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
            future: future,
            builder: (_, s) {
              if (s.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
                return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
              }
              if (s.hasError) {
                return Center(
                  child: Text('Could not load messages: ${s.error}'),
                );
              }
              final rows = s.data ?? [];
              return ListView.builder(
                reverse: false,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                itemCount: rows.length,
                itemBuilder: (_, i) {
                  final r = rows[i];
                  final own =
                      r['sender_id'] ==
                      Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
                  return Align(
                    alignment: own
                        ? Alignment.centerRight
                        : Alignment.centerLeft,
                    child: Container(
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: own ? igBlue : igElevated,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                      ),
                      child: Text((r['body'] ?? '').toString()),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
        SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: TextField(
                    controller: controller,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(hintText: 'Message…'),
                  ),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  onPressed: sending ? null : _send,
                  icon: sending
                      ? const SizedBox(
                          width: 18,
                          height: 18,
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                        )
                      : const Icon(Icons.send, color: violet),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}


class _ProfileNavAvatar extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ProfileNavAvatar({
    required this.url,
    required this.fallback,
    required this.selected,
  });

  final String url;
  final String fallback;
  final bool selected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final imageSource = url.trim();
    final initial = fallback.trim().isNotEmpty
        ? fallback.trim().characters.first.toUpperCase()
        : 'U';
    final hasImage = _isImageSource(imageSource);

    return Container(
      width: 29,
      height: 29,
      padding: EdgeInsets.all(selected ? 2 : 0),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        shape: BoxShape.circle,
        border: selected
            ? Border.all(color: Colors.white, width: 1.5)
            : null,
      ),
      child: ClipOval(
        child: hasImage
            ? Image(
                image: _twiceAvatarProvider(imageSource),
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                width: 29,
                height: 29,
                errorBuilder: (context, error, stackTrace) =>
                    _fallback(initial),
              )
            : _fallback(initial),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _fallback(String initial) {
    return ColoredBox(
      color: const Color(0xFF262626),
      child: Center(
        child: Text(
          initial,
          style: const TextStyle(
            color: Color(0xFF0095F6),
            fontSize: 13,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}


enum _SocialNavKind { home, search, create, activity, plus }

class _SocialNavIcon extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SocialNavIcon({
    required this.kind,
    this.selected = false,
  });

  final _SocialNavKind kind;
  final bool selected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const color = Colors.white;
    final stroke = selected
        ? (kind == _SocialNavKind.search ? 3.0 : 2.35)
        : 1.75;

    return SizedBox(
      width: 27,
      height: 27,
      child: CustomPaint(
        painter: _SocialNavPainter(
          kind: kind,
          color: color,
          stroke: stroke,
          selected: selected,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _SocialNavPainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _SocialNavPainter({
    required this.kind,
    required this.color,
    required this.stroke,
    required this.selected,
  });

  final _SocialNavKind kind;
  final Color color;
  final double stroke;
  final bool selected;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final paint = Paint()
      ..color = color
      ..style = selected ? PaintingStyle.fill : PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = stroke
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round
      ..strokeJoin = StrokeJoin.round;

    final outline = Paint()
      ..color = color
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = stroke
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round
      ..strokeJoin = StrokeJoin.round;

    switch (kind) {
      case _SocialNavKind.home:
        final path = Path()
          ..moveTo(3, 12)
          ..lineTo(13.5, 3.5)
          ..lineTo(24, 12)
          ..lineTo(22, 12)
          ..lineTo(22, 23)
          ..lineTo(15.8, 23)
          ..lineTo(15.8, 16.5)
          ..lineTo(11.2, 16.5)
          ..lineTo(11.2, 23)
          ..lineTo(5, 23)
          ..lineTo(5, 12)
          ..close();
        if (selected) {
          canvas.drawPath(path, paint);
          canvas.drawRect(
            const Rect.fromLTWH(11.2, 16.5, 4.6, 6.5),
            Paint()..color = igBlack,
          );
        } else {
          canvas.drawPath(path, outline);
        }

      case _SocialNavKind.search:
        canvas.drawCircle(const Offset(11, 11), 7, outline);
        canvas.drawLine(
          const Offset(16.2, 16.2),
          const Offset(23, 23),
          outline,
        );

      case _SocialNavKind.create:
        final back = RRect.fromRectAndRadius(
          const Rect.fromLTWH(3, 2.5, 17, 19),
          const Radius.circular(3.5),
        );
        final front = RRect.fromRectAndRadius(
          const Rect.fromLTWH(7, 5.5, 17, 19),
          const Radius.circular(3.5),
        );
        canvas.drawRRect(back, outline);
        if (selected) {
          canvas.drawRRect(front, paint);
          final cutout = Paint()..color = igBlack;
          final triangle = Path()
            ..moveTo(13, 11)
            ..lineTo(13, 19)
            ..lineTo(19, 15)
            ..close();
          canvas.drawPath(triangle, cutout);
        } else {
          canvas.drawRRect(front, outline);
          final triangle = Path()
            ..moveTo(13, 11)
            ..lineTo(13, 19)
            ..lineTo(19, 15)
            ..close();
          canvas.drawPath(triangle, outline);
        }

      case _SocialNavKind.plus:
        canvas.drawRRect(
          RRect.fromRectAndRadius(
            const Rect.fromLTWH(3, 3, 21, 21),
            const Radius.circular(6),
          ),
          outline,
        );
        final plusPaint = Paint()
          ..color = color
          ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
          ..strokeWidth = stroke
          ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round;
        canvas.drawLine(const Offset(13.5, 8.5), const Offset(13.5, 18.5), plusPaint);
        canvas.drawLine(const Offset(8.5, 13.5), const Offset(18.5, 13.5), plusPaint);

      case _SocialNavKind.activity:
        final heart = Path()
          ..moveTo(13.5, 23)
          ..cubicTo(11.5, 21, 3, 15, 3, 9)
          ..cubicTo(3, 3, 10, 2, 13.5, 7)
          ..cubicTo(17, 2, 24, 3, 24, 9)
          ..cubicTo(24, 15, 15.5, 21, 13.5, 23)
          ..close();
        canvas.drawPath(heart, selected ? paint : outline);
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _SocialNavPainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.kind != kind ||
      oldDelegate.color != color ||
      oldDelegate.stroke != stroke ||
      oldDelegate.selected != selected;
}

#if defined(__GNUC__)

#else
#define TWICE_EXPORT
#endif

extern "C" TWICE_EXPORT
int32_t twice_native_add(int32_t a, int32_t b) {
    return a + b;
}

extern "C" TWICE_EXPORT
int32_t twice_native_version() {
    return 1;
}

FILE: supabase/functions/twice-email-code/index.ts
==========================================================================================
import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";

const headers = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
  "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
  "Cache-Control": "no-store",
};

function reply(data: unknown, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status, headers });
}

function normalizeEmail(v: unknown): string {
  return typeof v === "string" ? v.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
}

function validEmail(email: string): boolean {
  return email.length <= 254 && /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email);
}

function randomCode(): string {
  // Rejection sampling avoids modulo bias.
  const limit = Math.floor(0x100000000 / 1_000_000) * 1_000_000;
  const values = new Uint32Array(1);
  do crypto.getRandomValues(values); while (values[0] >= limit);
  return String(values[0] % 1_000_000).padStart(6, "0");
}

async function hmac(value: string, secret: string): Promise<string> {
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "raw",
    new TextEncoder().encode(secret),
    { name: "HMAC", hash: "SHA-256" },
    false,
    ["sign"],
  );
  const signature = await crypto.subtle.sign(
    "HMAC",
    key,
    new TextEncoder().encode(value),
  );
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(signature))
    .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}

async function refreshGoogleToken(
  clientId: string,
  clientSecret: [REDACTED],
  refreshToken: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const response = await fetch("https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: new URLSearchParams({
      client_id: clientId,
      client_secret: [REDACTED],
      refresh_token: refreshToken,
      grant_type: "refresh_token",
    }),
  });
  const result = await response.json();
  if (!response.ok || typeof result.access_token !== "string") {
    console.error("Gmail token refresh failed:", result.error ?? response.status);
    throw new Error("Gmail sender unavailable");
  }
  return result.access_token;
}

function base64Url(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  let binary = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
  }
  return btoa(binary).replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_").replace(/=+$/g, "");
}

async function sendCode(
  email: string,
  code: string,
  sender: string,
  accessToken: [REDACTED],
): Promise<void> {
  const subject = "Your Twice verification code";
  const body =
    `Your Twice verification code is ${code}.\r\n\r\n` +
    "It expires in 5 minutes. If you did not request this code, ignore this email.";
  const raw = [
    `From: Twice <${sender}>`,
    `To: ${email}`,
    `Subject: ${subject}`,
    "MIME-Version: 1.0",
    'Content-Type: text/plain; charset="UTF-8"',
    "Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64",
    "",
    btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(body))),
  ].join("\r\n");

  const response = await fetch(
    "https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/messages/send",
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        raw: base64Url(new TextEncoder().encode(raw)),
      }),
    },
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    console.error("Gmail send failed with HTTP", response.status);
    throw new Error("Email delivery failed");
  }
}

async function findUserByEmail(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createClient>,
  email: string,
) {
  for (let page = 1; page <= 100; page++) {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.admin.listUsers({
      page,
      perPage: 1000,
    });
    if (error) throw new Error("Account lookup failed");
    const user = data.users.find((u) => u.email?.toLowerCase() === email);
    if (user) return user;
    if (data.users.length < 1000) return null;
  }
  throw new Error("Account lookup reached its safety limit");
}

serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return new Response("ok", { headers });
  if (req.method !== "POST") return reply({ error: "Method not allowed" }, 405);

  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL");
  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
  const hashSecret = Deno.env.get("OTP_HASH_SECRET");
  const googleClientId = Deno.env.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID");
  const googleClientSecret= [REDACTED]"GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET");
  const googleRefreshToken = Deno.env.get("GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN");
  const sender = normalizeEmail(Deno.env.get("GOOGLE_SENDER_EMAIL"));

  if (!supabaseUrl || !serviceKey || !hashSecret || hashSecret.length < 32 ||
      !googleClientId || !googleClientSecret || !googleRefreshToken ||
      !validEmail(sender)) {
    return reply({ error: "Server authentication configuration is incomplete" }, 500);
  }

  let input: Record<string, unknown>;
  try {
    const parsed = await req.json();
    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== "object" || Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      return reply({ error: "Invalid request" }, 400);
    }
    input = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
  } catch {
    return reply({ error: "Invalid JSON" }, 400);
  }

  const action = input.action;
  const email = normalizeEmail(input.email);
  if (!validEmail(email)) return reply({ error: "Enter a valid email address" }, 400);

  const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey, {
    auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
  });

  try {
    if (action === "send_code") {
      const username = typeof input.username === "string" ? input.username.trim() : "";
      const displayName = typeof input.display_name === "string"
        ? input.display_name.trim()
        : "";

      if (username.length > 30 || displayName.length > 80 ||
          (username && !/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,30}$/.test(username))) {
        return reply({ error: "Check your username and display name" }, 400);
      }

      // Reserve the 60-second cooldown atomically before sending.
      // If delivery fails, remove this reservation so the user can retry.
      const code = randomCode();
      const codeHash = await hmac(`${email}:${code}`, hashSecret);
      const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 60_000).toISOString();
      const metadata = { username, display_name: displayName };

      const { data: reserved, error: reserveError } = await supabase.rpc(
        "twice_issue_email_code",
        {
          p_email: email,
          p_code_hash: codeHash,
          p_expires_at: expiresAt,
          p_metadata: metadata,
        },
      );
      if (reserveError) throw new Error("Verification storage is not ready");
      if (reserved !== true) {
        return reply({ error: "Please wait before requesting another code" }, 429);
      }

      try {
        const accessToken= [REDACTED] refreshGoogleToken(
          googleClientId,
          googleClientSecret,
          googleRefreshToken,
        );
        await sendCode(email, code, sender, accessToken);
      } catch (error) {
        // Delete only our reservation; do not remove a newer code created later.
        await supabase.from("email_verification_codes")
          .delete()
          .eq("email", email)
          .eq("code_hash", codeHash);
        throw error;
      }

      return reply({
        ok: true,
        message: "If this address can receive mail, a verification code has been sent.",
      });
    }

    if (action === "verify_code") {
      const code = typeof input.code === "string" ? input.code.trim() : "";
      if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(code)) {
        return reply({ error: "Enter the six-digit code" }, 400);
      }

      // Read metadata before consuming the code; the atomic RPC prevents
      // two concurrent requests from consuming the same code successfully.
      const { data: row, error: readError } = await supabase
        .from("email_verification_codes")
        .select("user_metadata, expires_at, attempts")
        .eq("email", email)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (readError) throw new Error("Verification lookup failed");
      if (!row || Date.parse(row.expires_at) <= Date.now() || row.attempts >= 5) {
        return reply({ error: "Code is invalid or expired. Request a new code." }, 400);
      }

      const suppliedHash = await hmac(`${email}:${code}`, hashSecret);
      const { data: consumed, error: consumeError } = await supabase.rpc(
        "twice_consume_email_code",
        { p_email: email, p_code_hash: suppliedHash },
      );
      if (consumeError) throw new Error("Verification check failed");
      if (consumed !== true) {
        return reply({ error: "Code is incorrect or expired" }, 400);
      }

      const metadata = row.user_metadata ?? {};
      let user = await findUserByEmail(supabase, email);

      if (!user) {
        const requested = String(metadata.username || email.split("@")[0])
          .toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/g, "").slice(0, 30);
        const username = requested.length >= 3
          ? requested
          : `user_${crypto.randomUUID().replaceAll("-", "").slice(0, 12)}`;

        const created = await supabase.auth.admin.createUser({
          email,
          email_confirm: true,
          user_metadata: {
            username,
            display_name: String(metadata.display_name || ""),
          },
        });

        if (created.error || !created.data.user) {
          // A concurrent signup may have created this email; re-check.
          user = await findUserByEmail(supabase, email);
          if (!user) throw new Error("Account creation failed");
        } else {
          user = created.data.user;
        }
      }

      const link = await supabase.auth.admin.generateLink({
        type: "magiclink",
        email,
      });
      if (link.error || !link.data.properties?.hashed_token) {
        throw new Error("Sign-in token generation failed");
      }

      return reply({
        ok: true,
        token_hash: link.data.properties.hashed_token,
        verify_type: "magiclink",
        user_id: user.id,
      });
    }

    return reply({ error: "Unknown action. Use send_code or verify_code." }, 400);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "twice-email-code:",
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : "unknown error",
    );
    return reply({ error: "Authentication request failed. Please try again." }, 500);
  }
});

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";

const AUTH_URL = "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth";
const TOKEN_URL = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token";
const SCOPE = "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send";
const REDIRECT_URI = "https://jgqxvqlwnfywzoxbfkpk.supabase.co/functions/v1/twice-google-oauth";

function page(message: string, status = 200) {
  return new Response(
    `<!doctype html><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width"><title>Twice Gmail setup</title><h2>Twice Gmail setup</h2>${message}`,
    { status, headers: { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8", "cache-control": "no-store" } },
  );
}


function base64url(bytes: Uint8Array) {
  return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...bytes))
    .replaceAll("+", "-").replaceAll("/", "_").replaceAll("=", "");
}

function fromBase64url(value: string) {
  const normalized = value.replaceAll("-", "+").replaceAll("_", "/");
  const binary = atob(normalized + "=".repeat((4 - normalized.length % 4) % 4));
  return Uint8Array.from(binary, c => c.charCodeAt(0));
}

async function signState(payload: string, secret: string) {
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "raw", new TextEncoder().encode(secret),
    { name: "HMAC", hash: "SHA-256" }, false, ["sign"],
  );
  return base64url(new Uint8Array(
    await crypto.subtle.sign("HMAC", key, new TextEncoder().encode(payload)),
  ));
}

async function validState(state: string, secret: string) {
  const parts = state.split(".");
  if (parts.length !== 3) return false;
  const [timestampText, nonce, signature] = parts;
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(timestampText) || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}$/.test(nonce)) return false;

  const timestamp = Number(timestampText);
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(timestamp) || timestamp > now + 30 || now - timestamp > 600) return false;

  const payload = `${timestampText}.${nonce}`;
  const expected = await signState(payload, secret);
  const a = new TextEncoder().encode(expected);
  const b = new TextEncoder().encode(signature);
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;

  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) diff |= a[i] ^ b[i];
  return diff === 0;
}

async function createState(secret: string) {
  const timestamp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString();
  const nonceBytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(24));
  const nonce = base64url(nonceBytes);
  const payload = `${timestamp}.${nonce}`;
  return `${payload}.${await signState(payload, secret)}`;
}

serve(async (req) => {
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const clientId = Deno.env.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID");
  const clientSecret= [REDACTED]"GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET");
  const stateSecret = Deno.env.get("GOOGLE_OAUTH_STATE_SECRET");

  if (!clientId || !clientSecret || !stateSecret) {
    return page("Missing GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, or GOOGLE_OAUTH_STATE_SECRET in Supabase Secrets.", 500);
  }

  const redirectUri = REDIRECT_URI;

  if (url.searchParams.get("action") === "authorize") {
    const state = await createState(stateSecret);
    const authUrl = new URL(AUTH_URL);
    authUrl.searchParams.set("client_id", clientId);
    authUrl.searchParams.set("redirect_uri", redirectUri);
    authUrl.searchParams.set("response_type", "code");
    authUrl.searchParams.set("scope", SCOPE);
    authUrl.searchParams.set("access_type", "offline");
    authUrl.searchParams.set("prompt", "consent");
    authUrl.searchParams.set("state", state);

    return new Response(null, {
      status: 302,
      headers: {
        location: authUrl.toString(),
        "cache-control": "no-store",
      },
    });
  }

  const error = url.searchParams.get("error");
  if (error) return page("Google authorization was cancelled or denied. You can close this page.", 400);

  const code = url.searchParams.get("code");
  if (!code) return page('Open this function URL with <code>?action=authorize</code> to begin setup.');

  const state = url.searchParams.get("state");
  if (!state || !(await validState(state, stateSecret))) {
    return page("OAuth state validation failed or expired. Restart from the authorization URL and complete consent within 10 minutes.", 403);
  }

  const tokenResponse = await fetch(TOKEN_URL, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "content-type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: new URLSearchParams({
      code,
      client_id: clientId,
      client_secret: [REDACTED],
      redirect_uri: redirectUri,
      grant_type: "authorization_code",
    }),
  });

  const tokens = await tokenResponse.json();
  if (!tokenResponse.ok) {
    console.error("Google token exchange failed:", tokens.error);
    return new Response("Google token exchange failed. Check your OAuth client and redirect URI.", {
      status: 400,
      headers: { "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "cache-control": "no-store" },
    });
  }

  if (!tokens.refresh_token) {
    return new Response("No refresh token returned. Revoke prior access for this app in your Google Account, then restart consent.", {
      status: 400,
      headers: { "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "cache-control": "no-store" },
    });
  }

  // This temporary setup function reveals the token only to the browser
  // completing the state-validated OAuth flow. Save it as a Supabase secret,
  // then remove this setup function from public access.
  const escaped = String(tokens.refresh_token).replaceAll("&", "&amp;").replaceAll("<", "&lt;").replaceAll(">", "&gt;");
  return new Response(
    `<!doctype html><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width"><meta name="referrer" content="no-referrer"><title>Twice Gmail setup</title><h2>Authorization successful</h2><p>Copy this refresh token into Supabase Secrets as <code>GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN</code>. Do not share it or commit it to GitHub.</p><textarea id="token" rows="5" style="width:100%">${escaped}</textarea><button onclick="navigator.clipboard.writeText(document.getElementById('token').value)">Copy token</button><p>After saving it, disable or remove this temporary setup function.</p>`,
    { headers: { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8", "cache-control": "no-store", "referrer-policy": "no-referrer" } },
  );
});

  bucket_id = 'chat-media' and (storage.foldername(name))[1] = (select auth.uid())::text
);

commit;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20261019000200_twice_database_fixes.sql

begin;

-- Avoid recursive conversation-membership RLS checks.
create or replace function public.is_conversation_member(p_conversation_id uuid)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.conversation_members cm
    where cm.conversation_id = p_conversation_id
      and cm.user_id = (select auth.uid())
  );
$$;

revoke all on function public.is_conversation_member(uuid) from public;
grant execute on function public.is_conversation_member(uuid) to authenticated;

drop policy if exists "conversations_read_members" on public.conversations;
create policy "conversations_read_members"
on public.conversations for select to authenticated
using (public.is_conversation_member(id));

drop policy if exists "conversation_members_read_members" on public.conversation_members;
create policy "conversation_members_read_members"
on public.conversation_members for select to authenticated
using (public.is_conversation_member(conversation_id));

drop policy if exists "messages_read_members" on public.messages;
create policy "messages_read_members"
on public.messages for select to authenticated
using (public.is_conversation_member(conversation_id));

drop policy if exists "messages_insert_members" on public.messages;
create policy "messages_insert_members"
on public.messages for insert to authenticated
with check (
  sender_id = (select auth.uid())
  and public.is_conversation_member(conversation_id)
);

-- Automatically maintain updated_at.
create or replace function public.set_updated_at()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  new.updated_at = now();
  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists profiles_set_updated_at on public.profiles;
create trigger profiles_set_updated_at
before update on public.profiles
for each row execute function public.set_updated_at();

drop trigger if exists posts_set_updated_at on public.posts;
create trigger posts_set_updated_at
before update on public.posts
for each row execute function public.set_updated_at();

drop trigger if exists comments_set_updated_at on public.comments;
create trigger comments_set_updated_at
before update on public.comments
for each row execute function public.set_updated_at();

-- Generate a profile automatically when an auth user is created.
create or replace function public.handle_new_user()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  base_username text;
  candidate text;
  suffix integer := 0;
begin
  base_username := lower(
    regexp_replace(
      coalesce(
        new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'username',
        split_part(coalesce(new.email, 'user'), '@', 1)
      ),
      '[^a-zA-Z0-9_]', '', 'g'
    )
  );

  if length(base_username) < 3 then
    base_username := 'user' || substr(replace(new.id::text, '-', ''), 1, 8);
  end if;

  base_username := substr(base_username, 1, 24);
  candidate := base_username;

  while exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles p where p.username = candidate
  ) loop
    suffix := suffix + 1;
    candidate := substr(base_username, 1, 24) || suffix::text;
  end loop;

  insert into public.profiles (id, username, display_name)
  values (
    new.id,
    candidate,
    coalesce(
      nullif(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'display_name', ''),
      nullif(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name', ''),
      ''
    )
  )
  on conflict (id) do nothing;

  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists on_auth_user_created on auth.users;
create trigger on_auth_user_created
after insert on auth.users
for each row execute function public.handle_new_user();

commit;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20261019000300_twice_rls_hardening.sql

begin;

-- Posts: private accounts require accepted followers.
-- Posts marked private remain visible only to their owner.
drop policy if exists "posts_read_visible" on public.posts;
create policy "posts_read_visible"
on public.posts for select to authenticated
using (
  user_id = (select auth.uid())
  or (
    not exists (
      select 1 from public.blocks b
      where (b.blocker_id = posts.user_id and b.blocked_id = (select auth.uid()))
         or (b.blocker_id = (select auth.uid()) and b.blocked_id = posts.user_id)
    )
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.profiles p
      where p.id = posts.user_id
        and (
          not p.is_private
          or exists (
            select 1 from public.follows f
            where f.follower_id = (select auth.uid())
              and f.following_id = posts.user_id
              and f.status = 'accepted'
          )
        )
    )
    and (
      visibility = 'public'
      or (
        visibility = 'followers'
        and exists (
          select 1 from public.follows f
          where f.follower_id = (select auth.uid())
            and f.following_id = posts.user_id
            and f.status = 'accepted'
        )
      )
    )
  )
);

-- Follow requests: private accounts require pending requests.
drop policy if exists "follows_create_self" on public.follows;
create policy "follows_create_self"
on public.follows for insert to authenticated
with check (
  follower_id = (select auth.uid())
  and follower_id <> following_id
  and (
    (status = 'pending' and exists (
      select 1 from public.profiles p
      where p.id = following_id and p.is_private
    ))
    or
    (status = 'accepted' and exists (
      select 1 from public.profiles p
      where p.id = following_id and not p.is_private
    ))
  )
);

-- Comments are readable only when the associated post is readable.
drop policy if exists "comments_read_authenticated" on public.comments;
create policy "comments_read_authenticated"
on public.comments for select to authenticated
using (
  exists (select 1 from public.posts p where p.id = post_id)
);

-- Comment likes must belong to a comment on a readable post.
drop policy if exists "comment_likes_read_authenticated" on public.comment_likes;
create policy "comment_likes_read_authenticated"
on public.comment_likes for select to authenticated
using (
  exists (
    select 1 from public.comments c
    join public.posts p on p.id = c.post_id
    where c.id = comment_id
  )
);

drop policy if exists "comment_likes_insert_self" on public.comment_likes;
create policy "comment_likes_insert_self"
on public.comment_likes for insert to authenticated
with check (
  user_id = (select auth.uid())
  and exists (
    select 1 from public.comments c
    join public.posts p on p.id = c.post_id
    where c.id = comment_id
  )
);

-- Post likes: only interact with posts the user can read.
drop policy if exists "post_likes_read_authenticated" on public.post_likes;
create policy "post_likes_read_authenticated"
on public.post_likes for select to authenticated
using (
  exists (select 1 from public.posts p where p.id = post_id)
);

drop policy if exists "post_likes_insert_self" on public.post_likes;
create policy "post_likes_insert_self"
on public.post_likes for insert to authenticated
with check (
  user_id = (select auth.uid())
  and exists (select 1 from public.posts p where p.id = post_id)
);

-- Story reactions only expose reactions on readable stories.
drop policy if exists "story_reactions_read_authenticated" on public.story_reactions;
create policy "story_reactions_read_authenticated"
on public.story_reactions for select to authenticated
using (
  exists (select 1 from public.stories s where s.id = story_id)
);

drop policy if exists "story_reactions_insert_self" on public.story_reactions;
create policy "story_reactions_insert_self"
on public.story_reactions for insert to authenticated
with check (
  user_id = (select auth.uid())
  and exists (select 1 from public.stories s where s.id = story_id)
);

-- Prevent arbitrary users from joining an existing conversation.
-- A user can add themselves only when they created the conversation.
drop policy if exists "conversation_members_add_creator_or_self"
on public.conversation_members;
create policy "conversation_members_add_creator_or_self"
on public.conversation_members for insert to authenticated
with check (
  (
    user_id = (select auth.uid())
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.conversations c
      where c.id = conversation_id
        and c.created_by = (select auth.uid())
    )
  )
  or exists (
    select 1 from public.conversations c
    where c.id = conversation_id
      and c.created_by = (select auth.uid())
  )
);

commit;

      )
  )

FILE: supabase/migrations/20261020000200_email_code_atomic.sql
==========================================================================================
begin;

create or replace function public.twice_issue_email_code(
  p_email text,
  p_code_hash text,
  p_expires_at timestamptz,
  p_metadata jsonb default '{}'::jsonb
)
returns boolean
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_last timestamptz;
begin
  insert into public.email_verification_codes
    (email, code_hash, expires_at, attempts, last_sent_at, user_metadata)
  values
    (lower(trim(p_email)), p_code_hash, p_expires_at, 0, now(),
     coalesce(p_metadata, '{}'::jsonb))
  on conflict (email) do nothing;

  if found then
    return true;
  end if;

  update public.email_verification_codes
  set code_hash = p_code_hash,
      expires_at = p_expires_at,
      attempts = 0,
      last_sent_at = now(),
      user_metadata = coalesce(p_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
  where email = lower(trim(p_email))
    and last_sent_at <= now() - interval '60 seconds';

  return found;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.twice_consume_email_code(
  p_email text,
  p_code_hash text
)
returns boolean
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_hash text;
  v_expiry timestamptz;
  v_attempts integer;
begin
  select code_hash, expires_at, attempts
  into v_hash, v_expiry, v_attempts
  from public.email_verification_codes
  where email = lower(trim(p_email))
  for update;

  if not found or v_expiry <= now() or v_attempts >= 5 then
    return false;
  end if;

  if v_hash <> p_code_hash then
    update public.email_verification_codes
    set attempts = attempts + 1
    where email = lower(trim(p_email));
    return false;
  end if;

  delete from public.email_verification_codes
  where email = lower(trim(p_email));

  return true;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.twice_issue_email_code(text,text,timestamptz,jsonb)
  from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on function public.twice_consume_email_code(text,text)
  from public, anon, authenticated;

grant execute on function public.twice_issue_email_code(text,text,timestamptz,jsonb)
  to service_role;
grant execute on function public.twice_consume_email_code(text,text)
  to service_role;

commit;

-- Allow common phone-captured image/video formats used by the custom picker.
-- Keep the buckets private; this only widens accepted upload MIME types.
begin;

update storage.buckets
set
  allowed_mime_types = array(
    select distinct allowed.mime
    from unnest(coalesce(allowed_mime_types, array[]::text[]) || array[
      'image/jpeg',
      'image/png',
      'image/webp',
      'image/gif',
      'image/heic',
      'image/heif',
      'image/avif',
      'video/mp4',
      'video/webm',
      'video/quicktime',
      'video/x-m4v',
      'video/3gpp',
      'video/x-matroska'
    ]::text[]) as allowed(mime)
    order by allowed.mime
  ),
  file_size_limit = greatest(coalesce(file_size_limit, 0), 52428800)
where id in ('post-media', 'stories');

commit;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20261021000300_twice_inbox_notifications.sql
==========================================================================================
-- Twice Inbox: creates notifications automatically + turns on realtime.
-- Paste this whole file into Supabase Dashboard > SQL Editor > Run.
-- Safe to run more than once.

-- 1) Columns / allowed types ---------------------------------------------
alter table public.notifications add column if not exists body text;

alter table public.notifications drop constraint if exists notifications_type_check;
alter table public.notifications add constraint notifications_type_check check (
  type = any (array['follow','follow_request','like','comment','reply',
                    'message','story_reaction','story_reply']::text[])
);

create index if not exists notifications_recipient_idx
  on public.notifications (recipient_id, is_read, created_at desc);

-- 2) Trigger functions ----------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.twice_notify_like() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare owner uuid;
begin
  select user_id into owner from public.posts where id = new.post_id;
  if owner is null or owner = new.user_id then return new; end if;
  delete from public.notifications
   where recipient_id = owner and actor_id = new.user_id
     and type = 'like' and post_id = new.post_id;
  insert into public.notifications (recipient_id, actor_id, type, post_id)
  values (owner, new.user_id, 'like', new.post_id);
  return new;
end $$;

create or replace function public.twice_unnotify_like() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  delete from public.notifications
   where actor_id = old.user_id and type = 'like' and post_id = old.post_id;
  return old;
end $$;

create or replace function public.twice_notify_comment() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare owner uuid; parent_author uuid;
begin
  select user_id into owner from public.posts where id = new.post_id;
  if new.parent_id is not null then
    select user_id into parent_author from public.comments where id = new.parent_id;
    if parent_author is not null and parent_author <> new.user_id then
      insert into public.notifications
        (recipient_id, actor_id, type, post_id, comment_id, body)
      values (parent_author, new.user_id, 'reply', new.post_id, new.id, left(new.body, 200));
    end if;
  end if;
  if owner is not null and owner <> new.user_id
     and owner is distinct from parent_author then
    insert into public.notifications
      (recipient_id, actor_id, type, post_id, comment_id, body)
    values (owner, new.user_id, 'comment', new.post_id, new.id, left(new.body, 200));
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;

create or replace function public.twice_notify_follow() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  delete from public.notifications
   where recipient_id = new.following_id and actor_id = new.follower_id
     and type in ('follow','follow_request');
  insert into public.notifications (recipient_id, actor_id, type)
  values (new.following_id, new.follower_id,
          case when new.status = 'pending' then 'follow_request' else 'follow' end);
  return new;
end $$;

create or replace function public.twice_notify_follow_accept() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if old.status = 'pending' and new.status = 'accepted' then
    delete from public.notifications
     where recipient_id = new.following_id and actor_id = new.follower_id
       and type in ('follow','follow_request');
    insert into public.notifications (recipient_id, actor_id, type)
    values (new.following_id, new.follower_id, 'follow');
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;

create or replace function public.twice_unnotify_follow() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  delete from public.notifications
   where recipient_id = old.following_id and actor_id = old.follower_id
     and type in ('follow','follow_request');
  return old;
end $$;

create or replace function public.twice_notify_story_reaction() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare owner uuid;
begin
  select user_id into owner from public.stories where id = new.story_id;
  if owner is null or owner = new.user_id then return new; end if;
  delete from public.notifications
   where recipient_id = owner and actor_id = new.user_id
     and type = 'story_reaction' and story_id = new.story_id;
  insert into public.notifications (recipient_id, actor_id, type, story_id)
  values (owner, new.user_id, 'story_reaction', new.story_id);
  return new;
end $$;

create or replace function public.twice_unnotify_story_reaction() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  delete from public.notifications
   where actor_id = old.user_id and type = 'story_reaction' and story_id = old.story_id;
  return old;
end $$;

create or replace function public.twice_notify_story_reply() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if new.body like 'Replied to your story:%' then
    insert into public.notifications (recipient_id, actor_id, type, body)
    select m.user_id, new.sender_id, 'story_reply',
           left(btrim(substr(new.body, length('Replied to your story:') + 1)), 300)
      from public.conversation_members m
     where m.conversation_id = new.conversation_id
       and m.user_id <> new.sender_id;
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;

-- Trigger functions must not be callable from the API.
revoke all on function public.twice_notify_like(), public.twice_unnotify_like(),
  public.twice_notify_comment(), public.twice_notify_follow(),
  public.twice_notify_follow_accept(), public.twice_unnotify_follow(),
  public.twice_notify_story_reaction(), public.twice_unnotify_story_reaction(),
  public.twice_notify_story_reply()
  from public, anon, authenticated;

-- 3) Triggers -------------------------------------------------------------
drop trigger if exists twice_like_notify on public.post_likes;
create trigger twice_like_notify after insert on public.post_likes
  for each row execute function public.twice_notify_like();
drop trigger if exists twice_like_unnotify on public.post_likes;
create trigger twice_like_unnotify after delete on public.post_likes
  for each row execute function public.twice_unnotify_like();

drop trigger if exists twice_comment_notify on public.comments;
create trigger twice_comment_notify after insert on public.comments
  for each row execute function public.twice_notify_comment();

drop trigger if exists twice_follow_notify on public.follows;
create trigger twice_follow_notify after insert on public.follows
  for each row execute function public.twice_notify_follow();
drop trigger if exists twice_follow_accept_notify on public.follows;
create trigger twice_follow_accept_notify after update on public.follows
  for each row execute function public.twice_notify_follow_accept();
drop trigger if exists twice_follow_unnotify on public.follows;
create trigger twice_follow_unnotify after delete on public.follows
  for each row execute function public.twice_unnotify_follow();

drop trigger if exists twice_story_reaction_notify on public.story_reactions;
create trigger twice_story_reaction_notify after insert on public.story_reactions
  for each row execute function public.twice_notify_story_reaction();
drop trigger if exists twice_story_reaction_unnotify on public.story_reactions;
create trigger twice_story_reaction_unnotify after delete on public.story_reactions
  for each row execute function public.twice_unnotify_story_reaction();

drop trigger if exists twice_story_reply_notify on public.messages;
create trigger twice_story_reply_notify after insert on public.messages
  for each row execute function public.twice_notify_story_reply();

-- 4) Realtime -------------------------------------------------------------
do $$
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_publication where pubname = 'supabase_realtime') then
    create publication supabase_realtime;
  end if;
  if not exists (
    select 1 from pg_publication_tables
     where pubname = 'supabase_realtime'
       and schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'notifications'
  ) then
    alter publication supabase_realtime add table public.notifications;
  end if;
end $$;

-- 5) One-time backfill so your inbox is not empty (marked as already read) -
do $$
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.notifications) then
    insert into public.notifications
      (recipient_id, actor_id, type, post_id, is_read, created_at)
    select p.user_id, l.user_id, 'like', l.post_id, true, l.created_at
      from public.post_likes l join public.posts p on p.id = l.post_id
     where l.user_id <> p.user_id and l.created_at > now() - interval '30 days';

    insert into public.notifications
      (recipient_id, actor_id, type, post_id, comment_id, body, is_read, created_at)
    select p.user_id, c.user_id, 'comment', c.post_id, c.id, left(c.body, 200), true, c.created_at
      from public.comments c join public.posts p on p.id = c.post_id
     where c.parent_id is null and c.user_id <> p.user_id
       and c.created_at > now() - interval '30 days';

    insert into public.notifications
      (recipient_id, actor_id, type, is_read, created_at)
    select f.following_id, f.follower_id,
           case when f.status = 'pending' then 'follow_request' else 'follow' end,
           true, f.created_at
      from public.follows f
     where f.created_at > now() - interval '30 days';

    insert into public.notifications
      (recipient_id, actor_id, type, story_id, is_read, created_at)
    select s.user_id, r.user_id, 'story_reaction', r.story_id, true, r.created_at
      from public.story_reactions r join public.stories s on s.id = r.story_id
     where r.user_id <> s.user_id and r.created_at > now() - interval '30 days';
  end if;
end $$;


==========================================================================================
FILE: supabase/migrations/20261021000400_twice_conversation_creator_read.sql
==========================================================================================
-- Fixes: "new row violates row-level security policy for table conversations"
-- (code 42501) when tapping Message on a profile.
--
-- Cause: the app inserts a conversation and reads the new row back
-- (INSERT ... RETURNING). Reading it requires the SELECT policy, which only
-- allows members -- but the creator is not a member until the next step.
-- Fix: let the creator read the conversation they created.

begin;

drop policy if exists "conversations_read_creator" on public.conversations;
create policy "conversations_read_creator"
on public.conversations for select to authenticated
using (created_by = (select auth.uid()));

commit;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20261021180000_twice_instagram_messaging.sql
==========================================================================================
-- Twice Instagram-style messaging support
-- Run in Supabase SQL Editor (safe to re-run).

-- 1) Helper: count conversations with unread messages for a user
create or replace function public.twice_unread_conversation_count(p_user_id uuid)
returns integer
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select count(*)::integer
  from public.conversation_members cm
  where cm.user_id = p_user_id
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.messages m
      where m.conversation_id = cm.conversation_id
        and m.deleted_at is null
        and m.sender_id <> p_user_id
        and (cm.last_read_at is null or m.created_at > cm.last_read_at)
    );
$$;

grant execute on function public.twice_unread_conversation_count(uuid) to authenticated;

-- 2) Notify the other member(s) when a new message is inserted
create or replace function public.twice_notify_message()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  member record;
  preview text;
begin
  preview := left(coalesce(nullif(trim(new.body), ''), 
    case when new.media_type = 'image' then 'Sent a photo'
         when new.media_type = 'video' then 'Sent a video'
         else 'New message' end), 200);

  for member in
    select user_id
    from public.conversation_members
    where conversation_id = new.conversation_id
      and user_id <> new.sender_id
  loop
    insert into public.notifications (recipient_id, actor_id, type, body, is_read)
    values (member.user_id, new.sender_id, 'message', preview, false);
  end loop;
  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists twice_message_notify on public.messages;
create trigger twice_message_notify
  after insert on public.messages
  for each row execute function public.twice_notify_message();

-- 3) Ensure 'message' is allowed in notifications.type
alter table public.notifications drop constraint if exists notifications_type_check;
alter table public.notifications add constraint notifications_type_check check (
  type = any (array[
    'follow','follow_request','like','comment','reply',
    'message','story_reaction','story_reply'
  ]::text[])
);

-- 4) Index for inbox performance
create index if not exists messages_conversation_created_idx
  on public.messages (conversation_id, created_at desc)
  where deleted_at is null;

create index if not exists conversation_members_user_idx
  on public.conversation_members (user_id, joined_at desc);

-- 5) Realtime for messages (so open threads update live)
do $$
begin
  if not exists (
    select 1 from pg_publication_tables
     where pubname = 'supabase_realtime'
       and schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'messages'
  ) then
    alter publication supabase_realtime add table public.messages;
  end if;
end $$;

-- 6) Allow authenticated users to read messages of conversations they belong to
-- (policies should already exist; this is a safety net)
do $$
begin
  if not exists (
    select 1 from pg_policies
     where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'messages'
       and policyname = 'messages_read_members'
  ) then
    create policy messages_read_members on public.messages
      for select to authenticated
      using (public.is_conversation_member(conversation_id));
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1 from pg_policies
     where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'messages'
       and policyname = 'messages_insert_members'
  ) then
    create policy messages_insert_members on public.messages
      for insert to authenticated
      with check (
        sender_id = auth.uid()
        and public.is_conversation_member(conversation_id)
      );
  end if;
end $$;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20261021190000_twice_message_albums.sql

-- Grouped chat photo attachments; existing message types remain compatible.
create table if not exists public.message_attachments (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  conversation_id uuid not null references public.conversations(id) on delete cascade,
  message_id uuid not null references public.messages(id) on delete cascade,
  sender_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  media_url text not null,
  media_type text not null default 'image'
    check (media_type in ('image', 'video')),
  position integer not null default 0 check (position >= 0),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (message_id, position)
);

create index if not exists message_attachments_message_position_idx
  on public.message_attachments (message_id, position);

create index if not exists message_attachments_conversation_idx
  on public.message_attachments (conversation_id, created_at);

alter table public.message_attachments enable row level security;

drop policy if exists message_attachments_member_read
  on public.message_attachments;
create policy message_attachments_member_read
  on public.message_attachments for select to authenticated
  using (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.conversation_members cm
      where cm.conversation_id = message_attachments.conversation_id
        and cm.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

drop policy if exists message_attachments_sender_insert
  on public.message_attachments;
create policy message_attachments_sender_insert
  on public.message_attachments for insert to authenticated
  with check (
    sender_id = auth.uid()
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.conversation_members cm
      where cm.conversation_id = message_attachments.conversation_id
        and cm.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.messages m
      where m.id = message_attachments.message_id
        and m.conversation_id = message_attachments.conversation_id
        and m.sender_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

grant select, insert on public.message_attachments to authenticated;

do $$
begin
  if not exists (
    select 1 from pg_publication_tables
    where pubname = 'supabase_realtime'
      and schemaname = 'public'
      and tablename = 'message_attachments'
  ) then
    alter publication supabase_realtime
      add table public.message_attachments;
  end if;
end $$;

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:twice/main.dart';

void main() {
  testWidgets('Twice displays email sign-in when not configured', (
    WidgetTester tester,
  ) async {
    await tester.pumpWidget(const TwiceApp());
    await tester.pump();

    expect(find.textContaining('email', skipOffstage: false), findsWidgets);
    expect(find.text('Continue with Google'), findsNothing);
  });
}
